steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對相向折返與側線進入建立互斥進路的真值表。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construct mutually exclusive route truth tables for reversing movements and siding entry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states.

quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Communication delay and stale position” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在無線封包延遲增加時檢查授權有效期，保留停止狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check authority expiry as wireless packet delay grows, retaining a defined stopping state. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Communication delay and stale position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Communication delay and stale position”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量
knowledge.text: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。
knowledge.textEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Communication delay and stale position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3333 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.3325 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3333 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.3325 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3333 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.3325 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3333 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.3325 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.

Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Communication delay and stale position"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Communication delay and stale position” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在無線封包延遲增加時檢查授權有效期，保留停止狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check authority expiry as wireless packet delay grows, retaining a defined stopping state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Communication delay and stale position" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
optionsEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
quiz.explanation: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 折返作業與路徑占用與牽引饋線壓降
stages.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation & Traction feeder voltage drop
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「折返作業與路徑占用」與「牽引饋線壓降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Turnback and route occupation" and "Traction feeder voltage drop": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「折返作業與路徑占用」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turnback and route occupation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 比較一列列車換端與另一列車進入終端時的道岔占用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返作業與路徑占用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Compare switch occupation during one train reversal with a following train entering the terminus. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Turnback and route occupation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「折返作業與路徑占用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Turnback and route occupation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折返作業與路徑占用
knowledge.text: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。
knowledge.textEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「折返作業與路徑占用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turnback and route occupation" is correct?
options: 換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
optionsEn: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
quiz.explanation: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折返作業與路徑占用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Turnback and route occupation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 83.325 s，其餘固定，結果為 143.325 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 83.325 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 143.325 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 83.325 s，其餘固定，結果為 143.325 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 83.325 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 143.325 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「折返作業與路徑占用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Turnback and route occupation", which statement holds?
options: 備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間
只要最大加速度相同乘客感受到的突然性就相同
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s。
optionsEn: Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
Equal peak acceleration guarantees equal abruptness felt by passengers.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「折返作業與路徑占用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Turnback and route occupation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「折返作業與路徑占用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Turnback and route occupation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較一列列車換端與另一列車進入終端時的道岔占用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare switch occupation during one train reversal with a following train entering the terminus.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time.

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引饋線壓降」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction feeder voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 把最遠受電列車與同區段加速列車放入簡化供電模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引饋線壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Place the most distant receiving train and another accelerating train in a simplified supply model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Traction feeder voltage drop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「牽引饋線壓降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Traction feeder voltage drop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 牽引饋線壓降
knowledge.text: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。
knowledge.textEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝
牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。
optionsEn: Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop.
quiz.explanation: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引饋線壓降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction feeder voltage drop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。

Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牽引饋線壓降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Traction feeder voltage drop” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牽引饋線壓降」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Traction feeder voltage drop” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把最遠受電列車與同區段加速列車放入簡化供電模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Place the most distant receiving train and another accelerating train in a simplified supply model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。
knowledge.textEn: A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 聲能相加與分貝與備援電池與可維持時間
stages.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels & Backup battery endurance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「聲能相加與分貝」與「備援電池與可維持時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sound-energy addition and decibels" and "Backup battery endurance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲能相加與分貝」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sound-energy addition and decibels” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 在高架曲線旁區分輪胎滾動、設備與背景聲能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲能相加與分貝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Separate tyre rolling, equipment and background acoustic energy beside an elevated curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sound-energy addition and decibels” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聲能相加與分貝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sound-energy addition and decibels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「聲能相加與分貝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間
optionsEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers.
Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
quiz.explanation: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲能相加與分貝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sound-energy addition and decibels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。

Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲能相加與分貝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sound-energy addition and decibels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。 以聲級校正器檢查儀器前後漂移，記錄頻率加權和平均時間，再測背景聲單獨量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows. Check instrument drift with a sound calibrator before and after measurement, record frequency weighting and averaging time, and measure background separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同聲級與相差十分貝的兩聲源合成，列出背景扣除的適用條件，並解釋聲壓幅與聲能的對數係數差異。 再以本單元 L1 的對照值重算 combined，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Combine equal-level sources and sources ten decibels apart, list the conditions for background subtraction, and explain the different logarithmic factors for pressure amplitude and energy. Also recalculate combined for the alternative L1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.2 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.636 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.22 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 3.9996 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.2 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.636 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.22 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.9996 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

courses.summary: 以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。
courses.summaryEn: Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints.
courses.focus: 高密度都市幹線月台人流與行車協同
courses.focusEn: Dense urban trunk platform flow and train coordination
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 capacity=17647.06 persons/hour；單元 2 得 dwell=24.76042 s；單元 3 得 combined_sigma=0.08534378 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 headway 的擾動測試，結果改為 16042.78 persons/hour；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives capacity=17647.06 persons/hour; unit 2 gives dwell=24.76042 s; unit 3 gives combined_sigma=0.08534378 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing headway in the first unit changes its result to 16042.78 persons/hour. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 已查證背景：1997 年，淡水線開始營運成為臺北捷運早期路線。
教學假設，單元 1：headway=183.6 s/train，計算 capacity=17647.06 persons/hour；非實測性能。
教學假設，單元 2：exchange=245 persons，計算 dwell=24.76042 s；非實測性能。
教學假設，單元 3：stop_sigma=0.0816 m，計算 combined_sigma=0.08534378 m；非實測性能。
教學假設，單元 4：people=428 persons，計算 density=1.222857 persons/m^2；非實測性能。
教學假設，單元 5：reverse=76.5 s，計算 cycle=136.5 s；非實測性能。
factsEn: Verified background: 1997, The Tamsui line opened as an early Taipei Metro route.
Teaching assumption, unit 1: headway=183.6 s/train, calculated capacity=17647.06 persons/hour; not measured performance.
Teaching assumption, unit 2: exchange=245 persons, calculated dwell=24.76042 s; not measured performance.
Teaching assumption, unit 3: stop_sigma=0.0816 m, calculated combined_sigma=0.08534378 m; not measured performance.
Teaching assumption, unit 4: people=428 persons, calculated density=1.222857 persons/m^2; not measured performance.
Teaching assumption, unit 5: reverse=76.5 s, calculated cycle=136.5 s; not measured performance.
timeline: 1997　淡水線開始營運成為臺北捷運早期路線
2013　信義線於十一月通車延伸南北運輸走廊
2025　IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第二部分安全系統方法
timelineEn: 1997 — The Tamsui line opened as an early Taipei Metro route
2013 — The Xinyi line opened in November and extended the north-south corridor
2025 — IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 2 systems approach to safety
codes: IEC 62278-1:2025，鐵道 RAMS 通用程序；方法參考，不等同本案合約要求
IEC 62278-2:2025，鐵道安全系統方法；應另查現地適用規範
codesEn: IEC 62278-1:2025, railway RAMS generic process; methodological reference, not a project contract requirement
IEC 62278-2:2025, systems approach to railway safety; local applicable rules require separate checking

stages.title: 班距與有效運能與車門交換與停站時間
stages.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity & Door exchange and dwell time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「班距與有效運能」與「車門交換與停站時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Headway and usable capacity" and "Door exchange and dwell time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「班距與有效運能」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway and usable capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 讓尖峰轉乘需求與線上可用運能使用相同的時間窗比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距與有效運能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Compare peak interchange demand and usable line capacity over the same time window. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway and usable capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「班距與有效運能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Headway and usable capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 班距與有效運能
knowledge.text: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。
knowledge.textEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway and usable capacity" is correct?
options: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距與有效運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway and usable capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距與有效運能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway and usable capacity", which statement holds?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train。
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway and usable capacity"?
options: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：讓尖峰轉乘需求與線上可用運能使用相同的時間窗比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare peak interchange demand and usable line capacity over the same time window.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。
knowledge.textEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距與有效運能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway and usable capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 把樓梯附近的車門視為獨立服務群，檢查不均勻上車。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Treat doors beside the stairs as a distinct service group and test uneven boarding. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門交換與停站時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door exchange and dwell time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
optionsEn: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 270至 270 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.0625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 270, to 270 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.0625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
