steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway and usable capacity"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
quiz.explanation: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對高密度班表保留逐列負載，避免只看小時平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retain individual train loads in a dense timetable rather than only an hourly average.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。
knowledge.textEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距與有效運能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway and usable capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
optionsEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
quiz.explanation: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力與重複荷載與線性損傷帳
stages.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress & Repeated loading and linear damage account
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」與「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" and "Repeated loading and linear damage account": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 比較曝曬軌段和維修後鎖定軌段的熱應力零點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Compare the thermal-stress reference for exposed track and track after maintenance locking. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力
knowledge.text: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。
knowledge.textEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" is correct?
options: 完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。
疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響
optionsEn: A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression.
Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range.
quiz.explanation: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 34.65 K，其餘固定，結果為 83.67975 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 34.65 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 83.67975 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 34.65 K，其餘固定，結果為 83.67975 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 34.65 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 83.67975 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress", which statement holds?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K。
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.5 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=76.0725 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較曝曬軌段和維修後鎖定軌段的熱應力零點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare the thermal-stress reference for exposed track and track after maintenance locking.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.explanationEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated loading and linear damage account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。此帳務能比較荷載譜，卻忽略順序效應、腐蝕與裂紋成長，損傷和為一不是對任何構件的通用失效保證。 線性累積損傷不保留載重順序，也不能自行描述腐蝕、裂紋閉合和超載效應。疲勞曲線的適用材料與應力定義必須一致，否則算出的壽命比例沒有可比性。 將不同載重循環分組，檢查少量高應力事件的影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. Linear accumulation sums the fraction of life consumed at each level. This accounting compares load spectra but omits sequence effects, corrosion and crack growth; a sum of one is not a universal failure guarantee for every component. Linear cumulative damage does not retain load order and cannot independently describe corrosion, crack closure or overload effects. The fatigue curve must match the material and stress definition; otherwise calculated life fractions are not comparable. Group different loading cycles and inspect the influence of a small number of high-stress events. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated loading and linear damage account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeated loading and linear damage account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳
knowledge.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account
knowledge.text: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。此帳務能比較荷載譜，卻忽略順序效應、腐蝕與裂紋成長，損傷和為一不是對任何構件的通用失效保證。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. Linear accumulation sums the fraction of life consumed at each level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeated loading and linear damage account" is correct?
options: 疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響
頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞
疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。
optionsEn: Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range.
One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged.
Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count.
quiz.explanation: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated loading and linear damage account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1。敏感度：n1 將整數計數增加到 231001至 231001 cycles，其餘固定，結果為 0.431001 1。模型邊界：兩級循環的Miner帳務且壽命輸入已假設；不外推真實剩餘壽命。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1. Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 231001, to 231001 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.431001 1. Model boundary: Two-level Miner accounting with assumed life values; no real residual-life prediction is made. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 231001, to 231001 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.431001 1. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated loading and linear damage account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。 從原始應變檢查應力換算與循環計數，核對各級距的次數總和及疲勞曲線來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Check stress conversion and cycle counting from raw strain, verifying total counts across bins and the source of the fatigue curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持總循環數不變，將部分低應力循環移到高應力級，重算損傷帳並說明需要何種檢測來支持剩餘壽命判讀。 再以本單元 n1 的對照值重算 damage_index，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

steps.instruction: 漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 若應力級距漏計，累積損傷偏低不能證明構件仍完好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bearing signatures and rotational speed" and "Availability and repair time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸承故障頻率與轉速」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滾動軸承幾何決定故障衝擊相對轉速的頻率倍率，教學以已假設倍率乘轉速辨認階次。車速變動時固定頻率譜會展寬，階次追蹤可保留與轉速同步的訊號，但仍需排除輪軌激振。 幾何故障頻率是理想滾動關係，實際滑移會移動頻率或展寬峰值。量測頻譜需和當時轉速一起解讀，不能把固定頻率峰直接指派給某個故障部位。 以軸承頻譜與轉速比對建立狀態監測的頻率基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸承故障頻率與轉速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bearing geometry determines fault-impact orders relative to rotational speed. Multiplying an assumed order by rotation frequency illustrates diagnosis. Variable speed smears fixed-frequency spectra; order tracking retains speed-synchronous signatures but must still distinguish wheel-rail excitation from bearing faults. Geometric defect frequencies assume ideal rolling; slip can shift or broaden peaks. Interpret the measured spectrum together with contemporaneous rotation speed instead of assigning a fixed peak directly to a defect location. Use bearing spectra and rotation speed together to establish condition-monitoring frequency references. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev；計算：signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev; calculation: signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸承故障頻率與轉速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bearing signatures and rotational speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速
knowledge.text: 滾動軸承幾何決定故障衝擊相對轉速的頻率倍率，教學以已假設倍率乘轉速辨認階次。車速變動時固定頻率譜會展寬，階次追蹤可保留與轉速同步的訊號，但仍需排除輪軌激振。
knowledge.textEn: Bearing geometry determines fault-impact orders relative to rotational speed. Multiplying an assumed order by rotation frequency illustrates diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸承故障頻率與轉速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev；計算：signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz。敏感度：rpm 單獨增加百分之十至 693 rev/min，其餘固定，結果為 51.975 Hz。模型邊界：已知故障階次且轉速穩定；不代表某型軸承真實幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev; calculation: signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz. Sensitivity: rpm, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 693 rev/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 51.975 Hz. Model boundary: Assumed fault order and steady rotation; not the geometry of a particular bearing type. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev；計算：signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz。敏感度：rpm 單獨增加百分之十至 693 rev/min，其餘固定，結果為 51.975 Hz。模型邊界：已知故障階次且轉速穩定；不代表某型軸承真實幾何。

Sensitivity: rpm, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 693 rev/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 51.975 Hz. Model boundary: Assumed fault order and steady rotation; not the geometry of a particular bearing type.

steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸承故障頻率與轉速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。 以獨立轉速計核對每段資料，保留頻譜解析度和窗函數，並比較不同轉速的階次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration. Verify each data segment with an independent tachometer, retain spectral resolution and window function, and compare orders across rotation speeds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩種轉速檢查同一峰是否維持固定階次，再加入輪軌接縫頻率，比較哪些特徵能區分故障來源。 再以本單元 rpm 的對照值重算 signature，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use two speeds to test whether a peak maintains constant order, add a rail-joint excitation frequency, and compare features that distinguish the sources. Also recalculate signature for the alternative rpm value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。 以獨立轉速計核對每段資料，保留頻譜解析度和窗函數，並比較不同轉速的階次。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration. Verify each data segment with an independent tachometer, retain spectral resolution and window function, and compare orders across rotation speeds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用兩種轉速檢查同一峰是否維持固定階次，再加入輪軌接縫頻率，比較哪些特徵能區分故障來源。 再以本單元 rpm 的對照值重算 signature，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Use two speeds to test whether a peak maintains constant order, add a rail-joint excitation frequency, and compare features that distinguish the sources. Also recalculate signature for the alternative rpm value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軸承故障頻率與轉速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 速度改變後峰值若不隨階次移動，須檢查其他激振來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. If a peak does not track rotational order as speed changes, inspect other excitation sources. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以軸承頻譜與轉速比對建立狀態監測的頻率基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use bearing spectra and rotation speed together to establish condition-monitoring frequency references.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 速度改變後峰值若不隨階次移動，須檢查其他激振來源。
knowledge.textEn: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. If a peak does not track rotational order as speed changes, inspect other excitation sources.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 將列車故障修復與檢修窗口分開，檢查服務可用性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Separate fault repair from maintenance windows when examining delivered service availability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用度與修復時間
knowledge.text: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and repair time" is correct?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1386 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971223 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1386 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971223 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1386 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971223 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1386 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971223 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將列車故障修復與檢修窗口分開，檢查服務可用性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate fault repair from maintenance windows when examining delivered service availability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 山陽新幹線
courses.summary: 以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。
courses.summaryEn: Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation.
courses.focus: 山岳高速線隧道壓力與橋隧連續性
courses.focusEn: Mountain high speed tunnel pressure and bridge continuity
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 travel=7.794118 s；單元 2 得 density=0.7914385 kg/m^3；單元 3 得 displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 length 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.573529 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives travel=7.794118 s; unit 2 gives density=0.7914385 kg/m^3; unit 3 gives displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing length in the first unit changes its result to 8.573529 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞與高海拔壓力與氣體密度
stages.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel & Altitude pressure and air density
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隧道壓力波傳遞」與「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" and "Altitude pressure and air density": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道壓力波傳遞」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道壓力波傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道壓力波傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞
knowledge.text: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。
knowledge.textEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隧道壓力波傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" is correct?
options: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
optionsEn: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道壓力波傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「隧道壓力波傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tunnel pressure-wave travel", which statement holds?
options: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s。
optionsEn: A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道壓力波傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Altitude pressure and air density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。這同時影響散熱和氣動力，但車廂供氧與醫療需求不能由密度公式單獨決定。 此理想氣體式以絕對壓力和絕對溫度估算空氣密度，壓力不代表氧氣比例。高原環境的密度可影響氣動和冷卻估算，但人員生理與主動加壓系統需要另外分析。 以隧道內外溫度和絕對壓力估算空氣密度，另列壓力波模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. Lower pressure at altitude reduces the mass carried in a fixed air volume, affecting cooling and aerodynamic loads. Cabin oxygen provision and medical needs cannot be determined by density alone. This ideal-gas expression estimates air density from absolute pressure and temperature; pressure is not an oxygen fraction. Altitude-dependent density can affect aerodynamic and cooling estimates, while human physiology and active pressurisation require separate analysis. Estimate air density from tunnel and outside temperature and absolute pressure, separately identifying the pressure-wave model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Altitude pressure and air density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train piston flow and blockage ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車進入受限斷面時排擠空氣，列車截面乘速度提供幾何排量的量級。實際空氣可經車旁間隙、通風井和相鄰隧道分流，因此幾何排量不是某一通風井的實測流量。 列車排開體積的模型首先遵守連續方程，但洩漏、車站開口與可壓縮效應會改變實際流場。應明確使用剩餘通流面積，不能用整個隧道面積忽略車體阻塞。 在隧道橫斷面中分開列車阻塞面積與剩餘通風面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train displaces air in a confined section, and frontal area times speed gives the geometric displacement scale. Air divides through the annular gap, shafts and adjoining tunnels. Geometric displacement therefore does not equal measured flow through a particular ventilation shaft. A displaced-volume model first follows continuity, but leakage, station openings and compressibility alter the actual field. Use the remaining flow area explicitly rather than the whole tunnel area while ignoring train blockage. Separate train blockage area from the remaining ventilation area in a tunnel cross-section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train piston flow and blockage ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：train_area=9.54 m^2; speed=20 m/s；計算：displacement_flow=train_area*speed=190.8 m^3/s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train piston flow and blockage ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：train_area=9.54 m^2; speed=20 m/s；計算：displacement_flow=train_area*speed=190.8 m^3/s。敏感度：train_area 單獨增加百分之十至 10.494 m^2，其餘固定，結果為 209.88 m^3/s。模型邊界：不可壓縮幾何排量；未求壓差、流路分配與空氣壓縮。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: train_area=9.54 m^2; speed=20 m/s; calculation: displacement_flow=train_area*speed=190.8 m^3/s. Sensitivity: train_area, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 10.494 m^2, with all other inputs fixed, gives 209.88 m^3/s. Model boundary: Incompressible geometric displacement; pressure difference, path splitting and compressibility are not solved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以列車位置同步觸發各風井和月台風速量測，檢查流量方向與時間差，避免把瞬時尖峰當成持續換氣能力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trigger shaft and platform air-velocity measurements from train position, inspect direction and delay, and avoid treating a brief peak as continuous ventilation capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train piston flow and blockage ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Train piston flow and blockage ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風井受阻時氣流可能轉移到月台，造成局部強風；單一風速計又可能量到回流區而低估主流。 局部風速尖峰不能當作整段平均流量，須核對截面分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked shaft can redirect flow toward the platform and create local gusts; one anemometer inside a recirculation region may underestimate the main flow. A local velocity peak cannot represent whole-section flow; inspect the cross-sectional distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在隧道橫斷面中分開列車阻塞面積與剩餘通風面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate train blockage area from the remaining ventilation area in a tunnel cross-section.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「延遲與制動距離」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay and braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 把隧道內制動後的位置與避難通道的里程分開標示。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲與制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Mark the post-braking position and emergency-passage chainage separately inside a tunnel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delay and braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「延遲與制動距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delay and braking distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲與制動距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delay and braking distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 81.62 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4962.496 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 81.62 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4962.496 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲與制動距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delay and braking distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
