steps.instruction: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把隧道內制動後的位置與避難通道的里程分開標示。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mark the post-braking position and emergency-passage chainage separately inside a tunnel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「延遲與制動距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Delay and braking distance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.

quiz.explanationEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度與橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
stages.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration & Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" and "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較洞口附近曲線的平衡速度與低速維修列車工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare curve equilibrium speed near a portal with a slow maintenance-train condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cant and unbalanced acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度
knowledge.text: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。
knowledge.textEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" is correct?
options: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。
optionsEn: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration.
quiz.explanation: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.96 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4388004 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69.96 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.4388004 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.96 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4388004 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69.96 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.4388004 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cant and unbalanced acceleration", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cant and unbalanced acceleration"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. quiz.question: 在「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折與集水與排水容量
stages.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink & Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉陷差與軌道坡折」與「集水與排水容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential settlement and track kink" and "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and track kink” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 在路堤、橋台與隧道銜接處設計多點高程剖面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷差與軌道坡折」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Design multipoint elevation profiles across embankment, abutment and tunnel transitions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and track kink” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and track kink”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折
knowledge.text: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。
knowledge.textEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and track kink" is correct?
options: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and track kink” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013992 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6996 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6996 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013992 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6996 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6996 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential settlement and track kink", which statement holds?
options: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m。
optionsEn: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and track kink"?
options: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
optionsEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在路堤、橋台與隧道銜接處設計多點高程剖面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design multipoint elevation profiles across embankment, abutment and tunnel transitions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷差與軌道坡折」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and track kink" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 將洞口雨水與隧道滲水分為兩個入流來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Separate portal runoff and tunnel seepage into two inflow sources. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水與排水容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.332e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.356796 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.332e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.356796 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.332e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.356796 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水與排水容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity"?

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水與排水容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將洞口雨水與隧道滲水分為兩個入流來源。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

knowledge.textEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.

Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause.

stages.title: 接觸線張力波速與煞車熱量與溫升
stages.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed & Brake heat and temperature rise
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接觸線張力波速」與「煞車熱量與溫升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact-wire tension wave speed" and "Brake heat and temperature rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接觸線張力波速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸線張力波速」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-wire tension wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 比較露天和隧道內支承條件改變時的架線動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸線張力波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Compare contact-line dynamics when support conditions change between open track and tunnel. steps.instruction: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。短時平均模型無法描述表面熱點、對流冷卻或熱裂紋，需要把能量分配與熱擴散分開。 有效受熱質量可以小於構件總質量，短時接觸表面的熱量也未必已傳到內部。能量平衡應先界定摩擦分配比例，再評估對流、輻射和間歇冷卻是否可忽略。 在連續減速情境下區分單次熱量與尚未散去的殘熱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「煞車熱量與溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Brake heat and temperature rise" is correct?
options: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。
隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
optionsEn: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths.
A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
quiz.explanation: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「煞車熱量與溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brake heat and temperature rise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.272e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=125.6917 K。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 1.3992e+07 J，其餘固定，結果為 138.2609 K。模型邊界：均勻溫度且無散熱、常數比熱；不推定摩擦材極限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.272e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=125.6917 K. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1.3992e+07 J, with all other inputs fixed, gives 138.2609 K. Model boundary: Uniform temperature without heat loss and with constant heat capacity; no friction-material limit is inferred. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.272e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=125.6917 K. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1.3992e+07 J, with all other inputs fixed, gives 138.2609 K. Model boundary: Uniform temperature without heat loss and with constant heat capacity; no friction-material limit is inferred.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Brake heat and temperature rise", which statement holds?
options: 列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「煞車熱量與溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brake heat and temperature rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 在不同深度保留溫度曲線並核對感測器反應時間，用初末能量平衡檢查平均溫升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「煞車熱量與溫升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Brake heat and temperature rise"?
options: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「煞車熱量與溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brake heat and temperature rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在連續減速情境下區分單次熱量與尚未散去的殘熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish one braking event’s heat from residual heat during repeated deceleration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「煞車熱量與溫升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Brake heat and temperature rise" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。
隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature.
A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
quiz.explanation: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 東北新幹線
courses.summary: 以東北新幹線向日本北部延伸的歷史為背景，設計積雪、低溫與側風並存的教學工況。分析防雪、黏著、道床熱量與輪軌監測之間的取捨，要求每項氣候假設均對應可量測的環境量。
courses.summaryEn: Use the northward development of the Tohoku Shinkansen to frame a teaching scenario combining snow, low temperature and crosswind. Examine tradeoffs among snow management, adhesion, thermal demand and wheel-rail monitoring. Every weather assumption must correspond to a measurable environmental quantity, and a successful single-condition test must be distinguished from validation across a winter operating envelope.
courses.focus: 寒冷地區高速列車降雪側風與偵測
courses.focusEn: Cold region high speed snow crosswind and detection
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 melt_power=13.36 kW；單元 2 得 traction=162 kN；單元 3 得 moment=67.5 kN*m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 snow 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.696 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以東北新幹線向日本北部延伸的歷史為背景，設計積雪、低溫與側風並存的教學工況。分析防雪、黏著、道床熱量與輪軌監測之間的取捨，要求每項氣候假設均對應可量測的環境量。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives melt_power=13.36 kW; unit 2 gives traction=162 kN; unit 3 gives moment=67.5 kN*m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing snow in the first unit changes its result to 14.696 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the northward development of the Tohoku Shinkansen to frame a teaching scenario combining snow, low temperature and crosswind. Examine tradeoffs among snow management, adhesion, thermal demand and wheel-rail monitoring. Every weather assumption must correspond to a measurable environmental quantity, and a successful single-condition test must be distinguished from validation across a winter operating envelope. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 融雪熱量與補給率與黏著限制與可用牽引力
stages.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate & Adhesion limit and usable traction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「融雪熱量與補給率」與「黏著限制與可用牽引力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Snow-melting heat and supply rate" and "Adhesion limit and usable traction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「融雪熱量與補給率」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。積雪落在轉轍器附近會妨礙動作，融化後排水若再凍結也可能重新形成阻塞。 融雪至少要提供冰融化所需潛熱；若初溫低於冰點，還須先加熱到融點。此式僅算宣告的能量項，不能把理想加熱功率直接當成現場融雪產能。 把待融積雪質量與融雪能源分開量測，保留新雪補入量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「融雪熱量與補給率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat. Snow near point mechanisms can obstruct movement, while meltwater that refreezes may create another obstruction even after initial melting succeeds. Melting requires latent heat; snow initially below freezing must first be heated to the melting point. This expression includes only declared energy terms, so ideal heater power cannot be equated directly with field snow-removal capacity. Measure snow mass and melting energy separately while recording newly deposited snow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg；計算：melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg; calculation: melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「融雪熱量與補給率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Snow-melting heat and supply rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 融雪熱量與補給率
knowledge.text: 把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。積雪落在轉轍器附近會妨礙動作，融化後排水若再凍結也可能重新形成阻塞。
knowledge.textEn: Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat. Snow near point mechanisms can obstruct movement, while meltwater that refreezes may create another obstruction even after initial melting succeeds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「融雪熱量與補給率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Snow-melting heat and supply rate" is correct?
options: 只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決
把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved.
Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融雪熱量與補給率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg；計算：melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW。敏感度：snow 單獨增加百分之十至 0.044 kg/s，其餘固定，結果為 14.696 kW。模型邊界：雪初溫為熔點且無環境散熱；僅理論潛熱功率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg; calculation: melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW. Sensitivity: snow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.044 kg/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.696 kW. Model boundary: Snow initially at melting point with no environmental losses; latent-heat power only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg；計算：melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW。敏感度：snow 單獨增加百分之十至 0.044 kg/s，其餘固定，結果為 14.696 kW。模型邊界：雪初溫為熔點且無環境散熱；僅理論潛熱功率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg; calculation: melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW. Sensitivity: snow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.044 kg/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.696 kW. Model boundary: Snow initially at melting point with no environmental losses; latent-heat power only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「融雪熱量與補給率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Snow-melting heat and supply rate", which statement holds?
options: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg。
optionsEn: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg；計算：melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg; calculation: melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融雪熱量與補給率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。 先稱量積雪並量測初溫，核對加熱時間與電量，另記融水、散熱及持續降雪。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage. Weigh the snow and measure its initial temperature, verify heating time and electricity, and separately record meltwater, heat loss and continuing snowfall. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入初始低於冰點的顯熱與散熱兩項需求，重新列出能量收支，並為排水再凍結設計獨立的觀察點。 再以本單元 snow 的對照值重算 melt_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add sensible heating below freezing and environmental losses to the balance, then design an independent observation point for drainage refreezing. Also recalculate melt_power for the alternative snow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。 先稱量積雪並量測初溫，核對加熱時間與電量，另記融水、散熱及持續降雪。
knowledge.textEn: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage. Weigh the snow and measure its initial temperature, verify heating time and electricity, and separately record meltwater, heat loss and continuing snowfall.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加入初始低於冰點的顯熱與散熱兩項需求，重新列出能量收支，並為排水再凍結設計獨立的觀察點。 再以本單元 snow 的對照值重算 melt_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Add sensible heating below freezing and environmental losses to the balance, then design an independent observation point for drainage refreezing. Also recalculate melt_power for the alternative snow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「融雪熱量與補給率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Snow-melting heat and supply rate"?
options: 量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞
optionsEn: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged.
quiz.explanation: 量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融雪熱量與補給率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。 新增降雪和散熱未計入時，融雪速度必然偏向理想值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap. Omitting new snowfall and heat loss biases the melting-rate estimate toward ideal conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把待融積雪質量與融雪能源分開量測，保留新雪補入量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measure snow mass and melting energy separately while recording newly deposited snow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。 新增降雪和散熱未計入時，融雪速度必然偏向理想值。
knowledge.textEn: A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap. Omitting new snowfall and heat loss biases the melting-rate estimate toward ideal conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「融雪熱量與補給率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Snow-melting heat and supply rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion limit and usable traction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 用濕軌與雪後工況比較可用牽引力，保留輪重分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著限制與可用牽引力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Compare traction bounds on wet and post-snow track while retaining wheel-load distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion limit and usable traction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.18 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=162 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.18 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=162 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adhesion limit and usable traction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
