steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gradient resistance and climbing power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在同一坡道比較滿載與輕載的重力功率需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare gravitational power demand for loaded and lightly loaded trains on one gradient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion limit and usable traction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著限制與可用牽引力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion limit and usable traction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adhesion limit and usable traction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力
knowledge.text: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。
knowledge.textEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「黏著限制與可用牽引力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著

Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件與煞車熱量與溫升
stages.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity & Brake heat and temperature rise
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「再生煞車能量與受電條件」與「煞車熱量與溫升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Regenerative energy and receptivity" and "Brake heat and temperature rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regenerative energy and receptivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 把下坡能量回送與電網可接受時段對齊，另列剩餘摩擦熱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「再生煞車能量與受電條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Align downhill regenerative export with receptive intervals and separately record remaining friction heat. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regenerative energy and receptivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Regenerative energy and receptivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件
knowledge.text: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。
knowledge.textEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「再生煞車能量與受電條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。

optionsEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
quiz.explanation: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 266640 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.04479 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 266640 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.04479 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Regenerative energy and receptivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Regenerative energy and receptivity"?

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把下坡能量回送與電網可接受時段對齊，另列剩餘摩擦熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Align downhill regenerative export with receptive intervals and separately record remaining friction heat.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
optionsEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.

quiz.explanationEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「煞車熱量與溫升」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brake heat and temperature rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。短時平均模型無法描述表面熱點、對流冷卻或熱裂紋，需要把能量分配與熱擴散分開。 有效受熱質量可以小於構件總質量，短時接觸表面的熱量也未必已傳到內部。能量平衡應先界定摩擦分配比例，再評估對流、輻射和間歇冷卻是否可忽略。 檢查連續下坡制動造成的累積熱負荷與冷卻間隔。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「煞車熱量與溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. Average temperature rise is allocated energy divided by thermal capacity. A short-duration lumped model cannot describe surface hot spots, cooling or thermal cracks; energy allocation and thermal diffusion are separate questions. The effective heated mass can be smaller than total component mass, and short-duration surface heat may not reach the interior. First define frictional energy allocation, then assess whether convection, radiation and cooling between events can be neglected. Examine cumulative heat loading and cooling intervals during repeated downhill braking. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Brake heat and temperature rise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「煞車熱量與溫升」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Brake heat and temperature rise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 煞車熱量與溫升
knowledge.text: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。短時平均模型無法描述表面熱點、對流冷卻或熱裂紋，需要把能量分配與熱擴散分開。
knowledge.textEn: Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. Average temperature rise is allocated energy divided by thermal capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「煞車熱量與溫升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Brake heat and temperature rise" is correct?
options: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
optionsEn: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「煞車熱量與溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brake heat and temperature rise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 1.3332e+07 J，其餘固定，結果為 131.7391 K。模型邊界：均勻溫度且無散熱、常數比熱；不推定摩擦材極限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1.3332e+07 J, with all other inputs fixed, gives 131.7391 K. Model boundary: Uniform temperature without heat loss and with constant heat capacity; no friction-material limit is inferred. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 1.3332e+07 J，其餘固定，結果為 131.7391 K。模型邊界：均勻溫度且無散熱、常數比熱；不推定摩擦材極限。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1.3332e+07 J, with all other inputs fixed, gives 131.7391 K. Model boundary: Uniform temperature without heat loss and with constant heat capacity; no friction-material limit is inferred.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「煞車熱量與溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brake heat and temperature rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 在不同深度保留溫度曲線並核對感測器反應時間，用初末能量平衡檢查平均溫升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 在不同深度保留溫度曲線並核對感測器反應時間，用初末能量平衡檢查平均溫升。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「煞車熱量與溫升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「煞車熱量與溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brake heat and temperature rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查連續下坡制動造成的累積熱負荷與冷卻間隔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Examine cumulative heat loading and cooling intervals during repeated downhill braking.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度與地震偵測提前量
stages.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration & Seismic detection lead time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「地震偵測提前量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" and "Seismic detection lead time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 在山地曲線比較通過速度與超高過剩的低速情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare running speed with low-speed cant excess on a mountain curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cant and unbalanced acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度
knowledge.text: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。
knowledge.textEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" is correct?
options: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下
曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。
optionsEn: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration.
quiz.explanation: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 66.66 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3260889 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 66.66 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3260889 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 66.66 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3260889 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 66.66 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3260889 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. Check cant sign against curve direction to prevent swapping the inner and outer rails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在山地曲線比較通過速度與超高過剩的低速情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare running speed with low-speed cant excess on a mountain curve.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震偵測提前量」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic detection lead time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。 此處以相同距離比較兩種波速，屬簡化幾何模型。實際感測站可能不在線路與震源之間；可用時間還包括資料品質檢查及保護命令發送，不能只比較波速。 把震源距離和通訊延遲作為獨立變數，辨識預警限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震偵測提前量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time. An alarm therefore cannot make a moving train stop instantaneously, even when the detection itself works correctly. The exercise compares two wave speeds over the same distance and therefore uses simplified geometry. A real sensor may not lie between the source and railway. Available time also includes data-quality checks and protection-command delivery, not only wave propagation. Treat source distance and communication delay as separate variables when identifying warning limits. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic detection lead time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震偵測提前量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seismic detection lead time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震偵測提前量
knowledge.text: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。
knowledge.textEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震偵測提前量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic detection lead time" is correct?
options: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。
地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
optionsEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay.
A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震偵測提前量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seismic detection lead time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 111100 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.22619 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 111100 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.22619 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 111100 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.22619 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。

Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 111100 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.22619 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地震偵測提前量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seismic detection lead time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 以完整訊號重播核對每個時間戳，將總延遲分解成判定、網路與列車端處理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Use full-chain signal replay to verify every timestamp and separate total delay into decision, network and train-side processing components. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將震源距離縮短並把通訊延遲加倍，計算剩餘提前量；與制動時間比較，提出只在模型範圍內成立的結論。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 lead，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shorten source distance and double communication delay, calculate remaining lead time, and compare it with braking time without extending the conclusion beyond the model. Also recalculate lead for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 將震源距離縮短並把通訊延遲加倍，計算剩餘提前量；與制動時間比較，提出只在模型範圍內成立的結論。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 lead，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

Also recalculate lead for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震偵測提前量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seismic detection lead time"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。

Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution.
quiz.explanation: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地震偵測提前量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seismic detection lead time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 感測成功不等於制動成功，須查列車收到命令後的動作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. Successful detection is not successful braking; inspect the train response after command receipt. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把震源距離和通訊延遲作為獨立變數，辨識預警限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treat source distance and communication delay as separate variables when identifying warning limits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度與集水與排水容量
stages.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity & Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」與「集水與排水容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" and "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 量測橋跨與支點位移，避免把支承移動當成梁剛度改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Measure span and support motion to avoid mistaking support displacement for a stiffness change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
knowledge.text: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。
knowledge.textEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 27.775 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.38378 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.775 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.38378 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 27.775 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.38378 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。

Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.775 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.38378 mm. steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測橋跨與支點位移，避免把支承移動當成梁剛度改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measure span and support motion to avoid mistaking support displacement for a stiffness change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 以坡面集水和站口集水不同面積建立入流量比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Compare inflow from a hillside catchment and a station entrance using their different areas. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水與排水容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常

optionsEn: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.222e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.339966 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.222e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.339966 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.222e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.339966 m^3/s.
