knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水與排水容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引饋線壓降」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction feeder voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 在爬坡高電流時估算供電壓降並核對回路定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引饋線壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Estimate voltage drop during high-current climbing and verify the defined electrical loop. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Traction feeder voltage drop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「牽引饋線壓降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Traction feeder voltage drop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常

Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引饋線壓降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction feeder voltage drop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。

Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牽引饋線壓降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Traction feeder voltage drop” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 對設備停機建立修復時間分布，分析單一平均值的限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Build a repair-duration distribution and examine the limits of representing downtime with one mean. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用度與修復時間
knowledge.text: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and repair time" is correct?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。
長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1333.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970087 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1333.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970087 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1333.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970087 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1333.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970087 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「可用度與修復時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Availability and repair time", which statement holds?
options: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h。
optionsEn: Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and repair time"?
options: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對設備停機建立修復時間分布，分析單一平均值的限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Build a repair-duration distribution and examine the limits of representing downtime with one mean.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 法國東南高速鐵路
courses.summary: 以法國東南高速鐵路開創高速服務的歷史為背景，比較高速專用線和既有線銜接時的設計目標。課程將線形、牽引、分相、訊號與維護放在共同時間尺度，檢查一項速度提升是否需要多個子系統共同改變。
courses.summaryEn: Use the introduction of French high-speed service on LGV Sud-Est to compare dedicated high-speed alignment with connections to conventional infrastructure. Place geometry, traction, neutral sections, signalling and maintenance on a common time axis. Investigate whether a speed increase demands coordinated changes in several subsystems rather than a single adjustment to motor output.
courses.focus: 首代法國高速線線形與電氣介面
courses.focusEn: Early French high speed alignment and electrical interfaces
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 residual=0.15156 m/s^2；單元 2 得 climbing=2401.488 kW；單元 3 得 power=2183.966 kW。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 v 的擾動測試，結果改為 0.3481956 m/s^2；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以法國東南高速鐵路開創高速服務的歷史為背景，比較高速專用線和既有線銜接時的設計目標。課程將線形、牽引、分相、訊號與維護放在共同時間尺度，檢查一項速度提升是否需要多個子系統共同改變。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives residual=0.15156 m/s^2; unit 2 gives climbing=2401.488 kW; unit 3 gives power=2183.966 kW. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing v in the first unit changes its result to 0.3481956 m/s^2. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the introduction of French high-speed service on LGV Sud-Est to compare dedicated high-speed alignment with connections to conventional infrastructure. Place geometry, traction, neutral sections, signalling and maintenance on a common time axis. Investigate whether a speed increase demands coordinated changes in several subsystems rather than a single adjustment to motor output. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度與坡度阻力與爬坡功率
stages.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration & Gradient resistance and climbing power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" and "Gradient resistance and climbing power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 用同一曲線比較高速專用服務與低速轉線時的橫向需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare lateral demand on one curve for dedicated high-speed running and slower connecting movements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=61.2 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.15156 m/s^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=61.2 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.15156 m/s^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cant and unbalanced acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度
knowledge.text: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。
knowledge.textEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" is correct?
options: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。
長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
optionsEn: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration.
One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
quiz.explanation: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=61.2 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.15156 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 67.32 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3481956 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=61.2 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.15156 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 67.32 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3481956 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=61.2 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.15156 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 67.32 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3481956 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。

Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 67.32 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3481956 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cant and unbalanced acceleration", which statement holds?
options: 只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差

Original hypothetical exercise.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=61.2 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.15156 m/s^2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cant and unbalanced acceleration"?
options: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響
optionsEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range.
quiz.explanation: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gradient resistance and climbing power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 將坡度阻力與加速功率分開，檢查長坡頂部的速度裕度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. Separate gradient resistance from acceleration power and inspect speed margin near a long climb’s summit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gradient resistance and climbing power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 336600 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2641.637 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 336600 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2641.637 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「空氣阻力與牽引功率」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。 阻力是速度平方關係，而牽引功率還要乘一次速度。把逆風納入時應使用相對空氣速度；滾動阻力與坡度功率是另外的能量途徑，不能被此氣動項取代。 評估空氣阻力的速度三次方功率變化，保留阻力係數假設。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空氣阻力與牽引功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments. Passing trains, tunnels and crosswinds can invalidate the steady open-air approximation even when the nominal speed remains unchanged. Drag varies with squared speed, while traction power introduces another speed factor. Headwind requires relative air speed. Rolling resistance and gradient power are separate energy paths and cannot be replaced by this aerodynamic term. Evaluate cubic aerodynamic power growth while retaining the assumed drag coefficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=71.4 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2183.966 kW。

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=71.4 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2183.966 kW。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 78.54 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 2906.859 kW。模型邊界：定常靜風且阻力面積固定；僅空氣阻力功率，不含輪軌阻力與效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 78.54 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2906.859 kW. Model boundary: Steady still air and constant drag area; aerodynamic power only, excluding rolling resistance and conversion losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。 同步紀錄風向風速與地速，將穩速段牽引功率扣除可辨識的坡度和輔助負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. steps.title: 接觸線張力波速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸線張力波速」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-wire tension wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 把受電弓與接觸線看成互動系統，避免只提高張力求解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸線張力波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Treat pantograph and contact wire as an interacting system rather than solving by tension increase alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact-wire tension wave speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=20400 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.1817 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 22440 N，其餘固定，結果為 142.8286 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=20400 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.1817 m/s. Sensitivity: tension, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22440 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 142.8286 m/s. Model boundary: Uniform tensioned string without bending stiffness; not a current-collection acceptance rule or permitted train speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check compensation travel, wire temperature and tension, then examine contact-force statistics and loss-of-contact events to distinguish acceptable means from abnormal peaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 列車通過無電區時需依靠動能克服阻力，簡化恆阻力模型把阻力做功從初始動能扣除。區段長度、初速與坡度決定剩餘速度，供電切換邏輯和防誤合閘仍需獨立驗證。 無牽引不等於無運動，列車以動能克服所宣告的阻力。若距離超過此阻力下的可滑行距離，平方根將無實數解，表示通過情境不成立而非計算器錯誤。 在分相區設計無牽引滑行的初末速度與時間驗算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無電區惰行與速度損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

No traction does not mean no motion: kinetic energy overcomes the declared resistance. If the section exceeds the available coasting distance, the square root has no real solution, indicating an infeasible passage case rather than a calculator malfunction. Check entry speed, exit speed and coasting time through an unpowered neutral section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coasting through an unpowered section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=50 m/s; force=15300 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg；計算：exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.38421 m/s。敏感度：force 單獨增加百分之十至 16830 N，其餘固定，結果為 49.32221 m/s。模型邊界：水平路線且恆阻力，根號內必須非負；不含低速停車及切換暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=50 m/s; force=15300 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg; calculation: exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.38421 m/s. Sensitivity: force, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 16830 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.32221 m/s. Model boundary: Level track and constant resistance with a nonnegative radicand; stopping within the section and switching transients are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「速度限制轉換與預告距離」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 對高速線轉入低速區的目標速度建立監督距離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度限制轉換與預告距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Construct supervision distance for a transition from high-speed running to a lower target speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離
knowledge.text: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。
knowledge.textEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" is correct?
options: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
optionsEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
quiz.explanation: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=71.4 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2690.738 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 78.54 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3514.255 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=71.4 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2690.738 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 78.54 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3514.255 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=71.4 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2690.738 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 78.54 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3514.255 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed-limit transition and warning distance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成

A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對高速線轉入低速區的目標速度建立監督距離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construct supervision distance for a transition from high-speed running to a lower target speed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。
knowledge.textEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「速度限制轉換與預告距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力與重複荷載與線性損傷帳
stages.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress & Repeated loading and linear damage account
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」與「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" and "Repeated loading and linear damage account": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 比較線形改建前後鎖定軌溫與拘束條件的紀錄要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Compare documentation of stress-free temperature and restraint before and after alignment work. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30.6 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=73.899 MPa。

knowledge.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力
knowledge.text: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。
knowledge.textEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" is correct?
options: 完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。
疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響
optionsEn: A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression.
Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range.
quiz.explanation: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30.6 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=73.899 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 33.66 K，其餘固定，結果為 81.2889 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30.6 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=73.899 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 33.66 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 81.2889 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw free, partial and full restraint boundaries, recalculate expansion or stress, and identify inputs requiring rail-temperature measurements and fastener tests. Also recalculate compression for the alternative deltaT value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objective: 說明「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。此帳務能比較荷載譜，卻忽略順序效應、腐蝕與裂紋成長，損傷和為一不是對任何構件的通用失效保證。 線性累積損傷不保留載重順序，也不能自行描述腐蝕、裂紋閉合和超載效應。疲勞曲線的適用材料與應力定義必須一致，否則算出的壽命比例沒有可比性。 將多年通過列車造成的循環分成應力幅級距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. Linear accumulation sums the fraction of life consumed at each level. This accounting compares load spectra but omits sequence effects, corrosion and crack growth; a sum of one is not a universal failure guarantee for every component. Linear cumulative damage does not retain load order and cannot independently describe corrosion, crack closure or overload effects. The fatigue curve must match the material and stress definition; otherwise calculated life fractions are not comparable. Group repeated train passages into stress-range bins for cumulative-damage discussion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated loading and linear damage account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
