knowledge.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account
knowledge.text: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。此帳務能比較荷載譜，卻忽略順序效應、腐蝕與裂紋成長，損傷和為一不是對任何構件的通用失效保證。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. Linear accumulation sums the fraction of life consumed at each level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeated loading and linear damage account" is correct?
options: 疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響
快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。
optionsEn: Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range.
Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count.
quiz.explanation: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated loading and linear damage account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=204000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.404 1。敏感度：n1 將整數計數增加到 224401至 224401 cycles，其餘固定，結果為 0.424401 1。模型邊界：兩級循環的Miner帳務且壽命輸入已假設；不外推真實剩餘壽命。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=204000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.404 1. Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 224401, to 224401 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.424401 1. Model boundary: Two-level Miner accounting with assumed life values; no real residual-life prediction is made. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=204000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.404 1。敏感度：n1 將整數計數增加到 224401至 224401 cycles，其餘固定，結果為 0.424401 1。模型邊界：兩級循環的Miner帳務且壽命輸入已假設；不外推真實剩餘壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=204000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.404 1. Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 224401, to 224401 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.424401 1. Model boundary: Two-level Miner accounting with assumed life values; no real residual-life prediction is made.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=204000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.404 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=204000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.404 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated loading and linear damage account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。 從原始應變檢查應力換算與循環計數，核對各級距的次數總和及疲勞曲線來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Check stress conversion and cycle counting from raw strain, verifying total counts across bins and the source of the fatigue curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持總循環數不變，將部分低應力循環移到高應力級，重算損傷帳並說明需要何種檢測來支持剩餘壽命判讀。 再以本單元 n1 的對照值重算 damage_index，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep total cycles fixed while moving some cycles to the higher-stress level, recalculate damage, and identify inspections needed to support any remaining-life interpretation. Also recalculate damage_index for the alternative n1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。 從原始應變檢查應力換算與循環計數，核對各級距的次數總和及疲勞曲線來源。
knowledge.textEn: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Check stress conversion and cycle counting from raw strain, verifying total counts across bins and the source of the fatigue curve.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持總循環數不變，將部分低應力循環移到高應力級，重算損傷帳並說明需要何種檢測來支持剩餘壽命判讀。 再以本單元 n1 的對照值重算 damage_index，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Keep total cycles fixed while moving some cycles to the higher-stress level, recalculate damage, and identify inspections needed to support any remaining-life interpretation. Also recalculate damage_index for the alternative n1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeated loading and linear damage account"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。
無電區長度改變不會影響列車離開時的速度
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves.
Changing the length of an unpowered section cannot change exit speed.
quiz.explanation: 以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated loading and linear damage account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 若應力級距漏計，累積損傷偏低不能證明構件仍完好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. Understated damage caused by omitted stress bins is not evidence that the component remains sound. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將多年通過列車造成的循環分成應力幅級距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Group repeated train passages into stress-range bins for cumulative-damage discussion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 若應力級距漏計，累積損傷偏低不能證明構件仍完好。
knowledge.textEn: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. Understated damage caused by omitted stress bins is not evidence that the component remains sound.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repeated loading and linear damage account" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress.

quiz.explanationEn: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 快慢車追及與待避與電流平方損耗與散熱
stages.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up & Current-squared losses and cooling
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快慢車追及與待避」與「電流平方損耗與散熱」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fast-slow train catch-up" and "Current-squared losses and cooling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快慢車追及與待避」如何影響法國東南高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast-slow train catch-up” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Sud-Est”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 在既有線接續處檢查不同停站模式的追趕關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快慢車追及與待避」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Examine catch-up relationships where different stopping patterns join conventional infrastructure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fast-slow train catch-up” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12240 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=612 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12240 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=612 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快慢車追及與待避」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fast-slow train catch-up”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快慢車追及與待避
knowledge.text: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。
knowledge.textEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快慢車追及與待避」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast-slow train catch-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12240 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=612 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13464 m，其餘固定，結果為 673.2 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12240 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=612 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13464 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 673.2 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 導體與接點的焦耳熱與電流平方成正比，短時高電流可能主導熱循環而平均電流看不出來。散熱取決於環境與接觸表面，電氣損耗量不能直接當成最終溫升。 此式是導體焦耳熱，並不是列車全部耗電。電阻會隨溫度改變，而並聯饋電使電流重新分配；比較兩方案時應保持相同功率交付邊界，避免只移轉損失位置。 把高峰電流與線路損失連結，檢查單一饋電路徑的限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電流平方損耗與散熱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joule heating in conductors and joints scales with current squared, so short current peaks can dominate thermal cycling even when mean current looks moderate. Heat rejection depends on environment and contact surfaces; electrical loss alone is not a final temperature prediction. The expression represents conductor Joule heat, not all train consumption. Resistance changes with temperature, and parallel feeding redistributes current. Compare schemes at the same delivered-power boundary to avoid reporting loss relocation as an actual reduction. Link peak current to line losses and inspect the limits of a single feeding path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current-squared losses and cooling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1224 A; resistance=0.025 ohm; calculation: loss=current*current*resistance/1000=37.4544 kW. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1346.4 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 45.31982 kW. Model boundary: Constant resistance with direct or equivalent RMS current; transient cooling is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以均方根電流而非算術平均電流求熱負荷，同步記錄接頭溫度及環境；停電隔離後才由合格人員檢查接點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use RMS rather than arithmetic-mean current for thermal loading, log joint and ambient temperatures, and restrict physical inspection to qualified staff after isolation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 電流平方損耗與散熱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current-squared losses and cooling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電流平方損耗與散熱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current-squared losses and cooling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以均方根電流而非算術平均電流求熱負荷，同步記錄接頭溫度及環境；停電隔離後才由合格人員檢查接點。 由電流時間歷程積分損失，量測導體溫度以校正電阻，並比對兩端功率差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use RMS rather than arithmetic-mean current for thermal loading, log joint and ambient temperatures, and restrict physical inspection to qualified staff after isolation. Integrate losses over the current history, measure conductor temperature to correct resistance, and compare with the difference between terminal powers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較固定電流與同平均值脈衝電流的均方根，計算兩種損耗，寫出溫度監測與電流紀錄需要同步的原因。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 loss，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare constant and pulsed currents with equal means, calculate their RMS losses, and explain why current and temperature records must be time-aligned. Also recalculate loss for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loose joints increase resistance and concentrate heating; a cool one-time thermal image may simply coincide with low load and cannot rule out intermittent overheating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Integrate losses over the current history, measure conductor temperature to correct resistance, and compare with the difference between terminal powers.

knowledge.textEn: Compare constant and pulsed currents with equal means, calculate their RMS losses, and explain why current and temperature records must be time-aligned. Also recalculate loss for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電流平方損耗與散熱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current-squared losses and cooling"?
options: 以均方根電流而非算術平均電流求熱負荷，同步記錄接頭溫度及環境；停電隔離後才由合格人員檢查接點。

quiz.explanationEn: Use RMS rather than arithmetic-mean current for thermal loading, log joint and ambient temperatures, and restrict physical inspection to qualified staff after isolation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電流平方損耗與散熱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current-squared losses and cooling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電流平方損耗與散熱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current-squared losses and cooling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。 尖峰電流不能用平均電流取代，否則平方項損失被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loose joints increase resistance and concentrate heating; a cool one-time thermal image may simply coincide with low load and cannot rule out intermittent overheating. Peak current cannot be replaced by mean current without understating losses from the squared term. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把高峰電流與線路損失連結，檢查單一饋電路徑的限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Link peak current to line losses and inspect the limits of a single feeding path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「用平均電流代入平方損耗公式總能得到正確熱負荷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Squaring average current always gives the correct resistive heat load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。 尖峰電流不能用平均電流取代，否則平方項損失被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Loose joints increase resistance and concentrate heating; a cool one-time thermal image may simply coincide with low load and cannot rule out intermittent overheating. Peak current cannot be replaced by mean current without understating losses from the squared term.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電流平方損耗與散熱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current-squared losses and cooling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Loose joints increase resistance and concentrate heating.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loose joints increase resistance and concentrate heating; a cool one-time thermal image may simply coincide with low load and cannot rule out intermittent overheating. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 法國東歐高速鐵路
courses.summary: 以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。
courses.summaryEn: Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence.
courses.focus: 跨區高速線分期銜接與控制互通
courses.focusEn: Phased high speed connections and control interoperability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 stale_distance=7.725 m；單元 2 得 sigma=1.799212 m；單元 3 得 transition=2768.008 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 latency 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.4975 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives stale_distance=7.725 m; unit 2 gives sigma=1.799212 m; unit 3 gives transition=2768.008 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing latency in the first unit changes its result to 8.4975 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量與里程融合與不確定度
stages.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position & Position fusion and uncertainty
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「里程融合與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Communication delay and stale position" and "Position fusion and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Communication delay and stale position” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在模式轉換前後分別檢查封包年齡與授權到期時刻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Communication delay and stale position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3399 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.4975 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3399 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.4975 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「里程融合與不確定度」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position fusion and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 將定位的不確定區間帶入路段邊界，檢查前端位置定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「里程融合與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Carry position uncertainty into the section boundary and verify the train-front reference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position fusion and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 里程融合與不確定度
knowledge.text: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。
knowledge.textEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「里程融合與不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected.
quiz.explanation: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「里程融合與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position fusion and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.532 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.829748 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.532 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.829748 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「里程融合與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position fusion and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「里程融合與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Position fusion and uncertainty"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。
量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「里程融合與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position fusion and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將定位的不確定區間帶入路段邊界，檢查前端位置定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Carry position uncertainty into the section boundary and verify the train-front reference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「里程融合與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Position fusion and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval.
quiz.explanation: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離與互斥進路與真值驗證
stages.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance & Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速度限制轉換與預告距離」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" and "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度限制轉換與預告距離」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 連結目標速度限制和定位誤差，檢查保護距離是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度限制轉換與預告距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Connect target-speed restrictions and position error when checking protective distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Speed-limit transition and warning distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離
knowledge.text: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。
knowledge.textEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「速度限制轉換與預告距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" is correct?
options: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 79.31 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3607.751 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 79.31 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3607.751 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 79.31 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3607.751 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 79.31 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3607.751 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Speed-limit transition and warning distance", which statement holds?
options: 只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
Original hypothetical exercise.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。
knowledge.textEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed-limit transition and warning distance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低
重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope.
quiz.explanation: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：連結目標速度限制和定位誤差，檢查保護距離是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Connect target-speed restrictions and position error when checking protective distance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。
knowledge.textEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「速度限制轉換與預告距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 為新舊線交會設計進路互斥邏輯與故障狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Design route exclusion logic and fault states for the junction between new and old lines. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證
knowledge.text: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。
knowledge.textEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「互斥進路與真值驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" is correct?
options: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。
無電區長度改變不會影響列車離開時的速度
optionsEn: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes.
Changing the length of an unpowered section cannot change exit speed.
quiz.explanation: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 無電區惰行與速度損失：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「無電區惰行與速度損失」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coasting through an unpowered section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車通過無電區時需依靠動能克服阻力，簡化恆阻力模型把阻力做功從初始動能扣除。區段長度、初速與坡度決定剩餘速度，供電切換邏輯和防誤合閘仍需獨立驗證。 無牽引不等於無運動，列車以動能克服所宣告的阻力。若距離超過此阻力下的可滑行距離，平方根將無實數解，表示通過情境不成立而非計算器錯誤。 在供電邊界比較不同入口速度下的滑行通過時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無電區惰行與速度損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train coasting through an unpowered section uses kinetic energy to overcome resistance. A constant-resistance model subtracts work from initial kinetic energy. Length, entry speed and gradient determine remaining speed, while switching logic and prevention of inappropriate re-energisation require separate verification. No traction does not mean no motion: kinetic energy overcomes the declared resistance. If the section exceeds the available coasting distance, the square root has no real solution, indicating an infeasible passage case rather than a calculator malfunction. Compare coasting passage time across a supply boundary for different entry speeds. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coasting through an unpowered section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=50 m/s; force=15450 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg；計算：exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.37813 m/s。

steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸線張力波速」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-wire tension wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 檢查高速段架線波速與支承變化對受電的限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸線張力波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Inspect contact-wire wave speed and support changes as limits on high-speed collection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact-wire tension wave speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=20600 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.8476 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 22660 N，其餘固定，結果為 143.527 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=20600 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.8476 m/s. Sensitivity: tension, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22660 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 143.527 m/s. Model boundary: Uniform tensioned string without bending stiffness; not a current-collection acceptance rule or permitted train speed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 接觸線張力波速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接觸線張力波速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contact-wire tension wave speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。 核對接觸線張力、單位長度質量及量測位置，並用接觸力和離線事件檢查動態品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check compensation travel, wire temperature and tension, then examine contact-force statistics and loss-of-contact events to distinguish acceptable means from abnormal peaks. Verify contact-wire tension, mass per unit length and measurement location, then examine contact force and loss-of-contact events for dynamic quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將張力降低一成和線密度增加一成分別計算波速，列出尚需哪些接觸力量測才能討論動態受流品質。 再以本單元 tension 的對照值重算 wave_speed，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce tension and increase wire mass density separately by ten percent, calculate wave speed, and identify the contact-force measurements still needed to assess dynamic collection. Also recalculate wave_speed for the alternative tension value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sticking tensioning device lets temperature change tension, while slack droppers change local dynamic stiffness; static wire height alone cannot identify either mechanism. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
