steps.title: 接觸線張力波速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸線張力波速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contact-wire tension wave speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 波速符合估算仍可能離線，需查看接觸力的時間歷程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sticking tensioning device lets temperature change tension, while slack droppers change local dynamic stiffness; static wire height alone cannot identify either mechanism. Agreement in wave-speed estimates does not rule out contact loss; inspect contact-force histories. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查高速段架線波速與支承變化對受電的限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspect contact-wire wave speed and support changes as limits on high-speed collection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 波速符合估算仍可能離線，需查看接觸力的時間歷程。
knowledge.textEn: A sticking tensioning device lets temperature change tension, while slack droppers change local dynamic stiffness; static wire height alone cannot identify either mechanism. Agreement in wave-speed estimates does not rule out contact loss; inspect contact-force histories.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩與空氣阻力與牽引功率
stages.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment & Aerodynamic drag and traction power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「空氣阻力與牽引功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crosswind force and overturning moment" and "Aerodynamic drag and traction power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側風力與翻覆力矩」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crosswind force and overturning moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 將開闊地段側風方向分解為列車橫向作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側風力與翻覆力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Resolve open-country wind direction into the component acting across the train. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crosswind force and overturning moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側風力與翻覆力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crosswind force and overturning moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩
knowledge.text: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側風力與翻覆力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crosswind force and overturning moment" is correct?
options: 側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度
側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height.
Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側風力與翻覆力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 28.325 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 86.64901 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.325 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 86.64901 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 28.325 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 86.64901 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.325 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 86.64901 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側風力與翻覆力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crosswind force and overturning moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verify anemometer height and orientation, retain gust histories, and align vehicle attitude with lateral acceleration on one timeline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側風力與翻覆力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 日平均風速會掩蓋陣風，需檢查量測平均時間與峰值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. Daily mean wind hides gusts; inspect averaging duration and the recorded peaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將開闊地段側風方向分解為列車橫向作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Resolve open-country wind direction into the component acting across the train.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空氣阻力與牽引功率」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。 阻力是速度平方關係，而牽引功率還要乘一次速度。把逆風納入時應使用相對空氣速度；滾動阻力與坡度功率是另外的能量途徑，不能被此氣動項取代。 比較高速與降速工況的氣動功率，說明降速的能源效果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空氣阻力與牽引功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments. Passing trains, tunnels and crosswinds can invalidate the steady open-air approximation even when the nominal speed remains unchanged. Drag varies with squared speed, while traction power introduces another speed factor. Headwind requires relative air speed. Rolling resistance and gradient power are separate energy paths and cannot be replaced by this aerodynamic term. Compare aerodynamic power in fast and restricted operation to explain the energy effect of reduced speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aerodynamic drag and traction power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率
knowledge.text: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。
knowledge.textEn: Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空氣阻力與牽引功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率
高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。
optionsEn: A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed.
Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor.
quiz.explanation: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 79.31 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 2993.196 kW。模型邊界：定常靜風且阻力面積固定；僅空氣阻力功率，不含輪軌阻力與效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 79.31 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2993.196 kW. Model boundary: Steady still air and constant drag area; aerodynamic power only, excluding rolling resistance and conversion losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空氣阻力與牽引功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。 同步紀錄風向風速與地速，將穩速段牽引功率扣除可辨識的坡度和輔助負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. Record wind vector and ground speed together, then remove identifiable gradient and auxiliary loads from steady-running traction power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對速度增加一成與阻力面積減少一成各算一次，對比功率節省，並把輪軌阻力另列以避免誇大整列節能比例。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate a ten percent speed increase and a ten percent drag-area reduction separately, compare power changes, and keep rolling resistance separate from whole-train energy savings. Also recalculate power for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：車底設備改變或側風會改變有效阻力面積；若只以單一速度校準，仍可能在另一速度得到錯誤牽引需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underbody changes and crosswinds alter effective drag area; fitting one speed can still produce a wrong traction requirement at another speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. Record wind vector and ground speed together, then remove identifiable gradient and auxiliary loads from steady-running traction power.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空氣阻力與牽引功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 車底設備改變或側風會改變有效阻力面積；若只以單一速度校準，仍可能在另一速度得到錯誤牽引需求。 需核對風向，避免把順風和逆風的相對速度互換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underbody changes and crosswinds alter effective drag area; fitting one speed can still produce a wrong traction requirement at another speed. Check wind direction to avoid reversing the relative-speed treatment of headwind and tailwind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較高速與降速工況的氣動功率，說明降速的能源效果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare aerodynamic power in fast and restricted operation to explain the energy effect of reduced speed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 空間波長與量測取樣與並聯備援與共同原因
stages.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling & Parallel redundancy and common cause
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空間波長與量測取樣」與「並聯備援與共同原因」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spatial wavelength and sampling" and "Parallel redundancy and common cause": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空間波長與量測取樣」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spatial wavelength and sampling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。 取樣頻率超過訊號最高頻率兩倍是重建的必要起點，仍需要抗混疊濾波及足夠振幅精度。尖峰與非平穩事件的要求不同，應從量測目的回推頻寬與記錄長度。 以模式切換事件時間寬度檢查記錄器的取樣需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空間波長與量測取樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter. A higher sample rate alone cannot correct distance errors caused by wheel slip. Sampling above twice the highest signal frequency is a starting condition for reconstruction, but anti-alias filtering and amplitude accuracy remain necessary. Peaks and nonstationary events have different needs; derive bandwidth and recording duration from the measurement objective. Use mode-transition event duration to check recorder sampling requirements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spatial wavelength and sampling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空間波長與量測取樣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spatial wavelength and sampling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空間波長與量測取樣
knowledge.text: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空間波長與量測取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spatial wavelength and sampling" is correct?
options: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。
量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率

optionsEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength.
The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed.
Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
quiz.explanation: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空間波長與量測取樣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spatial wavelength and sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 56.65 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 56.65 samples/s。模型邊界：單一最短波長的理想Nyquist下界；實務需留濾波與取樣裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 56.65 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 56.65 samples/s. Model boundary: Ideal Nyquist lower bound for one shortest wavelength; practical filters and sampling need additional margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知波長的校驗訊號檢查量測鏈，對照獨立里程基準，並在不同車速下比較空間頻譜是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the chain with a known-wavelength reference, compare an independent distance datum, and inspect whether spatial spectra agree at different vehicle speeds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 56.65 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 56.65 samples/s。模型邊界：單一最短波長的理想Nyquist下界；實務需留濾波與取樣裕度。

Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 56.65 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 56.65 samples/s. Model boundary: Ideal Nyquist lower bound for one shortest wavelength; practical filters and sampling need additional margin.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spatial wavelength and sampling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用已知波長的校驗訊號檢查量測鏈，對照獨立里程基準，並在不同車速下比較空間頻譜是否一致。 用已知頻率訊號測試整條量測鏈，檢查抗混疊濾波器、時鐘誤差與遺漏樣本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the chain with a known-wavelength reference, compare an independent distance datum, and inspect whether spatial spectra agree at different vehicle speeds. Test the complete measurement chain with a known-frequency signal, checking anti-alias filtering, clock error and missing samples. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度提高一成並把最短波長減半，計算取樣率需求，繪出混疊示意後提出抗混疊濾波的頻寬要求。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 nyquist_lower_bound，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed by ten percent and halve the shortest wavelength, calculate sampling needs, illustrate aliasing, and specify the required antialias-filter bandwidth. Also recalculate nyquist_lower_bound for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不足取樣會把短波缺陷偽裝成長波，里程跳動又會改變重採樣位置；兩者需分別診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Undersampling disguises short-wave defects as long waves, while distance jumps alter resampling positions; the two mechanisms require separate diagnosis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空間波長與量測取樣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spatial wavelength and sampling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不足取樣會把短波缺陷偽裝成長波，里程跳動又會改變重採樣位置；兩者需分別診斷。 降低取樣率後出現新低頻峰值，應先查混疊而非機械故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Undersampling disguises short-wave defects as long waves, while distance jumps alter resampling positions; the two mechanisms require separate diagnosis. A new low-frequency peak after downsampling requires checking aliasing before diagnosing a mechanical fault. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以模式切換事件時間寬度檢查記錄器的取樣需求。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並聯備援與共同原因」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel redundancy and common cause” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 辨認通訊與電源共因，避免把兩個設備當作完全獨立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並聯備援與共同原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Identify shared communication and power causes instead of assuming two devices are independent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel redundancy and common cause” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「並聯備援與共同原因」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel redundancy and common cause”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「並聯備援與共同原因」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel redundancy and common cause” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02266 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006798 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02266 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006798 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel redundancy and common cause” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel redundancy and common cause"?
options: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度
optionsEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height.
quiz.explanation: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「並聯備援與共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel redundancy and common cause” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：辨認通訊與電源共因，避免把兩個設備當作完全獨立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identify shared communication and power causes instead of assuming two devices are independent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。
knowledge.textEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「並聯備援與共同原因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel redundancy and common cause" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。
平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
quiz.explanation: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 英國一號高速鐵路
courses.summary: 以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。
courses.summaryEn: Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness.
courses.focus: 跨海高速接線都市隧道與國際轉乘
courses.focusEn: International high speed links urban tunnels and interchange
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 travel=7.647059 s；單元 2 得 displacement_flow=187.2 m^3/s；單元 3 得 combined=72.4554 dB。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 length 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.411765 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives travel=7.647059 s; unit 2 gives displacement_flow=187.2 m^3/s; unit 3 gives combined=72.4554 dB. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing length in the first unit changes its result to 8.411765 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞與列車活塞流量與堵塞比
stages.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel & Train piston flow and blockage ratio
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隧道壓力波傳遞」與「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" and "Train piston flow and blockage ratio": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道壓力波傳遞」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道壓力波傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.647059 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.647059 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道壓力波傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞
knowledge.text: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。
knowledge.textEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隧道壓力波傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" is correct?
options: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。
列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量
optionsEn: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed.
Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft.
quiz.explanation: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道壓力波傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.647059 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2860 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.411765 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.647059 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2860 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.411765 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.647059 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2860 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.411765 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.647059 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2860 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.411765 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.instruction: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train piston flow and blockage ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車進入受限斷面時排擠空氣，列車截面乘速度提供幾何排量的量級。實際空氣可經車旁間隙、通風井和相鄰隧道分流，因此幾何排量不是某一通風井的實測流量。 列車排開體積的模型首先遵守連續方程，但洩漏、車站開口與可壓縮效應會改變實際流場。應明確使用剩餘通流面積，不能用整個隧道面積忽略車體阻塞。 把列車排開體積與有效通風截面連結，檢查短時空氣流量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train displaces air in a confined section, and frontal area times speed gives the geometric displacement scale. Air divides through the annular gap, shafts and adjoining tunnels. Geometric displacement therefore does not equal measured flow through a particular ventilation shaft. A displaced-volume model first follows continuity, but leakage, station openings and compressibility alter the actual field. Use the remaining flow area explicitly rather than the whole tunnel area while ignoring train blockage. Connect displaced train volume to effective ventilation area and inspect transient airflow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train piston flow and blockage ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：train_area=9.36 m^2; speed=20 m/s；計算：displacement_flow=train_area*speed=187.2 m^3/s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲能相加與分貝」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sound-energy addition and decibels” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 將曲線、牽引設備與背景噪音以聲能相加而非分貝相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲能相加與分貝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Combine curve, traction-equipment and background noise by acoustic energy rather than by adding decibels. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sound-energy addition and decibels” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聲能相加與分貝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲能相加與分貝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sound-energy addition and decibels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「到站變異與平均等候」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arrival variability and mean waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 對抵達終端後隨機候車的旅客比較規則與不規則班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「到站變異與平均等候」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Compare regular and irregular headways for passengers who arrive randomly to wait at the terminal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arrival variability and mean waiting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「到站變異與平均等候」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arrival variability and mean waiting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 s，其餘固定，結果為 111.7013 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 111.7013 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 要驗證「到站變異與平均等候」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arrival variability and mean waiting"?
options: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
optionsEn: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
quiz.explanation: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「到站變異與平均等候」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arrival variability and mean waiting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對抵達終端後隨機候車的旅客比較規則與不規則班距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare regular and irregular headways for passengers who arrive randomly to wait at the terminal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「到站變異與平均等候」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arrival variability and mean waiting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。
