steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並聯備援與共同原因」如何影響首爾—釜山高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel redundancy and common cause” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gyeongbu high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 對新舊列車共用的供電與通訊檢查共因失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並聯備援與共同原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Check common-cause failure in power and communication shared by old and new trains. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel redundancy and common cause” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「並聯備援與共同原因」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel redundancy and common cause”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 並聯備援與共同原因
knowledge.text: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。
knowledge.textEn: When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「並聯備援與共同原因」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel redundancy and common cause" is correct?
options: 只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低
兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。
長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
optionsEn: Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities.
One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
quiz.explanation: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「並聯備援與共同原因」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel redundancy and common cause” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02244 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006732 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02244 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006732 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02244 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006732 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02244 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006732 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel redundancy and common cause” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel redundancy and common cause"?
options: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「並聯備援與共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel redundancy and common cause” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對新舊列車共用的供電與通訊檢查共因失效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check common-cause failure in power and communication shared by old and new trains.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。
knowledge.textEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「並聯備援與共同原因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel redundancy and common cause" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。
長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over.
One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
quiz.explanation: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 麥加—麥地那高速鐵路
courses.summary: 以麥加至麥地那高速鐵路為背景，建立高溫、砂塵及集中旅客到達並存的教學案例。學徒把進氣過濾、散熱、供電和月台人流連結，在集中特殊需求下檢查系統瓶頸；所有人數與氣候數值均為自訂算例而非營運資料。
courses.summaryEn: Use the Haramain high-speed corridor to frame a teaching case combining heat, airborne sand and concentrated passenger arrivals. Connect intake filtration, cooling, power supply and platform flow under exceptional demand. All passenger and weather numbers are invented exercises, and students must distinguish a bottleneck revealed by a model from a verified constraint on the actual railway.
courses.focus: 沙漠高速線砂塵熱量與旅客尖峰
courses.focusEn: Desert high speed sand heat and pilgrimage demand
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 deposit=3.55968 kg；單元 2 得 fan_power=1502.083 W；單元 3 得 air_rise=12.81095 K。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 flux 的擾動測試，結果改為 3.915648 kg；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以麥加至麥地那高速鐵路為背景，建立高溫、砂塵及集中旅客到達並存的教學案例。學徒把進氣過濾、散熱、供電和月台人流連結，在集中特殊需求下檢查系統瓶頸；所有人數與氣候數值均為自訂算例而非營運資料。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives deposit=3.55968 kg; unit 2 gives fan_power=1502.083 W; unit 3 gives air_rise=12.81095 K. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing flux in the first unit changes its result to 3.915648 kg. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Haramain high-speed corridor to frame a teaching case combining heat, airborne sand and concentrated passenger arrivals. Connect intake filtration, cooling, power supply and platform flow under exceptional demand. All passenger and weather numbers are invented exercises, and students must distinguish a bottleneck revealed by a model from a verified constraint on the actual railway. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 已查證背景：2018 年，哈拉曼高速鐵路開始商業旅客服務。
教學假設，單元 1：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s)，計算 deposit=3.55968 kg；非實測性能。
教學假設，單元 2：pressure=360.5 Pa，計算 fan_power=1502.083 W；非實測性能。

stages.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期與濾網壓差與通風功率
stages.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval & Filter pressure drop and fan power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「砂塵沉積與清理週期」與「濾網壓差與通風功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dust deposition and cleaning interval" and "Filter pressure drop and fan power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「砂塵沉積與清理週期」如何影響麥加—麥地那高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。清理週期應依累積量與功能影響決定，而不是把全年平均濃度當成每次沙塵事件。 沉積通量乘接收面積與時間得到積砂質量，通量已是單位面積的到達率。它不同於空氣中的濃度；要從濃度推回沉積，還需風速、粒徑及捕集機制。 把地表沉積通量與設備接收面積連結，估算清理週期的積砂質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「砂塵沉積與清理週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time. Wind barriers alter local airflow and deposition location. Cleaning intervals should follow accumulation and functional impact rather than treating annual mean concentration as a description of every dust event. Deposition flux times receiving area and time gives accumulated sand mass. Flux is already an arrival rate per unit area and differs from airborne concentration. Deriving deposition from concentration also requires wind, particle size and a capture mechanism. Relate deposition flux to equipment receiving area and estimate sand mass over a cleaning interval. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s；計算：deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dust deposition and cleaning interval”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期
knowledge.text: 沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。清理週期應依累積量與功能影響決定，而不是把全年平均濃度當成每次沙塵事件。
knowledge.textEn: Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time. Wind barriers alter local airflow and deposition location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「砂塵沉積與清理週期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dust deposition and cleaning interval" is correct?
options: 防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降
沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。
濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好
optionsEn: Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location.
Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time.
Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition.
quiz.explanation: 沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s；計算：deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg。敏感度：flux 單獨增加百分之十至 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s)，其餘固定，結果為 3.915648 kg。模型邊界：固定沉積通量與面積；不含再懸浮、顆粒分徑和風向變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg. Sensitivity: flux, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s), with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.915648 kg. Model boundary: Fixed deposition flux and area; resuspension, particle-size distribution and changing wind direction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s；計算：deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg。敏感度：flux 單獨增加百分之十至 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s)，其餘固定，結果為 3.915648 kg。模型邊界：固定沉積通量與面積；不含再懸浮、顆粒分徑和風向變化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg. Sensitivity: flux, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s), with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.915648 kg. Model boundary: Fixed deposition flux and area; resuspension, particle-size distribution and changing wind direction are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dust deposition and cleaning interval", which statement holds?
options: 完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
用平均電流代入平方損耗公式總能得到正確熱負荷

Squaring average current always gives the correct resistive heat load.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「砂塵沉積與清理週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。 用已知面積收集盤在指定時間稱重，保留風向與取樣位置，並檢查再懸浮和散失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading. Weigh collection trays of known area over a stated interval, retain wind direction and sampling location, and inspect resuspension and losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較同總入砂量的均勻與集中沉積，設計清理頻率表，說明為何要保留風向與設備位置而不能只報總重量。 再以本單元 flux 的對照值重算 deposit，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare uniform and concentrated deposition at equal total input, design a cleaning-interval table, and explain why wind direction and equipment location matter beyond total mass. Also recalculate deposit for the alternative flux value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：防風牆可能把沉積集中到設備附近，清理不到的角落會比平均面積更快受堵；濕砂還可能附著於絕緣表面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wind barrier may concentrate deposits near equipment, inaccessible corners can clog faster than the mean, and wet dust can adhere to insulating surfaces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。 用已知面積收集盤在指定時間稱重，保留風向與取樣位置，並檢查再懸浮和散失。
knowledge.textEn: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading. Weigh collection trays of known area over a stated interval, retain wind direction and sampling location, and inspect resuspension and losses.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較同總入砂量的均勻與集中沉積，設計清理頻率表，說明為何要保留風向與設備位置而不能只報總重量。 再以本單元 flux 的對照值重算 deposit，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare uniform and concentrated deposition at equal total input, design a cleaning-interval table, and explain why wind direction and equipment location matter beyond total mass. Also recalculate deposit for the alternative flux value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「砂塵沉積與清理週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dust deposition and cleaning interval"?
options: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間
optionsEn: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
quiz.explanation: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 防風牆可能把沉積集中到設備附近，清理不到的角落會比平均面積更快受堵；濕砂還可能附著於絕緣表面。 平均沉積通量可能漏掉局部堆砂，須比較不同設備位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wind barrier may concentrate deposits near equipment, inaccessible corners can clog faster than the mean, and wet dust can adhere to insulating surfaces. Mean deposition flux can hide local drifts; compare different equipment locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把地表沉積通量與設備接收面積連結，估算清理週期的積砂質量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Relate deposition flux to equipment receiving area and estimate sand mass over a cleaning interval.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 防風牆可能把沉積集中到設備附近，清理不到的角落會比平均面積更快受堵；濕砂還可能附著於絕緣表面。 平均沉積通量可能漏掉局部堆砂，須比較不同設備位置。
knowledge.textEn: A wind barrier may concentrate deposits near equipment, inaccessible corners can clog faster than the mean, and wet dust can adhere to insulating surfaces. Mean deposition flux can hide local drifts; compare different equipment locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「砂塵沉積與清理週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dust deposition and cleaning interval" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
防風牆可能把沉積集中到設備附近，清理不到的角落會比平均面積更快受堵；濕砂還可能附著於絕緣表面。
濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾網壓差與通風功率」如何影響麥加—麥地那高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter pressure drop and fan power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 風機必須克服風道與濾網壓差才能輸送空氣，輸入功率近似為壓差乘體積流率再除效率。積塵提高阻力但工作點會沿風機曲線改變，因此固定風量假設只是一種受控比較。 風機功率等於壓力差乘體積流率再除以宣告效率，壓力與流量必須使用同一工作點。積塵使阻力和風機工作點共同改變，固定流量算例不能預測未控制風量時的耗電。 比較乾淨與積塵濾材的壓差，將風量保持在可比較範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾網壓差與通風功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency. Dust raises resistance but shifts the operating point on the fan curve, so fixed flow is only a controlled comparison. Fan power equals pressure difference times volume flow divided by the declared efficiency. Pressure and flow must refer to one operating point. Dust changes resistance and the fan operating point together, so a fixed-flow example cannot predict consumption without airflow control. Compare clean and dust-loaded filter pressure drop while holding airflow in a comparable range. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter pressure drop and fan power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W。

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾網壓差與通風功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter pressure drop and fan power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 396.55 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1652.292 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 396.55 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1652.292 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾網壓差與通風功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter pressure drop and fan power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

Separate passenger, equipment and outdoor-air sensible heat when checking peak cooling demand. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20394 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.09204 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20394 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.09204 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Measure inlet and outlet air temperature, airflow and electricity together, separately recording humidity and outdoor-air fraction to confirm consistent sensible boundaries. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Also recalculate air_rise for the alternative heat value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」如何影響麥加—麥地那高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 比較曝曬鋼軌和遮蔭軌段的溫度，不以氣象站讀值直接替代。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Compare exposed and shaded rail temperature without directly substituting a weather-station reading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力
knowledge.text: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30.9 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=74.6235 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 33.99 K，其餘固定，結果為 82.08585 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30.9 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=74.6235 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 33.99 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 82.08585 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出自由、部分拘束與完全拘束三種邊界，重算熱變形或應力，標明哪些輸入必須由鋼軌溫度及扣件試驗取得。 再以本單元 deltaT 的對照值重算 compression，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw free, partial and full restraint boundaries, recalculate expansion or stress, and identify inputs requiring rail-temperature measurements and fastener tests. Also recalculate compression for the alternative deltaT value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較曝曬鋼軌和遮蔭軌段的溫度，不以氣象站讀值直接替代。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度

Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading.

stages.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩與電流平方損耗與散熱
stages.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment & Current-squared losses and cooling
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「電流平方損耗與散熱」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crosswind force and overturning moment" and "Current-squared losses and cooling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側風力與翻覆力矩」如何影響麥加—麥地那高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crosswind force and overturning moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 對砂塵風中的側向風速單獨量測，不以能見度推估風力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側風力與翻覆力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Measure crosswind separately during dusty conditions instead of inferring wind force from visibility. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crosswind force and overturning moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。

steps.instruction: 導體與接點的焦耳熱與電流平方成正比，短時高電流可能主導熱循環而平均電流看不出來。散熱取決於環境與接觸表面，電氣損耗量不能直接當成最終溫升。 此式是導體焦耳熱，並不是列車全部耗電。電阻會隨溫度改變，而並聯饋電使電流重新分配；比較兩方案時應保持相同功率交付邊界，避免只移轉損失位置。 在冷房和牽引同時高負載時估算供電回路的熱損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電流平方損耗與散熱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joule heating in conductors and joints scales with current squared, so short current peaks can dominate thermal cycling even when mean current looks moderate. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1236 A; resistance=0.025 ohm；計算：loss=current*current*resistance/1000=38.1924 kW。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1359.6 A，其餘固定，結果為 46.2128 kW。模型邊界：恆定電阻且直流或等效均方根電流；不含散熱暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1236 A; resistance=0.025 ohm; calculation: loss=current*current*resistance/1000=38.1924 kW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use RMS rather than arithmetic-mean current for thermal loading, log joint and ambient temperatures, and restrict physical inspection to qualified staff after isolation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 以均方根電流而非算術平均電流求熱負荷，同步記錄接頭溫度及環境；停電隔離後才由合格人員檢查接點。 由電流時間歷程積分損失，量測導體溫度以校正電阻，並比對兩端功率差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Also recalculate loss for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 將集中到達旅客分布到候車與流動區域，保留通道淨空。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Distribute concentrated arrivals across waiting and movement zones while preserving clear paths. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arrival variability and mean waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 在均可登車的假設下比較不同班距波動造成的隨機等候。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「到站變異與平均等候」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Compare random waiting caused by headway variability under the assumption that every arrival can board. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arrival variability and mean waiting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=185.4 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=102.4087 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 203.94 s，其餘固定，結果為 110.7961 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=185.4 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=102.4087 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 203.94 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 110.7961 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「到站變異與平均等候」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arrival variability and mean waiting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 從逐列到站時間重建班距平均與標準差，將旅客隨機到達事件重播，核對等候樣本平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold mean headway fixed and halve its standard deviation, recalculate waiting, then use deterministic arrivals to show when the formula assumptions fail. Also recalculate wait for the alternative mean value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time.

knowledge.text: 保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

quiz.explanationEn: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「到站變異與平均等候」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arrival variability and mean waiting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在均可登車的假設下比較不同班距波動造成的隨機等候。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare random waiting caused by headway variability under the assumption that every arrival can board.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「到站變異與平均等候」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arrival variability and mean waiting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求
只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula.
quiz.explanation: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求與周轉時間與車隊需求
stages.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange & Round-trip time and fleet size
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「行李旅客與等效交換需求」與「周轉時間與車隊需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Luggage and effective passenger exchange" and "Round-trip time and fleet size": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「行李旅客與等效交換需求」如何影響麥加—麥地那高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 以行李比例建立等效通道負荷，再與旅客實際人數分列。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行李旅客與等效交換需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes. Door width, level differences and travelling groups also alter passage time. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. Build equivalent passage load from baggage proportions and report it separately from actual headcount. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「行李旅客與等效交換需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Luggage and effective passenger exchange”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求
knowledge.text: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。
knowledge.textEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「行李旅客與等效交換需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Luggage and effective passenger exchange" is correct?
options: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。
機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
optionsEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand.
Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
quiz.explanation: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行李旅客與等效交換需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。敏感度：luggage 將整數計數增加到 69至 69 persons，其餘固定，結果為 210.4 equivalent persons。模型邊界：線性加權的教學需求指標；不是正式容量標準或特定旅客評分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Sensitivity: luggage, increase the integer count to 69, to 69 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 210.4 equivalent persons. Model boundary: Linear teaching demand index; not a formal capacity standard or a rating of individual passengers. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。敏感度：luggage 將整數計數增加到 69至 69 persons，其餘固定，結果為 210.4 equivalent persons。模型邊界：線性加權的教學需求指標；不是正式容量標準或特定旅客評分。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Sensitivity: luggage, increase the integer count to 69, to 69 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 210.4 equivalent persons. Model boundary: Linear teaching demand index; not a formal capacity standard or a rating of individual passengers.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「行李旅客與等效交換需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。 分別計數一般旅客與行李旅客，以實測交換時間或占用面積校準係數，保留用途與區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour. Count ordinary and baggage passengers separately, calibrate the factor against exchange time or occupied area, and retain its purpose and range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較集中行李區與分散行李區的等效需求，提出無障礙與一般旅客都可使用的導引方式，並列出需要實測校準的係數。 再以本單元 luggage 的對照值重算 equivalent_demand，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare concentrated and distributed luggage areas, propose guidance usable by passengers with different access needs, and list coefficients requiring measurement-based calibration. Also recalculate equivalent_demand for the alternative luggage value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李集中在少數車門會使全列停站時間由局部控制；同樣人數但不同分布可能造成完全不同的交換效率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage clustering at a few doors can control whole-train dwell; the same passenger total with a different distribution can have very different exchange efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「行李旅客與等效交換需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Luggage and effective passenger exchange"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
