options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
本單元以坡度定位與車列總重區分模型與觀察，先用合成坡度圖與逐車質量清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Use gradient location and total consist mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以坡度定位與車列總重區分模型與觀察，先用合成坡度圖與逐車質量清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use gradient location and total consist mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡道牽引分力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gradient traction force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡道牽引分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gradient traction force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。這個失效與「坡道牽引分力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查坡度定位與車列總重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force. This failure and a measurement bias in Gradient traction force can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check gradient location and total consist mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用坡度定位與車列總重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。這個失效與「坡道牽引分力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查坡度定位與車列總重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force. This failure and a measurement bias in Gradient traction force can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check gradient location and total consist mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡道牽引分力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gradient traction force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界
忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary.
Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force.
quiz.explanation: 忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 速度與牽引功率與貨列制動距離
stages.titleEn: Speed and tractive power & Freight braking distance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速度與牽引功率」與「貨列制動距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Speed and tractive power" and "Freight braking distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 速度與牽引功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed and tractive power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度與牽引功率」如何影響鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed and tractive power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Betuweroute freight railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一牽引力在較高速度需要更高機械功率，功率限制與黏著限制是不同邊界。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率。使用輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度與牽引功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same tractive force needs more mechanical power at higher speed; power and adhesion limits are different boundaries. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.6 MW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted. Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed and tractive power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300000 N, v=20 m/s；y=F*v/1e6=6 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300000 N, v=20 m/s; y=F*v/1e6=6 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度與牽引功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Speed and tractive power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 速度與牽引功率
knowledge.text: 同一牽引力在較高速度需要更高機械功率，功率限制與黏著限制是不同邊界。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MW。
knowledge.textEn: The same tractive force needs more mechanical power at higher speed; power and adhesion limits are different boundaries. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「速度與牽引功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed and tractive power" is correct?
options: 同一牽引力在較高速度需要更高機械功率，功率限制與黏著限制是不同邊界。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離
optionsEn: The same tractive force needs more mechanical power at higher speed; power and adhesion limits are different boundaries.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance.
quiz.explanation: 同一牽引力在較高速度需要更高機械功率，功率限制與黏著限制是不同邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The same tractive force needs more mechanical power at higher speed; power and adhesion limits are different boundaries. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 速度與牽引功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed and tractive power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度與牽引功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed and tractive power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300000 N, v=20 m/s；y=F*v/1e6=6 MW。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=6.6 MW。模型邊界：輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300000 N, v=20 m/s; y=F*v/1e6=6 MW. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 MW. Boundary: Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用模擬輪周力與同步速度訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300000 N, v=20 m/s；y=F*v/1e6=6 MW。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=6.6 MW。模型邊界：輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300000 N, v=20 m/s; y=F*v/1e6=6 MW. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 MW. Boundary: Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「速度與牽引功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Speed and tractive power", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300000 N, v=20 m/s；y=F*v/1e6=6 MW。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：到達成群時平均庫存可能掩蓋短時壅塞
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring train length produces a theoretical headway below real occupancy.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300000 N, v=20 m/s; y=F*v/1e6=6 MW.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bunched arrivals can hide short congestion behind a moderate average inventory.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300000 N, v=20 m/s；y=F*v/1e6=6 MW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300000 N, v=20 m/s; y=F*v/1e6=6 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 速度與牽引功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed and tractive power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度與牽引功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed and tractive power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用模擬輪周力與同步速度訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「速度與牽引功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using simulated wheel force and synchronous speed signal, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Speed and tractive power. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「速度與牽引功率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界造成偏離的合成觀察，以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Speed and tractive power, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary. Explain which evidence in synchronous wheel-power and speed records distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用模擬輪周力與同步速度訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「速度與牽引功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using simulated wheel force and synchronous speed signal, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Speed and tractive power. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「速度與牽引功率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界造成偏離的合成觀察，以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Speed and tractive power, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary. Explain which evidence in synchronous wheel-power and speed records distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「速度與牽引功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed and tractive power"?

本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風
本單元以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用模擬輪周力與同步速度訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation.
Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用模擬輪周力與同步速度訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 速度與牽引功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed and tractive power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度與牽引功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed and tractive power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界。這個失效與「速度與牽引功率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary. This failure and a measurement bias in Speed and tractive power can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronous wheel-power and speed records rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「速度與牽引功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界。

optionsEn: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanationEn: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 貨列制動距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Freight braking distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「貨列制動距離」如何影響鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freight braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Betuweroute freight railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 制動建立前列車仍前進，反應距離與常減速度制動距離必須相加。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 866.25 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲時等速，其後固定減速度，不含坡度與黏著變化。使用制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貨列制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The train continues moving while braking builds up, so delay distance must be added to constant-deceleration stopping distance. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 866.25 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation. Use brake build-up delay and speed-decay trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Freight braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s；y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s; y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「貨列制動距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Freight braking distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 貨列制動距離
knowledge.text: 制動建立前列車仍前進，反應距離與常減速度制動距離必須相加。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 866.25 m。
knowledge.textEn: The train continues moving while braking builds up, so delay distance must be added to constant-deceleration stopping distance. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「貨列制動距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Freight braking distance" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離
制動建立前列車仍前進，反應距離與常減速度制動距離必須相加。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：裝載偏心會使動態外廓侵入鄰近構造
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance.
The train continues moving while braking builds up, so delay distance must be added to constant-deceleration stopping distance.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Eccentric loading can move the dynamic envelope into nearby structures.
quiz.explanation: 制動建立前列車仍前進，反應距離與常減速度制動距離必須相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The train continues moving while braking builds up, so delay distance must be added to constant-deceleration stopping distance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 貨列制動距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Freight braking distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「貨列制動距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freight braking distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s；y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=866.25 m。模型邊界：延遲時等速，其後固定減速度，不含坡度與黏著變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s; y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=866.25 m. Boundary: Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成制動命令、速度及減速度時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use brake build-up delay and speed-decay trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s；y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=866.25 m。模型邊界：延遲時等速，其後固定減速度，不含坡度與黏著變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s; y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=866.25 m. Boundary: Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s; y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 貨列制動距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Freight braking distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「貨列制動距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Freight braking distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成制動命令、速度及減速度時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「貨列制動距離」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use brake build-up delay and speed-decay trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic brake-command, speed and deceleration traces, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Freight braking distance. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「貨列制動距離」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出延遲時等速，其後固定減速度，不含坡度與黏著變化如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離造成偏離的合成觀察，以制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Freight braking distance, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance. Explain which evidence in brake build-up delay and speed-decay trace distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 貨列制動距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Freight braking distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「貨列制動距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Freight braking distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離。這個失效與「貨列制動距離」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance. This failure and a measurement bias in Freight braking distance can produce similar symptoms. steps.title: 貨物外廓餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cargo clearance margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「貨物外廓餘量」如何影響鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cargo clearance margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Betuweroute freight railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜態貨物高度之外仍須扣除動態擺動與測量不確定度，名義外廓不等於可用空間。本模型把 limit 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 550 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同一垂向基準的標量包絡，不含側向外廓和不確定度餘量。使用貨物掃描與代表性搖擺包絡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；裝載偏心會使動態外廓侵入鄰近構造，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貨物外廓餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic movement and measurement uncertainty consume space beyond static cargo height; a nominal envelope is not usable clearance. In this model, limit is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 550 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Scalar vertical envelopes on one datum, excluding lateral envelopes and uncertainty reserve. Use cargo scans and representative sway envelopes as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Eccentric loading can move the dynamic envelope into nearby structures; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cargo clearance margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：limit=4200 mm, load=4000 mm, sway=70 mm；y=limit-load-sway=130 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: limit=4200 mm, load=4000 mm, sway=70 mm; y=limit-load-sway=130 mm.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring train length produces a theoretical headway below real occupancy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以頭尾通過時刻與解鎖狀態區分模型與觀察，先用合成車頭車尾通過時間戳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「閉塞占用時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use front and rear passing times with release status to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic front and rear passage timestamps, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Block occupation time. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.text: 重算「閉塞占用時間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定速度、已知列車長度及固定解鎖裕量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用造成偏離的合成觀察，以頭尾通過時刻與解鎖狀態說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Block occupation time, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed speed, known train length and fixed release allowance. steps.title: 閉塞占用時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Block occupation time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉塞占用時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Block occupation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用。這個失效與「閉塞占用時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查頭尾通過時刻與解鎖狀態，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring train length produces a theoretical headway below real occupancy. This failure and a measurement bias in Block occupation time can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check front and rear passing times with release status rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用頭尾通過時刻與解鎖狀態作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring train length produces a theoretical headway below real occupancy; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring train length produces a theoretical headway below real occupancy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 滾動阻力能量與港區停留庫存
stages.titleEn: Rolling-resistance energy & Port dwell inventory
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「滾動阻力能量」與「港區停留庫存」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rolling-resistance energy" and "Port dwell inventory": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 滾動阻力能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rolling-resistance energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滾動阻力能量」如何影響鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rolling-resistance energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Betuweroute freight railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阻力作功按距離積分，長距離低阻力仍可形成可觀耗能。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 122.222 kWh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定阻力沿指定距離作功，不含加速或坡度能量。使用牽引能量與里程分段帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用單次瞬時功率代表整段能量會混淆時間與距離，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滾動阻力能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resistance work is integrated over distance, so modest resistance over a long route can consume substantial energy. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 122.222 kWh. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant resistance over a stated distance, excluding acceleration and gradient energy. Use traction-energy accounts divided by route distance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using one instantaneous power value confuses energy with time and distance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rolling-resistance energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=40000 N, L=10000 m；y=F*L/3.6e6=111.111 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=40000 N, L=10000 m; y=F*L/3.6e6=111.111 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用單次瞬時功率代表整段能量會混淆時間與距離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using one instantaneous power value confuses energy with time and distance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滾動阻力能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rolling-resistance energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滾動阻力能量
knowledge.text: 阻力作功按距離積分，長距離低阻力仍可形成可觀耗能。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 122.222 kWh。
knowledge.textEn: Resistance work is integrated over distance, so modest resistance over a long route can consume substantial energy. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用單次瞬時功率代表整段能量會混淆時間與距離 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using one instantaneous power value confuses energy with time and distance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滾動阻力能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rolling-resistance energy" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用單次瞬時功率代表整段能量會混淆時間與距離

本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：到達成群時平均庫存可能掩蓋短時壅塞
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using one instantaneous power value confuses energy with time and distance.
Resistance work is integrated over distance, so modest resistance over a long route can consume substantial energy.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bunched arrivals can hide short congestion behind a moderate average inventory.

steps.title: 滾動阻力能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rolling-resistance energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滾動阻力能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rolling-resistance energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=40000 N, L=10000 m；y=F*L/3.6e6=111.111 kWh。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=122.222 kWh。模型邊界：固定阻力沿指定距離作功，不含加速或坡度能量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=40000 N, L=10000 m; y=F*L/3.6e6=111.111 kWh. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=122.222 kWh. Boundary: Constant resistance over a stated distance, excluding acceleration and gradient energy; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以牽引能量與里程分段帳區分模型與觀察，先用模型牽引力計與里程積分紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use traction-energy accounts divided by route distance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=40000 N, L=10000 m；y=F*L/3.6e6=111.111 kWh。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=122.222 kWh。模型邊界：固定阻力沿指定距離作功，不含加速或坡度能量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Constant resistance over a stated distance, excluding acceleration and gradient energy; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.instruction: 本單元以牽引能量與里程分段帳區分模型與觀察，先用模型牽引力計與里程積分紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「滾動阻力能量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 港區停留庫存：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Port dwell inventory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「港區停留庫存」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Port dwell inventory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 到達成群時平均庫存可能掩蓋短時壅塞。這個失效與「港區停留庫存」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查到達時刻、離開時刻與在場列車數，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bunched arrivals can hide short congestion behind a moderate average inventory. This failure and a measurement bias in Port dwell inventory can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check arrival times, departure times and yard inventory rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用到達時刻、離開時刻與在場列車數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；到達成群時平均庫存可能掩蓋短時壅塞，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bunched arrivals can hide short congestion behind a moderate average inventory; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：到達成群時平均庫存可能掩蓋短時壅塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bunched arrivals can hide short congestion behind a moderate average inventory." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 列車噪音能量比較與隧道換氣量級

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train noise-energy comparison" and "Tunnel ventilation scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車噪音能量比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train noise-energy comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車噪音能量比較」如何影響鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train noise-energy comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Betuweroute freight railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同聲能事件數倍增只改變能量總量，不代表單一列車更吵。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 3.35792 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。各事件聲暴露相同且能量相加，不含不同列車差異。使用相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車噪音能量比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying equal-energy events increases total energy without making an individual train louder. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 3.35792 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equal sound exposure per event with additive energy, excluding differences among trains. Use event sound exposure and count at equal distance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train noise-energy comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=12 events, ref=6 events；y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=12 events, ref=6 events; y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車噪音能量比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Train noise-energy comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列車噪音能量比較
knowledge.text: 同聲能事件數倍增只改變能量總量，不代表單一列車更吵。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 3.35792 dB。

steps.title: 列車噪音能量比較：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車噪音能量比較」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train noise-energy comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=12 events, ref=6 events；y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB。只把 n 增加一個整數單位，y=3.35792 dB。模型邊界：各事件聲暴露相同且能量相加，不含不同列車差異；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=12 events, ref=6 events; y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB. Increasing only n with an increase of one whole unit gives y=3.35792 dB. Boundary: Equal sound exposure per event with additive energy, excluding differences among trains; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數區分模型與觀察，先用固定位置聲暴露計與事件計數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use event sound exposure and count at equal distance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=12 events, ref=6 events；y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB。只把 n 增加一個整數單位，y=3.35792 dB。模型邊界：各事件聲暴露相同且能量相加，不含不同列車差異；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.instruction: 將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音。這個失效與「列車噪音能量比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy. This failure and a measurement bias in Train noise-energy comparison can produce similar symptoms. steps.instruction: 平均流速乘有效斷面給出體積流量，列車活塞作用與局部回流需另列。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 85.8 m3/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效斷面上的均勻平均風速，不含暫態活塞效應。使用多點風速與有效斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道換氣量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean velocity times effective area gives volume flow, while piston action and local recirculation need separate treatment. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects. Use multi-point air velocity and effective area as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel ventilation scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 隧道換氣量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tunnel ventilation scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道換氣量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel ventilation scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以多點風速與有效斷面區分模型與觀察，先用多點風速計與斷面量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「隧道換氣量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multi-point air velocity and effective area to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using multi-point anemometers and section measurements, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Tunnel ventilation scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「隧道換氣量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出有效斷面上的均勻平均風速，不含暫態活塞效應如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風造成偏離的合成觀察，以多點風速與有效斷面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Tunnel ventilation scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. Explain which evidence in multi-point air velocity and effective area distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以多點風速與有效斷面區分模型與觀察，先用多點風速計與斷面量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「隧道換氣量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use multi-point air velocity and effective area to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using multi-point anemometers and section measurements, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Tunnel ventilation scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「隧道換氣量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出有效斷面上的均勻平均風速，不含暫態活塞效應如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風造成偏離的合成觀察，以多點風速與有效斷面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Tunnel ventilation scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. Explain which evidence in multi-point air velocity and effective area distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隧道換氣量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tunnel ventilation scale"?
options: 本單元以多點風速與有效斷面區分模型與觀察，先用多點風速計與斷面量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用單次瞬時功率代表整段能量會混淆時間與距離
optionsEn: Use multi-point air velocity and effective area to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using one instantaneous power value confuses energy with time and distance.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以多點風速與有效斷面區分模型與觀察，先用多點風速計與斷面量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multi-point air velocity and effective area to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隧道換氣量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tunnel ventilation scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道換氣量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel ventilation scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風。這個失效與「隧道換氣量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多點風速與有效斷面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. This failure and a measurement bias in Tunnel ventilation scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check multi-point air velocity and effective area rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用多點風速與有效斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風。這個失效與「隧道換氣量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多點風速與有效斷面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. This failure and a measurement bias in Tunnel ventilation scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check multi-point air velocity and effective area rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隧道換氣量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tunnel ventilation scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow.
quiz.explanation: 只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計
courses.titleEn: Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail
courses.summary: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計以「平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路線設計先建立平面與高程共同里程，再檢查曲率、坡度和變化率；地形可行的中心線仍可能因高速動態需求而需要更長緩和段。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Alignment design uses a shared chainage for plan and elevation before checking curvature, gradient and their rates; a terrain-feasible centreline may still require longer transitions for high-speed dynamics. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性
courses.focusEn: Alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.21 m/s2。模型邊界：等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：L=20 m, R=5000 m；y=L**2/(8*R)*1000=10 mm。只把 L 增加百分之十，y=12.1 mm。模型邊界：弦長遠小於半徑的小弦近似；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.21 m/s2. Boundary: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: L=20 m, R=5000 m; y=L**2/(8*R)*1000=10 mm. Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.1 mm. Boundary: Short-chord approximation with chord length much smaller than radius; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 圓曲線向心加速與曲線外矢估算
stages.titleEn: Circular-curve acceleration & Curve versine estimate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圓曲線向心加速」與「曲線外矢估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circular-curve acceleration" and "Curve versine estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圓曲線向心加速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circular-curve acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「圓曲線向心加速」如何影響高速鐵路路線平縱面設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circular-curve acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 向心加速度隨速度平方增加並隨半徑增加而降低。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.21 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償。使用同里程速度及曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「圓曲線向心加速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Centripetal acceleration increases with speed squared and decreases with radius. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.21 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation. Use speed and curvature at matching chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circular-curve acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 小弦長近似下外矢與弦長平方成正比，弦長改變時不能直接比較讀值。本模型把 L 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.1 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。弦長遠小於半徑的小弦近似。使用已知弦長的中點偏距作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把不同弦長外矢當同一幾何量會誤判曲率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線外矢估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a short chord the versine scales with chord length squared; different chord lengths cannot be compared directly. In this model, L is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 12.1 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Short-chord approximation with chord length much smaller than radius. Use midpoint offset for a known chord length as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Comparing versines from different chords misidentifies curvature; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curve versine estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 把不同弦長外矢當同一幾何量會誤判曲率。這個失效與「曲線外矢估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知弦長的中點偏距，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing versines from different chords misidentifies curvature. This failure and a measurement bias in Curve versine estimate can produce similar symptoms. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.title: 緩和曲線曲率率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transition curvature rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 克羅梭曲線讓曲率沿里程線性增長，並不代表橫向加速度在變速時仍線性。本模型把 R 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 6.31313e-07 1/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。曲率沿緩和長度線性變化。使用曲率對里程的斜率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；緩和段縮短會提高曲率變化率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「緩和曲線曲率率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A clothoid increases curvature linearly with distance, but lateral acceleration need not remain linear when speed changes. In this model, R is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 6.31313e-07 1/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Curvature varies linearly along transition length. Use curvature slope against chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Shortening the transition increases curvature rate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transition curvature rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元以固定速率曲率變化與橫向加速度區分模型與觀察，先用合成橫向加速度序列與時間基準建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「橫向加加速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 橫向加加速度：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 只檢查圓曲線半徑會漏掉進出曲線的不平順。這個失效與「橫向加加速度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查固定速率曲率變化與橫向加速度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking circular radius alone misses transition discomfort. This failure and a measurement bias in Lateral jerk estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check curvature change and lateral acceleration at steady speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用固定速率曲率變化與橫向加速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只檢查圓曲線半徑會漏掉進出曲線的不平順，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.title: 縱坡高程增量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical grade rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小坡度以高差除水平距離定義，應與沿軌距離使用方式一致。本模型把 s 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 23.76 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定小坡度且長度為水平距離。使用起終點高程與水平里程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用百分率與小數坡度會產生百倍誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「縱坡高程增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small gradients use rise over horizontal distance and require consistent distance conventions. In this model, s is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 23.76 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant small gradient with horizontal distance. steps.title: 豎曲線加速度：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical-curve acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=75 m/s, R=20000 m；y=v**2/R=0.28125 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.340313 m/s2。模型邊界：等速圓形豎曲線，只計幾何加速度幅值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=75 m/s, R=20000 m; y=v**2/R=0.28125 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.340313 m/s2. Boundary: Constant-speed circular vertical curve; geometric acceleration magnitude only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以車速、豎曲率與垂向反應區分模型與觀察，先用合成垂向加速度計與豎曲率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed, vertical curvature and vertical response to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vertical-curve acceleration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以車速、豎曲率與垂向反應區分模型與觀察，先用合成垂向加速度計與豎曲率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「豎曲線加速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed, vertical curvature and vertical response to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「豎曲線加速度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等速圓形豎曲線，只計幾何加速度幅值如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由曲線正負號錯誤會顛倒輪重增加或減少造成偏離的合成觀察，以車速、豎曲率與垂向反應說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Vertical-curve acceleration, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Constant-speed circular vertical curve; geometric acceleration magnitude only. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A curvature sign error reverses the inferred wheel-load trend. steps.failure: 注意干擾：曲線正負號錯誤會顛倒輪重增加或減少。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A curvature sign error reverses the inferred wheel-load trend. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
