steps.title: 板端偏轉估算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slab yaw from endpoint offsets: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「板端偏轉估算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab yaw from endpoint offsets” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以前後測點橫向差區分模型與觀察，先用板前後棱鏡橫向座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「板端偏轉估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use lateral difference between front and rear targets to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using lateral coordinates of front and rear slab prisms, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Slab yaw from endpoint offsets. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「板端偏轉估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出小角度剛體偏轉，不含板體彎曲如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化造成偏離的合成觀察，以前後測點橫向差說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Slab yaw from endpoint offsets, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Small-angle rigid yaw excluding slab bending. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other. Explain which evidence in lateral difference between front and rear targets distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 板端偏轉估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slab yaw from endpoint offsets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「板端偏轉估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab yaw from endpoint offsets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化。這個失效與「板端偏轉估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查前後測點橫向差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other. This failure and a measurement bias in Slab yaw from endpoint offsets can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check lateral difference between front and rear targets rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用前後測點橫向差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 板體俯仰估算與調整螺距位移

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「板體俯仰估算」與「調整螺距位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slab pitch estimate" and "Adjustment screw displacement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 板體俯仰估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slab pitch estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「板體俯仰估算」如何影響預鑄軌道板精調的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab pitch estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Precision alignment of precast track slabs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 縱向高差形成俯仰，應先扣除設計縱坡再判斷誤差。本模型把 dz 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.33 mrad。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已扣設計縱坡的小角度俯仰。使用設計高程與實測高程差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把設計坡度當板體誤差會破壞路線縱面，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「板體俯仰估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Longitudinal level difference produces pitch; subtract the design gradient before identifying error. In this model, dz is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.33 mrad. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-angle pitch after subtracting design gradient. Use differences between design and measured levels as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating design gradient as slab error damages the vertical alignment; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slab pitch estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=1.5 mm, L=5 m；y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=1.5 mm, L=5 m; y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把設計坡度當板體誤差會破壞路線縱面」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating design gradient as slab error damages the vertical alignment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「板體俯仰估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slab pitch estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability.

steps.title: 調整螺距位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adjustment screw displacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調整螺距位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adjustment screw displacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：pitch=2 mm/turn, turn=0.35 turn；y=pitch*turn=0.7 mm。只把 pitch 增加百分之十，y=0.77 mm。模型邊界：理想螺距且無間隙或受力回彈；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: pitch=2 mm/turn, turn=0.35 turn; y=pitch*turn=0.7 mm. Increasing only pitch with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.77 mm. Boundary: Ideal thread pitch without backlash or elastic recovery; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以單向逼近與回程差區分模型與觀察，先用螺桿角度標記與位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use one-direction approach and reverse-travel difference to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adjustment screw displacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以單向逼近與回程差區分模型與觀察，先用螺桿角度標記與位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「調整螺距位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use one-direction approach and reverse-travel difference to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using screw-angle marks and displacement gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adjustment screw displacement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「調整螺距位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出理想螺距且無間隙或受力回彈如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩造成偏離的合成觀察，以單向逼近與回程差說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Adjustment screw displacement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Ideal thread pitch without backlash or elastic recovery. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability. Explain which evidence in one-direction approach and reverse-travel difference distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 調整螺距位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adjustment screw displacement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調整螺距位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adjustment screw displacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩。這個失效與「調整螺距位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查單向逼近與回程差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability. This failure and a measurement bias in Adjustment screw displacement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check one-direction approach and reverse-travel difference rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用單向逼近與回程差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 測站角度投影：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Station angle projection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測站角度投影」如何影響預鑄軌道板精調的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Station angle projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Precision alignment of precast track slabs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 角度誤差沿視距放大成橫向誤差，長視距不一定更精確。本模型把 R 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.88 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小角度橫向投影，不含距離誤差。使用視距與重複角度觀測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略視距放大會低估遠端點誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測站角度投影」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Angular error grows into transverse error with sight distance, so a longer sight is not necessarily more precise. In this model, R is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.88 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-angle transverse projection excluding range error. Use sight distance and repeated angular observations as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring distance amplification understates far-target error; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Station angle projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：R=40 m, theta=0.00002 rad；y=R*theta*1000=0.8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: R=40 m, theta=0.00002 rad; y=R*theta*1000=0.8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略視距放大會低估遠端點誤差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring distance amplification understates far-target error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測站角度投影」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Prism-constant bias” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：measured=30 m, bias=2 mm；y=measured*1000-bias=29998 mm。只把 measured 增加百分之十，y=32998 mm。模型邊界：單一固定量距偏差，符號按校正定義；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: measured=30 m, bias=2 mm; y=measured*1000-bias=29998 mm. Increasing only measured with a ten-percent increase gives y=32998 mm. Boundary: One fixed range bias with sign defined by calibration; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以不同棱鏡互換與基線區分模型與觀察，先用基線量測與棱鏡互換建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use prism interchange and a reference baseline to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 棱鏡常數偏差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prism-constant bias: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「棱鏡常數偏差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prism-constant bias” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以不同棱鏡互換與基線區分模型與觀察，先用基線量測與棱鏡互換建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「棱鏡常數偏差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use prism interchange and a reference baseline to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using baseline measurement and prism interchange, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Prism-constant bias. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「棱鏡常數偏差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一固定量距偏差，符號按校正定義如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由錯誤常數會平移整批量測造成偏離的合成觀察，以不同棱鏡互換與基線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Prism-constant bias, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One fixed range bias with sign defined by calibration. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch. Explain which evidence in prism interchange and a reference baseline distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯誤常數會平移整批量測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 棱鏡常數偏差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prism-constant bias: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「棱鏡常數偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prism-constant bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯誤常數會平移整批量測。這個失效與「棱鏡常數偏差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查不同棱鏡互換與基線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch. This failure and a measurement bias in Prism-constant bias can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check prism interchange and a reference baseline rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用不同棱鏡互換與基線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；錯誤常數會平移整批量測，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：錯誤常數會平移整批量測」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錯誤常數會平移整批量測。這個失效與「棱鏡常數偏差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查不同棱鏡互換與基線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「棱鏡常數偏差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接分配粗差會把錯誤散布到全部控制點

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distributing a blunder spreads error across all control points.

stages.title: 水準閉合分配與三點高程平均
stages.titleEn: Levelling closure allocation & Three-point elevation mean
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水準閉合分配」與「三點高程平均」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Levelling closure allocation" and "Three-point elevation mean": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水準閉合分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Levelling closure allocation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水準閉合分配」如何影響預鑄軌道板精調的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Levelling closure allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Precision alignment of precast track slabs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 按長度分配閉合差只是一種模型，需先排除粗差再調整。本模型把 closure 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.66 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已排除粗差後按路線長度分配。使用往返高差及分段長度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直接分配粗差會把錯誤散布到全部控制點，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水準閉合分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Allocating closure by length is one adjustment model; blunders must be excluded first. In this model, closure is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.66 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Length-weighted allocation after excluding blunders. Use forward-back level differences and segment lengths as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Distributing a blunder spreads error across all control points; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Levelling closure allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：closure=2.4 mm, length=200 m, total=800 m；y=closure*length/total=0.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: closure=2.4 mm, length=200 m, total=800 m; y=closure*length/total=0.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接分配粗差會把錯誤散布到全部控制點」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distributing a blunder spreads error across all control points." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水準閉合分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Levelling closure allocation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sigma=1.2 mm, n=9 count；y=sigma/sqrt(n)=0.4 mm。只把 sigma 增加百分之十，y=0.44 mm。模型邊界：獨立同分布隨機誤差，無自相關；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Increasing only sigma with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.44 mm. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated-survey mean uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以不同測站而非同站重讀區分模型與觀察，先用不同測站重測結果建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「重測平均不確定度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent stations rather than repeated display readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using repeat observations from independent stations, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Repeated-survey mean uncertainty. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「重測平均不確定度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出獨立同分布隨機誤差，無自相關如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度造成偏離的合成觀察，以不同測站而非同站重讀說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Repeated-survey mean uncertainty, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Independent identically distributed random errors without autocorrelation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision. Explain which evidence in independent stations rather than repeated display readings distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 重測平均不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated-survey mean uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重測平均不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated-survey mean uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度。這個失效與「重測平均不確定度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查不同測站而非同站重讀，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision. This failure and a measurement bias in Repeated-survey mean uncertainty can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check independent stations rather than repeated display readings rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用不同測站而非同站重讀作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

courses.title: 長焊鋼軌應力放散
courses.titleEn: Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail
courses.summary: 長焊鋼軌應力放散以「連續焊軌中性溫度約束與位移證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。連續鋼軌的熱伸縮被扣件與道床約束，軌溫與應力自由溫度的差才是熱力判斷的起點；軌道橫向阻力及初始不整也影響穩定性。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops neutral temperature restraint and displacement evidence in welded rail through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Fastenings and ballast restrain thermal rail movement; the difference between rail temperature and stress-free temperature starts the force assessment, while lateral resistance and initial misalignment also govern stability. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 連續焊軌中性溫度約束與位移證據
courses.focusEn: Neutral temperature restraint and displacement evidence in welded rail
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K；y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=66.4125 MPa。模型邊界：線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K; y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=66.4125 MPa. Boundary: A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.

stages.title: 自由鋼軌伸長與全約束熱應力
stages.titleEn: Free rail expansion & Fully restrained thermal stress
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由鋼軌伸長」與「全約束熱應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free rail expansion" and "Fully restrained thermal stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由鋼軌伸長」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free rail expansion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 25.3 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度。使用軌溫和端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由鋼軌伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 25.3 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted. Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free rail expansion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由鋼軌伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free rail expansion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由鋼軌伸長
knowledge.text: 無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 25.3 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由鋼軌伸長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free rail expansion" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設
無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior.
Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate.
quiz.explanation: 無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由鋼軌伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free rail expansion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free rail expansion", which statement holds?

quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由鋼軌伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free rail expansion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「自由鋼軌伸長」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model-bar endpoint displacement gauges, gauge length and distributed temperature records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Free rail expansion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「自由鋼軌伸長」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設造成偏離的合成觀察，以軌溫和端部位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Free rail expansion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. Explain which evidence in rail temperature and endpoint displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「自由鋼軌伸長」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model-bar endpoint displacement gauges, gauge length and distributed temperature records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Free rail expansion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「自由鋼軌伸長」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設造成偏離的合成觀察，以軌溫和端部位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. Explain which evidence in rail temperature and endpoint displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由鋼軌伸長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free rail expansion"?
options: 本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均溫度正常仍可能有差異熱彎曲
optionsEn: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean temperature can coexist with differential thermal bending.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由鋼軌伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free rail expansion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設。這個失效與「自由鋼軌伸長」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查軌溫和端部位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. This failure and a measurement bias in Free rail expansion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail temperature and endpoint displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用軌溫和端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.instruction: 完全約束下軸向熱應變轉成應力。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 66.4125 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸。使用軌溫與可追溯應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「全約束熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 熱軸力換算：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「熱軸力換算」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 軸力等於平均應力乘有效斷面，左右兩軌須分別核對。本模型把 sigma 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 501.6 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。應力沿有效斷面均勻；只算單根鋼軌的軸力。使用斷面損耗與軸向應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；磨耗斷面仍沿用新軌面積會誤算軸力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱軸力換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial force equals mean stress times effective area, with each rail checked separately. In this model, sigma is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 501.6 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Stress is uniform over the effective section; force is for one rail only. Use section loss and axial strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using new-rail area for worn rail miscalculates force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal axial-force conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal axial-force conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sigma=60 MPa, A=7600 mm2；y=sigma*A/1000=456 kN。只把 sigma 增加百分之十，y=501.6 kN。模型邊界：應力沿有效斷面均勻；只算單根鋼軌的軸力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: sigma=60 MPa, A=7600 mm2; y=sigma*A/1000=456 kN. Increasing only sigma with a ten-percent increase gives y=501.6 kN. Boundary: Stress is uniform over the effective section; force is for one rail only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 溫度誤差經彈性係數直接傳到熱應力估計。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 5.313 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。只傳播軌溫誤差；彈性係數、熱膨脹係數及約束皆視為已知。使用兩種接觸式溫度量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軌溫量測誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature error propagates through stiffness into thermal-stress estimation. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail-temperature error propagation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性。這個失效與「軌溫量測誤差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩種接觸式溫度量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative. This failure and a measurement bias in Rail-temperature error propagation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check two contact-temperature measurements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用兩種接觸式溫度量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check two contact-temperature measurements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 扣件阻力累積與溫差等效位移
stages.titleEn: Fastening resistance accumulation & Temperature-equivalent displacement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「扣件阻力累積」與「溫差等效位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fastening resistance accumulation" and "Temperature-equivalent displacement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 扣件阻力累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fastening resistance accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「扣件阻力累積」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fastening resistance accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻分布縱向阻力積分後形成可傳遞軸力的量級。本模型把 r 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 264 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。全長均勻且已動員的縱向阻力；不是未滑移狀態的彈性剛度。使用沿線相對滑移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「扣件阻力累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrating uniform longitudinal resistance gives a transferable-force scale. In this model, r is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 264 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform longitudinal resistance is fully mobilized along the length; it is not pre-slip elastic stiffness. Use relative slip along the line as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fastening resistance accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：r=8 kN/m, L=30 m；y=r*L=240 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: r=8 kN/m, L=30 m; y=r*L=240 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「扣件阻力累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fastening resistance accumulation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 扣件阻力累積
knowledge.text: 均勻分布縱向阻力積分後形成可傳遞軸力的量級。本模型把 r 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 264 kN。
knowledge.textEn: Integrating uniform longitudinal resistance gives a transferable-force scale. In this model, r is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 扣件阻力累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fastening resistance accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「扣件阻力累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fastening resistance accumulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：r=8 kN/m, L=30 m；y=r*L=240 kN。只把 r 增加百分之十，y=264 kN。模型邊界：全長均勻且已動員的縱向阻力；不是未滑移狀態的彈性剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: r=8 kN/m, L=30 m; y=r*L=240 kN. Increasing only r with a ten-percent increase gives y=264 kN. Boundary: Uniform longitudinal resistance is fully mobilized along the length; it is not pre-slip elastic stiffness; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以沿線相對滑移區分模型與觀察，先用多段模型滑移量與相對應縱向反力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use relative slip along the line to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：r=8 kN/m, L=30 m；y=r*L=240 kN。只把 r 增加百分之十，y=264 kN。模型邊界：全長均勻且已動員的縱向阻力；不是未滑移狀態的彈性剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fastening resistance accumulation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以沿線相對滑移區分模型與觀察，先用多段模型滑移量與相對應縱向反力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「扣件阻力累積」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use relative slip along the line to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using segment-by-segment model slip and corresponding longitudinal reactions, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fastening resistance accumulation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms. steps.failure: 注意干擾：把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 扣件阻力累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fastening resistance accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「扣件阻力累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fastening resistance accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制。這個失效與「扣件阻力累積」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查沿線相對滑移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms. This failure and a measurement bias in Fastening resistance accumulation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check relative slip along the line rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用沿線相對滑移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms. This failure and a measurement bias in Fastening resistance accumulation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check relative slip along the line rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「扣件阻力累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fastening resistance accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差
把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change.
Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms.

steps.title: 溫差等效位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature-equivalent displacement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫差等效位移」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temperature-equivalent displacement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 等效熱位移只能在指定長度與邊界下解讀。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.144 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同一已知標距的自由熱位移；不把它視為有約束鋼軌的實際位移。使用標距及基準端點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫差等效位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equivalent thermal movement is meaningful only for the stated length and boundaries. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 12.144 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Free thermal movement over a known gauge length; it is not actual movement of a restrained rail. Use gauge length and reference endpoints as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Temperature-equivalent displacement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=80 m, dT=12 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=11.04 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=80 m, dT=12 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=11.04 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫差等效位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Temperature-equivalent displacement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫差等效位移
knowledge.text: 等效熱位移只能在指定長度與邊界下解讀。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.144 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Equivalent thermal movement is meaningful only for the stated length and boundaries. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 溫差等效位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature-equivalent displacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫差等效位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temperature-equivalent displacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=80 m, dT=12 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=11.04 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=12.144 mm。模型邊界：同一已知標距的自由熱位移；不把它視為有約束鋼軌的實際位移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=80 m, dT=12 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=11.04 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.144 mm. Boundary: Free thermal movement over a known gauge length; it is not actual movement of a restrained rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以標距及基準端點區分模型與觀察，先用固定基準標記、模型標距及平均鋼條溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use gauge length and reference endpoints to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 溫差等效位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature-equivalent displacement: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temperature-equivalent displacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以標距及基準端點區分模型與觀察，先用固定基準標記、模型標距及平均鋼條溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「溫差等效位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use gauge length and reference endpoints to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using fixed reference markers, model gauge length and mean bar temperature, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Temperature-equivalent displacement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「溫差等效位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同一已知標距的自由熱位移；不把它視為有約束鋼軌的實際位移如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差造成偏離的合成觀察，以標距及基準端點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Temperature-equivalent displacement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Free thermal movement over a known gauge length; it is not actual movement of a restrained rail. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. Explain which evidence in gauge length and reference endpoints distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
