steps.titleEn: Temperature-equivalent displacement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫差等效位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temperature-equivalent displacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差。這個失效與「溫差等效位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查標距及基準端點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. This failure and a measurement bias in Temperature-equivalent displacement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check gauge length and reference endpoints rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用標距及基準端點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 中性溫差反算與截面溫度梯度
stages.titleEn: Neutral-temperature difference inversion & Cross-section temperature curvature
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中性溫差反算」與「截面溫度梯度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neutral-temperature difference inversion" and "Cross-section temperature curvature": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 中性溫差反算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Neutral-temperature difference inversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「中性溫差反算」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Neutral-temperature difference inversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應變反算溫差必須先分離機械與熱補償項。本模型把 strain 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11 K。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。應變是已分離機械載重的熱等效大小；只能反算溫差大小，不能單獨定出中性溫度。使用補償應變計與獨立溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；儀器熱漂移會被誤認為中性溫度改變，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「中性溫差反算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring temperature difference from strain requires separating mechanical strain and temperature compensation. In this model, strain is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11 K. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Strain is an isolated thermal-equivalent magnitude; inversion yields a temperature-difference magnitude, not neutral temperature by itself. Use compensated strain gauges and independent temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Instrument thermal drift can resemble a neutral-temperature change; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Neutral-temperature difference inversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：strain=0.000115 1, alpha=0.0000115 1/K；y=strain/alpha=10 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: strain=0.000115 1, alpha=0.0000115 1/K; y=strain/alpha=10 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：儀器熱漂移會被誤認為中性溫度改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Instrument thermal drift can resemble a neutral-temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「中性溫差反算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Neutral-temperature difference inversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 中性溫差反算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutral-temperature difference inversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中性溫差反算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Neutral-temperature difference inversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：strain=0.000115 1, alpha=0.0000115 1/K；y=strain/alpha=10 K。只把 strain 增加百分之十，y=11 K。模型邊界：應變是已分離機械載重的熱等效大小；只能反算溫差大小，不能單獨定出中性溫度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: strain=0.000115 1, alpha=0.0000115 1/K; y=strain/alpha=10 K. Increasing only strain with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 K. Boundary: Strain is an isolated thermal-equivalent magnitude; inversion yields a temperature-difference magnitude, not neutral temperature by itself; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以補償應變計與獨立溫度區分模型與觀察，先用已知約束的合成應變、獨立溫度及熱漂移零點紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use compensated strain gauges and independent temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 中性溫差反算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutral-temperature difference inversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中性溫差反算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Neutral-temperature difference inversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以補償應變計與獨立溫度區分模型與觀察，先用已知約束的合成應變、獨立溫度及熱漂移零點紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「中性溫差反算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use compensated strain gauges and independent temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic strain with known restraint, independent temperature and thermal-drift zero records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Neutral-temperature difference inversion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「中性溫差反算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出應變是已分離機械載重的熱等效大小；只能反算溫差大小，不能單獨定出中性溫度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由儀器熱漂移會被誤認為中性溫度改變造成偏離的合成觀察，以補償應變計與獨立溫度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Neutral-temperature difference inversion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Strain is an isolated thermal-equivalent magnitude; inversion yields a temperature-difference magnitude, not neutral temperature by itself. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Instrument thermal drift can resemble a neutral-temperature change. Explain which evidence in compensated strain gauges and independent temperature distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：儀器熱漂移會被誤認為中性溫度改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Instrument thermal drift can resemble a neutral-temperature change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 截面溫度梯度：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: A normal mean temperature can coexist with differential thermal bending. This failure and a measurement bias in Cross-section temperature curvature can produce similar symptoms. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean temperature can coexist with differential thermal bending." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 彈性釋放位移與軌斷缺口量級

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性釋放位移」與「軌斷缺口量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic release displacement" and "Broken-rail gap scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性釋放位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic release displacement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性釋放位移」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic release displacement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軸向彈性位移由軸力、長度與軸向剛度共同決定。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 10.3383 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫。使用模型載入卸載位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性釋放位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial elastic movement depends on force, length and axial rigidity. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 10.3383 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking. Use loading-unloading movement in the model as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic release displacement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性釋放位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic release displacement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 彈性釋放位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic release displacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性釋放位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic release displacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=10.3383 mm。模型邊界：均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=10.3383 mm. Boundary: A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以模型載入卸載位移區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型力計、兩端相對位移及卸載回復曲線建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use loading-unloading movement in the model to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=10.3383 mm。模型邊界：均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.title: 彈性釋放位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elastic release displacement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性釋放位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic release displacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以模型載入卸載位移區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型力計、兩端相對位移及卸載回復曲線建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「彈性釋放位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use loading-unloading movement in the model to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load model force gauge, relative endpoint displacement and unloading recovery, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Elastic release displacement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「彈性釋放位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長造成偏離的合成觀察，以模型載入卸載位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Elastic release displacement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic. Explain which evidence in loading-unloading movement in the model distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以模型載入卸載位移區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型力計、兩端相對位移及卸載回復曲線建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「彈性釋放位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using low-load model force gauge, relative endpoint displacement and unloading recovery, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Elastic release displacement. knowledge.text: 重算「軌斷缺口量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出長度是缺口兩側的總等效釋放長度；忽略分布摩擦與斷裂動態如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一造成偏離的合成觀察，以缺口附近位移剖面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Broken-rail gap scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Length is the total effective released length on both sides of a gap; distributed friction and fracture dynamics are omitted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line. Explain which evidence in displacement profile near a gap distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軌斷缺口量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Broken-rail gap scale"?
options: 本單元以缺口附近位移剖面區分模型與觀察，先用合成缺口位移剖面、溫差及明列的兩側有效長度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：儀器熱漂移會被誤認為中性溫度改變
optionsEn: Use displacement profile near a gap to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Instrument thermal drift can resemble a neutral-temperature change.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以缺口附近位移剖面區分模型與觀察，先用合成缺口位移剖面、溫差及明列的兩側有效長度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use displacement profile near a gap to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 軌斷缺口量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Broken-rail gap scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軌斷缺口量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Broken-rail gap scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一。這個失效與「軌斷缺口量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查缺口附近位移剖面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line. This failure and a measurement bias in Broken-rail gap scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check displacement profile near a gap rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用缺口附近位移剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一。這個失效與「軌斷缺口量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查缺口附近位移剖面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line. This failure and a measurement bias in Broken-rail gap scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check displacement profile near a gap rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軌斷缺口量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Broken-rail gap scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line.

courses.title: 鋼軌閃光焊接
courses.summary: 鋼軌閃光焊接以「電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。閃光對焊把電熱輸入、接合面狀態與頂鍛塑性變形串接；焊後外觀平順只是幾何條件，不能單獨證明熱影響區與內部接合品質。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Flash-butt welding couples electrical heat input, interface condition and upset deformation; a smooth finished profile is a geometric condition and alone does not prove heat-affected-zone or internal bond quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據
courses.focusEn: Resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=4 V, I=5000 A；y=V*I/1000=20 kW。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=22 kW。模型邊界：電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.05 kJ. Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=4 V, I=5000 A; y=V*I/1000=20 kW. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 kW. Boundary: Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 電阻熱積分與電功率帳核對
stages.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration & Electrical power cross-check
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電阻熱積分」與「電功率帳核對」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resistance-heat integration" and "Electrical power cross-check": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電阻熱積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電阻熱積分」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resistance-heat integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.05 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量。使用同步電流電壓波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電阻熱積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.05 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted. Use synchronized current and voltage waveforms as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resistance-heat integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電阻熱積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resistance-heat integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電阻熱積分
knowledge.text: 焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.05 kJ。
knowledge.textEn: Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電阻熱積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resistance-heat integration" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入
焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current.
Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat.
quiz.explanation: 焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電阻熱積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電阻熱積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resistance-heat integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.05 kJ. Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

Boundary: Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Electrical power cross-check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以接頭四線式電壓量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓等效試件的四端電壓、電流及量測端點圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「電功率帳核對」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use four-terminal voltage measurements across the joint to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using four-terminal voltage, current and sensing-point diagram for a low-voltage equivalent specimen, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Electrical power cross-check. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「電功率帳核對」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量造成偏離的合成觀察，以接頭四線式電壓量測說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Electrical power cross-check, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat. steps.failure: 注意干擾：量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 電功率帳核對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electrical power cross-check: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電功率帳核對」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Electrical power cross-check” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量。這個失效與「電功率帳核對」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭四線式電壓量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat. This failure and a measurement bias in Electrical power cross-check can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check four-terminal voltage measurements across the joint rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用接頭四線式電壓量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 頂鍛平均壓力與頂鍛作功估計
stages.titleEn: Mean upset pressure & Upset-work estimate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂鍛平均壓力」與「頂鍛作功估計」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean upset pressure" and "Upset-work estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂鍛平均壓力」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean upset pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軸力除面積是平均頂鍛壓力，不等於接觸面每處應力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 65.1316 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布。使用力位移同步曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂鍛平均壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial force divided by area is mean upset pressure, not local contact stress everywhere. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 65.1316 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution. Use synchronized force-displacement curves as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean upset pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂鍛平均壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean upset pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂鍛平均壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean upset pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=65.1316 MPa。模型邊界：力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=65.1316 MPa. Boundary: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以力位移同步曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成軸向力、接觸面積及接頭對中偏差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronized force-displacement curves to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂鍛平均壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean upset pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以力位移同步曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成軸向力、接觸面積及接頭對中偏差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頂鍛平均壓力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronized force-displacement curves to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic axial force, contact area and joint-alignment offset, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean upset pressure. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「頂鍛平均壓力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均造成偏離的合成觀察，以力位移同步曲線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean upset pressure, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow. Explain which evidence in synchronized force-displacement curves distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂鍛平均壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mean upset pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均。這個失效與「頂鍛平均壓力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查力位移同步曲線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow. This failure and a measurement bias in Mean upset pressure can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronized force-displacement curves rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用力位移同步曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「頂鍛平均壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 頂鍛作功估計：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Upset-work estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂鍛作功估計」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Upset-work estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 近似定力作功是力乘行程，塑性熱與外部散熱仍須分帳。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1760 J。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。平均力在接頭有效行程內恆定；扣除機架彈性位移。使用行程零點與載荷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂鍛作功估計」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Approximate constant-force work multiplies force by travel; plastic heat and external loss remain separate. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1760 J. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mean force is constant over effective joint travel; frame elastic movement is excluded. Use travel zero and load as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Upset-work estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=400 kN, d=4 mm；y=F*d=1600 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=400 kN, d=4 mm; y=F*d=1600 J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂鍛作功估計」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=400 kN, d=4 mm；y=F*d=1600 J。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=1760 J。模型邊界：平均力在接頭有效行程內恆定；扣除機架彈性位移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=400 kN, d=4 mm; y=F*d=1600 J. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=1760 J. Boundary: Mean force is constant over effective joint travel; frame elastic movement is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以行程零點與載荷區分模型與觀察，先用合成力位移曲線、機架回彈量與接頭相對行程建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use travel zero and load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 頂鍛作功估計：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Upset-work estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以行程零點與載荷區分模型與觀察，先用合成力位移曲線、機架回彈量與接頭相對行程建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頂鍛作功估計」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use travel zero and load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic force-displacement curve, frame recovery and relative joint travel, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Upset-work estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「頂鍛作功估計」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出平均力在接頭有效行程內恆定；扣除機架彈性位移如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移造成偏離的合成觀察，以行程零點與載荷說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Upset-work estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mean force is constant over effective joint travel; frame elastic movement is excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement. Explain which evidence in travel zero and load distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 頂鍛作功估計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Upset-work estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂鍛作功估計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Upset-work estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移。這個失效與「頂鍛作功估計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查行程零點與載荷，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement. This failure and a measurement bias in Upset-work estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check travel zero and load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用行程零點與載荷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移。這個失效與「頂鍛作功估計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查行程零點與載荷，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Cross-check travel zero and load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 熱影響區顯熱與平均冷卻速率
stages.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat & Average cooling rate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱影響區顯熱」與「平均冷卻速率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Heat-affected-zone sensible heat" and "Average cooling rate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱影響區顯熱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱影響區顯熱」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 顯熱量級不包含相變與溫度依賴比熱。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 693 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性。使用熱影響區範圍與溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱影響區顯熱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sensible-heat scale excludes phase change and temperature-dependent heat capacity. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 693 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded. Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱影響區顯熱」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 熱影響區顯熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat: quantitative estimate

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=693 kJ。模型邊界：區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=693 kJ. Boundary: Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以熱影響區範圍與溫度區分模型與觀察，先用合成多位置溫度曲線、區域質量估計與比熱資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic distributed temperature traces, region-mass estimate and heat-capacity data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heat-affected-zone sensible heat. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「熱影響區顯熱」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度造成偏離的合成觀察，以熱影響區範圍與溫度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Heat-affected-zone sensible heat, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients. Explain which evidence in heat-affected-zone extent and temperature distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度。這個失效與「熱影響區顯熱」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查熱影響區範圍與溫度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients. This failure and a measurement bias in Heat-affected-zone sensible heat can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check heat-affected-zone extent and temperature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用熱影響區範圍與溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 平均冷卻速率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Average cooling rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平均冷卻速率」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Average cooling rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 區間平均冷卻速率不等於所有時刻的冷卻速率。本模型把 dT 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.4 K/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。只計兩個時間端點的平均溫降；不能推斷中間極值。使用完整冷卻曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一平均值會掩蓋局部快速冷卻，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平均冷卻速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An interval-average cooling rate is not the rate at every instant. In this model, dT is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.4 K/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Only endpoint-average cooling is calculated; intermediate peak rates cannot be inferred. Use the complete cooling trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One average hides locally rapid cooling; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Average cooling rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dT=240 K, dt=60 s；y=dT/dt=4 K/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dT=240 K, dt=60 s; y=dT/dt=4 K/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一平均值會掩蓋局部快速冷卻」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One average hides locally rapid cooling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平均冷卻速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 短尺平順可能漏掉較長波長折角。這個失效與「焊頭垂向角差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩側直尺與縱向剖面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short straightedge can miss a longer-wavelength angular defect. This failure and a measurement bias in Weld vertical angular mismatch can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check straightedge readings and longitudinal profiles on both sides rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用兩側直尺與縱向剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短尺平順可能漏掉較長波長折角，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.instruction: 硬度差反映局部材料狀態，但不直接等同疲勞壽命差。本模型把 H1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命。使用等距硬度剖面與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「硬度相對差異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hardness variation reflects local material state but does not directly equal a fatigue-life difference. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life. Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. steps.title: 硬度相對差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Relative hardness difference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「硬度相對差異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative hardness difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV；y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent。只把 H1 增加百分之十，y=32 percent。模型邊界：兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV; y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent. Increasing only H1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=32 percent. Boundary: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以等距硬度剖面與位置區分模型與觀察，先用同載荷壓痕硬度網格、位置及重複試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 硬度相對差異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative hardness difference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「硬度相對差異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative hardness difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以等距硬度剖面與位置區分模型與觀察，先用同載荷壓痕硬度網格、位置及重複試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「硬度相對差異」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using indentation-hardness grid at equal load, position records and repeat tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Relative hardness difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「硬度相對差異」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區造成偏離的合成觀察，以等距硬度剖面與位置說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Relative hardness difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. Explain which evidence in equally spaced hardness profiles and positions distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 硬度相對差異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative hardness difference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「硬度相對差異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative hardness difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區。這個失效與「硬度相對差異」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查等距硬度剖面與位置，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. This failure and a measurement bias in Relative hardness difference can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check equally spaced hardness profiles and positions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用等距硬度剖面與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
