steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast tamping and track alignment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 目標與現況差值需同一高程基準。本模型把 target 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9.2 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。目標與現況高程使用同一固定基準；不含後續回沉。使用整正前後同基準高程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；基準移動會使起道量失真，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「起道量分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Target-minus-existing lift requires a common elevation datum. In this model, target is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 9.2 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Target and existing elevations share a fixed datum; later settlement is excluded. Use before-and-after levels on the same datum as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A moving datum corrupts the inferred lift; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lift allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：target=12 mm, existing=4 mm；y=target-existing=8 mm。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：基準移動會使起道量失真」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「起道量分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift allocation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準移動會使起道量失真。這個失效與「起道量分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查整正前後同基準高程，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A moving datum corrupts the inferred lift. This failure and a measurement bias in Lift allocation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check before-and-after levels on the same datum rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：基準移動會使起道量失真」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 整正後回沉率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-correction settlement ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast tamping and track alignment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回沉比例描述短期保留量，不預測無限期穩定。本模型把 settled 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。回沉與起道量使用同一基準和指定觀測期間。使用通車荷載量與高程趨勢作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未記錄通過噸位會讓不同觀測期不可比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「整正後回沉率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement fraction describes short-term retention and does not predict indefinite stability. In this model, settled is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.5 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Settlement and lift share a datum and a specified observation period. Use traffic loading and elevation trend as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Missing traffic tonnage makes observation periods incomparable; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-correction settlement ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 支承剛度回復：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 載重位移斜率描述支承剛度而非單純高度。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 kN/mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。力位移由共同零點計算割線剛度；不把它當非線性切線剛度。使用重複模型載重曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同一高程可能隱藏不同承載剛度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承剛度回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Load-displacement slope characterizes support stiffness rather than height alone. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.5 kN/mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Force and displacement from one origin give secant stiffness, not nonlinear tangent stiffness. Use repeated model loading curves as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「幾何殘差均方根」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出三點等權且採同一基準；未量測區域及局部最大值另查如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以逐點殘差與位置說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Geometry residual RMS, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Three equally weighted points share a datum; unmeasured regions and local maxima require separate checks. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One average quality score hides localized defects. Explain which evidence in pointwise residuals and positions distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以逐點殘差與位置區分模型與觀察，先用逐點里程、高程殘差及感測器零點紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「幾何殘差均方根」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use pointwise residuals and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using pointwise chainage, elevation residuals and sensor-zero records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Geometry residual RMS. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One average quality score hides localized defects. quiz.question: 要驗證「幾何殘差均方根」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Geometry residual RMS"?

quiz.explanationEn: Use pointwise residuals and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 幾何殘差均方根：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometry residual RMS: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何殘差均方根」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometry residual RMS” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷。這個失效與「幾何殘差均方根」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查逐點殘差與位置，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One average quality score hides localized defects. This failure and a measurement bias in Geometry residual RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check pointwise residuals and positions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用逐點殘差與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One average quality score hides localized defects; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One average quality score hides localized defects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「幾何殘差均方根」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Geometry residual RMS" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

One average quality score hides localized defects.

courses.title: 道碴清篩與再利用
courses.summary: 道碴清篩與再利用以「粒徑分離再利用物料帳與排水性能」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。清篩將受污染道碴分成可再用粗料與廢細料，回收比例不能取代粒形、強度及排水驗證；含水率和顆粒損傷會影響質量帳的解讀。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops gradation separation reuse mass accounts and drainage performance through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Cleaning separates fouled ballast into reusable coarse material and discarded fines, but recovery fraction cannot replace checks on particle shape, strength and drainage; moisture and particle damage affect the mass account. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 粒徑分離再利用物料帳與排水性能
courses.focusEn: Gradation separation reuse mass accounts and drainage performance
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。只把 feed 增加百分之十，y=13 t。模型邊界：各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：reusable=72 t, feed=100 t；y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent。只把 reusable 增加百分之十，y=79.2 percent。模型邊界：可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t. Increasing only feed with a ten-percent increase gives y=13 t. Boundary: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: reusable=72 t, feed=100 t; y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent. Increasing only reusable with a ten-percent increase gives y=79.2 percent. Boundary: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 清篩質量守恆與可再用材料比例
stages.titleEn: Cleaning mass conservation & Reusable material fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「清篩質量守恆」與「可再用材料比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cleaning mass conservation" and "Reusable material fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 清篩質量守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cleaning mass conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「清篩質量守恆」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cleaning mass conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輸入減已知輸出應對應存量變化與量測差。本模型把 feed 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13 t。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化。使用各料流同步乾質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「清篩質量守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Input minus known outputs corresponds to inventory change and measurement discrepancy. In this model, feed is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13 t. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change. Use synchronized dry mass in each material stream as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cleaning mass conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「清篩質量守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cleaning mass conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 清篩質量守恆
knowledge.text: 輸入減已知輸出應對應存量變化與量測差。本模型把 feed 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13 t。
knowledge.textEn: Input minus known outputs corresponds to inventory change and measurement discrepancy. In this model, feed is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「清篩質量守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cleaning mass conservation" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗
輸入減已知輸出應對應存量變化與量測差。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。只把 feed 增加百分之十，y=13 t。模型邊界：各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：reusable=72 t, feed=100 t；y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent。只把 reusable 增加百分之十，y=79.2 percent。模型邊界：可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reusable material fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以粗料質量與獨立性能試驗區分模型與觀察，先用乾質量秤重、粒形與強度試驗的批次對照建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「可再用材料比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use coarse mass and independent property tests to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using dry-mass weighing and batch-matched particle-shape and strength tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Reusable material fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「可再用材料比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒造成偏離的合成觀察，以粗料質量與獨立性能試驗說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Reusable material fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high recovery fraction may retain weak particles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reusable material fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒。這個失效與「可再用材料比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查粗料質量與獨立性能試驗，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A high recovery fraction may retain weak particles. This failure and a measurement bias in Reusable material fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check coarse mass and independent property tests rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用粗料質量與獨立性能試驗作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.title: 補充新道碴需求：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「補充新道碴需求」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fresh ballast requirement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 需求扣除合格回料才得到新料需求。本模型把 demand 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32.5 t。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。需求不少於合格回料且兩者同為乾質量；超額回料另列存量。使用可用回料與設計斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「補充新道碴需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh demand is required material minus qualified recovered material. In this model, demand is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 32.5 t. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Demand is at least qualified recovery and both are dry mass; surplus recovery is separate inventory. Use usable recovered material and required section as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating all coarse material as qualified understates fresh demand; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fresh ballast requirement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：demand=95 t, recovered=72 t；y=demand-recovered=23 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: demand=95 t, recovered=72 t; y=demand-recovered=23 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating all coarse material as qualified understates fresh demand." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「補充新道碴需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 含水率以乾質量為分母時，濕質量須除一加含水率。本模型把 wet 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 110 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。含水率定義為水質量除乾料質量；水分分布具有代表性。使用濕重及乾燥後質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用濕基與乾基含水率會破壞物料平衡，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水率乾重換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For moisture content on a dry-mass basis, divide wet mass by one plus moisture ratio. In this model, wet is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 110 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass; sampled moisture is representative. Use wet mass and mass after drying as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing wet-basis and dry-basis moisture corrupts mass balance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture dry-mass conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元以濕重及乾燥後質量區分模型與觀察，先用同批濕重、乾燥後恆重及天平校準紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「含水率乾重換算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use wet mass and mass after drying to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.instruction: 混用濕基與乾基含水率會破壞物料平衡。這個失效與「含水率乾重換算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查濕重及乾燥後質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing wet-basis and dry-basis moisture corrupts mass balance. This failure and a measurement bias in Moisture dry-mass conversion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check wet mass and mass after drying rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用濕重及乾燥後質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用濕基與乾基含水率會破壞物料平衡，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.title: 篩分通過比例：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「篩分通過比例」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sieve passing fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 通過質量除樣本乾重描述指定篩級。本模型把 passing 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 16.5 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。通過量與樣本量皆為同批乾質量；只代表一個篩級。使用篩前篩後稱量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「篩分通過比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passing mass divided by sample dry mass describes one specified sieve class. In this model, passing is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 16.5 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Passing and sample amounts are dry masses from one batch; only one sieve class is represented. Use weighing before and after sieving as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Screen clogging misclassifies fines as coarse material; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sieve passing fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：passing=18 kg, sample=120 kg；y=passing/sample*100=15 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: passing=18 kg, sample=120 kg; y=passing/sample*100=15 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 篩分通過比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sieve passing fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「篩分通過比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sieve passing fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：passing=18 kg, sample=120 kg；y=passing/sample*100=15 percent。只把 passing 增加百分之十，y=16.5 percent。模型邊界：通過量與樣本量皆為同批乾質量；只代表一個篩級；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: passing=18 kg, sample=120 kg; y=passing/sample*100=15 percent. Increasing only passing with a ten-percent increase gives y=16.5 percent. Boundary: Passing and sample amounts are dry masses from one batch; only one sieve class is represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以篩前篩後稱量區分模型與觀察，先用篩前樣本重、各篩留存重及質量閉合差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use weighing before and after sieving to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sieve passing fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以篩前篩後稱量區分模型與觀察，先用篩前樣本重、各篩留存重及質量閉合差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「篩分通過比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use weighing before and after sieving to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using initial sample mass, mass retained on each sieve and mass-closure residual, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sieve passing fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「篩分通過比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出通過量與樣本量皆為同批乾質量；只代表一個篩級如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料造成偏離的合成觀察，以篩前篩後稱量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Sieve passing fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Passing and sample amounts are dry masses from one batch; only one sieve class is represented. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Screen clogging misclassifies fines as coarse material. Explain which evidence in weighing before and after sieving distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Screen clogging misclassifies fines as coarse material. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 篩分通過比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sieve passing fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「篩分通過比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sieve passing fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料。這個失效與「篩分通過比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查篩前篩後稱量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Screen clogging misclassifies fines as coarse material. This failure and a measurement bias in Sieve passing fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check weighing before and after sieving rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用篩前篩後稱量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Screen clogging misclassifies fines as coarse material; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：篩網堵塞會讓細料被錯列為粗料」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Screen clogging misclassifies fines as coarse material." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

steps.title: 散裝體積換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bulk-volume conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「散裝體積換算」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bulk-volume conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 散裝密度包含顆粒間空隙，不能改用岩石本體密度。本模型把 mass 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 m3。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。散裝密度適用同含水率及堆積狀態；不使用岩石本體密度。使用料斗體積與質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「散裝體積換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bulk density includes interparticle voids and cannot be replaced by solid-rock density. In this model, mass is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.5 m3. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Bulk density applies to the same moisture and packing state; solid-rock density is not used. Use hopper volume and mass as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bulk-volume conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「散裝體積換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=40 t, bulk=1.6 t/m3；y=mass/bulk=25 m3。只把 mass 增加百分之十，y=27.5 m3。模型邊界：散裝密度適用同含水率及堆積狀態；不使用岩石本體密度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=40 t, bulk=1.6 t/m3; y=mass/bulk=25 m3. Increasing only mass with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.5 m3. Boundary: Bulk density applies to the same moisture and packing state; solid-rock density is not used; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以料斗體積與質量區分模型與觀察，先用已知容積容器、批次秤重及堆積狀態影像建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bulk-volume conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以料斗體積與質量區分模型與觀察，先用已知容積容器、批次秤重及堆積狀態影像建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「散裝體積換算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use hopper volume and mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using known-volume container, batch weighing and packing-state images, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Bulk-volume conversion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「散裝體積換算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出散裝密度適用同含水率及堆積狀態；不使用岩石本體密度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積造成偏離的合成觀察，以料斗體積與質量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Bulk-volume conversion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Bulk density applies to the same moisture and packing state; solid-rock density is not used. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume. Explain which evidence in hopper volume and mass distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 散裝體積換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bulk-volume conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「散裝體積換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bulk-volume conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積。這個失效與「散裝體積換算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查料斗體積與質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume. This failure and a measurement bias in Bulk-volume conversion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check hopper volume and mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用料斗體積與質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 清篩處理速率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「清篩處理速率」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Screening throughput” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 物料處理率需明確時間窗並扣除等待。本模型把 mass 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 176 t/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。質量與時間窗一致；說明時間是否包含等待與維修。使用連續秤重與運轉時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短時峰值不代表整班處理量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「清篩處理速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Processing rate needs a defined time window and treatment of waiting. In this model, mass is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 176 t/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included. Use continuous weighing and operating time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A short peak rate does not represent shift production; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Screening throughput” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=80 t, time=0.5 h；y=mass/time=160 t/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=80 t, time=0.5 h; y=mass/time=160 t/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短時峰值不代表整班處理量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「清篩處理速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=80 t, time=0.5 h；y=mass/time=160 t/h。只把 mass 增加百分之十，y=176 t/h。模型邊界：質量與時間窗一致；說明時間是否包含等待與維修；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=80 t, time=0.5 h; y=mass/time=160 t/h. Increasing only mass with a ten-percent increase gives y=176 t/h. Boundary: Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以連續秤重與運轉時間區分模型與觀察，先用連續皮帶秤、起訖時間戳與設備狀態記錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Screening throughput” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以連續秤重與運轉時間區分模型與觀察，先用連續皮帶秤、起訖時間戳與設備狀態記錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「清篩處理速率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use continuous weighing and operating time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using continuous belt-scale readings, start-end timestamps and equipment-state log, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Screening throughput. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「清篩處理速率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出質量與時間窗一致；說明時間是否包含等待與維修如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由短時峰值不代表整班處理量造成偏離的合成觀察，以連續秤重與運轉時間說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Screening throughput, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production. Explain which evidence in continuous weighing and operating time distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：短時峰值不代表整班處理量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short peak rate does not represent shift production. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 清篩處理速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screening throughput: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「清篩處理速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screening throughput” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短時峰值不代表整班處理量。這個失效與「清篩處理速率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查連續秤重與運轉時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short peak rate does not represent shift production. This failure and a measurement bias in Screening throughput can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check continuous weighing and operating time rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用連續秤重與運轉時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短時峰值不代表整班處理量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A short peak rate does not represent shift production; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短時峰值不代表整班處理量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 細料新增損傷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: New fines from breakage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「細料新增損傷」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “New fines from breakage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前後細料差可檢查清篩過程是否產生額外破碎。本模型把 before 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 3.5 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。前後樣本來自同批並使用同一篩界；沒有外來細料加入。使用同批料前後粒徑作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同取樣位置會被誤認為破碎增量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「細料新增損傷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Change in fines checks whether processing generated additional breakage. In this model, before is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 3.5 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Before-after samples share a batch and sieve boundary; no external fines are added. Use before-and-after grading of the same batch as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different sampling positions can imitate breakage growth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “New fines from breakage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=5 kg, after=9 kg, total=100 kg；y=(after-before)/total*100=4 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=5 kg, after=9 kg, total=100 kg; y=(after-before)/total*100=4 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同取樣位置會被誤認為破碎增量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different sampling positions can imitate breakage growth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「細料新增損傷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “New fines from breakage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 流量反算滲透率須記錄水力梯度與試體斷面。本模型把 Q 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.011 m/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。飽和穩態達西滲流且無側漏；結果是試體等效滲透率。使用水頭與流量穩定區段作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滲透流量比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring permeability from flow requires hydraulic gradient and specimen area. In this model, Q is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.011 m/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability. Use stable intervals of head and flow as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permeability flow comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permeability flow comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Q=0.0001 m3/s, A=0.02 m2, i=0.5 1；y=Q/(A*i)=0.01 m/s。只把 Q 增加百分之十，y=0.011 m/s。模型邊界：飽和穩態達西滲流且無側漏；結果是試體等效滲透率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: Q=0.0001 m3/s, A=0.02 m2, i=0.5 1; y=Q/(A*i)=0.01 m/s. Increasing only Q with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.011 m/s. Boundary: Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以水頭與流量穩定區段區分模型與觀察，先用穩定水頭時間序列、試體斷面與定時排水量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use stable intervals of head and flow to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 滲透流量比較：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滲透流量比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permeability flow comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以水頭與流量穩定區段區分模型與觀察，先用穩定水頭時間序列、試體斷面與定時排水量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「滲透流量比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use stable intervals of head and flow to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using stable head history, specimen area and timed discharge volume, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Permeability flow comparison. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「滲透流量比較」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出飽和穩態達西滲流且無側漏；結果是試體等效滲透率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態造成偏離的合成觀察，以水頭與流量穩定區段說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Permeability flow comparison, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. Explain which evidence in stable intervals of head and flow distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 滲透流量比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permeability flow comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滲透流量比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permeability flow comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態。這個失效與「滲透流量比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查水頭與流量穩定區段，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. This failure and a measurement bias in Permeability flow comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check stable intervals of head and flow rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用水頭與流量穩定區段作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「未回收物料比例」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unrecovered material fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未回收量可以包含秤重誤差、濺散與滯留，不能直接判定偷漏。本模型把 lost 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因。使用秤重校正與存量盤點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「未回收物料比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecovered quantity can include weighing error, spillage and retained inventory; it does not identify a cause by itself. In this model, lost is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.3 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause. Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unrecovered material fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：lost=3 t, feed=100 t；y=lost/feed*100=3 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: lost=3 t, feed=100 t; y=lost/feed*100=3 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「未回收物料比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unrecovered material fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：lost=3 t, feed=100 t；y=lost/feed*100=3 percent。只把 lost 增加百分之十，y=3.3 percent。模型邊界：分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: lost=3 t, feed=100 t; y=lost/feed*100=3 percent. Increasing only lost with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.3 percent. Boundary: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以秤重校正與存量盤點區分模型與觀察，先用各秤重點校準、容器殘料與物料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「未回收物料比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unrecovered material fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以秤重校正與存量盤點區分模型與觀察，先用各秤重點校準、容器殘料與物料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「未回收物料比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibration at each scale, retained container material and inventory count, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Unrecovered material fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「未回收物料比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題造成偏離的合成觀察，以秤重校正與存量盤點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Unrecovered material fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. Explain which evidence in scale calibration and inventory reconciliation distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「未回收物料比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unrecovered material fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題。這個失效與「未回收物料比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查秤重校正與存量盤點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. This failure and a measurement bias in Unrecovered material fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check scale calibration and inventory reconciliation rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用秤重校正與存量盤點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

courses.title: 軌道扣件彈性設計
courses.summary: 軌道扣件彈性設計以「扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。扣件同時控制鋼軌位置、提供彈性支承與維持電氣條件，增加夾持力並不保證所有性能改善；墊片、彈條與錨定件的路徑需分開辨認。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Fastenings locate the rail, provide resilient support and maintain electrical conditions; increasing clamping force does not improve every property, so pads, clips and anchors need separate load-path interpretation. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計
courses.focusEn: Fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=44 kN/mm。模型邊界：從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k1=25 kN/mm, k2=35 kN/mm；y=k1+k2=60 kN/mm。只把 k1 增加百分之十，y=62.5 kN/mm。模型邊界：兩支承保持接觸且位移相同；各元件線彈性；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=44 kN/mm. Boundary: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k1=25 kN/mm, k2=35 kN/mm; y=k1+k2=60 kN/mm. Increasing only k1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=62.5 kN/mm. Boundary: Both supports stay in contact with identical displacement; each component is linearly elastic; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 墊片壓縮剛度與平行支承合成
stages.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness & Parallel support stiffness
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「墊片壓縮剛度」與「平行支承合成」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pad compression stiffness" and "Parallel support stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 墊片壓縮剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「墊片壓縮剛度」如何影響軌道扣件彈性設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pad compression stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Resilient rail-fastening design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剛度應由指定載重區間的力位移關係定義。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 44 kN/mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率。使用載入卸載斜率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墊片壓縮剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stiffness should be defined over a specified loading interval. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 44 kN/mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate. Use loading and unloading slopes as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pad compression stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性墊片用單一剛度會漏掉載重依賴」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One stiffness misses load dependence in a nonlinear pad." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「墊片壓縮剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pad compression stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
