steps.title: 剛度不均分力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unequal-stiffness force share: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剛度不均分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unequal-stiffness force share” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=100 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=20 kN/mm；y=F*k1/(k1+k2)=60 kN。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=66 kN。模型邊界：剛性板保持兩支承同位移且無轉動；兩者皆接觸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=100 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=20 kN/mm; y=F*k1/(k1+k2)=60 kN. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=66 kN. Boundary: A rigid plate maintains identical support displacement without rotation; both supports remain in contact; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以支承高度與剛度區分模型與觀察，先用兩支承分力、共同位移及板體轉角建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use support height and stiffness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unequal-stiffness force share” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以支承高度與剛度區分模型與觀察，先用兩支承分力、共同位移及板體轉角建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「剛度不均分力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Checking total stiffness alone misses local overload. Explain which evidence in support height and stiffness distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢查總剛度會漏掉局部過載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 靜壓縮與動態振幅都消耗同一間隙。本模型把 gap 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 14 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。動態量是朝限位方向的峰值位移；與靜壓縮共用同一基準。使用最小間隙與峰值位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；異物橋接會旁路隔振支承，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「間隙餘量檢查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 異物橋接會旁路隔振支承。這個失效與「間隙餘量檢查」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查最小間隙與峰值位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Foreign material can bridge and bypass the isolation support. This failure and a measurement bias in Clearance reserve can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check minimum clearance and peak displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用最小間隙與峰值位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；異物橋接會旁路隔振支承，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Foreign material can bridge and bypass the isolation support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：異物橋接會旁路隔振支承」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Foreign material can bridge and bypass the isolation support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 積水附加質量與頻率降低敏感度
stages.titleEn: Water added mass & Frequency reduction sensitivity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「積水附加質量」與「頻率降低敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water added mass" and "Frequency reduction sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 積水附加質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water added mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「積水附加質量」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water added mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水不良會增加質量且改變固有頻率。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 660 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水深及面積均勻且水全隨板體運動；不含流動與晃動。使用水位與模態頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；積水也可能形成額外接觸阻尼，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「積水附加質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Poor drainage adds mass and changes natural frequency. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 660 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Water depth and area are uniform and water moves fully with the slab; flow and sloshing are excluded. Use water depth and modal frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Standing water can create additional contact damping; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water added mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=1000 kg/m3, A=20 m2, h=0.03 m；y=rho*A*h=600 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=1000 kg/m3, A=20 m2, h=0.03 m; y=rho*A*h=600 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：積水也可能形成額外接觸阻尼」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Standing water can create additional contact damping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「積水附加質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water added mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Poor drainage adds mass and changes natural frequency. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.title: 積水附加質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water added mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「積水附加質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water added mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=1000 kg/m3, A=20 m2, h=0.03 m；y=rho*A*h=600 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=660 kg。模型邊界：水深及面積均勻且水全隨板體運動；不含流動與晃動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=1000 kg/m3, A=20 m2, h=0.03 m; y=rho*A*h=600 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=660 kg. Boundary: Water depth and area are uniform and water moves fully with the slab; flow and sloshing are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以水位與模態頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型積水深度網格、總水量及振動頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use water depth and modal frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Water depth and area are uniform and water moves fully with the slab; flow and sloshing are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water added mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以水位與模態頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型積水深度網格、總水量及振動頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「積水附加質量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Water added mass, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Water depth and area are uniform and water moves fully with the slab; flow and sloshing are excluded. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率降低敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frequency reduction sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只追求低頻會忽略剩餘行程不足。這個失效與「頻率降低敏感度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載重前後頻率與高度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pursuing low frequency alone ignores insufficient travel reserve. This failure and a measurement bias in Frequency reduction sensitivity can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check frequency and height before and after added load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用載重前後頻率與高度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只追求低頻會忽略剩餘行程不足，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pursuing low frequency alone ignores insufficient travel reserve; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只追求低頻會忽略剩餘行程不足」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Pursuing low frequency alone ignores insufficient travel reserve." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只追求低頻會忽略剩餘行程不足。這個失效與「頻率降低敏感度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載重前後頻率與高度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Pursuing low frequency alone ignores insufficient travel reserve. This failure and a measurement bias in Frequency reduction sensitivity can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check frequency and height before and after added load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻率降低敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frequency reduction sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只追求低頻會忽略剩餘行程不足。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Pursuing low frequency alone ignores insufficient travel reserve.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency.
quiz.explanation: 只追求低頻會忽略剩餘行程不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pursuing low frequency alone ignores insufficient travel reserve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鋼軌波磨研磨整治
courses.summary: 鋼軌波磨研磨整治以「波磨波長接觸激振與材料去除量」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。鋼軌波磨把空間不平順轉成輪軌週期激振，研磨要同時保留輪廓、材料餘量與缺陷判讀，表面變亮不是品質證明。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops corrugation wavelength contact excitation and material removal through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Rail corrugation converts spatial irregularity into periodic wheel contact excitation; grinding must preserve profile, material reserve and defect interpretation, and a shiny surface is not proof of quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 波磨波長接觸激振與材料去除量
courses.focusEn: Corrugation wavelength contact excitation and material removal
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=550 Hz。模型邊界：單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz；y=v/fs*1000=10 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=11 mm。模型邊界：時間取樣均勻且速度固定；未計遺失取樣及編碼器滑移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=550 Hz. Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz; y=v/fs*1000=10 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 mm. Boundary: Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 波磨通過頻率與空間取樣間隔
stages.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency & Spatial sampling interval
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波磨通過頻率」與「空間取樣間隔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrugation passage frequency" and "Spatial sampling interval": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波磨通過頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波磨通過頻率」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrugation passage frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 空間波長經速度轉換為時間激振頻率。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 550 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振。使用同步速度及波長頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波磨通過頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 550 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded. Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrugation passage frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波磨通過頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrugation passage frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波磨通過頻率
knowledge.text: 空間波長經速度轉換為時間激振頻率。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 550 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波磨通過頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrugation passage frequency" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長
空間波長經速度轉換為時間激振頻率。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength.
Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation.
quiz.explanation: 空間波長經速度轉換為時間激振頻率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波磨通過頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波磨通過頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrugation passage frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=550 Hz。模型邊界：單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=550 Hz. Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同步速度及波長頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成輪廓波長譜、同步速度及振動頻譜建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=550 Hz。模型邊界：單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=550 Hz. Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波磨通過頻率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrugation passage frequency", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量

steps.title: 空間取樣間隔：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨。這個失效與「空間取樣間隔」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查編碼器位置與取樣時刻，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation. This failure and a measurement bias in Spatial sampling interval can produce similar symptoms. steps.title: 正弦輪廓斜率：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 同振幅下波長越短，輪廓最大斜率越大。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.00575959 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小振幅單一正弦輪廓；結果為最大斜率的大小。使用輪廓高度與導數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「正弦輪廓斜率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At equal amplitude a shorter wavelength gives a larger maximum slope. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.00575959 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A small-amplitude single sinusoidal profile; the result is maximum slope magnitude. Use profile height and its derivative as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sinusoidal profile slope” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以輪廓高度與導數區分模型與觀察，先用校準輪廓儀、空間振幅波長及數值導數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「正弦輪廓斜率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use profile height and its derivative to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibrated profilometer, spatial amplitude and wavelength, and numerical derivative, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sinusoidal profile slope. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「正弦輪廓斜率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出小振幅單一正弦輪廓；結果為最大斜率的大小如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性造成偏離的合成觀察，以輪廓高度與導數說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Sinusoidal profile slope, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: A small-amplitude single sinusoidal profile; the result is maximum slope magnitude. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves. Explain which evidence in profile height and its derivative distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 正弦輪廓斜率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sinusoidal profile slope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「正弦輪廓斜率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sinusoidal profile slope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性。這個失效與「正弦輪廓斜率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查輪廓高度與導數，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves. This failure and a measurement bias in Sinusoidal profile slope can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check profile height and its derivative rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用輪廓高度與導數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 幾何激振加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometric excitation acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何激振加速度」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric excitation acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想追隨正弦輪廓的加速度與頻率平方相關。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 542.828 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。質點完全追隨正弦幾何；不代表含接觸濾波的實際車輪加速度。使用幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何激振加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal sinusoidal profile-following acceleration scales with frequency squared. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 542.828 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A particle perfectly follows sinusoidal geometry; actual wheel acceleration with contact filtering is not represented. Use geometric profile and contact-filter model as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Rigid following can overestimate actual wheel acceleration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric excitation acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.00005 m, f=500 Hz；y=(2*pi*f)**2*A=493.48 m/s2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.00005 m, f=500 Hz; y=(2*pi*f)**2*A=493.48 m/s2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Rigid following can overestimate actual wheel acceleration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何激振加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric excitation acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 幾何激振加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometric excitation acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何激振加速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric excitation acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.00005 m, f=500 Hz；y=(2*pi*f)**2*A=493.48 m/s2。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=542.828 m/s2。模型邊界：質點完全追隨正弦幾何；不代表含接觸濾波的實際車輪加速度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.00005 m, f=500 Hz; y=(2*pi*f)**2*A=493.48 m/s2. Increasing only A with a ten-percent increase gives y=542.828 m/s2. Boundary: A particle perfectly follows sinusoidal geometry; actual wheel acceleration with contact filtering is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型區分模型與觀察，先用原始正弦輪廓、理想導數與輪軌濾波後合成訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use geometric profile and contact-filter model to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型區分模型與觀察，先用原始正弦輪廓、理想導數與輪軌濾波後合成訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「幾何激振加速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use geometric profile and contact-filter model to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 幾何激振加速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometric excitation acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何激振加速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric excitation acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度。這個失效與「幾何激振加速度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rigid following can overestimate actual wheel acceleration. This failure and a measurement bias in Geometric excitation acceleration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check geometric profile and contact-filter model rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rigid following can overestimate actual wheel acceleration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Rigid following can overestimate actual wheel acceleration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 研磨去除體積與磨耗剩餘高度
stages.titleEn: Grinding removal volume & Remaining wear allowance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「研磨去除體積」與「磨耗剩餘高度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grinding removal volume" and "Remaining wear allowance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 研磨去除體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grinding removal volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「研磨去除體積」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grinding removal volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均去除厚度須乘有效研磨寬度與長度。本模型把 width 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 660 cm3。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。去除厚度與寬度沿長度均勻；不含側面或局部額外去除。使用前後輪廓與有效寬度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；假設均勻去除會漏掉局部過磨，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「研磨去除體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean removal depth multiplies effective width and length. In this model, width is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 660 cm3. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Removal depth and width are uniform along length; side removal and local excess are excluded. Use before-after profiles and effective width as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Uniform-removal assumptions miss local overgrinding; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grinding removal volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：width=0.06 m, depth=0.0001 m, length=100 m；y=width*depth*length*1e6=600 cm3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: width=0.06 m, depth=0.0001 m, length=100 m; y=width*depth*length*1e6=600 cm3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：假設均勻去除會漏掉局部過磨」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uniform-removal assumptions miss local overgrinding." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「研磨去除體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grinding removal volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 研磨去除體積

steps.title: 研磨去除體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grinding removal volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「研磨去除體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grinding removal volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：width=0.06 m, depth=0.0001 m, length=100 m；y=width*depth*length*1e6=600 cm3。只把 width 增加百分之十，y=660 cm3。模型邊界：去除厚度與寬度沿長度均勻；不含側面或局部額外去除；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: width=0.06 m, depth=0.0001 m, length=100 m; y=width*depth*length*1e6=600 cm3. Increasing only width with a ten-percent increase gives y=660 cm3. Boundary: Removal depth and width are uniform along length; side removal and local excess are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以前後輪廓與有效寬度區分模型與觀察，先用前後同位置截面掃描、有效寬度及路段長度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use before-after profiles and effective width to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Removal depth and width are uniform along length; side removal and local excess are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「磨耗剩餘高度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining wear allowance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以截面掃描與歷史磨耗區分模型與觀察，先用歷次同截面掃描、材料去除紀錄及基準定位建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「磨耗剩餘高度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use section scans and historical wear to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using repeated scans of the same section, removal records and datum registration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Remaining wear allowance. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「磨耗剩餘高度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出初始餘量、磨耗及修整深度採同一截面方向與基準如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量造成偏離的合成觀察，以截面掃描與歷史磨耗說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Remaining wear allowance, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Initial allowance, wear and correction depth share one section direction and datum. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve. Explain which evidence in section scans and historical wear distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 磨耗剩餘高度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Remaining wear allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磨耗剩餘高度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining wear allowance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量。這個失效與「磨耗剩餘高度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查截面掃描與歷史磨耗，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve. This failure and a measurement bias in Remaining wear allowance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check section scans and historical wear rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用截面掃描與歷史磨耗作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量。這個失效與「磨耗剩餘高度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查截面掃描與歷史磨耗，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve. This failure and a measurement bias in Remaining wear allowance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check section scans and historical wear rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磨耗剩餘高度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Remaining wear allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善
optionsEn: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement.
quiz.explanation: 局部過磨會縮減後續修整餘量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 頻帶振幅衰減與摩擦熱輸入
stages.titleEn: Band-amplitude reduction & Grinding frictional heat scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頻帶振幅衰減」與「摩擦熱輸入」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Band-amplitude reduction" and "Grinding frictional heat scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頻帶振幅衰減：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Band-amplitude reduction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頻帶振幅衰減」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Band-amplitude reduction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 幅值比用二十倍對數，不能改成能量比公式。本模型把 before 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 -12.8691 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。相同頻帶、窗函數與振幅定義；負分貝表示振幅降低。使用同頻帶同窗函數頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻帶振幅衰減」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Amplitude ratios use twenty times the logarithm, unlike energy ratios. In this model, before is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to -12.8691 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Matched frequency band, window and amplitude definition; negative decibels indicate reduced amplitude. Use spectra with matched bands and windows as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Band-amplitude reduction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=40 um, after=10 um；y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=40 um, after=10 um; y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻帶振幅衰減」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Band-amplitude reduction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻帶振幅衰減
knowledge.text: 幅值比用二十倍對數，不能改成能量比公式。本模型把 before 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 -12.8691 dB。
knowledge.textEn: Amplitude ratios use twenty times the logarithm, unlike energy ratios. In this model, before is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻帶振幅衰減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Band-amplitude reduction" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善
幅值比用二十倍對數，不能改成能量比公式。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement.
Amplitude ratios use twenty times the logarithm, unlike energy ratios.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating.
quiz.explanation: 幅值比用二十倍對數，不能改成能量比公式。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Amplitude ratios use twenty times the logarithm, unlike energy ratios. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻帶振幅衰減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Band-amplitude reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻帶振幅衰減」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Band-amplitude reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=40 um, after=10 um；y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB。只把 before 增加百分之十，y=-12.8691 dB。模型邊界：相同頻帶、窗函數與振幅定義；負分貝表示振幅降低；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=40 um, after=10 um; y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB. Increasing only before with a ten-percent increase gives y=-12.8691 dB. Boundary: Matched frequency band, window and amplitude definition; negative decibels indicate reduced amplitude; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同頻帶同窗函數頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用同位置前後原始輪廓、頻譜設定與幅值比建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use spectra with matched bands and windows to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=40 um, after=10 um；y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB。只把 before 增加百分之十，y=-12.8691 dB。模型邊界：相同頻帶、窗函數與振幅定義；負分貝表示振幅降低；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=40 um, after=10 um; y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB. Increasing only before with a ten-percent increase gives y=-12.8691 dB. Boundary: Matched frequency band, window and amplitude definition; negative decibels indicate reduced amplitude; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頻帶振幅衰減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Band-amplitude reduction", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=40 um, after=10 um。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=40 um, after=10 um; y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=40 um, after=10 um；y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=40 um, after=10 um; y=20*log(after/before)/log(10)=-12.0412 dB. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻帶振幅衰減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Band-amplitude reduction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻帶振幅衰減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Band-amplitude reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以同頻帶同窗函數頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用同位置前後原始輪廓、頻譜設定與幅值比建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頻帶振幅衰減」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use spectra with matched bands and windows to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using registered before-after raw profiles, spectrum settings and amplitude ratio, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Band-amplitude reduction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「頻帶振幅衰減」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出相同頻帶、窗函數與振幅定義；負分貝表示振幅降低如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善造成偏離的合成觀察，以同頻帶同窗函數頻譜說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Band-amplitude reduction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Matched frequency band, window and amplitude definition; negative decibels indicate reduced amplitude. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement. Explain which evidence in spectra with matched bands and windows distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 頻帶振幅衰減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Band-amplitude reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻帶振幅衰減」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Band-amplitude reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善。這個失效與「頻帶振幅衰減」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同頻帶同窗函數頻譜，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement. This failure and a measurement bias in Band-amplitude reduction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check spectra with matched bands and windows rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用同頻帶同窗函數頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善。這個失效與「頻帶振幅衰減」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同頻帶同窗函數頻譜，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement. This failure and a measurement bias in Band-amplitude reduction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check spectra with matched bands and windows rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻帶振幅衰減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Band-amplitude reduction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating.
quiz.explanation: 改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 摩擦熱輸入：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grinding frictional heat scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「摩擦熱輸入」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grinding frictional heat scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接觸作功可能分配到鋼軌、砂輪與碎屑。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 440 J。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。切向力與滑動速度恆定；結果為總接觸作功，非全進入鋼軌的熱。使用接觸功率與表面溫升作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「摩擦熱輸入」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Contact work partitions among rail, grinding wheel and debris. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 440 J. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant tangential force and sliding speed; the result is total contact work, not heat wholly entering the rail. Use contact power and surface temperature rise as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grinding frictional heat scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s；y=F*v*t=400 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s; y=F*v*t=400 J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「摩擦熱輸入」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grinding frictional heat scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 摩擦熱輸入
knowledge.text: 接觸作功可能分配到鋼軌、砂輪與碎屑。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 440 J。
knowledge.textEn: Contact work partitions among rail, grinding wheel and debris. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「摩擦熱輸入」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grinding frictional heat scale" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升

optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation.
Contact work partitions among rail, grinding wheel and debris.
quiz.explanation: 接觸作功可能分配到鋼軌、砂輪與碎屑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Contact work partitions among rail, grinding wheel and debris. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 摩擦熱輸入：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grinding frictional heat scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「摩擦熱輸入」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grinding frictional heat scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s；y=F*v*t=400 J。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=440 J。模型邊界：切向力與滑動速度恆定；結果為總接觸作功，非全進入鋼軌的熱；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s; y=F*v*t=400 J. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=440 J. Boundary: Constant tangential force and sliding speed; the result is total contact work, not heat wholly entering the rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以接觸功率與表面溫升區分模型與觀察，先用合成切向力、相對滑速及不同物體熱量分配建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use contact power and surface temperature rise to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s；y=F*v*t=400 J。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=440 J。模型邊界：切向力與滑動速度恆定；結果為總接觸作功，非全進入鋼軌的熱；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s; y=F*v*t=400 J. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=440 J. Boundary: Constant tangential force and sliding speed; the result is total contact work, not heat wholly entering the rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「摩擦熱輸入」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grinding frictional heat scale", which statement holds?

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=100 N, v=20 m/s, t=0.2 s; y=F*v*t=400 J. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 摩擦熱輸入：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grinding frictional heat scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「摩擦熱輸入」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grinding frictional heat scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以接觸功率與表面溫升區分模型與觀察，先用合成切向力、相對滑速及不同物體熱量分配建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「摩擦熱輸入」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use contact power and surface temperature rise to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic tangential force, relative sliding speed and heat partition among bodies, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Grinding frictional heat scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「摩擦熱輸入」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出切向力與滑動速度恆定；結果為總接觸作功，非全進入鋼軌的熱如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升造成偏離的合成觀察，以接觸功率與表面溫升說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Grinding frictional heat scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Constant tangential force and sliding speed; the result is total contact work, not heat wholly entering the rail. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating. Explain which evidence in contact power and surface temperature rise distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 摩擦熱輸入：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grinding frictional heat scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「摩擦熱輸入」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grinding frictional heat scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升。這個失效與「摩擦熱輸入」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接觸功率與表面溫升，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating. This failure and a measurement bias in Grinding frictional heat scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check contact power and surface temperature rise rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用接觸功率與表面溫升作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部熱量放進鋼軌會高估溫升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「摩擦熱輸入」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Assigning all heat to the rail overestimates heating.
