stages.title: 波磨再生速率與輪廓均方根值
stages.titleEn: Corrugation regrowth rate & Profile RMS
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波磨再生速率」與「輪廓均方根值」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrugation regrowth rate" and "Profile RMS": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波磨再生速率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrugation regrowth rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波磨再生速率」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrugation regrowth rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 按通過總重表示的成長率便於比較不同觀察期。本模型把 da 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 um/MGT。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。在指定噸位區間使用平均增幅；不保證線性長期成長。使用波磨振幅與通過噸位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波磨再生速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Growth per gross tonnage supports comparison across observation periods. In this model, da is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 um/MGT. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mean growth applies over the specified gross-tonnage interval; long-term linear growth is not assumed. Use corrugation amplitude and gross tonnage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrugation regrowth rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：da=12 um, M=6 MGT；y=da/M=2 um/MGT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: da=12 um, M=6 MGT; y=da/M=2 um/MGT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波磨再生速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrugation regrowth rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波磨再生速率
knowledge.text: 按通過總重表示的成長率便於比較不同觀察期。本模型把 da 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 um/MGT。
knowledge.textEn: Growth per gross tonnage supports comparison across observation periods. In this model, da is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波磨再生速率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrugation regrowth rate" is correct?
options: 按通過總重表示的成長率便於比較不同觀察期。

optionsEn: Growth per gross tonnage supports comparison across observation periods.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects.

steps.title: 波磨再生速率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrugation regrowth rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波磨再生速率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrugation regrowth rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：da=12 um, M=6 MGT；y=da/M=2 um/MGT。只把 da 增加百分之十，y=2.2 um/MGT。模型邊界：在指定噸位區間使用平均增幅；不保證線性長期成長；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: da=12 um, M=6 MGT; y=da/M=2 um/MGT. Increasing only da with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 um/MGT. Boundary: Mean growth applies over the specified gross-tonnage interval; long-term linear growth is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以波磨振幅與通過噸位區分模型與觀察，先用配準波磨振幅、累積通過總噸位及車種紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use corrugation amplitude and gross tonnage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：da=12 um, M=6 MGT；y=da/M=2 um/MGT。只把 da 增加百分之十，y=2.2 um/MGT。模型邊界：在指定噸位區間使用平均增幅；不保證線性長期成長；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: da=12 um, M=6 MGT; y=da/M=2 um/MGT. Increasing only da with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 um/MGT. Boundary: Mean growth applies over the specified gross-tonnage interval; long-term linear growth is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波磨再生速率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Original assumed example, not field operating values: da=12 um, M=6 MGT; y=da/M=2 um/MGT.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：da=12 um, M=6 MGT；y=da/M=2 um/MGT。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.instruction: 季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效。這個失效與「波磨再生速率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查波磨振幅與通過噸位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Corrugation regrowth rate can produce similar symptoms. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 均方根描述高度能量尺度但不保留相位與位置。本模型把 a1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 15.0997 um。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三點等權且已去除不相關基準偏移；不保留空間相位。使用原始輪廓與位置索引作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪廓均方根值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained. quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: a1=20 um, a2=-10 um, a3=10 um; y=sqrt((a1**2+a2**2+a3**2)/3)=14.1421 um. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪廓均方根值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Profile RMS: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪廓均方根值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Profile RMS” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以原始輪廓與位置索引區分模型與觀察，先用原始點高程、里程索引及去趨勢規則建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「輪廓均方根值」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use raw profiles and position index to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using raw point elevations, chainage index and detrending rules, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Profile RMS. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「輪廓均方根值」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出三點等權且已去除不相關基準偏移；不保留空間相位如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以原始輪廓與位置索引說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Profile RMS, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. Explain which evidence in raw profiles and position index distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以原始輪廓與位置索引區分模型與觀察，先用原始點高程、里程索引及去趨勢規則建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「輪廓均方根值」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use raw profiles and position index to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using raw point elevations, chainage index and detrending rules, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Profile RMS. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「輪廓均方根值」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出三點等權且已去除不相關基準偏移；不保留空間相位如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以原始輪廓與位置索引說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Profile RMS, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. Explain which evidence in raw profiles and position index distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輪廓均方根值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Profile RMS"?
options: 本單元以原始輪廓與位置索引區分模型與觀察，先用原始點高程、里程索引及去趨勢規則建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變分析頻帶會製造虛假的改善
optionsEn: Use raw profiles and position index to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing the analysis band creates an artificial improvement.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以原始輪廓與位置索引區分模型與觀察，先用原始點高程、里程索引及去趨勢規則建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use raw profiles and position index to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪廓均方根值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Profile RMS: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪廓均方根值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Profile RMS” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷。這個失效與「輪廓均方根值」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始輪廓與位置索引，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. This failure and a measurement bias in Profile RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check raw profiles and position index rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用原始輪廓與位置索引作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷。這個失效與「輪廓均方根值」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始輪廓與位置索引，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. This failure and a measurement bias in Profile RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check raw profiles and position index rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪廓均方根值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Profile RMS" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 軌道幾何動態檢測
courses.summary: 軌道幾何動態檢測以「動態幾何量測取樣基準與事件定位」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。動態軌道幾何檢測把車載慣性與相對位移轉為沿線幾何，速度、濾波及定位誤差會影響結果，單次超標需能回到明確里程與原始訊號。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops dynamic geometry sampling datums and event location through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Dynamic geometry inspection converts onboard inertia and relative displacement into track geometry; speed, filtering and localization affect results, and an exceedance must be traceable to chainage and raw signals. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 動態幾何量測取樣基準與事件定位
courses.focusEn: Dynamic geometry sampling datums and event location
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz；y=v/fs=0.05 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.055 m。模型邊界：車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=0.05 m；y=2*dx=0.1 m。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=0.11 m。模型邊界：均勻取樣且帶限訊號；兩倍點距是理論界限而非準確重建保證；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz; y=v/fs=0.05 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.055 m. Boundary: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=0.05 m; y=2*dx=0.1 m. Increasing only dx with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.11 m. Boundary: Uniform sampling and a band-limited signal; twice the spacing is a theoretical boundary, not guaranteed accurate reconstruction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 取樣空間解析度與最低無混疊波長
stages.titleEn: Sampling spatial resolution & Minimum unaliased wavelength
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣空間解析度」與「最低無混疊波長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling spatial resolution" and "Minimum unaliased wavelength": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣空間解析度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling spatial resolution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣空間解析度」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling spatial resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一時間取樣率在不同速度對應不同沿程解析度。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.055 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力。使用車速與逐筆時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣空間解析度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed temporal sampling rate gives different spatial resolution at different speeds. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.055 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power. Use speed and per-sample timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling spatial resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz；y=v/fs=0.05 m。

steps.instruction: 感測與定位不同步會把缺陷移到錯誤里程。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲期間速度恆定且延遲已知；不含定位本身的偏差。使用感測器共同時鐘作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；固定延遲在高速形成更大定位誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時間延遲定位差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「弦測轉移增益」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chord transfer gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：L=20 m, lam=40 m；y=1-cos(pi*L/lam)=1 1。只把 L 增加百分之十，y=1.15643 1。模型邊界：長度是完整對稱弦長，測點在中點；輸入為單一正弦輪廓；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: L=20 m, lam=40 m; y=1-cos(pi*L/lam)=1 1. Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.15643 1. Boundary: Length is the complete symmetric chord with a midpoint sensor; input is a single sinusoidal profile; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應區分模型與觀察，先用已知振幅波長的模型輪廓及弦端中點座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use chord response to a known sinusoidal profile to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 弦測轉移增益：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「弦測轉移增益」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Chord transfer gain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應區分模型與觀察，先用已知振幅波長的模型輪廓及弦端中點座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「弦測轉移增益」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use chord response to a known sinusoidal profile to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model profile with known amplitude and wavelength plus chord-end and midpoint coordinates, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Chord transfer gain. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「弦測轉移增益」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出長度是完整對稱弦長，測點在中點；輸入為單一正弦輪廓如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較造成偏離的合成觀察，以已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Chord transfer gain, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Length is the complete symmetric chord with a midpoint sensor; input is a single sinusoidal profile. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands. Explain which evidence in chord response to a known sinusoidal profile distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 弦測轉移增益：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chord transfer gain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「弦測轉移增益」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Chord transfer gain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較。這個失效與「弦測轉移增益」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands. This failure and a measurement bias in Chord transfer gain can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check chord response to a known sinusoidal profile rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 局部扭轉估算與離群點比例
stages.titleEn: Local track twist & Outlier fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「局部扭轉估算」與「離群點比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Local track twist" and "Outlier fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 局部扭轉估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local track twist: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部扭轉估算」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local track twist” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超高差必須附帶量測基長才能定義扭轉。本模型把 dc 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉。使用同一基長兩端超高作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部扭轉估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cant difference requires a measurement base to define twist. In this model, dc is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented. Use cant at both ends of one defined base as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local track twist” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dc=6 mm, base=3 m；y=dc/base=2 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dc=6 mm, base=3 m; y=dc/base=2 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部扭轉估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local track twist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dc=6 mm, base=3 m；y=dc/base=2 mm/m。只把 dc 增加百分之十，y=2.2 mm/m。模型邊界：兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dc=6 mm, base=3 m; y=dc/base=2 mm/m. Increasing only dc with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 mm/m. Boundary: Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同一基長兩端超高區分模型與觀察，先用同基準雙端超高、基長及正負方向標記建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use cant at both ends of one defined base to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local track twist” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以同一基長兩端超高區分模型與觀察，先用同基準雙端超高、基長及正負方向標記建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「局部扭轉估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use cant at both ends of one defined base to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using endpoint cant on one datum, base length and sign-convention markers, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Local track twist. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「局部扭轉估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代造成偏離的合成觀察，以同一基長兩端超高說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Local track twist, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable. Explain which evidence in cant at both ends of one defined base distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 局部扭轉估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local track twist: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部扭轉估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local track twist” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代。這個失效與「局部扭轉估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同一基長兩端超高，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable. This failure and a measurement bias in Local track twist can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check cant at both ends of one defined base rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用同一基長兩端超高作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 離群點比例：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「離群點比例」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 離群比例描述資料品質但不指出異常是設備或真實缺陷。本模型把 bad 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 0.45 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。異常標記規則與總樣本窗固定；比例不區分感測故障與真缺陷。使用原始波形與重複通過比對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「離群點比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Outlier fraction describes data quality but does not identify sensor faults versus actual defects. In this model, bad is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 0.45 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Outlier rule and sample window are fixed; the ratio does not distinguish sensor faults from real defects. Use raw traces and repeat-pass comparison as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outlier fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：bad=8 count, n=2000 count；y=bad/n*100=0.4 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: bad=8 count, n=2000 count; y=bad/n*100=0.4 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「離群點比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 本單元以原始波形與重複通過比對區分模型與觀察，先用保留未刪除原始訊號、標記規則及重複通過資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「離群點比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use raw traces and repeat-pass comparison to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 離群點比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outlier fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「離群點比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outlier fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷。這個失效與「離群點比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始波形與重複通過比對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect. This failure and a measurement bias in Outlier fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check raw traces and repeat-pass comparison rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用原始波形與重複通過比對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 重複通過差值：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 同里程比較前需先校正位置偏移。本模型把 x1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.92 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩次資料已配準至同里程與相同方向；量測條件可比較。使用交叉相關與固定地標作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複通過差值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.92 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions. Use cross-correlation and fixed landmarks as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeat-pass difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：x1=2.2 mm, x2=1.5 mm；y=x1-x2=0.7 mm。只把 x1 增加百分之十，y=0.92 mm。模型邊界：兩次資料已配準至同里程與相同方向；量測條件可比較；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: x1=2.2 mm, x2=1.5 mm; y=x1-x2=0.7 mm. Increasing only x1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.92 mm. Boundary: Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeat-pass difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以交叉相關與固定地標區分模型與觀察，先用固定地標定位、交叉相關位移及配準後殘差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「重複通過差值」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use cross-correlation and fixed landmarks to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using fixed-landmark registration, correlation displacement and registered residuals, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Repeat-pass difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「重複通過差值」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩次資料已配準至同里程與相同方向；量測條件可比較如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化造成偏離的合成觀察，以交叉相關與固定地標說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Repeat-pass difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different. Explain which evidence in cross-correlation and fixed landmarks distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 重複通過差值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeat-pass difference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複通過差值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeat-pass difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化。這個失效與「重複通過差值」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查交叉相關與固定地標，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different. This failure and a measurement bias in Repeat-pass difference can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check cross-correlation and fixed landmarks rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用交叉相關與固定地標作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

steps.title: 檢測率統計：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Detection recall: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢測率統計」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Detection recall” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 檢出率須使用含漏檢的已知真值集。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 90.4762 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。真值集完整且事件配對規則固定；結果是樣本召回率。使用盲測標註與事件配對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢測率統計」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Recall requires a known truth set including missed defects. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 90.4762 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. The truth set is complete and event-matching rule fixed; the result is sample recall. Use blinded truth labels and event matching as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Counting only reported events hides misses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Detection recall” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=18 count, FN=2 count；y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=18 count, FN=2 count; y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only reported events hides misses." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢測率統計」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=18 count, FN=2 count；y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent。只把 TP 增加一個整數單位，y=90.4762 percent。模型邊界：真值集完整且事件配對規則固定；結果是樣本召回率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=18 count, FN=2 count; y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent. Increasing only TP with an increase of one whole unit gives y=90.4762 percent. Boundary: The truth set is complete and event-matching rule fixed; the result is sample recall; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以盲測標註與事件配對區分模型與觀察，先用盲測真值表、逐事件判定及漏檢清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢測率統計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Detection recall” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以盲測標註與事件配對區分模型與觀察，先用盲測真值表、逐事件判定及漏檢清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢測率統計」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use blinded truth labels and event matching to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using blinded truth table, event-by-event decisions and missed-event list, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Detection recall. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「檢測率統計」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出真值集完整且事件配對規則固定；結果是樣本召回率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢造成偏離的合成觀察，以盲測標註與事件配對說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Detection recall, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: The truth set is complete and event-matching rule fixed; the result is sample recall. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Counting only reported events hides misses. Explain which evidence in blinded truth labels and event matching distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only reported events hides misses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 檢測率統計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detection recall: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢測率統計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Detection recall” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。這個失效與「檢測率統計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測標註與事件配對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only reported events hides misses. This failure and a measurement bias in Detection recall can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded truth labels and event matching rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用盲測標註與事件配對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Counting only reported events hides misses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only reported events hides misses." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

courses.title: 鋼軌超音波探傷
courses.summary: 鋼軌超音波探傷以「聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。超音波探傷以聲束與缺陷交互作用取得間接證據，耦合、角度和鋼軌幾何會改變回波；沒有回波不能獨立證明沒有裂紋。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops sound paths refraction coupling blind zones and defect evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Ultrasonic testing obtains indirect evidence from beam-defect interaction; coupling, angle and rail geometry alter echoes, so absence of an echo alone does not prove absence of a crack. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據
courses.focusEn: Sound paths refraction coupling blind zones and defect evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=77.7817 mm。模型邊界：角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm. Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=77.7817 mm. Boundary: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 垂直回波深度與斜入射聲程
stages.titleEn: Normal echo depth & Oblique sound path
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直回波深度」與「斜入射聲程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Normal echo depth" and "Oblique sound path": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直回波深度」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Normal echo depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 64.9 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一。使用已知厚度試塊的回波時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直回波深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 64.9 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector. Use echo time from a block of known thickness as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Normal echo depth” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直回波深度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Normal echo depth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍
脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。

optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth.
Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直回波深度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Normal echo depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use echo time from a block of known thickness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直回波深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Normal echo depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「垂直回波深度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use echo time from a block of known thickness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using known-thickness teaching block, time-zero calibration and full echo waveform, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Normal echo depth. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「垂直回波深度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍造成偏離的合成觀察，以已知厚度試塊的回波時間說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Normal echo depth, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. Explain which evidence in echo time from a block of known thickness distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「垂直回波深度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using known-thickness teaching block, time-zero calibration and full echo waveform, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. quiz.question: 要驗證「垂直回波深度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Normal echo depth"?
options: 本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂直回波深度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Normal echo depth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍。這個失效與「垂直回波深度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知厚度試塊的回波時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. This failure and a measurement bias in Normal echo depth can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check echo time from a block of known thickness rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用已知厚度試塊的回波時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍。這個失效與「垂直回波深度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知厚度試塊的回波時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. This failure and a measurement bias in Normal echo depth can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check echo time from a block of known thickness rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 斜入射聲程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Oblique sound path: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斜入射聲程」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Oblique sound path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 斜聲束聲程大於垂向深度。本模型把 depth 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 77.7817 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路。使用折射角與反射體位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把聲程直接當深度會錯定位，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斜入射聲程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An oblique beam travels farther than the vertical depth. In this model, depth is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 77.7817 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated. Use refracted angle and reflector location as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Oblique sound path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把聲程直接當深度會錯定位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斜入射聲程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Oblique sound path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
