steps.title: 斜入射聲程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Oblique sound path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜入射聲程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Oblique sound path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=77.7817 mm。模型邊界：角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm. Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=77.7817 mm. Boundary: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以折射角與反射體位置區分模型與觀察，先用模型折射角、試塊反射體深度及聲程回波建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use refracted angle and reflector location to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斜入射聲程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Oblique sound path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜入射聲程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Oblique sound path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以折射角與反射體位置區分模型與觀察，先用模型折射角、試塊反射體深度及聲程回波建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「斜入射聲程」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use refracted angle and reflector location to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model refracted angle, block-reflector depth and path-time echo, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Oblique sound path. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「斜入射聲程」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把聲程直接當深度會錯定位造成偏離的合成觀察，以折射角與反射體位置說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Oblique sound path, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector. Explain which evidence in refracted angle and reflector location distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把聲程直接當深度會錯定位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以折射角與反射體位置區分模型與觀察，先用模型折射角、試塊反射體深度及聲程回波建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「斜入射聲程」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.title: 水平定位偏距與頻率波長換算
stages.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset & Frequency-wavelength conversion
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水平定位偏距」與「頻率波長換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Horizontal reflector offset" and "Frequency-wavelength conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水平定位偏距」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Horizontal reflector offset” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射體水平位置由聲程方向與深度共同決定。本模型把 depth 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 55 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定。使用探頭座標及折射角作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水平定位偏距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal reflector position depends on beam direction and depth. In this model, depth is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 55 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign. Use probe coordinate and refracted angle as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Horizontal reflector offset” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水平定位偏距」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Horizontal reflector offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水平定位偏距」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Horizontal reflector offset” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=55 mm。模型邊界：材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm. Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=55 mm. Boundary: Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以探頭座標及折射角區分模型與觀察，先用探頭固定座標、朝向標記及已知反射體位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use probe coordinate and refracted angle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水平定位偏距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Horizontal reflector offset” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以探頭座標及折射角區分模型與觀察，先用探頭固定座標、朝向標記及已知反射體位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「水平定位偏距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use probe coordinate and refracted angle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using fixed probe coordinates, orientation markers and known reflector position, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Horizontal reflector offset. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「水平定位偏距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側造成偏離的合成觀察，以探頭座標及折射角說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Horizontal reflector offset, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. Explain which evidence in probe coordinate and refracted angle distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 本單元以探頭座標及折射角區分模型與觀察，先用探頭固定座標、朝向標記及已知反射體位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「水平定位偏距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水平定位偏距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Horizontal reflector offset” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側。這個失效與「水平定位偏距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查探頭座標及折射角，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. This failure and a measurement bias in Horizontal reflector offset can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check probe coordinate and refracted angle rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用探頭座標及折射角作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

steps.instruction: 背壁回波可協助監測耦合但也受幾何與材質影響。本模型把 back 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.66 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。基準與目前回波使用相同幾何、增益及材質；比例不是單獨耦合真值。使用背壁回波與表面狀況作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「耦合訊號監測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backwall echoes help monitor coupling but also depend on geometry and material. In this model, back is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.66 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Baseline and current echoes share geometry, gain and material; the ratio is not independent coupling truth. Use backwall echo and surface condition as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coupling signal ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：back=0.6 1, baseline=1 1；y=back/baseline=0.6 1。只把 back 增加百分之十，y=0.66 1。模型邊界：基準與目前回波使用相同幾何、增益及材質；比例不是單獨耦合真值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: back=0.6 1, baseline=1 1; y=back/baseline=0.6 1. Increasing only back with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.66 1. Boundary: Baseline and current echoes share geometry, gain and material; the ratio is not independent coupling truth; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以背壁回波與表面狀況區分模型與觀察，先用背壁回波、表面條件影像及另一參考反射體建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use backwall echo and surface condition to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以背壁回波與表面狀況區分模型與觀察，先用背壁回波、表面條件影像及另一參考反射體建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「耦合訊號監測」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use backwall echo and surface condition to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using backwall echoes, surface-condition images and another reference reflector, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Coupling signal ratio. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Coupling signal ratio, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Baseline and current echoes share geometry, gain and material; the ratio is not independent coupling truth. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together. steps.failure: 注意干擾：耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 耦合訊號監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coupling signal ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「耦合訊號監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coupling signal ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱。這個失效與「耦合訊號監測」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查背壁回波與表面狀況，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together. This failure and a measurement bias in Coupling signal ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check backwall echo and surface condition rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用背壁回波與表面狀況作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 有已知真值的盲測才能估計樣本漏檢比例。本模型把 misses 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 13.3333 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。所有真缺陷樣本皆列入且判定規則固定；不外推為通用檢出率。使用盲測反射體清單與報告作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只保留成功案例會使績效失真，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「盲測漏檢比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A blinded set with known truth is required to estimate sample miss fraction. In this model, misses is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 13.3333 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. All true-defect samples are included with fixed decision rules; no universal detection rate is inferred. Use blinded reflector inventory and test report as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Keeping only successful cases distorts performance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：misses=3 count, total=30 count；y=misses/total*100=10 percent。只把 misses 增加一個整數單位，y=13.3333 percent。模型邊界：所有真缺陷樣本皆列入且判定規則固定；不外推為通用檢出率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: misses=3 count, total=30 count; y=misses/total*100=10 percent. Increasing only misses with an increase of one whole unit gives y=13.3333 percent. Boundary: All true-defect samples are included with fixed decision rules; no universal detection rate is inferred; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以盲測反射體清單與報告區分模型與觀察，先用盲測樣本編碼、已知反射體清單及逐件報告建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use blinded reflector inventory and test report to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以盲測反射體清單與報告區分模型與觀察，先用盲測樣本編碼、已知反射體清單及逐件報告建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「盲測漏檢比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 盲測漏檢比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Blind-test miss fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「盲測漏檢比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Blind-test miss fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留成功案例會使績效失真。這個失效與「盲測漏檢比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測反射體清單與報告，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Keeping only successful cases distorts performance. This failure and a measurement bias in Blind-test miss fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded reflector inventory and test report rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用盲測反射體清單與報告作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只保留成功案例會使績效失真，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只保留成功案例會使績效失真」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

courses.title: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗
courses.summary: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗以「軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌枕把扣件荷載分散至道碴或支承面，軌座與中部彎矩取決於接觸分布；承載試驗和耐久試驗需要分別定義邊界與損傷指標。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Sleepers distribute fastening loads to ballast or support surfaces; rail-seat and centre moments depend on contact distribution, so load tests and durability tests need separate boundaries and damage indicators. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久
courses.focusEn: Sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=26.4 kN*m。模型邊界：單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3；y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa。只把 M 增加百分之十，y=13.2 MPa。模型邊界：未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3; y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa. Increasing only M with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.2 MPa. Boundary: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 簡支跨中彎矩與軌枕彎曲應力
stages.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment & Sleeper bending stress
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「簡支跨中彎矩」與「軌枕彎曲應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Simply supported midspan moment" and "Sleeper bending stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 簡支跨中彎矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「簡支跨中彎矩」如何影響軌枕耐久與承載試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Simply supported midspan moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sleeper durability and load testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨中集中載重的彎矩取決於支點間距。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 kN*m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布。使用荷載與支承距離作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「簡支跨中彎矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moment under a central load depends on support spacing. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 kN*m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented. Use load and support spacing as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different test support positions prevent direct comparison; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Simply supported midspan moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「簡支跨中彎矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Simply supported midspan moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 簡支跨中彎矩
knowledge.text: 跨中集中載重的彎矩取決於支點間距。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 kN*m。
knowledge.textEn: Moment under a central load depends on support spacing. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「簡支跨中彎矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Simply supported midspan moment" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較
跨中集中載重的彎矩取決於支點間距。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison.
Moment under a central load depends on support spacing.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress.
quiz.explanation: 跨中集中載重的彎矩取決於支點間距。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Moment under a central load depends on support spacing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 簡支跨中彎矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「簡支跨中彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Simply supported midspan moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=26.4 kN*m。模型邊界：單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=26.4 kN*m。模型邊界：單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「簡支跨中彎矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Simply supported midspan moment", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不均支承會讓局部壓碎先發生
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven support can trigger local crushing first.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 簡支跨中彎矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「簡支跨中彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Simply supported midspan moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡支跨中彎矩」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using scaled-beam support positions, load cell and midspan strain, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Simply supported midspan moment. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「簡支跨中彎矩」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較造成偏離的合成觀察，以荷載與支承距離說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Simply supported midspan moment, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. Explain which evidence in load and support spacing distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡支跨中彎矩」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using scaled-beam support positions, load cell and midspan strain, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Simply supported midspan moment. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「簡支跨中彎矩」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較造成偏離的合成觀察，以荷載與支承距離說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Simply supported midspan moment, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. Explain which evidence in load and support spacing distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Simply supported midspan moment"?
options: 本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：表面附水未處理會高估吸水
optionsEn: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanation: 本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 簡支跨中彎矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「簡支跨中彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Simply supported midspan moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較。這個失效與「簡支跨中彎矩」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷載與支承距離，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. This failure and a measurement bias in Simply supported midspan moment can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load and support spacing rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用荷載與支承距離作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check load and support spacing rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「簡支跨中彎矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Simply supported midspan moment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Different test support positions prevent direct comparison.

steps.title: 軌枕彎曲應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sleeper bending stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軌枕彎曲應力」如何影響軌枕耐久與承載試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sleeper bending stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sleeper durability and load testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 彎矩除斷面模數給出線彈性極纖維應力。本模型把 M 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力。使用斷面幾何與應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軌枕彎曲應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moment divided by section modulus gives elastic extreme-fibre stress. In this model, M is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13.2 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only. Use section geometry and strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sleeper bending stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3；y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3; y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軌枕彎曲應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sleeper bending stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌枕彎曲應力
knowledge.text: 彎矩除斷面模數給出線彈性極纖維應力。本模型把 M 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: Moment divided by section modulus gives elastic extreme-fibre stress. In this model, M is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌枕彎曲應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sleeper bending stress" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力
彎矩除斷面模數給出線彈性極纖維應力。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance.
Moment divided by section modulus gives elastic extreme-fibre stress.
quiz.explanation: 彎矩除斷面模數給出線彈性極纖維應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Moment divided by section modulus gives elastic extreme-fibre stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌枕彎曲應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sleeper bending stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌枕彎曲應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sleeper bending stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3；y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa。只把 M 增加百分之十，y=13.2 MPa。模型邊界：未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3; y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa. Increasing only M with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.2 MPa. Boundary: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以斷面幾何與應變區分模型與觀察，先用模型截面尺寸、曲率應變及裂縫起始觀察建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use section geometry and strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3；y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa。只把 M 增加百分之十，y=13.2 MPa。模型邊界：未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 軌枕彎曲應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sleeper bending stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軌枕彎曲應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sleeper bending stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以斷面幾何與應變區分模型與觀察，先用模型截面尺寸、曲率應變及裂縫起始觀察建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌枕彎曲應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use section geometry and strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model section dimensions, curvature strain and crack-initiation observation, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sleeper bending stress. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「軌枕彎曲應力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力造成偏離的合成觀察，以斷面幾何與應變說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Sleeper bending stress, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress. Explain which evidence in section geometry and strain distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以斷面幾何與應變區分模型與觀察，先用模型截面尺寸、曲率應變及裂縫起始觀察建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌枕彎曲應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using model section dimensions, curvature strain and crack-initiation observation, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sleeper bending stress. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress. steps.title: 軌枕彎曲應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sleeper bending stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軌枕彎曲應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sleeper bending stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力。這個失效與「軌枕彎曲應力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查斷面幾何與應變，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress. This failure and a measurement bias in Sleeper bending stress can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check section geometry and strain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用斷面幾何與應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 預力平均壓應力與預力偏心彎矩
stages.titleEn: Mean prestress compression & Prestress eccentric moment
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預力平均壓應力」與「預力偏心彎矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean prestress compression" and "Prestress eccentric moment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預力平均壓應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean prestress compression: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預力平均壓應力」如何影響軌枕耐久與承載試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean prestress compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sleeper durability and load testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均預壓可抵消部分拉應力，但偏心也帶入彎矩。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列。使用預力值與端部應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預力平均壓應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean precompression offsets some tension, while eccentricity adds a moment. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.6 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Prestress is the effective value after losses and compression uniform; eccentric moment is separate. Use prestress and end-region strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean prestress compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2；y=P/A/1000=6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2; y=P/A/1000=6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預力平均壓應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean prestress compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預力平均壓應力
knowledge.text: 平均預壓可抵消部分拉應力，但偏心也帶入彎矩。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: Mean precompression offsets some tension, while eccentricity adds a moment. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.title: 預力平均壓應力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預力平均壓應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean prestress compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2；y=P/A/1000=6 MPa。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=6.6 MPa。模型邊界：預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2; y=P/A/1000=6 MPa. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 MPa. Boundary: Prestress is the effective value after losses and compression uniform; eccentric moment is separate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以預力值與端部應變區分模型與觀察，先用合成有效預力、截面面積及對稱軸向應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use prestress and end-region strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2；y=P/A/1000=6 MPa。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=6.6 MPa。模型邊界：預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.title: 預力平均壓應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean prestress compression: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預力平均壓應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean prestress compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以預力值與端部應變區分模型與觀察，先用合成有效預力、截面面積及對稱軸向應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「預力平均壓應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use prestress and end-region strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic effective prestress, section area and symmetric axial strains, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean prestress compression. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「預力平均壓應力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力造成偏離的合成觀察，以預力值與端部應變說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean prestress compression, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Prestress is the effective value after losses and compression uniform; eccentric moment is separate. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance. Explain which evidence in prestress and end-region strain distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 本單元以預力筋位置與幾何區分模型與觀察，先用模型預力筋位置、有效張力及截面正負方向建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「預力偏心彎矩」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use tendon positions and geometry to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model tendon positions, effective tension and section sign convention, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Prestress eccentric moment. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「預力偏心彎矩」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出預力軸線與截面形心相距指定偏心；只算對橫向軸的彎矩如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用造成偏離的合成觀察，以預力筋位置與幾何說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Prestress eccentric moment, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: The prestress line has the stated centroidal offset; only bending about a transverse axis is included. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action. Explain which evidence in tendon positions and geometry distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

steps.title: 預力偏心彎矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prestress eccentric moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預力偏心彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prestress eccentric moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用。這個失效與「預力偏心彎矩」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查預力筋位置與幾何，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action. This failure and a measurement bias in Prestress eccentric moment can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check tendon positions and geometry rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用預力筋位置與幾何作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action. This failure and a measurement bias in Prestress eccentric moment can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check tendon positions and geometry rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預力偏心彎矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection.

stages.title: 彈性撓度檢核與軌座接觸壓力
stages.titleEn: Elastic deflection check & Rail-seat contact pressure
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性撓度檢核」與「軌座接觸壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic deflection check" and "Rail-seat contact pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性撓度檢核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic deflection check: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性撓度檢核」如何影響軌枕耐久與承載試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic deflection check” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sleeper durability and load testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁撓度對跨度呈三次方依賴。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.87733 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻簡支梁受跨中力、微小撓度且忽略剪切變形。使用載重位移與支點沉陷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性撓度檢核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Simply supported beam deflection depends on span cubed. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.87733 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform simply supported beam under a central load, small deflection and negligible shear deformation. Use load-displacement and support settlement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic deflection check” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60000 N, L=1.6 m, E=30000000000 Pa, I=0.0001 m4; y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000=1.70667 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性撓度檢核」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic deflection check”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彈性撓度檢核
knowledge.text: 簡支梁撓度對跨度呈三次方依賴。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.87733 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Simply supported beam deflection depends on span cubed. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彈性撓度檢核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic deflection check" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不均支承會讓局部壓碎先發生
簡支梁撓度對跨度呈三次方依賴。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven support can trigger local crushing first.
Simply supported beam deflection depends on span cubed.
quiz.explanation: 簡支梁撓度對跨度呈三次方依賴。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Simply supported beam deflection depends on span cubed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彈性撓度檢核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic deflection check: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性撓度檢核」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic deflection check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60000 N, L=1.6 m, E=30000000000 Pa, I=0.0001 m4；y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000=1.70667 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.87733 mm。模型邊界：均勻簡支梁受跨中力、微小撓度且忽略剪切變形；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60000 N, L=1.6 m, E=30000000000 Pa, I=0.0001 m4; y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000=1.70667 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.87733 mm. Boundary: Uniform simply supported beam under a central load, small deflection and negligible shear deformation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以載重位移與支點沉陷區分模型與觀察，先用跨中位移計、兩支點沉陷量及同步載荷建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use load-displacement and support settlement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60000 N, L=1.6 m, E=30000000000 Pa, I=0.0001 m4；y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000=1.70667 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.87733 mm。模型邊界：均勻簡支梁受跨中力、微小撓度且忽略剪切變形；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60000 N, L=1.6 m, E=30000000000 Pa, I=0.0001 m4; y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000=1.70667 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.87733 mm. Boundary: Uniform simply supported beam under a central load, small deflection and negligible shear deformation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
