steps.title: 彈性撓度檢核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elastic deflection check: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性撓度檢核」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic deflection check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以載重位移與支點沉陷區分模型與觀察，先用跨中位移計、兩支點沉陷量及同步載荷建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「彈性撓度檢核」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use load-displacement and support settlement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using midspan displacement gauge, settlement of both supports and synchronized load, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Elastic deflection check. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「彈性撓度檢核」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻簡支梁受跨中力、微小撓度且忽略剪切變形如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度造成偏離的合成觀察，以載重位移與支點沉陷說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Elastic deflection check, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform simply supported beam under a central load, small deflection and negligible shear deformation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection. Explain which evidence in load-displacement and support settlement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Support settlement can be mistaken for specimen deflection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 軌座接觸壓力：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 不均支承會讓局部壓碎先發生。這個失效與「軌座接觸壓力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接觸印跡與壓力分布，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven support can trigger local crushing first. This failure and a measurement bias in Rail-seat contact pressure can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check contact imprint and pressure distribution rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven support can trigger local crushing first." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 裂縫開口變化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crack-opening change: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂縫開口變化」如何影響軌枕耐久與承載試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack-opening change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sleeper durability and load testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫變化要在相同荷載和溫度下比較。本模型把 w1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.032 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同一裂縫位置、載荷及溫度；差值不自動等於不可逆損傷。使用裂縫計與同步載重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；荷載不同會被誤判為永久裂縫成長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂縫開口變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crack changes require matched load and temperature. In this model, w1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 0.032 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Same crack location, load and temperature; the difference is not automatically irreversible damage. Use crack gauge and synchronized load as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different loads can resemble permanent crack growth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crack-opening change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w1=0.08 mm, w2=0.12 mm；y=w2-w1=0.04 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: w1=0.08 mm, w2=0.12 mm; y=w2-w1=0.04 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：荷載不同會被誤判為永久裂縫成長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different loads can resemble permanent crack growth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂縫開口變化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 裂縫開口變化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crack-opening change: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂縫開口變化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack-opening change” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w1=0.08 mm, w2=0.12 mm；y=w2-w1=0.04 mm。只把 w1 增加百分之十，y=0.032 mm。模型邊界：同一裂縫位置、載荷及溫度；差值不自動等於不可逆損傷；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: w1=0.08 mm, w2=0.12 mm; y=w2-w1=0.04 mm. Increasing only w1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.032 mm. Boundary: Same crack location, load and temperature; the difference is not automatically irreversible damage; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以裂縫計與同步載重區分模型與觀察，先用裂縫計零點、同步載荷溫度及卸載後讀值建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use crack gauge and synchronized load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack-opening change” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以裂縫計與同步載重區分模型與觀察，先用裂縫計零點、同步載荷溫度及卸載後讀值建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「裂縫開口變化」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Crack-opening change, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Same crack location, load and temperature; the difference is not automatically irreversible damage. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Different loads can resemble permanent crack growth. steps.failure: 注意干擾：荷載不同會被誤判為永久裂縫成長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

quiz.explanation: 本單元以共振頻率及試件質量區分模型與觀察，先用同模態共振頻率、試件質量含水率及支承配置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use resonant frequency and specimen mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 動態彈模比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dynamic modulus ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態彈模比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic modulus ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀。這個失效與「動態彈模比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查共振頻率及試件質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference. This failure and a measurement bias in Dynamic modulus ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check resonant frequency and specimen mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用共振頻率及試件質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

courses.title: 高速道岔組裝
courses.summary: 高速道岔組裝以「道岔線形組裝公差與輪軌導引」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。高速道岔不是單一轉向角，而是尖軌、導曲線與轍叉協同導引；各構件公差需回到共同中心線和輪對通過包絡。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops turnout alignment assembly tolerances and wheel guidance through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A high-speed turnout is not a single angle but coordinated guidance by switch rails, closure curves and crossing; component tolerances need one centreline and wheelset passage envelope. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 道岔線形組裝公差與輪軌導引
courses.focusEn: Turnout alignment assembly tolerances and wheel guidance
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=2.89127 degree。模型邊界：道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=45 m/s, R=1800 m；y=v**2/R=1.125 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.36125 m/s2。模型邊界：固定分歧速度及圓曲線半徑；不含超高與車體滾動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=18 1; y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.89127 degree. Boundary: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=45 m/s, R=1800 m; y=v**2/R=1.125 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.36125 m/s2. Boundary: Constant diverging speed and circular radius; cant and body roll are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 道岔分岔角估算與導曲線橫向加速
stages.titleEn: Turnout divergence angle & Closure-curve lateral acceleration
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「道岔分岔角估算」與「導曲線橫向加速」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Turnout divergence angle" and "Closure-curve lateral acceleration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 道岔分岔角估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Turnout divergence angle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「道岔分岔角估算」如何影響高速道岔組裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turnout divergence angle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High-speed turnout assembly”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分岔角與道岔號數的定義需一致。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 2.89127 degree。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用。使用中心線方向與號數定義作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用不同號數定義會錯配構件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「道岔分岔角估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Divergence angle requires a consistent turnout-number definition. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 2.89127 degree. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply. Use centreline directions and turnout-number definition as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Turnout divergence angle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=18 1; y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用不同號數定義會錯配構件」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「道岔分岔角估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Turnout divergence angle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 道岔分岔角估算
knowledge.text: 分岔角與道岔號數的定義需一致。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 2.89127 degree。
knowledge.textEn: Divergence angle requires a consistent turnout-number definition. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「道岔分岔角估算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turnout divergence angle" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用不同號數定義會錯配構件

steps.title: 道岔分岔角估算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turnout divergence angle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「道岔分岔角估算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Turnout divergence angle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=2.89127 degree。模型邊界：道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=18 1; y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.89127 degree. Boundary: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以中心線方向與號數定義區分模型與觀察，先用模型兩中心線方位、號數定義及角度量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use centreline directions and turnout-number definition to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=2.89127 degree。模型邊界：道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「道岔分岔角估算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 混用不同號數定義會錯配構件。這個失效與「道岔分岔角估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查中心線方向與號數定義，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components. This failure and a measurement bias in Turnout divergence angle can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check centreline directions and turnout-number definition rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用中心線方向與號數定義作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用不同號數定義會錯配構件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用不同號數定義會錯配構件」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 分歧路徑速度與導曲線半徑共同決定幾何橫向需求。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.36125 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定分歧速度及圓曲線半徑；不含超高與車體滾動。使用分歧速度與曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直股速度不能直接當作側股速度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導曲線橫向加速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diverging speed and closure radius jointly determine geometric lateral demand. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. Constant diverging speed and circular radius; cant and body roll are excluded. Use diverging speed and curvature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure-curve lateral acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 導曲線橫向加速：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure-curve lateral acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直股速度不能直接當作側股速度。這個失效與「導曲線橫向加速」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查分歧速度與曲率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed. This failure and a measurement bias in Closure-curve lateral acceleration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check diverging speed and curvature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直股速度不能直接當作側股速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 兩端座標閉合：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 道岔端點閉合應保留方向與共同座標。本模型把 dx 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.72022 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向。使用獨立控制點測量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「兩端座標閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turnout endpoint closure needs direction and common coordinates. In this model, dx is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.72022 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction. Use independent control-point survey as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Endpoint coordinate closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm；y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=3.72022 mm。模型邊界：端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 兩端座標閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Endpoint coordinate closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩端座標閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Endpoint coordinate closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以獨立控制點測量區分模型與觀察，先用獨立控制點、東北向殘差及閉合向量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「兩端座標閉合」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent control-point survey to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using independent control points, east-north residuals and closure vector, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Endpoint coordinate closure. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「兩端座標閉合」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略造成偏離的合成觀察，以獨立控制點測量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Endpoint coordinate closure, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. Explain which evidence in independent control-point survey distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 兩端座標閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Endpoint coordinate closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩端座標閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Endpoint coordinate closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。這個失效與「兩端座標閉合」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查獨立控制點測量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. This failure and a measurement bias in Endpoint coordinate closure can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check independent control-point survey rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用獨立控制點測量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。這個失效與「兩端座標閉合」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查獨立控制點測量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Cross-check independent control-point survey rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「兩端座標閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Endpoint coordinate closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形
optionsEn: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load.
quiz.explanation: 整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支承高差坡度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support-level slope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支承高差坡度」如何影響高速道岔組裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support-level slope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High-speed turnout assembly”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續支承高程影響道岔平順而非只看單點高度。本模型把 dz 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。高差與長度採同一路徑及基準；以平均坡度代表該段。使用各長岔枕高程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承高差坡度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support-level continuity governs smoothness beyond individual point heights. In this model, dz is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.55 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Height difference and length share one path and datum; the result is segment-average slope. Use levels of successive bearers as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support-level slope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=2 mm, L=4 m；y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=2 mm, L=4 m; y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支承高差坡度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support-level slope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支承高差坡度
knowledge.text: 連續支承高程影響道岔平順而非只看單點高度。本模型把 dz 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 mm/m。
knowledge.textEn: Support-level continuity governs smoothness beyond individual point heights. In this model, dz is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支承高差坡度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support-level slope" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形
連續支承高程影響道岔平順而非只看單點高度。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：底座鬆動會使命令行程不等於有效尖軌行程
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load.
Support-level continuity governs smoothness beyond individual point heights.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loose support makes commanded travel differ from useful rail movement.
quiz.explanation: 連續支承高程影響道岔平順而非只看單點高度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support-level continuity governs smoothness beyond individual point heights. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支承高差坡度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support-level slope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支承高差坡度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support-level slope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=2 mm, L=4 m；y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m。只把 dz 增加百分之十，y=0.55 mm/m。模型邊界：高差與長度採同一路徑及基準；以平均坡度代表該段；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=2 mm, L=4 m; y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m. Increasing only dz with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 mm/m. Boundary: Height difference and length share one path and datum; the result is segment-average slope; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以各長岔枕高程區分模型與觀察，先用各岔枕模型高程、支承位置及載重前後剖面建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use levels of successive bearers to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=2 mm, L=4 m；y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m。只把 dz 增加百分之十，y=0.55 mm/m。模型邊界：高差與長度採同一路徑及基準；以平均坡度代表該段；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=2 mm, L=4 m; y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m. Increasing only dz with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 mm/m. Boundary: Height difference and length share one path and datum; the result is segment-average slope; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=2 mm, L=4 m; y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支承高差坡度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support-level slope: testing and verification

steps.title: 支承高差坡度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support-level slope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支承高差坡度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support-level slope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形。這個失效與「支承高差坡度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各長岔枕高程，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load. This failure and a measurement bias in Support-level slope can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check levels of successive bearers rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用各長岔枕高程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.titleEn: Switch-rail relative movement & Assembly tolerance stack

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Switch-rail relative movement" and "Assembly tolerance stack": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 尖軌相對位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Switch-rail relative movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「尖軌相對位移」如何影響高速道岔組裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Switch-rail relative movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High-speed turnout assembly”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 尖端與根部位移差描述相對彎曲而非整體平移。本模型把 tip 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 127 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。尖端與根部位移同時且同向定義；只描述相對運動。使用尖端與根部同步位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；底座鬆動會使命令行程不等於有效尖軌行程，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尖軌相對位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tip-minus-root movement describes relative bending rather than translation. In this model, tip is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 127 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Tip and root movement are simultaneous with matched direction; relative movement only. Use synchronized tip and root displacement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Loose support makes commanded travel differ from useful rail movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Switch-rail relative movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：tip=120 mm, base=5 mm；y=tip-base=115 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: tip=120 mm, base=5 mm; y=tip-base=115 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：底座鬆動會使命令行程不等於有效尖軌行程」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loose support makes commanded travel differ from useful rail movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「尖軌相對位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Switch-rail relative movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 尖軌相對位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Switch-rail relative movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「尖軌相對位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Switch-rail relative movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：tip=120 mm, base=5 mm；y=tip-base=115 mm。只把 tip 增加百分之十，y=127 mm。模型邊界：尖端與根部位移同時且同向定義；只描述相對運動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: tip=120 mm, base=5 mm; y=tip-base=115 mm. Increasing only tip with a ten-percent increase gives y=127 mm. Boundary: Tip and root movement are simultaneous with matched direction; relative movement only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Tip and root movement are simultaneous with matched direction; relative movement only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.instructionEn: Loose support makes commanded travel differ from useful rail movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Switch-rail relative movement can produce similar symptoms. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Assembly tolerance stack” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以構件尺寸與公差方向區分模型與觀察，先用各構件尺寸紀錄、方向鏈及極值組合圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「組裝公差疊加」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use component dimensions and tolerance directions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using component dimension records, direction chain and extreme-combination diagram, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Assembly tolerance stack. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「組裝公差疊加」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出各誤差可同向達到極值；結果是最壞邊界而非標準差如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把最壞值改用均方根會低估保證邊界造成偏離的合成觀察，以構件尺寸與公差方向說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Assembly tolerance stack, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Errors may reach aligned extremes; the result is a worst-case bound rather than standard deviation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound. Explain which evidence in component dimensions and tolerance directions distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把最壞值改用均方根會低估保證邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 組裝公差疊加：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Assembly tolerance stack: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「組裝公差疊加」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Assembly tolerance stack” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把最壞值改用均方根會低估保證邊界。這個失效與「組裝公差疊加」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查構件尺寸與公差方向，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound. This failure and a measurement bias in Assembly tolerance stack can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check component dimensions and tolerance directions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用構件尺寸與公差方向作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把最壞值改用均方根會低估保證邊界，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把最壞值改用均方根會低估保證邊界」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「組裝公差疊加」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload.

stages.title: 緊固件夾持分配與輪緣導引時間
stages.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation & Flange-guidance time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「緊固件夾持分配」與「輪緣導引時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fastener clamp-force allocation" and "Flange-guidance time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「緊固件夾持分配」如何影響高速道岔組裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fastener clamp-force allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High-speed turnout assembly”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分。使用各緊固點力或伸長作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「緊固件夾持分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing. Use force or extension at each fastening point as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fastener clamp-force allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「緊固件夾持分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fastener clamp-force allocation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 緊固件夾持分配
knowledge.text: 均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 kN。
knowledge.textEn: Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「緊固件夾持分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fastener clamp-force allocation" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同
均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：取樣不足可能漏掉短時接觸
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload.
Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Insufficient sampling misses short contact events.
quiz.explanation: 均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「緊固件夾持分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fastener clamp-force allocation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=22 kN。模型邊界：幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 kN. Boundary: Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以各緊固點力或伸長區分模型與觀察，先用模型各點伸長、獨立夾持力及支承接觸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use force or extension at each fastening point to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=22 kN。模型邊界：幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 kN. Boundary: Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「緊固件夾持分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fastener clamp-force allocation", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: testing and verification

steps.instructionEn: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. This failure and a measurement bias in Fastener clamp-force allocation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check force or extension at each fastening point rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 量測溫差補正：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Survey temperature correction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 日照造成的溫差會混入組裝誤差。這個失效與「量測溫差補正」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查構件溫度與基準長度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sun-driven temperature difference appears as assembly error. This failure and a measurement bias in Survey temperature correction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check component temperature and reference length rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 清單完成比例不等於系統安全通過率。本模型把 done 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 92 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。完成與必需項的定義固定；數量比例不替代關鍵項判定。使用每項驗證證據與未完成項作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢驗覆蓋清單」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Checklist completion is not a system safety pass rate. In this model, done is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 92 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「檢驗覆蓋清單」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出完成與必需項的定義固定；數量比例不替代關鍵項判定如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案造成偏離的合成觀察，以每項驗證證據與未完成項說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection checklist coverage, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. Explain which evidence in evidence for each check and open items distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以每項驗證證據與未完成項區分模型與觀察，先用每項模型證據、未完成原因與關鍵項獨立判定建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢驗覆蓋清單」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use evidence for each check and open items to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using evidence for each model check, open-item reasons and independent critical-item decisions, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection checklist coverage. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「檢驗覆蓋清單」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出完成與必需項的定義固定；數量比例不替代關鍵項判定如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案造成偏離的合成觀察，以每項驗證證據與未完成項說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection checklist coverage, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. Explain which evidence in evidence for each check and open items distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢驗覆蓋清單」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inspection checklist coverage"?
options: 本單元以每項驗證證據與未完成項區分模型與觀察，先用每項模型證據、未完成原因與關鍵項獨立判定建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同
optionsEn: Use evidence for each check and open items to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以每項驗證證據與未完成項區分模型與觀察，先用每項模型證據、未完成原因與關鍵項獨立判定建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use evidence for each check and open items to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢驗覆蓋清單：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspection checklist coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢驗覆蓋清單」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inspection checklist coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。這個失效與「檢驗覆蓋清單」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查每項驗證證據與未完成項，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection checklist coverage can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check evidence for each check and open items rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用每項驗證證據與未完成項作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。這個失效與「檢驗覆蓋清單」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查每項驗證證據與未完成項，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection checklist coverage can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check evidence for each check and open items rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢驗覆蓋清單」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspection checklist coverage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用不同號數定義會錯配構件
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components.
quiz.explanation: 用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 道岔可動心軌控制
courses.summary: 道岔可動心軌控制以「可動心軌位置鎖閉與回讀一致性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。可動心軌在不同路徑下提供連續輪面支承，位置、機械鎖閉與電氣表示是三種獨立證據；命令發出並不等於路徑已可使用。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops movable frog position locking and feedback consistency through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A movable frog provides continuous running support for different routes; position, mechanical locking and electrical indication are separate evidence, and issuing a command does not establish route availability. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 可動心軌位置鎖閉與回讀一致性
courses.focusEn: Movable frog position locking and feedback consistency
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。只把 travel 增加百分之十，y=22 mm/s。模型邊界：位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s；y=timeout-move-prove=3 s。只把 timeout 增加百分之十，y=3.8 s。模型邊界：移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s. Increasing only travel with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 mm/s. Boundary: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s; y=timeout-move-prove=3 s. Increasing only timeout with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.8 s. Boundary: Movement and proving stages are sequential without overlap; timeout budget is a teaching assumption; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 心軌平均行程速度與鎖閉時間餘量
stages.titleEn: Mean frog travel speed & Locking time reserve
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「心軌平均行程速度」與「鎖閉時間餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean frog travel speed" and "Locking time reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 心軌平均行程速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean frog travel speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「心軌平均行程速度」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean frog travel speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均速度不描述起動和鎖閉區的局部速度。本模型把 travel 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 mm/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻。使用全行程位置時間曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「心軌平均行程速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean speed does not describe local speed during starting and locking. In this model, travel is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 mm/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed. Use full-stroke position-time trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean frog travel speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「心軌平均行程速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean frog travel speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 心軌平均行程速度
knowledge.text: 平均速度不描述起動和鎖閉區的局部速度。本模型把 travel 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 mm/s。
knowledge.textEn: Mean speed does not describe local speed during starting and locking. In this model, travel is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「心軌平均行程速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean frog travel speed" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s；y=timeout-move-prove=3 s。只把 timeout 增加百分之十，y=3.8 s。模型邊界：移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 本單元以命令位置鎖閉的時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用合成命令、到位、鎖閉與回讀事件時間戳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「鎖閉時間餘量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use command, position and lock timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
