Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Locking time reserve. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「鎖閉時間餘量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態造成偏離的合成觀察，以命令位置鎖閉的時間戳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Locking time reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態。這個失效與「鎖閉時間餘量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查命令位置鎖閉的時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring motor stop alone misses an unlocked state. This failure and a measurement bias in Locking time reserve can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check command, position and lock timestamps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用命令位置鎖閉的時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 數位分辨率不是絕對位置精度。本模型把 stroke 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0268555 mm/count。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。完整行程均勻分配至計數格；不含校準誤差及間隙。使用基準尺與編碼器對照作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高位元數可能掩蓋機械間隙，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「感測器分辨率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Digital resolution is not absolute position accuracy. In this model, stroke is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.0268555 mm/count. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Full stroke is uniformly divided into count bins; calibration error and backlash are excluded. Use reference gauge versus encoder reading as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position sensor resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高位元數可能掩蓋機械間隙」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash. This failure and a measurement bias in Position sensor resolution can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reference gauge versus encoder reading rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以低載模型推力及速度區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型同步電功率、機械速度與推力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「推力量級估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use low-load model force and speed to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Actuation-force scale. steps.title: 推力量級估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Actuation-force scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推力量級估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Actuation-force scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以堵轉電流直接推定有效推力可能失準。這個失效與「推力量級估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查低載模型推力及速度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stall current alone can misrepresent useful force. This failure and a measurement bias in Actuation-force scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check low-load model force and speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用低載模型推力及速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；以堵轉電流直接推定有效推力可能失準，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stall current alone can misrepresent useful force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：以堵轉電流直接推定有效推力可能失準」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Stall current alone can misrepresent useful force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 行程不一致量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「行程不一致量」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stroke discrepancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 命令與實測差描述運動鏈的未完成量。本模型把 commanded 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。命令與實測使用同一零點和行程方向；差值不直接指認原因。使用獨立位移與控制器紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；連桿鬆脫使馬達到位但心軌未到位，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行程不一致量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Command-minus-measured travel describes an incomplete movement chain. In this model, commanded is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Command and measurement share zero and direction; the discrepancy does not identify its cause. Use independent displacement and controller log as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A detached linkage lets the motor arrive without the frog; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stroke discrepancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：commanded=80 mm, measured=75 mm；y=commanded-measured=5 mm。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：連桿鬆脫使馬達到位但心軌未到位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 本單元以兩條獨立量測鏈區分模型與觀察，先用兩獨立供電量測鏈、基準尺與時間同步紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「雙感測差異量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use two independent measurement chains to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.instructionEn: Common-source sensors can agree while both are wrong. This failure and a measurement bias in Dual-sensor disagreement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check two independent measurement chains rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=20 mm/s, stale=0.3 s；y=v*stale=6 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=6.6 mm。模型邊界：陳舊期間速度恆定；結果為延遲造成的位置落後量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stale-data movement scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 舊到位表示不可當作當前鎖閉證據。這個失效與「資料陳舊位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查時間戳與現值比對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An old arrival indication is not current lock evidence. This failure and a measurement bias in Stale-data movement scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check timestamp and current-position comparison rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用時間戳與現值比對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；舊到位表示不可當作當前鎖閉證據，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An old arrival indication is not current lock evidence; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：舊到位表示不可當作當前鎖閉證據」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An old arrival indication is not current lock evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 只有獨立漏檢才可用乘積，不能套用共同原因故障。本模型把 p1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.00022 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩漏檢事件獨立且概率屬同一需求；未計共同原因。使用人工注入故障與獨立性證據作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立漏檢乘積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Only independent misses multiply; common-cause faults violate this assumption. In this model, p1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.00022 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Miss events are independent and probabilities refer to one demand; common causes are excluded. Use injected faults and evidence of independence as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Independent miss coincidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元以人工注入故障與獨立性證據區分模型與觀察，先用合成獨立及共同原因故障注入、逐事件結果建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「獨立漏檢乘積」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use injected faults and evidence of independence to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 獨立漏檢乘積：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立漏檢乘積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent miss coincidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀。這個失效與「獨立漏檢乘積」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查人工注入故障與獨立性證據，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic. This failure and a measurement bias in Independent miss coincidence can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check injected faults and evidence of independence rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用人工注入故障與獨立性證據作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 回讀掃描間距：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Feedback scan interval: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回讀掃描間距」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Feedback scan interval” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掃描週期是延遲的一部分而非全部。本模型把 fs 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 18.1818 ms。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定週期且無遺失掃描；不是端到端最壞反應時間。使用輸入輸出共同時鐘紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回讀掃描間距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scan period is only one part of latency. In this model, fs is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 18.1818 ms. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed period without missed scans; not worst-case end-to-end response time. Use input-output records on one clock as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Feedback scan interval” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：fs=50 Hz；y=1/fs*1000=20 ms。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回讀掃描間距」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：fs=50 Hz；y=1/fs*1000=20 ms。只把 fs 增加百分之十，y=18.1818 ms。模型邊界：固定週期且無遺失掃描；不是端到端最壞反應時間；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Feedback scan interval” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以輸入輸出共同時鐘紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用同一時鐘的輸入事件、掃描、通訊及輸出時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「回讀掃描間距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use input-output records on one clock to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using input-event, scan, communication and output times on one clock, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Feedback scan interval. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「回讀掃描間距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定週期且無遺失掃描；不是端到端最壞反應時間如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以輸入輸出共同時鐘紀錄說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Feedback scan interval, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed period without missed scans; not worst-case end-to-end response time. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time. Explain which evidence in input-output records on one clock distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 回讀掃描間距：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Feedback scan interval: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回讀掃描間距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Feedback scan interval” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間。這個失效與「回讀掃描間距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查輸入輸出共同時鐘紀錄，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time. This failure and a measurement bias in Feedback scan interval can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check input-output records on one clock rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用輸入輸出共同時鐘紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 道岔融雪加熱系統
courses.summary: 道岔融雪加熱系統以「道岔加熱熱損融冰與控制遲滯」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。道岔加熱需把熱量送到真正阻礙動作的位置，環境風、冰水相變與機械遮蔽會改變效果；耗電增加不能直接證明融雪能力改善。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops turnout heating heat loss ice melting and control hysteresis through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Turnout heating must deliver heat to locations that actually obstruct movement; wind, ice-water phase change and mechanical shielding alter effectiveness, so more electricity does not by itself prove better snow melting. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 道岔加熱熱損融冰與控制遲滯
courses.focusEn: Turnout heating heat loss ice melting and control hysteresis
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=58.08 W。模型邊界：隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=0.2 kg, latent=334 kJ/kg；y=m*latent=66.8 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=73.48 kJ。模型邊界：冰已在相變溫度且全部融化；不含預熱及融水升溫；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=58.08 W. Boundary: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=0.2 kg, latent=334 kJ/kg; y=m*latent=66.8 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=73.48 kJ. Boundary: Ice starts at the phase-change temperature and melts fully; preheating and warming meltwater are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 加熱電功率與冰融化潛熱
stages.titleEn: Heater electrical power & Ice melting latent heat
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「加熱電功率」與「冰融化潛熱」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Heater electrical power" and "Ice melting latent heat": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 加熱電功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Heater electrical power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「加熱電功率」如何影響道岔融雪加熱系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heater electrical power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Turnout snow-melting heaters”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固定電壓下電阻升高會降低純電阻加熱功率。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 58.08 W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗。使用隔離低壓電壓電流量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「加熱電功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At fixed voltage, increased resistance lowers resistive heating power. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 58.08 W. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded. Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Heater electrical power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「加熱電功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Heater electrical power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 加熱電功率

knowledge.textEn: At fixed voltage, increased resistance lowers resistive heating power. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「加熱電功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Heater electrical power" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置
固定電壓下電阻升高會降低純電阻加熱功率。

optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations.
At fixed voltage, increased resistance lowers resistive heating power.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only temperature rise understates melting energy.
quiz.explanation: 固定電壓下電阻升高會降低純電阻加熱功率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At fixed voltage, increased resistance lowers resistive heating power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 加熱電功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heater electrical power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「加熱電功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heater electrical power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=58.08 W。模型邊界：隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=58.08 W. Boundary: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以隔離低壓電壓電流量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型加熱器端電壓、電流及接頭溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=58.08 W。模型邊界：隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=58.08 W. Boundary: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「加熱電功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Heater electrical power", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：風速增加會使原有效功率不足
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：加熱位置錯誤會使高耗電仍無法解除卡冰
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wrong heater placement can consume power without releasing trapped ice.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 加熱電功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heater electrical power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「加熱電功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heater electrical power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以隔離低壓電壓電流量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型加熱器端電壓、電流及接頭溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「加熱電功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage model heater-terminal voltage, current and connection temperature, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heater electrical power. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「加熱電功率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置造成偏離的合成觀察，以隔離低壓電壓電流量測說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Heater electrical power, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. Explain which evidence in isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以隔離低壓電壓電流量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型加熱器端電壓、電流及接頭溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「加熱電功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage model heater-terminal voltage, current and connection temperature, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heater electrical power. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「加熱電功率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置造成偏離的合成觀察，以隔離低壓電壓電流量測說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Heater electrical power, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. Explain which evidence in isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「加熱電功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Heater electrical power"?
options: 本單元以隔離低壓電壓電流量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型加熱器端電壓、電流及接頭溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用穩態溫度推論升溫速度會失準
optionsEn: Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Steady temperature does not determine heating speed.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以隔離低壓電壓電流量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型加熱器端電壓、電流及接頭溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 加熱電功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Heater electrical power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「加熱電功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Heater electrical power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置。這個失效與「加熱電功率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查隔離低壓電壓電流量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. This failure and a measurement bias in Heater electrical power can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用隔離低壓電壓電流量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Counting only temperature rise understates melting energy. This failure and a measurement bias in Ice melting latent heat can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check ice mass and meltwater mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冰融化潛熱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ice melting latent heat" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間
只計溫升會低估融冰所需熱量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wind cooling and warm drainage extend real duration.
Counting only temperature rise understates melting energy.
quiz.explanation: 只計溫升會低估融冰所需熱量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting only temperature rise understates melting energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 理想融冰時間與對流熱損量
stages.titleEn: Ideal melting duration & Convective heat loss
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「理想融冰時間」與「對流熱損量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ideal melting duration" and "Convective heat loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 理想融冰時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal melting duration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想融冰時間」如何影響道岔融雪加熱系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal melting duration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Turnout snow-melting heaters”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量除有效功率是理想時間，下限取決於損失是否忽略。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1837 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效功率恆定且能量全部用於所列融化負荷。使用有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想融冰時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy divided by useful power gives an ideal time, with ignored losses making it a lower estimate. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1837 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Useful power is constant and all its energy serves the declared melting load. Use useful heat input and melting completion time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wind cooling and warm drainage extend real duration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal melting duration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W；y=E*1000/P=1670 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W; y=E*1000/P=1670 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wind cooling and warm drainage extend real duration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想融冰時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ideal melting duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Energy divided by useful power gives an ideal time, with ignored losses making it a lower estimate. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.title: 理想融冰時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ideal melting duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想融冰時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ideal melting duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W；y=E*1000/P=1670 s。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=1837 s。模型邊界：有效功率恆定且能量全部用於所列融化負荷；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W; y=E*1000/P=1670 s. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=1837 s. Boundary: Useful power is constant and all its energy serves the declared melting load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型有效熱功率、剩餘冰量及完成時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use useful heat input and melting completion time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W；y=E*1000/P=1670 s。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=1837 s。模型邊界：有效功率恆定且能量全部用於所列融化負荷；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Useful power is constant and all its energy serves the declared melting load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 理想融冰時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal melting duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想融冰時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal melting duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型有效熱功率、剩餘冰量及完成時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「理想融冰時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use useful heat input and melting completion time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage model useful thermal power, remaining ice and completion time, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Ideal melting duration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「理想融冰時間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出有效功率恆定且能量全部用於所列融化負荷如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Ideal melting duration, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Useful power is constant and all its energy serves the declared melting load. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Wind cooling and warm drainage extend real duration. Explain which evidence in useful heat input and melting completion time distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wind cooling and warm drainage extend real duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 理想融冰時間：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理想融冰時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.title: 鋼件顯熱負荷：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 先加熱鋼件所需熱量與融冰潛熱分屬不同帳。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 16.5 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。鋼件溫升均勻且比熱固定；不計冰的顯熱或潛熱。使用鋼件質量與平均溫升作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；巨大熱容量會造成啟動延遲，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼件顯熱負荷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heating steel and melting ice are separate energy accounts. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. Steel temperature rise is uniform and heat capacity constant; ice sensible or latent heat is excluded. Use steel mass and mean temperature rise as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Large heat capacity creates start-up delay; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel sensible-heat demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=3 kg, c=500 J/kgK, dT=10 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=15 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=16.5 kJ。模型邊界：鋼件溫升均勻且比熱固定；不計冰的顯熱或潛熱；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=3 kg, c=500 J/kgK, dT=10 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=15 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=16.5 kJ. Boundary: Steel temperature rise is uniform and heat capacity constant; ice sensible or latent heat is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以鋼件質量與平均溫升區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼件秤重、多點溫度與平均溫升建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 鋼件顯熱負荷：失效診斷

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 巨大熱容量會造成啟動延遲。這個失效與「鋼件顯熱負荷」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查鋼件質量與平均溫升，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Large heat capacity creates start-up delay. This failure and a measurement bias in Steel sensible-heat demand can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check steel mass and mean temperature rise rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼件顯熱負荷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel sensible-heat demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

巨大熱容量會造成啟動延遲。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wrong heater placement can consume power without releasing trapped ice.
Large heat capacity creates start-up delay.
quiz.explanation: 巨大熱容量會造成啟動延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Large heat capacity creates start-up delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 加熱效率比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Useful heating fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「加熱效率比例」如何影響道岔融雪加熱系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Useful heating fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Turnout snow-melting heaters”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 有效熱量比例須定義送到哪個作用區。本模型把 useful 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 68.75 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。作用區與時間窗明確且兩功率同步；不把輸入電功率全算有效熱。使用作用區熱量與輸入電能作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；加熱位置錯誤會使高耗電仍無法解除卡冰，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「加熱效率比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Useful fraction needs a defined target region. In this model, useful is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 68.75 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Target region and interval are defined and powers synchronous; input electrical power is not all useful heat. Use target-zone heat and electrical input as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wrong heater placement can consume power without releasing trapped ice; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Useful heating fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：useful=30 W, input=48 W；y=useful/input*100=62.5 percent。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「加熱效率比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 加熱效率比例：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：useful=30 W, input=48 W；y=useful/input*100=62.5 percent。只把 useful 增加百分之十，y=68.75 percent。模型邊界：作用區與時間窗明確且兩功率同步；不把輸入電功率全算有效熱；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: useful=30 W, input=48 W; y=useful/input*100=62.5 percent. Increasing only useful with a ten-percent increase gives y=68.75 percent. Boundary: Target region and interval are defined and powers synchronous; input electrical power is not all useful heat; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以作用區熱量與輸入電能區分模型與觀察，先用作用區熱量帳、輸入電功率及其他散熱路徑建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use target-zone heat and electrical input to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 加熱效率比例：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Useful heating fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以作用區熱量與輸入電能區分模型與觀察，先用作用區熱量帳、輸入電功率及其他散熱路徑建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「加熱效率比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use target-zone heat and electrical input to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using target-zone heat account, electrical input power and other heat-loss paths, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Useful heating fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「加熱效率比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出作用區與時間窗明確且兩功率同步；不把輸入電功率全算有效熱如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由加熱位置錯誤會使高耗電仍無法解除卡冰造成偏離的合成觀察，以作用區熱量與輸入電能說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Useful heating fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Target region and interval are defined and powers synchronous; input electrical power is not all useful heat. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Wrong heater placement can consume power without releasing trapped ice. Explain which evidence in target-zone heat and electrical input distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：加熱位置錯誤會使高耗電仍無法解除卡冰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrong heater placement can consume power without releasing trapped ice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 開關門檻差可以降低頻繁切換，但也改變溫度波動。本模型把 off 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加攝氏一度，輸出增加為 4 K。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。開啟與關閉溫度在同一尺度；只算門檻差，不預測動態超調。使用開關事件與溫度時間序列作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；無遲滯且有雜訊時可能快速抖動，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制遲滯帶寬」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 溫度時間常數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal time constant: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度時間常數」如何影響道岔融雪加熱系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal time constant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Turnout snow-melting heaters”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集中模型的時間常數為熱容量除總散熱導納。本模型把 C 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 330 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均溫單熱容節點及線性散熱導納；不含相變。使用階躍加熱的溫度反應作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用穩態溫度推論升溫速度會失準，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度時間常數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lumped thermal time constant is heat capacity divided by heat-loss conductance. In this model, C is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 330 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One uniform-temperature capacitance node and linear heat-loss conductance; phase change is excluded. Use temperature response to a heating step as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Steady temperature does not determine heating speed; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal time constant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=1500 J/K, H=5 W/K；y=C/H=300 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: C=1500 J/K, H=5 W/K; y=C/H=300 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用穩態溫度推論升溫速度會失準」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Steady temperature does not determine heating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=1500 J/K, H=5 W/K；y=C/H=300 s。只把 C 增加百分之十，y=330 s。模型邊界：均溫單熱容節點及線性散熱導納；不含相變；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: C=1500 J/K, H=5 W/K; y=C/H=300 s. Increasing only C with a ten-percent increase gives y=330 s. Boundary: One uniform-temperature capacitance node and linear heat-loss conductance; phase change is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 雪密度改變會讓同厚度有不同融化負荷。本模型把 area 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。雪深與雪密度在面積內均勻；結果是質量而非水當量厚度。使用雪深面積與密度樣本作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只按雪深判斷負荷會忽略濕雪，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「降雪水當量負荷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Snow density changes melting load even at equal depth. In this model, area is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.1 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Snow depth and density are uniform over area; the result is mass rather than water-equivalent depth. Use snow depth, area and density samples as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：area=0.5 m2, depth=0.02 m, rho=100 kg/m3；y=area*depth*rho=1 kg。只把 area 增加百分之十，y=1.1 kg。模型邊界：雪深與雪密度在面積內均勻；結果是質量而非水當量厚度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: area=0.5 m2, depth=0.02 m, rho=100 kg/m3; y=area*depth*rho=1 kg. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 只按雪深判斷負荷會忽略濕雪。這個失效與「降雪水當量負荷」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查雪深面積與密度樣本，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

knowledge.text: 感測器貼附不良會增加環境偏差。這個失效與「感測器偏差餘量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查獨立參考溫度與控制讀值，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Poor sensor attachment increases ambient bias. This failure and a measurement bias in Sensor-bias reserve can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check independent reference temperature and control reading rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「感測器偏差餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sensor-bias reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
感測器貼附不良會增加環境偏差。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Poor sensor attachment increases ambient bias.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations.
quiz.explanation: 感測器貼附不良會增加環境偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor sensor attachment increases ambient bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理
courses.summary: 鐵路路基過渡段處理以「剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同
courses.focusEn: Stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm；y=khard/ksoft=4 1。只把 khard 增加百分之十，y=4.4 1。模型邊界：相同載重區間的等效剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1. Increasing only khard with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 1. Boundary: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
