steps.title: 相容反力分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compatible reaction sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相容反力分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compatible reaction sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以各支承反力與共同位移區分模型與觀察，先用雙荷重元與位移基準建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「相容反力分配」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use support reactions and common displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using paired load cells and displacement datum, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Compatible reaction sharing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「相容反力分配」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個平行線性支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力造成偏離的合成觀察，以各支承反力與共同位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Compatible reaction sharing, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two parallel linear supports. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Changing one support alters force in the other. Explain which evidence in support reactions and common displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing one support alters force in the other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Establish a baseline using paired load cells and displacement datum, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Compatible reaction sharing. quiz.question: 要驗證「相容反力分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compatible reaction sharing"?
options: 本單元以各支承反力與共同位移區分模型與觀察，先用雙荷重元與位移基準建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

quiz.explanationEn: Use support reactions and common displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 相容反力分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compatible reaction sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相容反力分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compatible reaction sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。這個失效與「相容反力分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各支承反力與共同位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing one support alters force in the other. This failure and a measurement bias in Compatible reaction sharing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support reactions and common displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用各支承反力與共同位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Changing one support alters force in the other; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing one support alters force in the other." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。這個失效與「相容反力分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各支承反力與共同位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Changing one support alters force in the other. This failure and a measurement bias in Compatible reaction sharing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support reactions and common displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相容反力分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compatible reaction sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：固定點判錯會錯估位移方向
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Changing one support alters force in the other.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction.
quiz.explanation: 單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing one support alters force in the other. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 軌旁落石與異物偵測
courses.summary: 軌旁落石與異物偵測以「異物偵測覆蓋延遲與誤報漏報」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌旁異物偵測要把感測範圍、事件判定與列車防護動作連接，警報延遲和漏檢比漂亮影像更重要，正常訊號不能直接視為安全許可。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops obstruction coverage latency false alarms and missed events through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Trackside obstruction detection connects sensing coverage, event decisions and train protection; latency and missed events matter more than attractive images, and a normal signal is not automatically movement permission. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 異物偵測覆蓋延遲與誤報漏報
courses.focusEn: Obstruction coverage latency false alarms and missed events
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.11783 s。模型邊界：無初速無阻力垂落；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s；y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s。只把 sense 增加百分之十，y=0.36 s。模型邊界：順序處理無重疊；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.11783 s. Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s; y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s. Increasing only sense with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.36 s. Boundary: Sequential processing without overlap; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 落體到達時間與警報總延遲
stages.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time & Total alarm latency
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「落體到達時間」與「警報總延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Falling-object arrival time" and "Total alarm latency": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 落體到達時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落體到達時間」如何影響軌旁落石與異物偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Falling-object arrival time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想自由落體時間只是事件時間尺度。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.11783 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。無初速無阻力垂落。使用合成物體軌跡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落體到達時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal free-fall time is only an event timescale. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.11783 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Vertical fall without initial speed or drag. Use synthetic object trajectory as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Falling-object arrival time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Increasing only sense with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.36 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以端到端時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用共同時鐘事件記錄器建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以端到端時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用共同時鐘事件記錄器建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「警報總延遲」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain which evidence in end-to-end timestamps distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均網路延遲不能保證最壞反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 警報總延遲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total alarm latency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警報總延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total alarm latency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均網路延遲不能保證最壞反應。這個失效與「警報總延遲」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查端到端時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean network latency cannot guarantee worst response. This failure and a measurement bias in Total alarm latency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check end-to-end timestamps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用端到端時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均網路延遲不能保證最壞反應，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean network latency cannot guarantee worst response; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均網路延遲不能保證最壞反應」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mean network latency cannot guarantee worst response." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train travel during latency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=40 m/s, t=0.35 s；y=v*t=14 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=15.4 m。模型邊界：延遲期間等速；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=40 m/s, t=0.35 s; y=v*t=14 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=15.4 m. Boundary: Constant speed during latency; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以列車速度和警報時間區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度與警報紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use train speed and alarm time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 忽略延遲會高估保護距離。這個失效與「延遲列車前進量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查列車速度和警報時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring delay overstates protection distance. This failure and a measurement bias in Train travel during latency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check train speed and alarm time rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用列車速度和警報時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略延遲會高估保護距離，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring delay overstates protection distance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略延遲會高估保護距離」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring delay overstates protection distance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Detection recall estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只收集警報影片無法估漏檢。這個失效與「辨識召回率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測真值集，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Alarm clips alone cannot estimate misses. This failure and a measurement bias in Detection recall estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded ground-truth set rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用盲測真值集作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只收集警報影片無法估漏檢，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alarm clips alone cannot estimate misses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只收集警報影片無法估漏檢」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Alarm clips alone cannot estimate misses." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 警報精確率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「警報精確率」如何影響軌旁落石與異物偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 精確率描述警報中真事件比例。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 75.4098 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變。使用全部警報與複核結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高召回可伴隨過多誤報，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警報精確率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Precision describes the true-event fraction among alarms. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 75.4098 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Alternative count datasets with a fixed event definition and variable alarm totals. Use all alarms and review outcomes as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alarm precision estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高召回可伴隨過多誤報」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alarm precision estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以全部警報與複核結果區分模型與觀察，先用盲測複核表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「警報精確率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use all alarms and review outcomes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using blinded adjudication table, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Alarm precision estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「警報精確率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由高召回可伴隨過多誤報造成偏離的合成觀察，以全部警報與複核結果說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Alarm precision estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Alternative count datasets with a fixed event definition and variable alarm totals. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. Explain which evidence in all alarms and review outcomes distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高召回可伴隨過多誤報。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 警報精確率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alarm precision estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警報精確率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alarm precision estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高召回可伴隨過多誤報。這個失效與「警報精確率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查全部警報與複核結果，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. This failure and a measurement bias in Alarm precision estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check all alarms and review outcomes rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用全部警報與複核結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高召回可伴隨過多誤報，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高召回可伴隨過多誤報」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 罕見事件下誤報可主導警報總數。本模型把 p 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0947073 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。機率穩定且測試集具代表性。使用事件基率與正常樣本作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只報正確率會掩蓋低警報可信度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「稀有事件基率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: False alarms can dominate when true events are rare. In this model, p is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.0947073 1. This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Perspective reduces pixels on distant objects.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以天候分層運行紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用事件與天候時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use weather-stratified operating records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測試誤報頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test false-alarm rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測試誤報頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test false-alarm rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件。這個失效與「測試誤報頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查天候分層運行紀錄，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog. This failure and a measurement bias in Test false-alarm rate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check weather-stratified operating records rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用天候分層運行紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件。這個失效與「測試誤報頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查天候分層運行紀錄，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Cross-check weather-stratified operating records rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測試誤報頻率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test false-alarm rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog.

courses.title: 架空電車線懸掛系統
courses.summary: 架空電車線懸掛系統以「接觸線懸掛張力垂度與溫度補償」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。架空電車線同時是導電路徑與受拉結構，跨距、張力和支承彈性共同決定受流幾何，靜態高度並不能代表列車通過的動態接觸。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops contact-wire suspension tension sag and thermal compensation through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. An overhead contact line is both a conductor and a tension structure; span, tension and support flexibility determine current-collection geometry, while static height does not establish dynamic contact. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 接觸線懸掛張力垂度與溫度補償
courses.focusEn: Contact-wire suspension tension sag and thermal compensation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。只把 w 增加百分之十，y=0.229167 m。模型邊界：均勻載重小垂度弦；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：T=15000 N, mu=1.35 kg/m；y=sqrt(T/mu)=105.409 m/s。只把 T 增加百分之十，y=110.554 m/s。模型邊界：均勻柔弦無彎曲剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m. Increasing only w with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.229167 m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded small-sag string; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: T=15000 N, mu=1.35 kg/m; y=sqrt(T/mu)=105.409 m/s. Increasing only T with a ten-percent increase gives y=110.554 m/s. Boundary: Uniform flexible string without bending rigidity; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 跨中垂度近似與弦波傳播速度
stages.titleEn: Midspan sag approximation & String wave speed
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨中垂度近似」與「弦波傳播速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Midspan sag approximation" and "String wave speed": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨中垂度近似：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Midspan sag approximation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨中垂度近似」如何影響架空電車線懸掛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Midspan sag approximation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overhead contact-line suspension systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小垂度近似中跨距平方放大垂度。本模型把 w 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.229167 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻載重小垂度弦。使用張力與跨中高度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨中垂度近似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Span squared amplifies sag in the small-sag approximation. In this model, w is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.229167 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniformly loaded small-sag string. Use tension and midspan level as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Loss of tension changes static contact height; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Midspan sag approximation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跨中垂度近似」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Midspan sag approximation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨中垂度近似
knowledge.text: 小垂度近似中跨距平方放大垂度。本模型把 w 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.229167 m。
knowledge.textEn: Span squared amplifies sag in the small-sag approximation. In this model, w is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨中垂度近似」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Midspan sag approximation" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度
小垂度近似中跨距平方放大垂度。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部附加質量會改變波傳
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height.
Span squared amplifies sag in the small-sag approximation.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local added mass changes wave propagation.
quiz.explanation: 小垂度近似中跨距平方放大垂度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Span squared amplifies sag in the small-sag approximation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨中垂度近似：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Midspan sag approximation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中垂度近似」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Midspan sag approximation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。只把 w 增加百分之十，y=0.229167 m。模型邊界：均勻載重小垂度弦；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m. Increasing only w with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.229167 m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded small-sag string; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以張力與跨中高度區分模型與觀察，先用模型張力計與高度尺建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use tension and midspan level to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。只把 w 增加百分之十，y=0.229167 m。模型邊界：均勻載重小垂度弦；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m. Increasing only w with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.229167 m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded small-sag string; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨中垂度近似」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Midspan sag approximation", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：點數與間隔數混淆造成定位誤差

steps.instruction: 橫波速度由張力與線密度比決定。本模型把 T 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 110.554 m/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻柔弦無彎曲剛度。使用脈衝傳播時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部附加質量會改變波傳，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弦波傳播速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Ideal pulley ratio trades force against travel. In this model, weight is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. knowledge.textEn: Use wire temperature and four-terminal resistance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-voltage four-wire measurement, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Conductor DC resistance. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「導線直流電阻」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均溫直流均勻斷面如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由磨耗減面積會提高電阻造成偏離的合成觀察，以導線溫度與四線電阻說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Conductor DC resistance, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform-temperature DC conductor with constant area. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Wear-reduced area raises resistance. Explain which evidence in wire temperature and four-terminal resistance distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.

steps.title: 導線直流電阻：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conductor DC resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導線直流電阻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conductor DC resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 磨耗減面積會提高電阻。這個失效與「導線直流電阻」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查導線溫度與四線電阻，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wear-reduced area raises resistance. This failure and a measurement bias in Conductor DC resistance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check wire temperature and four-terminal resistance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用導線溫度與四線電阻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；磨耗減面積會提高電阻，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wear-reduced area raises resistance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：磨耗減面積會提高電阻」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wear-reduced area raises resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 導線焦耳損耗與風載橫向位移
stages.titleEn: Conductor Joule loss & Wind-load lateral displacement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導線焦耳損耗」與「風載橫向位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conductor Joule loss" and "Wind-load lateral displacement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導線焦耳損耗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conductor Joule loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導線焦耳損耗」如何影響架空電車線懸掛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conductor Joule loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overhead contact-line suspension systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電流平方造成導線熱損耗。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 19.36 kW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定電阻與有效值電流。使用電流均方與電阻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；脈動電流用平均值會低估損耗，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導線焦耳損耗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current squared produces conductor heating. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 19.36 kW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed resistance and RMS current. Use mean-square current and resistance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Average current understates loss under ripple; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conductor Joule loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=400 A, R=0.1 ohm；y=I**2*R/1000=16 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=400 A, R=0.1 ohm; y=I**2*R/1000=16 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：脈動電流用平均值會低估損耗」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Average current understates loss under ripple." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導線焦耳損耗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conductor Joule loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 導線焦耳損耗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conductor Joule loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導線焦耳損耗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conductor Joule loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=400 A, R=0.1 ohm；y=I**2*R/1000=16 kW。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=19.36 kW。模型邊界：固定電阻與有效值電流；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=400 A, R=0.1 ohm; y=I**2*R/1000=16 kW. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=19.36 kW. Boundary: Fixed resistance and RMS current; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以電流均方與電阻區分模型與觀察，先用合成有效值電流記錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use mean-square current and resistance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Average current understates loss under ripple. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。這個失效與「懸掛點彈性位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查支點力位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Suspension-point elastic movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support force-displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸掛點彈性位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Suspension-point elastic movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height.
quiz.explanation: 把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證
courses.summary: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證以「接觸力離線受流率與測試不確定度」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。受電弓與電車線耦合時，平均接觸力、力的散布、離線與電弧必須分開量測，單一平均值無法描述短暫中斷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops contact force contact loss and test uncertainty through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Coupled pantograph and contact-line behavior requires separate measures of mean force, dispersion, loss of contact and arcing; a mean cannot describe brief interruptions. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 接觸力離線受流率與測試不確定度
courses.focusEn: Contact force contact loss and test uncertainty
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=103.512 N。模型邊界：等權有限樣本均方根；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=103.512 N. Boundary: Equal-weight finite-sample RMS; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 平均接觸力與接觸力均方根
stages.titleEn: Mean contact force & Contact-force RMS
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平均接觸力」與「接觸力均方根」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean contact force" and "Contact-force RMS": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 平均接觸力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean contact force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平均接觸力」如何影響高速鐵路受流性能驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean contact force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 113 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等時距三筆合成取樣。使用最小力與接觸影像作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；正常平均可同時含零接觸片段，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平均接觸力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 113 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Three equally spaced synthetic samples. Use minimum force and contact images as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean contact force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平均接觸力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean contact force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平均接觸力
knowledge.text: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 113 N。
knowledge.textEn: Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平均接觸力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean contact force" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段
平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals.
Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them.
quiz.explanation: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平均接觸力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean contact force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平均接觸力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean contact force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以最小力與接觸影像區分模型與觀察，先用低載力計與同步攝影建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use minimum force and contact images to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平均接觸力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mean contact force", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同事件數可能有完全不同中斷時間
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把跨中剛度套到吊點會錯估抬升
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using midspan stiffness at a dropper misestimates uplift.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平均接觸力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean contact force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平均接觸力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean contact force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以最小力與接觸影像區分模型與觀察，先用低載力計與同步攝影建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「平均接觸力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use minimum force and contact images to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 接觸力均方根：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them. This failure and a measurement bias in Contact-force RMS can produce similar symptoms. steps.title: 力散布標準差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-force population deviation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 全體樣本標準差量化此時窗相對均值的散布。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 13.1993 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三個等權樣本的全體標準差，式內平均隨擾動重算。使用時窗分段後散布作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混合不同速度時窗會把工況差當隨機散布，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「力散布標準差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Population deviation quantifies spread about the mean in this window. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 13.1993 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Population deviation of three equally weighted samples, with the mean recalculated inside the expression. steps.instruction: 把跨中剛度套到吊點會錯估抬升。這個失效與「接觸點抬升量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接觸點與支點位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using midspan stiffness at a dropper misestimates uplift. This failure and a measurement bias in Contact-point uplift scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check contact and support displacements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. steps.title: 弓頭慣性修正：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pantograph-head inertia correction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「弓頭慣性修正」如何影響高速鐵路受流性能驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pantograph-head inertia correction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 加速度造成慣性項，感測器內力不一定直接等於接觸力。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 17.6 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。剛性弓頭的一維平動。使用加速度與力的共同相位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；質量或加速度正負號錯誤會加倍偏差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弓頭慣性修正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceleration produces an inertia term, so measured internal force may differ from contact force. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 17.6 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One-dimensional rigid-head translation. Use common phase of acceleration and force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wrong mass or acceleration sign can increase bias; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pantograph-head inertia correction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=8 kg, a=2 m/s2；y=m*a=16 N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=8 kg, a=2 m/s2; y=m*a=16 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：質量或加速度正負號錯誤會加倍偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wrong mass or acceleration sign can increase bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「弓頭慣性修正」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 弓頭慣性修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pantograph-head inertia correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「弓頭慣性修正」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pantograph-head inertia correction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=8 kg, a=2 m/s2；y=m*a=16 N。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=17.6 N。模型邊界：剛性弓頭的一維平動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=8 kg, a=2 m/s2; y=m*a=16 N. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=17.6 N. Boundary: One-dimensional rigid-head translation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以加速度與力的共同相位區分模型與觀察，先用模型力計與加速度計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use common phase of acceleration and force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以加速度與力的共同相位區分模型與觀察，先用模型力計與加速度計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「弓頭慣性修正」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 時延經車速轉換為里程錯位。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.352 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲期間等速。使用訊號對時與里程標記作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未校正時延會把缺陷定位到錯誤吊點，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「感測延遲位置偏移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 感測延遲位置偏移：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測延遲位置偏移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, delay=0.004 s；y=v*delay=0.32 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.352 m。模型邊界：延遲期間等速；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, delay=0.004 s; y=v*delay=0.32 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.352 m. Boundary: Constant speed during the delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 獨立標準不確定度可平方和合成，相關項須加共變異。本模型把 sensor 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.85227 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。零共變異的一階近似。使用各項校正與相關性作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「合成量測不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
