steps.instruction: 本單元以對照組與重複樣本區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片與盲測輪廓建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「磨耗改善比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use control group and repeat specimens to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion. steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足。這個失效與「磨耗改善比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查對照組與重複樣本，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

courses.title: 軌道旁儲能系統
courses.summary: 軌道旁儲能系統以「再生能量回收儲存與功率限制」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌旁儲能需同時滿足能量容量、充放電功率與列車事件時序，再生能量存在並不保證能被當時的儲能設備接收。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops regenerative recovery storage and power limits through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Wayside storage must satisfy energy capacity, power limits and train-event timing; available regenerative energy does not guarantee that storage can accept it at that moment. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
courses.focus: 再生能量回收儲存與功率限制
courses.focusEn: Regenerative recovery storage and power limits
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s；y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=12.2222 kWh。模型邊界：水平平動且不含旋轉慣量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=10 kWh, eta=0.85 1；y=E*eta=8.5 kWh。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=9.35 kWh。模型邊界：固定單段效率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s; y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.2222 kWh. Boundary: Level translational motion excluding rotational inertia; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=10 kWh, eta=0.85 1; y=E*eta=8.5 kWh. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=9.35 kWh. Boundary: Fixed single-stage efficiency; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 列車動能上限與回收轉換能量
stages.titleEn: Train kinetic-energy ceiling & Recovered conversion energy
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車動能上限」與「回收轉換能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train kinetic-energy ceiling" and "Recovered conversion energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車動能上限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train kinetic-energy ceiling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車動能上限」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train kinetic-energy ceiling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動能是可回收能量的上界之一，阻力與轉換損失需扣除。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.2222 kWh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水平平動且不含旋轉慣量。使用速度質量與減速能量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部動能當回收量會高估收益，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車動能上限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kinetic energy is one upper bound on recoverable energy, before resistance and conversion losses. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 12.2222 kWh. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Level translational motion excluding rotational inertia. Use speed, mass and deceleration energy as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train kinetic-energy ceiling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s；y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s; y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部動能當回收量會高估收益」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車動能上限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Train kinetic-energy ceiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列車動能上限
knowledge.text: 動能是可回收能量的上界之一，阻力與轉換損失需扣除。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.2222 kWh。
knowledge.textEn: Kinetic energy is one upper bound on recoverable energy, before resistance and conversion losses. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部動能當回收量會高估收益 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車動能上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Train kinetic-energy ceiling" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部動能當回收量會高估收益
動能是可回收能量的上界之一，阻力與轉換損失需扣除。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重複套用同一損失會低估淨回收
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit.
Kinetic energy is one upper bound on recoverable energy, before resistance and conversion losses.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting the same loss twice understates recovery.
quiz.explanation: 動能是可回收能量的上界之一，阻力與轉換損失需扣除。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Kinetic energy is one upper bound on recoverable energy, before resistance and conversion losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列車動能上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train kinetic-energy ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車動能上限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train kinetic-energy ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s；y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=12.2222 kWh。模型邊界：水平平動且不含旋轉慣量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s; y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.2222 kWh. Boundary: Level translational motion excluding rotational inertia; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以速度質量與減速能量區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度與能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed, mass and deceleration energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Level translational motion excluding rotational inertia; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Train kinetic-energy ceiling", which statement holds?

steps.title: 列車動能上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train kinetic-energy ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車動能上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Train kinetic-energy ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以速度質量與減速能量區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度與能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「列車動能上限」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed, mass and deceleration energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed and energy ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Train kinetic-energy ceiling. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「列車動能上限」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出水平平動且不含旋轉慣量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把全部動能當回收量會高估收益造成偏離的合成觀察，以速度質量與減速能量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Train kinetic-energy ceiling, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Level translational motion excluding rotational inertia. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit. Explain which evidence in speed, mass and deceleration energy distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全部動能當回收量會高估收益。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以速度質量與減速能量區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度與能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「列車動能上限」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use speed, mass and deceleration energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed and energy ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Train kinetic-energy ceiling. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「列車動能上限」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出水平平動且不含旋轉慣量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把全部動能當回收量會高估收益造成偏離的合成觀察，以速度質量與減速能量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit. Explain which evidence in speed, mass and deceleration energy distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

steps.title: 列車動能上限：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit. This failure and a measurement bias in Train kinetic-energy ceiling can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed, mass and deceleration energy rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating all kinetic energy as recovery overstates benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 單段效率只屬於其明列輸入輸出邊界。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9.35 kWh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定單段效率。使用轉換前後電能作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重複套用同一損失會低估淨回收，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回收轉換能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A stage efficiency belongs only to its stated input/output boundary. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=10 kWh, eta=0.85 1；y=E*eta=8.5 kWh。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=9.35 kWh。模型邊界：固定單段效率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=10 kWh, eta=0.85 1; y=E*eta=8.5 kWh. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=9.35 kWh. Boundary: Fixed single-stage efficiency; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Counting the same loss twice understates recovery. This failure and a measurement bias in Recovered conversion energy can produce similar symptoms. stages.title: 功率充電時間與可用荷電空間
stages.titleEn: Power-limited charging time & Available state-of-charge headroom
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「功率充電時間」與「可用荷電空間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 功率充電時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Power-limited charging time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「功率充電時間」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power-limited charging time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量除功率給出理想充電時間，短制動事件可能先結束。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 31.68 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。恆功率且無充電尾段。使用事件時長與充電功率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「功率充電時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy divided by power gives ideal charge time, but braking may end first. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 31.68 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant power without a charge taper. Use event duration and charging power as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Power-limited charging time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=8 kWh, P=1000 kW；y=E/P*3600=28.8 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=8 kWh, P=1000 kW; y=E/P*3600=28.8 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=8 kWh, P=1000 kW；y=E/P*3600=28.8 s。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=31.68 s。模型邊界：恆功率且無充電尾段；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=8 kWh, P=1000 kW; y=E/P*3600=28.8 s. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=31.68 s. Boundary: Constant power without a charge taper; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以事件時長與充電功率區分模型與觀察，先用合成功率時序積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收。這個失效與「功率充電時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查事件時長與充電功率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power. This failure and a measurement bias in Power-limited charging time can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check event duration and charging power rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用事件時長與充電功率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收。這個失效與「功率充電時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查事件時長與充電功率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power. This failure and a measurement bias in Power-limited charging time can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check event duration and charging power rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「功率充電時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間
optionsEn: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom.

quiz.explanationEn: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用荷電空間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Available state-of-charge headroom: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用荷電空間」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Available state-of-charge headroom” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可用空間由當下荷電狀態與允許上界決定。本模型把 capacity 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11 kWh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線性能量荷電映射。使用荷電估計與庫倫帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用荷電空間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Headroom depends on present state of charge and allowed upper bound. In this model, capacity is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11 kWh. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Linear energy-to-state-of-charge mapping. Use state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Available state-of-charge headroom” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1；y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1; y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用荷電空間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Available state-of-charge headroom”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用荷電空間
knowledge.text: 可用空間由當下荷電狀態與允許上界決定。本模型把 capacity 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11 kWh。
knowledge.textEn: Headroom depends on present state of charge and allowed upper bound. In this model, capacity is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用荷電空間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

可用空間由當下荷電狀態與允許上界決定。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom.
Headroom depends on present state of charge and allowed upper bound.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity.
quiz.explanation: 可用空間由當下荷電狀態與允許上界決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Headroom depends on present state of charge and allowed upper bound. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用荷電空間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Available state-of-charge headroom: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用荷電空間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Available state-of-charge headroom” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1；y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh。只把 capacity 增加百分之十，y=11 kWh。模型邊界：線性能量荷電映射；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1; y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh. Increasing only capacity with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 kWh. Boundary: Linear energy-to-state-of-charge mapping; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以荷電估計與庫倫帳區分模型與觀察，先用合成狀態估計與獨立能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1；y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh。只把 capacity 增加百分之十，y=11 kWh。模型邊界：線性能量荷電映射；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Increasing only capacity with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 kWh. Boundary: Linear energy-to-state-of-charge mapping; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 可用荷電空間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Available state-of-charge headroom: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用荷電空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Available state-of-charge headroom” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以荷電估計與庫倫帳區分模型與觀察，先用合成狀態估計與獨立能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「可用荷電空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic state estimate and independent energy ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Available state-of-charge headroom. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「可用荷電空間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性能量荷電映射如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間造成偏離的合成觀察，以荷電估計與庫倫帳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Available state-of-charge headroom, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear energy-to-state-of-charge mapping. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. Explain which evidence in state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以荷電估計與庫倫帳區分模型與觀察，先用合成狀態估計與獨立能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「可用荷電空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用荷電空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Available state-of-charge headroom” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間。這個失效與「可用荷電空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷電估計與庫倫帳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. This failure and a measurement bias in Available state-of-charge headroom can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用荷電估計與庫倫帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 電容能量窗與內阻瞬時損耗
stages.titleEn: Capacitor usable energy window & Internal-resistance instantaneous loss
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電容能量窗」與「內阻瞬時損耗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Capacitor usable energy window" and "Internal-resistance instantaneous loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電容能量窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Capacitor usable energy window: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電容能量窗」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capacitor usable energy window” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電容能量取決於電壓平方差而非電壓差。本模型把 C 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 24.4444 Wh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想定電容量且不含內阻。使用電壓與實際電容量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電容能量窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Capacitor energy depends on squared-voltage difference rather than voltage difference. In this model, C is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 24.4444 Wh. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal constant capacitance without internal resistance. Use voltage and measured capacitance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Capacitor usable energy window” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V；y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V; y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電容能量窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Capacitor usable energy window”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電容能量窗
knowledge.text: 電容能量取決於電壓平方差而非電壓差。本模型把 C 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 24.4444 Wh。
knowledge.textEn: Capacitor energy depends on squared-voltage difference rather than voltage difference. In this model, C is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱

optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Pulse-average current does not represent mean heating.
Capacitor energy depends on squared-voltage difference rather than voltage difference.
quiz.explanation: 電容能量取決於電壓平方差而非電壓差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 電容能量窗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Capacitor usable energy window: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電容能量窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Capacitor usable energy window” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V；y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh。只把 C 增加百分之十，y=24.4444 Wh。模型邊界：理想定電容量且不含內阻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V; y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh. Increasing only C with a ten-percent increase gives y=24.4444 Wh. Boundary: Ideal constant capacitance without internal resistance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以電壓與實際電容量區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低能電容縮比試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use voltage and measured capacitance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V；y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh。只把 C 增加百分之十，y=24.4444 Wh。模型邊界：理想定電容量且不含內阻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Increasing only C with a ten-percent increase gives y=24.4444 Wh. Boundary: Ideal constant capacitance without internal resistance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 電容能量窗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Capacitor usable energy window: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電容能量窗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Capacitor usable energy window” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以電壓與實際電容量區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低能電容縮比試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「電容能量窗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use voltage and measured capacitance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-energy scaled capacitor test, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Capacitor usable energy window. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「電容能量窗」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出理想定電容量且不含內阻如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量造成偏離的合成觀察，以電壓與實際電容量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Capacitor usable energy window, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Ideal constant capacitance without internal resistance. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity. Explain which evidence in voltage and measured capacitance distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observation: 連結機制：使用電流有效值與內阻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱。這個失效與「內阻瞬時損耗」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查電流有效值與內阻，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Pulse-average current does not represent mean heating. This failure and a measurement bias in Internal-resistance instantaneous loss can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check RMS current and internal resistance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內阻瞬時損耗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率
optionsEn: Pulse-average current does not represent mean heating.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 往返效率與削峰能量需求
stages.titleEn: Round-trip efficiency & Peak-shaving energy demand
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「往返效率」與「削峰能量需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Round-trip efficiency" and "Peak-shaving energy demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 往返效率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip efficiency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「往返效率」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續轉換效率相乘而非取平均。本模型把 charge 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加零點零一，輸出增加為 90.24 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同一循環且待機損耗另列。使用相同循環的輸入與輸出作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「往返效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sequential conversion efficiencies multiply rather than average. In this model, charge is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An absolute increase of 0.01 means the output increases to 90.24 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One cycle with standby losses accounted separately. Use input and output of the same cycle as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：charge=0.95 1, discharge=0.94 1；y=charge*discharge*100=89.3 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: charge=0.95 1, discharge=0.94 1; y=charge*discharge*100=89.3 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「往返效率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Sequential conversion efficiencies multiply rather than average. In this model, charge is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「往返效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Sequential conversion efficiencies multiply rather than average.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Sizing from daily energy misses instantaneous power needs.

steps.title: 往返效率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：charge=0.95 1, discharge=0.94 1；y=charge*discharge*100=89.3 percent。只把 charge 增加零點零一，y=90.24 percent。模型邊界：同一循環且待機損耗另列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: charge=0.95 1, discharge=0.94 1; y=charge*discharge*100=89.3 percent. Increasing only charge with an absolute increase of 0.01 gives y=90.24 percent. Boundary: One cycle with standby losses accounted separately; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以相同循環的輸入與輸出區分模型與觀察，先用合成完整循環電能帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use input and output of the same cycle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：charge=0.95 1, discharge=0.94 1；y=charge*discharge*100=89.3 percent。只把 charge 增加零點零一，y=90.24 percent。模型邊界：同一循環且待機損耗另列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以相同循環的輸入與輸出區分模型與觀察，先用合成完整循環電能帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「往返效率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use input and output of the same cycle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「削峰能量需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Peak-shaving energy demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表
以日平均能量選型會漏掉瞬時功率需求。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate.
Sizing from daily energy misses instantaneous power needs.
quiz.explanation: 以日平均能量選型會漏掉瞬時功率需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing from daily energy misses instantaneous power needs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 每日等效循環與再生能量接收比例
stages.titleEn: Daily equivalent full cycles & Regenerated-energy acceptance fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「每日等效循環」與「再生能量接收比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Daily equivalent full cycles" and "Regenerated-energy acceptance fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 每日等效循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Daily equivalent full cycles: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「每日等效循環」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Daily equivalent full cycles” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 充放雙向吞吐量除兩倍容量估算等效循環。本模型把 throughput 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 cycles/day。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。throughput明定為每日雙向能量總和。使用充放分項電能作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「每日等效循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bidirectional throughput divided by twice capacity estimates equivalent cycles. In this model, throughput is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.6 cycles/day. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Throughput explicitly denotes daily bidirectional energy. Use separate charge and discharge energy as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Daily equivalent full cycles” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh；y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh; y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「每日等效循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Daily equivalent full cycles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 每日等效循環
knowledge.text: 充放雙向吞吐量除兩倍容量估算等效循環。本模型把 throughput 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 cycles/day。
knowledge.textEn: Bidirectional throughput divided by twice capacity estimates equivalent cycles. In this model, throughput is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「每日等效循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Daily equivalent full cycles" is correct?
options: 充放雙向吞吐量除兩倍容量估算等效循環。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只分析成功接收事件會高估利用率
optionsEn: Bidirectional throughput divided by twice capacity estimates equivalent cycles.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Analyzing only successful events overstates utilization.
quiz.explanation: 充放雙向吞吐量除兩倍容量估算等效循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bidirectional throughput divided by twice capacity estimates equivalent cycles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 每日等效循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Daily equivalent full cycles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每日等效循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Daily equivalent full cycles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh；y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day。只把 throughput 增加百分之十，y=6.6 cycles/day。模型邊界：throughput明定為每日雙向能量總和；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh; y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day. Increasing only throughput with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 cycles/day. Boundary: Throughput explicitly denotes daily bidirectional energy; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以充放分項電能區分模型與觀察，先用合成每日充放電帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use separate charge and discharge energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh；y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day。只把 throughput 增加百分之十，y=6.6 cycles/day。模型邊界：throughput明定為每日雙向能量總和；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Increasing only throughput with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 cycles/day. Boundary: Throughput explicitly denotes daily bidirectional energy; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「每日等效循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Daily equivalent full cycles", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重複套用同一損失會低估淨回收
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting the same loss twice understates recovery.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh; y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh；y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: throughput=600 kWh/day, capacity=50 kWh; y=throughput/(2*capacity)=6 cycles/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 每日等效循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Daily equivalent full cycles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「每日等效循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Daily equivalent full cycles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以充放分項電能區分模型與觀察，先用合成每日充放電帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「每日等效循環」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use separate charge and discharge energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic daily charge/discharge ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Daily equivalent full cycles. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「每日等效循環」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出throughput明定為每日雙向能量總和如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表造成偏離的合成觀察，以充放分項電能說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Daily equivalent full cycles, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Throughput explicitly denotes daily bidirectional energy. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. Explain which evidence in separate charge and discharge energy distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以充放分項電能區分模型與觀察，先用合成每日充放電帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「每日等效循環」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use separate charge and discharge energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic daily charge/discharge ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Daily equivalent full cycles. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「每日等效循環」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出throughput明定為每日雙向能量總和如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表造成偏離的合成觀察，以充放分項電能說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. Explain which evidence in separate charge and discharge energy distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「每日等效循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Daily equivalent full cycles"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱
本單元以充放分項電能區分模型與觀察，先用合成每日充放電帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Use separate charge and discharge energy to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 每日等效循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Daily equivalent full cycles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每日等效循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Daily equivalent full cycles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表。這個失效與「每日等效循環」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查充放分項電能，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. This failure and a measurement bias in Daily equivalent full cycles can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check separate charge and discharge energy rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用充放分項電能作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表。這個失效與「每日等效循環」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查充放分項電能，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. This failure and a measurement bias in Daily equivalent full cycles can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check separate charge and discharge energy rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「每日等效循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Daily equivalent full cycles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 深度溫度與倍率差異不能由循環數單獨代表。

courses.title: 列車自動防護系統
courses.summary: 列車自動防護系統以「制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。列車自動防護把速度位置、路線許可及制動能力組成可持續檢查的包絡，離線算例只解釋邊界，不能作可上線的安全控制器。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Automatic train protection combines speed/location, movement authority and braking capability into a continuously checked envelope; offline examples explain boundaries rather than forming a deployable safety controller. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.

courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=726 m。模型邊界：水平常減速度且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s；y=v*t=36 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=39.6 m。模型邊界：延遲期間速度固定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=726 m. Boundary: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s; y=v*t=36 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=39.6 m. Boundary: Fixed speed during the delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
