steps.title: 監督訊息頻寬：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Supervisory message bandwidth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監督訊息頻寬」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Supervisory message bandwidth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用應用資料長度估算會漏掉協定開銷，所有車同時更新又可能造成短時佇列爆滿。回到「監督訊息頻寬」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Application payload length alone misses protocol overhead; simultaneous train updates can fill queues despite moderate mean traffic. Trace the input chain for supervisory message bandwidth. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻持續流量，不包含加密協商、重送尖峰或介質競爭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform sustained traffic; handshakes, retransmission bursts and medium contention are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均頻寬足夠就保證每一個封包都準時抵達」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sufficient average bandwidth guarantees on-time arrival of every packet." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 到發時間共同時基：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「到發時間共同時基」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Common timebase for arrivals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元檢查行控紀錄和車站資訊系統是否使用一致時間，避免把時鐘漂移解讀成準點率變化。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「到發時間共同時基」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether control logs and station information share a consistent timebase, avoiding interpretation of clock drift as a change in punctuality. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Common timebase for arrivals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「到發時間共同時基」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 到發時間共同時基：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Common timebase for arrivals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「到發時間共同時基」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Common timebase for arrivals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

stages.title: 營運異常警報排序與列車任務狀態管理
stages.titleEn: Ordering operational alarms & Managing train-mission states
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「營運異常警報排序」與「列車任務狀態管理」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ordering operational alarms" and "Managing train-mission states": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 營運異常警報排序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ordering operational alarms: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「營運異常警報排序」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ordering operational alarms” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將重複延誤警報與真正不同的設備異常分開，讓操作員看見原因鏈而非只看警報數。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。大量同根因警報可能淹沒最早的關鍵訊息；抑制重複訊號應保留可追溯性，不能以刪掉重要警報來美化數字。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「營運異常警報排序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate duplicate delay alarms from distinct equipment anomalies so operators can understand the causal chain rather than merely the alarm count. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability. Many alarms from one cause can obscure the first critical message. Duplicate suppression must preserve traceability rather than deleting important alarms to improve a metric. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ordering operational alarms” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「營運異常警報排序」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ordering operational alarms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Separate duplicate delay alarms from distinct equipment anomalies so operators can understand the causal chain rather than merely the alarm count. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「營運異常警報排序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

本單元將重複延誤警報與真正不同的設備異常分開，讓操作員看見原因鏈而非只看警報數。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved.
Separate duplicate delay alarms from distinct equipment anomalies so operators can understand the causal chain rather than merely the alarm count.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

steps.title: 營運異常警報排序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ordering operational alarms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「營運異常警報排序」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ordering operational alarms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「營運異常警報排序」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元安排整日營運事件的縮時重播，將重置環境、保存證據和異常重測納入測試工時。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「監督整合重播計畫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Plan accelerated replay of a full operating day, including environment reset, evidence preservation and anomaly reruns in the test-effort budget. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. knowledge.title: 監督整合重播計畫
knowledge.text: 本單元安排整日營運事件的縮時重播，將重置環境、保存證據和異常重測納入測試工時。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。
knowledge.textEn: Plan accelerated replay of a full operating day, including environment reset, evidence preservation and anomaly reruns in the test-effort budget. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「監督整合重播計畫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Supervision integration replay plan" is correct?
options: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
本單元安排整日營運事件的縮時重播，將重置環境、保存證據和異常重測納入測試工時。
只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
optionsEn: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Plan accelerated replay of a full operating day, including environment reset, evidence preservation and anomaly reruns in the test-effort budget.
Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
quiz.explanation: 本單元安排整日營運事件的縮時重播，將重置環境、保存證據和異常重測納入測試工時。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Plan accelerated replay of a full operating day, including environment reset, evidence preservation and anomaly reruns in the test-effort budget. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 監督整合重播計畫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Supervision integration replay plan: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監督整合重播計畫」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Supervision integration replay plan” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「監督整合重播計畫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Supervision integration replay plan", which statement holds?

steps.title: 監督整合重播計畫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Supervision integration replay plan: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監督整合重播計畫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Supervision integration replay plan” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「監督整合重播計畫」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For supervision integration replay plan, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「監督整合重播計畫」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for supervision integration replay plan, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For supervision integration replay plan, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「監督整合重播計畫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Supervision integration replay plan"?
options: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決
optionsEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved.
quiz.explanation: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監督整合重播計畫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Supervision integration replay plan: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監督整合重播計畫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Supervision integration replay plan” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「監督整合重播計畫」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for supervision integration replay plan. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「監督整合重播計畫」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for supervision integration replay plan. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監督整合重播計畫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Supervision integration replay plan" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。
只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
quiz.explanation: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 通訊式列車控制
courses.summary: 本課聚焦無線列控資料可信度與端到端時間邊界。從位置回報時效邊界建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把多車共用頻道與無線備援共同原因連成可驗證的介面，最後以通訊試驗證據界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies trustworthy radio train-control data and end-to-end timing bounds. Start with position-report freshness bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect many trains sharing a channel with common causes in radio redundancy as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through limits of communication-test evidence. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 無線列控資料可信度與端到端時間邊界
courses.focusEn: Trustworthy radio train-control data and end-to-end timing bounds
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究位置回報時效邊界。原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。敏感度只改 t=0.25 至 0.275 s，輸出變為 5.55 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究車地控制時序鏈：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate position-report freshness bounds. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. For sensitivity, change only t=0.25 to 0.275 s; the output becomes 5.55 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate train-to-wayside timing chain: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 位置回報時效邊界與車地控制時序鏈
stages.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds & Train-to-wayside timing chain
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「位置回報時效邊界」與「車地控制時序鏈」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position-report freshness bounds" and "Train-to-wayside timing chain": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「位置回報時效邊界」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position-report freshness bounds” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位置回報時效邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position-report freshness bounds” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly received packet always contains the present position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「位置回報時效邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Position-report freshness bounds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A newly received packet always contains the present position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「位置回報時效邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Position-report freshness bounds" is correct?
options: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.

quiz.explanationEn: Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位置回報時效邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position-report freshness bounds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位置回報時效邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position-report freshness bounds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「位置回報時效邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For position-report freshness bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「位置回報時效邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for position-report freshness bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「位置回報時效邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For position-report freshness bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Position-report freshness bounds"?

Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位置回報時效邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position-report freshness bounds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「位置回報時效邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for position-report freshness bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A newly received packet always contains the present position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「位置回報時效邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for position-report freshness bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車地控制時序鏈」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train-to-wayside timing chain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車地控制時序鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train-to-wayside timing chain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車地控制時序鏈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Train-to-wayside timing chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車地控制時序鏈

knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。
optionsEn: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages.
quiz.explanation: 本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車地控制時序鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train-to-wayside timing chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車地控制時序鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車地控制時序鏈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Train-to-wayside timing chain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「車地控制時序鏈」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For train-to-wayside timing chain, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「車地控制時序鏈」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for train-to-wayside timing chain, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車地控制時序鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Train-to-wayside timing chain"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車地控制時序鏈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Train-to-wayside timing chain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「車地控制時序鏈」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for train-to-wayside timing chain. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「車地控制時序鏈」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for train-to-wayside timing chain. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車地控制時序鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Train-to-wayside timing chain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance.
quiz.explanation: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 無線成串遺失與多車共用頻道
stages.titleEn: Bursts of radio packet loss & Many trains sharing a channel
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無線成串遺失」與「多車共用頻道」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bursts of radio packet loss" and "Many trains sharing a channel": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無線成串遺失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bursts of radio packet loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無線成串遺失」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bursts of radio packet loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較獨立丟包與隧道遮蔽造成的連續失聯，判斷重送策略是否犧牲資料新鮮度。獨立封包遺失可以相乘得到連續遺失機率，但實際無線遮蔽常造成成串遺失。增加重送次數會占用時間與頻寬，不能把可靠度與時效分開最佳化；舊封包即使最後送達，也可能已不適合當前控制。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無線成串遺失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare independent losses with continuous outages caused by tunnel obstruction, asking whether retransmission trades away the freshness of control information. Independent packet losses multiply to give a consecutive-loss probability, but radio obstruction often causes correlated bursts. Retransmissions consume time and bandwidth, so reliability and freshness cannot be optimized independently. A packet eventually delivered may already be too old for the current control decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bursts of radio packet loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 多車共用頻道：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Many trains sharing a channel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車數 trains=30 trains；每次訊息大小 bytes=240 bytes；更新頻率 rate=5 Hz；協定擴張倍率 overhead=1.6 1。公式 y=trains*bytes*8*rate*overhead/1000，代入得 y=460.8 kbit/s。邊界：均勻持續流量，不包含加密協商、重送尖峰或介質競爭。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train count trains=30 trains; message size bytes=240 bytes; update frequency rate=5 Hz; protocol overhead factor overhead=1.6 1. Formula y=trains*bytes*8*rate*overhead/1000 gives y=460.8 kbit/s. Boundary: Uniform sustained traffic; handshakes, retransmission bursts and medium contention are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在封包擷取中核對實際線上長度，將同步與錯開更新兩種情境分別量測延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual wire length in packet captures and compare delay for synchronized versus staggered updates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 在封包擷取中核對實際線上長度，將同步與錯開更新兩種情境分別量測延遲。以「多車共用頻道」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 多車共用頻道：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 只用應用資料長度估算會漏掉協定開銷，所有車同時更新又可能造成短時佇列爆滿。回到「多車共用頻道」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 移動間隔概念模型：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「移動間隔概念模型」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conceptual moving separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把列車長度、防護距離與路徑釋放時間轉為時間資源，明確區分概念模型與實際行車規則。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「移動間隔概念模型」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert train length, protected distance and route-release time into a time resource, explicitly separating a teaching model from real operating rules. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conceptual moving separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元比較車載與地面時間戳的漂移，檢查資料排序是否可能因校時跳變而顛倒。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分散時鐘一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「分散時鐘一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「分散時鐘一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 無線備援共同原因：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Common causes in radio redundancy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無線備援共同原因」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Common causes in radio redundancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元檢查雙無線路徑是否仍共用電源、天線位置或軟體，將共同原因從獨立丟包中分離。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無線備援共同原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Examine whether duplicated radio paths still share power, antenna location or software, separating common causes from independent packet losses. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Common causes in radio redundancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objective: 說明「模式與有效性旗標」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Modes and validity flags” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把模式、位置有效性和資料時效視為不同狀態，不讓某個正常旗標掩蓋其他未知資訊。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模式與有效性旗標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat operating mode, position validity and data age as separate states so one normal flag cannot conceal uncertainty in another input. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Modes and validity flags” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 無線交接案例矩陣：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「無線交接案例矩陣」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radio-handover case matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用離線重播覆蓋基地台交接邊界、重複資料與亂序資料，保留每項需求的判定證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無線交接案例矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use offline replay to cover access-point handover boundaries, duplicated data and out-of-order messages, retaining evidence for every requirement decision. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Radio-handover case matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「無線交接案例矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 通訊試驗證據界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Limits of communication-test evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通訊試驗證據界限」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Limits of communication-test evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元檢查大量成功封包是否其實集中在少數容易場景，將統計推論限制在真正抽樣的環境。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊試驗證據界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether many successful packets came from only a few easy scenarios, limiting statistical inference to the environments genuinely represented by the sample. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Limits of communication-test evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通訊試驗證據界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Limits of communication-test evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 本單元檢查大量成功封包是否其實集中在少數容易場景，將統計推論限制在真正抽樣的環境。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether many successful packets came from only a few easy scenarios, limiting statistical inference to the environments genuinely represented by the sample. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 通訊試驗證據界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Limits of communication-test evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊試驗證據界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Limits of communication-test evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊試驗證據界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「通訊試驗證據界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Limits of communication-test evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「通訊試驗證據界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for limits of communication-test evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for limits of communication-test evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通訊試驗證據界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Limits of communication-test evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.

quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 歐洲列車控制系統整合
courses.summary: 本課聚焦歐洲列控版本介面與車地相容驗證。從列控制動模型輸入建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把車地資料交接與介面失配頂事件連成可驗證的介面，最後以互通試驗推論範圍整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies european train-control version interfaces and train–track compatibility. Start with train-control braking-model inputs to define physical or information boundaries, connect train–track data handoff with top event for interface mismatch as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through scope of interoperability inference. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 歐洲列控版本介面與車地相容驗證
courses.focusEn: European train-control version interfaces and train–track compatibility
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究列控制動模型輸入。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究應答器位置與時效：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate train-control braking-model inputs. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate balise position and data freshness: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
