steps.title: 安全停機與服務可用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Safe withdrawal and service availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「安全停機與服務可用」如何影響鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Safe withdrawal and service availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Electronic interlocking logic verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將故障時保守停止服務的結果與危險輸出分開，避免為提高可用度而忽略安全性質。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安全停機與服務可用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish conservative service withdrawal from a hazardous output during a fault, avoiding loss of safety properties merely to improve availability. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Safe withdrawal and service availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「安全停機與服務可用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Safe withdrawal and service availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Distinguish conservative service withdrawal from a hazardous output during a fault, avoiding loss of safety properties merely to improve availability. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

本單元將故障時保守停止服務的結果與危險輸出分開，避免為提高可用度而忽略安全性質。
optionsEn: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.

steps.title: 安全停機與服務可用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Safe withdrawal and service availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安全停機與服務可用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Safe withdrawal and service availability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「安全停機與服務可用」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 聯鎖反例重播：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Replaying interlocking counterexamples: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聯鎖反例重播」如何影響鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Replaying interlocking counterexamples” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Electronic interlocking logic verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將找到的反例縮成可重現事件序列，保留初始狀態及每一步輸入以便修正後回歸。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聯鎖反例重播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reduce a discovered counterexample to a reproducible event sequence, retaining initial state and every input for regression after correction. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Replaying interlocking counterexamples” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Replaying interlocking counterexamples” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「聯鎖反例重播」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for replaying interlocking counterexamples. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「聯鎖反例重播」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.

quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 聯鎖測試與證明邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boundaries of testing and proof: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」如何影響鐵路電子聯鎖邏輯驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundaries of testing and proof” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Electronic interlocking logic verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較有限次成功測試與所有可達狀態的性質驗證，明示兩者支持的結論並不相同。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare finite successful tests with property verification over all reachable states, stating clearly that the two support different conclusions. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundaries of testing and proof” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundaries of testing and proof”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 聯鎖測試與證明邊界

knowledge.textEn: Compare finite successful tests with property verification over all reachable states, stating clearly that the two support different conclusions. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 聯鎖測試與證明邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Boundaries of testing and proof: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundaries of testing and proof” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 聯鎖測試與證明邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Boundaries of testing and proof: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundaries of testing and proof” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For boundaries of testing and proof, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「聯鎖測試與證明邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for boundaries of testing and proof, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 軌道電路列車占用偵測
courses.summary: 本課聚焦軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀。從軌道回路電阻帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把牽引干擾訊雜比與斷線與供電異常辨識連成可驗證的介面，最後以誤占用維修履歷整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation. Start with resistance accounting for the track circuit to define physical or information boundaries, connect signal quality under traction interference with distinguishing disconnection and supply faults as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through maintenance history of false occupancy. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀
courses.focusEn: Track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究軌道回路電阻帳。原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。敏感度只改 R=8 至 8.8 ohm，輸出變為 1.36364 A；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究輪對分流與漏電：原創假想教學輸入：支路一電阻 R1=10 ohm；支路二電阻 R2=40 ohm。公式 y=R1*R2/(R1+R2)，代入得 y=8 ohm。邊界：兩個線性電阻的靜態教具，未模擬頻率選擇接收器。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate resistance accounting for the track circuit. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Formula y=V/R gives y=1.5 A. Boundary: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included. For sensitivity, change only R=8 to 8.8 ohm; the output becomes 1.36364 A. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate wheelset shunts and leakage: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: branch one resistance R1=10 ohm; branch two resistance R2=40 ohm. Formula y=R1*R2/(R1+R2) gives y=8 ohm. Boundary: Static teaching circuit with two linear resistors; frequency-selective receivers are not represented. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 軌道回路電阻帳與輪對分流與漏電
stages.titleEn: Resistance accounting for the track circuit & Wheelset shunts and leakage
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軌道回路電阻帳」與「輪對分流與漏電」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resistance accounting for the track circuit" and "Wheelset shunts and leakage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軌道回路電阻帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Resistance accounting for the track circuit: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軌道回路電阻帳」如何影響軌道電路列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resistance accounting for the track circuit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-circuit train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。電壓與電流的關係取決於完整回路阻抗，不能只看單一導體。簡化電阻模型能用來辨認分流、接觸與漏電的量級，但交流軌道電路還涉及頻率、相位與耦合；量到電壓存在並不等於接收端已可靠判定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軌道回路電阻帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes. Voltage-current behaviour depends on the entire circuit rather than one conductor. A resistance model helps reason about shunts, contacts and leakage, while AC track circuits also depend on frequency, phase and coupling. Voltage presence alone does not establish a valid receiver decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resistance accounting for the track circuit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軌道回路電阻帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resistance accounting for the track circuit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌道回路電阻帳
knowledge.titleEn: Resistance accounting for the track circuit
knowledge.text: 本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。電壓與電流的關係取決於完整回路阻抗，不能只看單一導體。
knowledge.textEn: Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes. Voltage-current behaviour depends on the entire circuit rather than one conductor.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌道回路電阻帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resistance accounting for the track circuit" is correct?
options: 只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常
本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。
並聯多一條漏電路徑不會改變整個電路的電流
optionsEn: Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.
Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes.
Adding a parallel leakage path cannot change the total circuit current.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌道回路電阻帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resistance accounting for the track circuit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌道回路電阻帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resistance accounting for the track circuit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Formula y=V/R gives y=1.5 A. Boundary: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軌道回路電阻帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resistance accounting for the track circuit", which statement holds?
options: 總量測電壓越大就能保證訊號品質越好
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致

steps.title: 軌道回路電阻帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resistance accounting for the track circuit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軌道回路電阻帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resistance accounting for the track circuit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。以「軌道回路電阻帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time. For resistance accounting for the track circuit, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把等效電阻 R 從 8 改成 8.8 ohm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.5 變為 1.36364 A。先說明「軌道回路電阻帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only equivalent resistance R from 8 to 8.8 ohm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.5 to 1.36364 A. Explain the causal direction for resistance accounting for the track circuit, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: branch one resistance R1=10 ohm; branch two resistance R2=40 ohm. Formula y=R1*R2/(R1+R2) gives y=8 ohm. Boundary: Static teaching circuit with two linear resistors; frequency-selective receivers are not represented. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以階躍試驗觀察接收端濾波的延遲代價，將短脈衝抑制與真正狀態改變分開。電阻電容時間常數表示一階響應速度，濾除短脈衝也會延後真正的狀態改變。增強濾波與提高反應速度常互相衝突；訊號判定應結合雜訊頻譜與允許延遲，不可只追求顯示平穩。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性一階小訊號模型，時間常數不是確定的安全動作延時。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輸入濾波與延時」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 占用事件時間校核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Checking occupancy-event timing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「占用事件時間校核」如何影響軌道電路列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Checking occupancy-event timing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-circuit train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將實際模型輪對通過與接收輸出放在同一時基，分開時鐘偏差及接收反應時間。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「占用事件時間校核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Place model-wheelset passage and receiver output on one timebase, separating clock offset from receiver response time. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Checking occupancy-event timing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接收鏈共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Common causes in receiving chains: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接收鏈共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Common causes in receiving chains” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「接收鏈共同原因」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For common causes in receiving chains, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「接收鏈共同原因」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for common causes in receiving chains, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接收鏈共同原因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.

steps.title: 接收鏈共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Common causes in receiving chains: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接收鏈共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Common causes in receiving chains” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「接收鏈共同原因」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for common causes in receiving chains. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

Trace the input chain for common causes in receiving chains. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接收鏈共同原因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Common causes in receiving chains" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch.
quiz.explanation: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 乾濕與故障情境矩陣：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry wet and fault test matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-circuit train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以教具建立乾濕漏電、接觸變化與干擾案例，明列哪些狀態仍未取得測試證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build teaching-rig cases for dry/wet leakage, contact changes and interference, explicitly listing states for which test evidence is still absent. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dry wet and fault test matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元分開保守占用顯示與真正設備失效紀錄，將重複報修合併到同一根因而保留服務影響。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「誤占用維修履歷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate conservative occupied indications from equipment-failure records, linking repeated reports to one cause while retaining their service impact. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Maintenance history of false occupancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「誤占用維修履歷」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For maintenance history of false occupancy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「誤占用維修履歷」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for maintenance history of false occupancy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「誤占用維修履歷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Maintenance history of false occupancy"?
options: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘
optionsEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.

quiz.explanationEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 誤占用維修履歷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Maintenance history of false occupancy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「誤占用維修履歷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance history of false occupancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「誤占用維修履歷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for maintenance history of false occupancy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「誤占用維修履歷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Maintenance history of false occupancy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 計軸器列車占用偵測
courses.summary: 本課聚焦計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性。從區段軸數守恆建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把輪感測訊號品質與未知占用狀態保存連成可驗證的介面，最後以漏計試驗統計界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies axle-count event conservation direction and data validity. Start with axle conservation within a section to define physical or information boundaries, connect wheel-sensor signal quality with preserving unknown occupancy states as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through statistical bounds for missed counts. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性
courses.focusEn: Axle-count event conservation direction and data validity
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究區段軸數守恆。原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。敏感度只改 enter=48 至 49 axles，輸出變為 5 axles；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究雙感測點方向判別：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate axle conservation within a section. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. For sensitivity, change only enter=48 to 49 axles; the output becomes 5 axles. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate direction from paired sensing points: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：區段軸數守恆採 enter=48 axles；本課公式結果 4 axles，非現場額定值。
教學假設：雙感測點方向判別採 spacing=0.3 m；本課公式結果 20 m/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：輪脈衝時間解析度採 v=25 m/s；本課公式結果 1.25 m/sample，非現場額定值。
教學假設：輪感測訊號品質採 signal=2 V_rms；本課公式結果 26.0206 dB，非現場額定值。
教學假設：計軸事件排序採 drift=20 ppm；本課公式結果 0.072 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：計數訊息遺失分析採 p=0.02 1；本課公式結果 8e-06 1，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for axle conservation within a section: enter=48 axles; this model gives 4 axles, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for direction from paired sensing points: spacing=0.3 m; this model gives 20 m/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for temporal resolution of wheel pulses: v=25 m/s; this model gives 1.25 m/sample, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for wheel-sensor signal quality: signal=2 V_rms; this model gives 26.0206 dB, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for ordering axle-count events: drift=20 ppm; this model gives 0.072 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for loss of count-event messages: p=0.02 1; this model gives 8e-06 1, not a field rating.

stages.title: 區段軸數守恆與雙感測點方向判別
stages.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section & Direction from paired sensing points
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「區段軸數守恆」與「雙感測點方向判別」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axle conservation within a section" and "Direction from paired sensing points": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 區段軸數守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區段軸數守恆」如何影響計軸器列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axle conservation within a section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Axle-counter train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段軸數守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Axle conservation within a section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段軸數守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Axle conservation within a section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 區段軸數守恆
knowledge.text: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。
knowledge.textEn: Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「區段軸數守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Axle conservation within a section" is correct?
options: 進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車
本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
optionsEn: Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 區段軸數守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section: quantitative estimate

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 本單元比較不同通過速度的脈衝寬度與取樣間隔，判斷資料列數是否足以保留事件邊界。固定時間取樣在移動系統中對應空間間隔，速度越高相同頻率越容易漏過狹窄特徵。時間戳抖動會讓空間取樣不均勻；提高取樣率仍需足夠感測頻寬與抗混疊處理，不能只增加資料列數。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪脈衝時間解析度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pulse width and sampling interval at different passage speeds, assessing whether the samples preserve the event boundaries. Time sampling in a moving system corresponds to spatial spacing; at higher speed, the same rate can miss narrow features. Timestamp jitter makes spatial samples nonuniform. A higher rate still requires adequate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering, rather than merely more rows of data. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size. steps.title: 計軸事件排序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ordering axle-count events: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「計軸事件排序」如何影響計軸器列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ordering axle-count events” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Axle-counter train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤分散感測點的時間偏差，檢查資料延後抵達時是否仍能保留原始事件順序。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「計軸事件排序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track clock offsets among distributed sensing points, checking whether original event order survives delayed message arrival. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ordering axle-count events” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元將輪對測試紀錄按速度與輪型分層，說明單一條件下零漏計不能證明所有條件無誤。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏計試驗統計界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Statistical bounds for missed counts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 漏計試驗統計界限：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏計試驗統計界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Statistical bounds for missed counts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Statistical bounds for missed counts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「漏計試驗統計界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For statistical bounds for missed counts, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「漏計試驗統計界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for statistical bounds for missed counts, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「漏計試驗統計界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

courses.title: 鐵路道岔轉轍機
courses.summary: 本課聚焦轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈。從轉轍力位移作功建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把馬達回路與接觸與鎖閉確認狀態機連成可驗證的介面，最後以轉轍維修服務影響整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain. Start with point-machine force–travel work to define physical or information boundaries, connect motor circuit and contact behaviour with state machine for lock confirmation as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through service impact of point maintenance. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈
courses.focusEn: Point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究轉轍力位移作功。原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。敏感度只改 F=4500 至 4950 N，輸出變為 913.846 J；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究連桿幾何與力矩：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate point-machine force–travel work. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. For sensitivity, change only F=4500 to 4950 N; the output becomes 913.846 J. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate linkage geometry and torque: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
