stages.title: 轉轍力位移作功與連桿幾何與力矩
stages.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work & Linkage geometry and torque
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉轍力位移作功」與「連桿幾何與力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Point-machine force–travel work" and "Linkage geometry and torque": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉轍力位移作功」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Point-machine force–travel work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉轍力位移作功」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Point-machine force–travel work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Point-machine force–travel work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉轍力位移作功
knowledge.text: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。
knowledge.textEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉轍力位移作功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Point-machine force–travel work" is correct?
options: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉
本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。
力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩
optionsEn: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak.
A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉轍力位移作功」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Point-machine force–travel work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉轍力位移作功」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Point-machine force–travel work", which statement holds?
options: 只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常
前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉轍力位移作功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Point-machine force–travel work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「轉轍力位移作功」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For point-machine force–travel work, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「轉轍力位移作功」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for point-machine force–travel work, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「轉轍力位移作功」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For point-machine force–travel work, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「轉轍力位移作功」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for point-machine force–travel work, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉轍力位移作功」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Point-machine force–travel work"?
options: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉轍力位移作功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Point-machine force–travel work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for point-machine force–travel work. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for point-machine force–travel work. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉轍力位移作功」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Point-machine force–travel work" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。
力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking.
A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「連桿幾何與力矩」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Linkage geometry and torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。力矩取決於力與轉軸的垂直力臂，不只取決於馬達功率。連桿角度改變會改變機械利益，接近死點時力與位移關係尤其敏感；外殼上的扭矩讀值也不一定等於尖軌端的實際推力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「連桿幾何與力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. Torque depends on force and perpendicular lever arm, not merely motor power. Linkage angle changes mechanical advantage, particularly near a dead centre where force-displacement relations become sensitive. Torque measured at the housing need not equal effective force at the switch blade. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Linkage geometry and torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Linkage geometry and torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連桿幾何與力矩
knowledge.text: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。力矩取決於力與轉軸的垂直力臂，不只取決於馬達功率。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. Torque depends on force and perpendicular lever arm, not merely motor power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連桿幾何與力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Linkage geometry and torque" is correct?
options: 力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩
兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。
optionsEn: A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes.
quiz.explanation: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連桿幾何與力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Linkage geometry and torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連桿幾何與力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Linkage geometry and torque", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連桿幾何與力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Linkage geometry and torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。以「連桿幾何與力矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. For linkage geometry and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「連桿幾何與力矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for linkage geometry and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。以「連桿幾何與力矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. For linkage geometry and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「連桿幾何與力矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for linkage geometry and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「連桿幾何與力矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Linkage geometry and torque"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連桿幾何與力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Linkage geometry and torque” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。回到「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。回到「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連桿幾何與力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Linkage geometry and torque" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel.
quiz.explanation: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 雙端行程差異與馬達回路與接觸
stages.titleEn: Travel mismatch between coupled ends & Motor circuit and contact behaviour
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙端行程差異」與「馬達回路與接觸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Travel mismatch between coupled ends" and "Motor circuit and contact behaviour": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙端行程差異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Travel mismatch between coupled ends: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙端行程差異」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Travel mismatch between coupled ends” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以雙致動教具觀察小速度差如何累積為位置差，將同步需求與機械柔度分開。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙端行程差異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use coupled actuators on a teaching rig to observe small speed differences accumulating into displacement mismatch, separating synchronization from mechanical compliance. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Travel mismatch between coupled ends” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「馬達回路與接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Motor circuit and contact behaviour" is correct?
options: 只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常
本單元用隔離直流回路分析接點電阻與供電下降，避免將低電流直接解讀為機械負載低。
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
optionsEn: Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.
Use an isolated DC circuit to examine contact resistance and supply drop, avoiding interpretation of low current as necessarily low mechanical load.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用隔離直流回路分析接點電阻與供電下降，避免將低電流直接解讀為機械負載低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use an isolated DC circuit to examine contact resistance and supply drop, avoiding interpretation of low current as necessarily low mechanical load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 馬達回路與接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Motor circuit and contact behaviour: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「馬達回路與接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Motor circuit and contact behaviour” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Formula y=V/R gives y=1.5 A. Boundary: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「馬達回路與接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Motor circuit and contact behaviour", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 馬達回路與接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Motor circuit and contact behaviour: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「馬達回路與接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Motor circuit and contact behaviour” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。以「馬達回路與接觸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time. For motor circuit and contact behaviour, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把等效電阻 R 從 8 改成 8.8 ohm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.5 變為 1.36364 A。先說明「馬達回路與接觸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only equivalent resistance R from 8 to 8.8 ohm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.5 to 1.36364 A. Explain the causal direction for motor circuit and contact behaviour, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。以「馬達回路與接觸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「馬達回路與接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Motor circuit and contact behaviour"?
options: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉
optionsEn: On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
quiz.explanation: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 馬達回路與接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Motor circuit and contact behaviour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「馬達回路與接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Motor circuit and contact behaviour” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。回到「馬達回路與接觸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Such experiments do not belong on an operating track. Trace the input chain for motor circuit and contact behaviour. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。回到「馬達回路與接觸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Such experiments do not belong on an operating track. Trace the input chain for motor circuit and contact behaviour. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「馬達回路與接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Motor circuit and contact behaviour" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
quiz.explanation: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 等效持續發熱估算與傳動磨耗履歷
stages.titleEn: Equivalent sustained heating estimate & Transmission-wear history
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「等效持續發熱估算」與「傳動磨耗履歷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equivalent sustained heating estimate" and "Transmission-wear history": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 等效持續發熱估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent sustained heating estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「等效持續發熱估算」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把頻繁轉換的週期平均發熱視為等效持續功率，僅估穩態溫度並檢查外殼量測是否漏掉內部熱點。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等效持續發熱估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「等效持續發熱估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equivalent sustained heating estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「等效持續發熱估算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「等效持續發熱估算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。以「等效持續發熱估算」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes. For equivalent sustained heating estimate, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「等效持續發熱估算」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for equivalent sustained heating estimate, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 等效持續發熱估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equivalent sustained heating estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「等效持續發熱估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「等效持續發熱估算」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. Trace the input chain for equivalent sustained heating estimate. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「等效持續發熱估算」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

quiz.question: 在「等效持續發熱估算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。

The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima.

steps.title: 傳動磨耗履歷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transmission-wear history: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「傳動磨耗履歷」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transmission-wear history” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤連接銷與齒輪間隙隨動作次數的變化，避免把短期磨合率當成全壽命磨耗率。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳動磨耗履歷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track pin and gear clearance with movement count rather than treating short running-in wear as a lifetime wear rate. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transmission-wear history” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「傳動磨耗履歷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transmission-wear history”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Track pin and gear clearance with movement count rather than treating short running-in wear as a lifetime wear rate. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「傳動磨耗履歷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transmission-wear history" is correct?
options: 本單元追蹤連接銷與齒輪間隙隨動作次數的變化，避免把短期磨合率當成全壽命磨耗率。
前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Track pin and gear clearance with movement count rather than treating short running-in wear as a lifetime wear rate.
The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 本單元追蹤連接銷與齒輪間隙隨動作次數的變化，避免把短期磨合率當成全壽命磨耗率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 傳動磨耗履歷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transmission-wear history: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「傳動磨耗履歷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transmission-wear history” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. Formula y=depth/cycles*future gives y=0.2 mm. Boundary: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation.

steps.instruction: 在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。以「傳動磨耗履歷」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 傳動磨耗履歷：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transmission-wear history” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。回到「傳動磨耗履歷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. Trace the input chain for transmission-wear history. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「鎖閉確認狀態機」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “State machine for lock confirmation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將行程完成、鎖閉與位置確認分成獨立條件，檢查任何單一訊號是否被錯當全部成立。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鎖閉確認狀態機」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate completed travel, locking and position confirmation, checking whether any one signal is incorrectly treated as proof of all conditions. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “State machine for lock confirmation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元比較命令、馬達啟動、行程結束與回授採用時刻，辨認機械延遲及介面延遲。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動作與回授時間鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare command, motor start, end of travel and feedback adoption to distinguish mechanical delay from interface delay. steps.instruction: 本單元只在隔離教具重播障礙與失電情境，確認測試覆蓋並保留安全中止後的狀態證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「障礙與中止試驗矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Obstruction and interruption test matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「障礙與中止試驗矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for obstruction and interruption test matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉轍維修服務影響」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Service impact of point maintenance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將故障頻率與修復等待分開，辨認備品、定位診斷或機械調整何者主導不可用時間。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉轍維修服務影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate failure frequency from repair waiting to identify whether spares, diagnosis or mechanical adjustment dominates unavailable time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Service impact of point maintenance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉轍維修服務影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Service impact of point maintenance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 本單元將故障頻率與修復等待分開，辨認備品、定位診斷或機械調整何者主導不可用時間。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。
knowledge.textEn: Separate failure frequency from repair waiting to identify whether spares, diagnosis or mechanical adjustment dominates unavailable time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉轍維修服務影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Service impact of point maintenance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「轉轍維修服務影響」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

quiz.explanation: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉轍維修服務影響」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Service impact of point maintenance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「轉轍維修服務影響」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for service impact of point maintenance. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「轉轍維修服務影響」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for service impact of point maintenance. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉轍維修服務影響」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service impact of point maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 列車定位與里程融合
courses.summary: 本課聚焦多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性。從輪徑比例與里程建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把定位不確定度合成與融合感測時基漂移連成可驗證的介面，最後以失訊與錯圖案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization. Start with wheel-scale error and odometry to define physical or information boundaries, connect combining localization uncertainty with clock drift in sensor fusion as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through signal-loss and map-error cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性
courses.focusEn: Error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑比例與里程。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。敏感度只改 distance=1500 至 1650 m，輸出變為 6.8 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究局部通過速度觀測：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel-scale error and odometry. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. For sensitivity, change only distance=1500 to 1650 m; the output becomes 6.8 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local passage-speed observations: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：輪徑比例與里程採 distance=1500 m；本課公式結果 6.2 m，非現場額定值。
教學假設：局部通過速度觀測採 spacing=0.3 m；本課公式結果 20 m/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：獨立觀測加權融合採 x1=100 m；本課公式結果 100.8 m，非現場額定值。
教學假設：定位不確定度合成採 s1=3 mm；本課公式結果 5 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：延遲定位外推採 v=18 m/s；本課公式結果 5.1 m，非現場額定值。
教學假設：速度取樣與空間間距採 v=25 m/s；本課公式結果 1.25 m/sample，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for wheel-scale error and odometry: distance=1500 m; this model gives 6.2 m, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for local passage-speed observations: spacing=0.3 m; this model gives 20 m/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for weighted fusion of independent observations: x1=100 m; this model gives 100.8 m, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for combining localization uncertainty: s1=3 mm; this model gives 5 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for extrapolating delayed positions: v=18 m/s; this model gives 5.1 m, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for speed sampling and spatial intervals: v=25 m/s; this model gives 1.25 m/sample, not a field rating.
