stages.title: 輪徑比例與里程與局部通過速度觀測
stages.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry & Local passage-speed observations
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪徑比例與里程」與「局部通過速度觀測」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel-scale error and odometry" and "Local passage-speed observations": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪徑比例與里程」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel-scale error and odometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪徑比例與里程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel-scale error and odometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wheel-scale error and odometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪徑比例與里程
knowledge.text: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。
knowledge.textEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪徑比例與里程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel-scale error and odometry" is correct?
options: 短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確
本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
optionsEn: Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪徑比例與里程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel-scale error and odometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪徑比例與里程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wheel-scale error and odometry", which statement holds?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同
原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。
optionsEn: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪徑比例與里程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel-scale error and odometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。以「輪徑比例與里程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects. For wheel-scale error and odometry, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把行走距離 distance 從 1500 改成 1650 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6.2 變為 6.8 m。先說明「輪徑比例與里程」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only travelled distance distance from 1500 to 1650 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6.2 to 6.8 m. Explain the causal direction for wheel-scale error and odometry, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪徑比例與里程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel-scale error and odometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for wheel-scale error and odometry. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部通過速度觀測」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local passage-speed observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以雙感測點估計局部速度，討論事件配對錯誤如何在里程積分中變成位置跳變。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部通過速度觀測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate local speed with paired sensing points and examine how event-pairing errors become position jumps when integrated into odometry. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local passage-speed observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部通過速度觀測」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local passage-speed observations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部通過速度觀測」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local passage-speed observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。以「局部通過速度觀測」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests. For local passage-speed observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把通過時間差 dt 從 0.015 改成 0.0165 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變為 18.1818 m/s。先說明「局部通過速度觀測」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only passage time difference dt from 0.015 to 0.0165 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 20 to 18.1818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for local passage-speed observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部通過速度觀測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local passage-speed observations"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部通過速度觀測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local passage-speed observations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。回到「局部通過速度觀測」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. Trace the input chain for local passage-speed observations. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。回到「局部通過速度觀測」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. Trace the input chain for local passage-speed observations. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部通過速度觀測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local passage-speed observations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩個感測器讀值一致就能保證融合位置正確
將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position.
Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events.
quiz.explanation: 將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 獨立觀測加權融合與定位不確定度合成
stages.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations & Combining localization uncertainty
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「獨立觀測加權融合」與「定位不確定度合成」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weighted fusion of independent observations" and "Combining localization uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「獨立觀測加權融合」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weighted fusion of independent observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較輪速與外部定位的權重，只有在獨立無偏假設有證據時才採用倒變異數加權。獨立無偏觀測可依變異數倒數加權，較小不確定度取得較大權重。融合不會自動修正共同偏差或地圖錯誤；如果兩個感測器實際共享同一來源，當成獨立資料就會過度自信，並把錯誤估計包裝成精準結果。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立觀測加權融合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare weights for wheel-based and external position observations, using inverse-variance fusion only when independence and lack of bias are justified. Independent unbiased observations can be weighted by inverse variance, giving more weight to lower uncertainty. Fusion does not automatically remove common bias or map errors. Treating two sensors that share a source as independent creates false confidence and can make an incorrect estimate appear precise. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weighted fusion of independent observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個感測器讀值一致就能保證融合位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「獨立觀測加權融合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weighted fusion of independent observations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 獨立觀測加權融合
knowledge.text: 本單元比較輪速與外部定位的權重，只有在獨立無偏假設有證據時才採用倒變異數加權。獨立無偏觀測可依變異數倒數加權，較小不確定度取得較大權重。
knowledge.textEn: Compare weights for wheel-based and external position observations, using inverse-variance fusion only when independence and lack of bias are justified. Independent unbiased observations can be weighted by inverse variance, giving more weight to lower uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個感測器讀值一致就能保證融合位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「獨立觀測加權融合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weighted fusion of independent observations" is correct?
options: 本單元比較輪速與外部定位的權重，只有在獨立無偏假設有證據時才採用倒變異數加權。
兩個感測器讀值一致就能保證融合位置正確
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Compare weights for wheel-based and external position observations, using inverse-variance fusion only when independence and lack of bias are justified.
Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較輪速與外部定位的權重，只有在獨立無偏假設有證據時才採用倒變異數加權。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare weights for wheel-based and external position observations, using inverse-variance fusion only when independence and lack of bias are justified. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立觀測加權融合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weighted fusion of independent observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。公式 y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)，代入得 y=100.8 m。邊界：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m. Formula y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2) gives y=100.8 m. Boundary: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。公式 y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)，代入得 y=100.8 m。邊界：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m. Formula y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2) gives y=100.8 m. Boundary: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「獨立觀測加權融合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weighted fusion of independent observations", which statement holds?
options: 取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同
原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。
進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車
optionsEn: Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m.
Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立觀測加權融合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weighted fusion of independent observations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。以「獨立觀測加權融合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable. For weighted fusion of independent observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把觀測二標準差 s2 從 4 改成 4.4 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 100.8 變為 100.685 m。先說明「獨立觀測加權融合」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only second standard deviation s2 from 4 to 4.4 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 100.8 to 100.685 m. Explain the causal direction for weighted fusion of independent observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同地圖誤差可讓兩感測器互相同意卻都錯，將相關性忽略會縮小不合理的信賴區間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common map error can make both sensors agree while both are wrong; ignored correlation yields unrealistically narrow confidence intervals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。以「獨立觀測加權融合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable. For weighted fusion of independent observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weighted fusion of independent observations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同地圖誤差可讓兩感測器互相同意卻都錯，將相關性忽略會縮小不合理的信賴區間。回到「獨立觀測加權融合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Combining localization uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元區分隨機標準差、最大界限與共同偏差，避免以平方和開根號縮小所有誤差。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定位不確定度合成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish random standard deviation, maximum bounds and common bias rather than reducing every error through root-sum-square combination. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Combining localization uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Combining localization uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 延遲定位外推：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元保留量測原始時間並估算資料變舊期間的前進距離，檢查高速時的誤差放大。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲定位外推」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve the original measurement time and estimate travel while the observation ages, examining error growth at higher speed. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Extrapolating delayed positions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤感測、濾波、地圖比對與輸出更新的時間，防止漂亮的定位誤差掩蓋過時結果。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定位處理管線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace sensing, filtering, map matching and output-update timing so an attractive position-error statistic cannot conceal stale results. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Localization processing pipeline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 失訊與錯圖案例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Signal-loss and map-error cases: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「失訊與錯圖案例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Signal-loss and map-error cases” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「失訊與錯圖案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For signal-loss and map-error cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「失訊與錯圖案例」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for signal-loss and map-error cases, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 失訊與錯圖案例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Signal-loss and map-error cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「失訊與錯圖案例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Signal-loss and map-error cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「失訊與錯圖案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for signal-loss and map-error cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「失訊與錯圖案例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Signal-loss and map-error cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鐵路時刻表衝突消解
courses.summary: 本課聚焦資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解。從區間占用時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把折返資源利用率與衝突優先權狀態連成可驗證的介面，最後以穩健時刻證據限制整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation. Start with open-line occupation time to define physical or information boundaries, connect utilization of reversal resources with conflict-priority states as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence limits for robust timetables. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解
courses.focusEn: Timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究區間占用時間。原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。敏感度只改 S=420 至 462 m，輸出變為 62.8 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究交會緩衝分配：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate open-line occupation time. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. For sensitivity, change only S=420 to 462 m; the output becomes 62.8 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate allocating crossing buffers: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：區間占用時間採 L=180 m；本課公式結果 60 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：交會緩衝分配採 scheduled=140 s；本課公式結果 12 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：停站變異傳播採 N=180 persons；本課公式結果 30.75 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：折返資源利用率採 arrival=8 jobs/h；本課公式結果 0.666667 1，非現場額定值。
教學假設：月台旅客積壓採 arrival=3.2 persons/s；本課公式結果 72 persons，非現場額定值。
教學假設：實績時刻對齊採 drift=20 ppm；本課公式結果 0.072 s，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for open-line occupation time: L=180 m; this model gives 60 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for allocating crossing buffers: scheduled=140 s; this model gives 12 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for propagation of dwell variability: N=180 persons; this model gives 30.75 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for utilization of reversal resources: arrival=8 jobs/h; this model gives 0.666667 1, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for passenger accumulation at platforms: arrival=3.2 persons/s; this model gives 72 persons, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for aligning recorded operating times: drift=20 ppm; this model gives 0.072 s, not a field rating.

stages.title: 區間占用時間與交會緩衝分配
stages.titleEn: Open-line occupation time & Allocating crossing buffers
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「區間占用時間」與「交會緩衝分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Open-line occupation time" and "Allocating crossing buffers": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 區間占用時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Open-line occupation time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區間占用時間」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Open-line occupation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區間占用時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Open-line occupation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 區間占用時間：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區間占用時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Allocating crossing buffers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元為單線交會配置獨立餘裕，檢查一列車晚到時另一列車的等待如何向後傳播。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。餘裕可以吸收小延誤，卻不是可隨意重複使用的免費容量；同一段緩衝若被兩個衝突約束同時借用，紙面上可行的時刻仍會在實際重播中互相追趕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「交會緩衝分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Assign distinct margins to a single-track meet and examine how one late arrival propagates waiting to the opposing train. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation. It can absorb small delays but is not free capacity that may be reused indefinitely. If two conflicting constraints both claim the same buffer, a timetable that appears feasible on paper can still produce converging delays in replay. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. steps.title: 交會緩衝分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Allocating crossing buffers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交會緩衝分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Allocating crossing buffers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「交會緩衝分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Allocating crossing buffers", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交會緩衝分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Allocating crossing buffers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「交會緩衝分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Allocating crossing buffers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「交會緩衝分配」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For allocating crossing buffers, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「交會緩衝分配」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for allocating crossing buffers, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交會緩衝分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Allocating crossing buffers"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 交會緩衝分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Allocating crossing buffers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「交會緩衝分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Allocating crossing buffers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「交會緩衝分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for allocating crossing buffers. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「交會緩衝分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for allocating crossing buffers. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交會緩衝分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Allocating crossing buffers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction.
quiz.explanation: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 停站變異傳播與折返資源利用率
stages.titleEn: Propagation of dwell variability & Utilization of reversal resources
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停站變異傳播」與「折返資源利用率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Propagation of dwell variability" and "Utilization of reversal resources": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停站變異傳播：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Propagation of dwell variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停站變異傳播」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Propagation of dwell variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停站變異傳播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Propagation of dwell variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停站變異傳播」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Propagation of dwell variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停站變異傳播
knowledge.text: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。
knowledge.textEn: Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停站變異傳播」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Propagation of dwell variability" is correct?
options: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
optionsEn: Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停站變異傳播：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Propagation of dwell variability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停站變異傳播」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Propagation of dwell variability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「折返資源利用率」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Utilization of reversal resources” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將折返股道視為有限服務通道，檢查平均需求、尖峰到達與設備中斷的差異。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。平均需求小於平均容量仍可能出現短暫尖峰與排隊；若排程把所有時段填滿，任何變異都只能向後傳播，缺乏讓系統恢復的空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返資源利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat reversal tracks as finite service channels and distinguish mean demand, peak arrivals and equipment interruptions. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer. Mean demand below mean capacity still permits bursts and queues. When every interval is fully occupied, variability propagates downstream because no recovery space remains. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Utilization of reversal resources” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
