quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Utilization of reversal resources: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「折返資源利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Utilization of reversal resources” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「折返資源利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of reversal resources, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「折返資源利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of reversal resources, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Utilization of reversal resources: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「折返資源利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Utilization of reversal resources” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「折返資源利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of reversal resources. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of reversal resources. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「折返資源利用率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Utilization of reversal resources" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 月台旅客積壓與實績時刻對齊
stages.titleEn: Passenger accumulation at platforms & Aligning recorded operating times
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台旅客積壓」與「實績時刻對齊」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Passenger accumulation at platforms" and "Aligning recorded operating times": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台旅客積壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Passenger accumulation at platforms: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台旅客積壓」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Passenger accumulation at platforms” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤列車延誤期間旅客流入與離開，將月台存量納入調度代價而不只最小化列車晚點。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台旅客積壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track passenger arrivals and departures during a train delay, including platform occupancy in dispatch costs rather than minimizing train lateness alone. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Passenger accumulation at platforms” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台旅客積壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Passenger accumulation at platforms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台旅客積壓
knowledge.text: 本單元追蹤列車延誤期間旅客流入與離開，將月台存量納入調度代價而不只最小化列車晚點。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。
knowledge.textEn: Track passenger arrivals and departures during a train delay, including platform occupancy in dispatch costs rather than minimizing train lateness alone. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 月台旅客積壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Passenger accumulation at platforms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台旅客積壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Passenger accumulation at platforms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Explain the causal direction for aligning recorded operating times, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「實績時刻對齊」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aligning recorded operating times"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實績時刻對齊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aligning recorded operating times: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實績時刻對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aligning recorded operating times” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「實績時刻對齊」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for aligning recorded operating times. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for aligning recorded operating times. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

stages.title: 衝突優先權狀態與擾動情境覆蓋
stages.titleEn: Conflict-priority states & Coverage of disruption scenarios
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「衝突優先權狀態」與「擾動情境覆蓋」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conflict-priority states" and "Coverage of disruption scenarios": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 衝突優先權狀態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflict-priority states: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「衝突優先權狀態」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflict-priority states” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元列舉讓行、等待與資源保留的抽象狀態，檢查局部決策是否形成循環等待。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衝突優先權狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Enumerate abstract yield, wait and reservation states to check whether local decisions create a circular wait. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflict-priority states” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「衝突優先權狀態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflict-priority states”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 衝突優先權狀態
knowledge.text: 本單元列舉讓行、等待與資源保留的抽象狀態，檢查局部決策是否形成循環等待。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。
knowledge.textEn: Enumerate abstract yield, wait and reservation states to check whether local decisions create a circular wait. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「衝突優先權狀態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合

測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Enumerate abstract yield, wait and reservation states to check whether local decisions create a circular wait.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 本單元列舉讓行、等待與資源保留的抽象狀態，檢查局部決策是否形成循環等待。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Enumerate abstract yield, wait and reservation states to check whether local decisions create a circular wait. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 衝突優先權狀態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflict-priority states: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「衝突優先權狀態」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflict-priority states” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「衝突優先權狀態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零

原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.

steps.title: 衝突優先權狀態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflict-priority states: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「衝突優先權狀態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflict-priority states” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「衝突優先權狀態」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For conflict-priority states, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把布林變數數量 bits 從 8 改成 9 bits（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 256 變為 512 states。先說明「衝突優先權狀態」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For conflict-priority states, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.

quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 時刻重播工作量與穩健時刻證據限制
stages.titleEn: Timetable-replay effort & Evidence limits for robust timetables
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「時刻重播工作量」與「穩健時刻證據限制」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Timetable-replay effort" and "Evidence limits for robust timetables": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 時刻重播工作量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Timetable-replay effort: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時刻重播工作量」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Timetable-replay effort” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元規畫多個需求水準與擾動組合的重播，保留初始列車位置和旅客需求以利比較。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時刻重播工作量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Plan replay over demand levels and disruption combinations, retaining initial train positions and passenger demand for meaningful comparison. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Timetable-replay effort” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時刻重播工作量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 時刻重播工作量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Timetable-replay effort: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時刻重播工作量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Timetable-replay effort” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 時刻重播工作量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Timetable-replay effort: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時刻重播工作量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Timetable-replay effort” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「時刻重播工作量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 本單元檢查零衝突模擬是否來自有限擾動集合，將可行性結論限制在已驗證的假設範圍。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩健時刻證據限制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Examine whether conflict-free simulations cover only a limited disruption set, bounding feasibility claims by the assumptions actually tested. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Evidence limits for robust timetables” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩健時刻證據限制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Evidence limits for robust timetables”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 穩健時刻證據限制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits for robust timetables: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩健時刻證據限制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Evidence limits for robust timetables” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穩健時刻證據限制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 穩健時刻證據限制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits for robust timetables: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩健時刻證據限制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Evidence limits for robust timetables” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「穩健時刻證據限制」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For evidence limits for robust timetables, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「穩健時刻證據限制」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for evidence limits for robust timetables, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「穩健時刻證據限制」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For evidence limits for robust timetables, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩健時刻證據限制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evidence limits for robust timetables"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

steps.title: 穩健時刻證據限制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits for robust timetables: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩健時刻證據限制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Evidence limits for robust timetables” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「穩健時刻證據限制」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for evidence limits for robust timetables. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「穩健時刻證據限制」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for evidence limits for robust timetables. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穩健時刻證據限制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evidence limits for robust timetables" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.

quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 行車控制中心人機介面
courses.summary: 本課聚焦行控資訊層次警報與人員判讀。從警報負荷與重複建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把畫面位置資料年齡與顯示可讀性環境連成可驗證的介面，最後以少量受試結果外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies control-centre information hierarchy alarms and human interpretation. Start with alarm loading and duplication to define physical or information boundaries, connect age of displayed position data with viewing environment and legibility as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating limited user trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 行控資訊層次警報與人員判讀
courses.focusEn: Control-centre information hierarchy alarms and human interpretation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究警報負荷與重複。原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。敏感度只改 events=18 至 19 alarms，輸出變為 3.16667 alarms/min；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究察覺與動作延遲：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate alarm loading and duplication. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. For sensitivity, change only events=18 to 19 alarms; the output becomes 3.16667 alarms/min. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate detection and action delay: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 警報負荷與重複與察覺與動作延遲
stages.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication & Detection and action delay
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警報負荷與重複」與「察覺與動作延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alarm loading and duplication" and "Detection and action delay": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警報負荷與重複」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alarm loading and duplication” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。大量同根因警報可能淹沒最早的關鍵訊息；抑制重複訊號應保留可追溯性，不能以刪掉重要警報來美化數字。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警報負荷與重複」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability. Many alarms from one cause can obscure the first critical message. Duplicate suppression must preserve traceability rather than deleting important alarms to improve a metric. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alarm loading and duplication” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警報負荷與重複」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alarm loading and duplication”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 警報負荷與重複
knowledge.text: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。
knowledge.textEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「警報負荷與重複」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alarm loading and duplication" is correct?
options: 操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決
本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。
制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
optionsEn: Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved.
Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information.
Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「警報負荷與重複」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alarm loading and duplication” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「警報負荷與重複」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alarm loading and duplication", which statement holds?
options: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。
optionsEn: A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「警報負荷與重複」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alarm loading and duplication” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「警報負荷與重複」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. For alarm loading and duplication, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把警報數 events 從 18 改成 19 alarms（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變為 3.16667 alarms/min。先說明「警報負荷與重複」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only alarm count events from 18 to 19 alarms (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3 to 3.16667 alarms/min. Explain the causal direction for alarm loading and duplication, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「警報負荷與重複」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. For alarm loading and duplication, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把警報數 events 從 18 改成 19 alarms（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變為 3.16667 alarms/min。先說明「警報負荷與重複」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only alarm count events from 18 to 19 alarms (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3 to 3.16667 alarms/min. Explain the causal direction for alarm loading and duplication, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「警報負荷與重複」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alarm loading and duplication"?
options: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警報負荷與重複」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alarm loading and duplication” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。回到「警報負荷與重複」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. Trace the input chain for alarm loading and duplication. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。

steps.instruction: 本單元在安全桌面情境量測訊息出現到正確處置的時間，區分看見、理解與動作三個階段，再換算同期間列車前進距離。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「察覺與動作延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure message-to-correct-action time in a safe desktop scenario, distinguishing seeing, understanding and acting, then convert that delay into distance travelled by the moving train. Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.explanation: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 事件時間線一致性與畫面位置資料年齡
stages.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines & Age of displayed position data
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「事件時間線一致性」與「畫面位置資料年齡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Consistency of event timelines" and "Age of displayed position data": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「事件時間線一致性」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consistency of event timelines” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元對照各設備日誌的時鐘偏移，防止畫面上的先後排序讓操作員建立錯誤因果故事。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「事件時間線一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare clock offsets in equipment logs so display ordering does not lead operators to construct an incorrect causal explanation. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consistency of event timelines” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「事件時間線一致性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Consistency of event timelines”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 事件時間線一致性
knowledge.text: 本單元對照各設備日誌的時鐘偏移，防止畫面上的先後排序讓操作員建立錯誤因果故事。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare clock offsets in equipment logs so display ordering does not lead operators to construct an incorrect causal explanation. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「事件時間線一致性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Consistency of event timelines" is correct?
options: 本單元對照各設備日誌的時鐘偏移，防止畫面上的先後排序讓操作員建立錯誤因果故事。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Compare clock offsets in equipment logs so display ordering does not lead operators to construct an incorrect causal explanation.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 本單元對照各設備日誌的時鐘偏移，防止畫面上的先後排序讓操作員建立錯誤因果故事。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare clock offsets in equipment logs so display ordering does not lead operators to construct an incorrect causal explanation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「事件時間線一致性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Consistency of event timelines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「事件時間線一致性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Consistency of event timelines", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「事件時間線一致性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Consistency of event timelines” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「事件時間線一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For consistency of event timelines, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「事件時間線一致性」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for consistency of event timelines, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「事件時間線一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For consistency of event timelines, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「事件時間線一致性」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for consistency of event timelines, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「事件時間線一致性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Consistency of event timelines"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件時間線一致性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Consistency of event timelines” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「事件時間線一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for consistency of event timelines. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「事件時間線一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for consistency of event timelines. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「事件時間線一致性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Consistency of event timelines" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 畫面位置資料年齡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Age of displayed position data: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「畫面位置資料年齡」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Age of displayed position data” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元讓位置圖示同時顯示資料年齡，辨認流暢動畫與可信即時資訊並不是同一件事。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「畫面位置資料年齡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Display data age alongside the position symbol, distinguishing a smooth animation from trustworthy current information. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. steps.instruction: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「命令確認與模式」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「命令確認與模式」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 顯示可讀性環境：機制與系統路徑
