stages.title: 危害需求追溯與零失效證據解讀
stages.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements & Interpreting zero-failure evidence
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「危害需求追溯」與「零失效證據解讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tracing hazards to requirements" and "Interpreting zero-failure evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「危害需求追溯」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tracing hazards to requirements” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「危害需求追溯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tracing hazards to requirements” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「危害需求追溯」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tracing hazards to requirements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 危害需求追溯
knowledge.text: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「危害需求追溯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tracing hazards to requirements" is correct?
options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「危害需求追溯」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tracing hazards to requirements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「危害需求追溯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tracing hazards to requirements", which statement holds?
options: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
optionsEn: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「危害需求追溯」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tracing hazards to requirements” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「危害需求追溯」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For tracing hazards to requirements, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「危害需求追溯」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for tracing hazards to requirements, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「危害需求追溯」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For tracing hazards to requirements, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「危害需求追溯」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for tracing hazards to requirements, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「危害需求追溯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tracing hazards to requirements"?
options: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「危害需求追溯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tracing hazards to requirements” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「危害需求追溯」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for tracing hazards to requirements. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「危害需求追溯」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for tracing hazards to requirements. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「危害需求追溯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tracing hazards to requirements" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 零失效證據解讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「零失效證據解讀」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從有限試驗推導單側機率上界，說明不能以零失敗取代系統性故障的設計論證。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「零失效證據解讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Derive a one-sided probability bound from finite trials and explain why zero failures cannot replace arguments about systematic design faults. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「零失效證據解讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Interpreting zero-failure evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 零失效證據解讀
knowledge.text: 本單元從有限試驗推導單側機率上界，說明不能以零失敗取代系統性故障的設計論證。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。
knowledge.textEn: Derive a one-sided probability bound from finite trials and explain why zero failures cannot replace arguments about systematic design faults. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「零失效證據解讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interpreting zero-failure evidence" is correct?

本單元從有限試驗推導單側機率上界，說明不能以零失敗取代系統性故障的設計論證。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Derive a one-sided probability bound from finite trials and explain why zero failures cannot replace arguments about systematic design faults.

quiz.explanationEn: Derive a one-sided probability bound from finite trials and explain why zero failures cannot replace arguments about systematic design faults. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 零失效證據解讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「零失效證據解讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「零失效證據解讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interpreting zero-failure evidence", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的

If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.

steps.title: 零失效證據解讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「零失效證據解讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「零失效證據解讀」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For interpreting zero-failure evidence, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「零失效證據解讀」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for interpreting zero-failure evidence, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「零失效證據解讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interpreting zero-failure evidence"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 零失效證據解讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「零失效證據解讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「零失效證據解讀」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for interpreting zero-failure evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「零失效證據解讀」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for interpreting zero-failure evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「零失效證據解讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interpreting zero-failure evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.

stages.title: 故障時間窗一致性與變更後證據重建
stages.titleEn: Consistent fault time windows & Rebuilding evidence after change
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「故障時間窗一致性」與「變更後證據重建」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Consistent fault time windows" and "Rebuilding evidence after change": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 故障時間窗一致性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Consistent fault time windows: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「故障時間窗一致性」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consistent fault time windows” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元核對失效事件與任務期間的定義，避免把不同時間窗的紀錄直接放進同一風險模型。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「故障時間窗一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check definitions of failure events and mission duration, avoiding combination of records from different time windows in one risk model. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consistent fault time windows” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「故障時間窗一致性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Check definitions of failure events and mission duration, avoiding combination of records from different time windows in one risk model. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Consistent fault time windows" is correct?
options: 本單元核對失效事件與任務期間的定義，避免把不同時間窗的紀錄直接放進同一風險模型。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Check definitions of failure events and mission duration, avoiding combination of records from different time windows in one risk model.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 本單元核對失效事件與任務期間的定義，避免把不同時間窗的紀錄直接放進同一風險模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Check definitions of failure events and mission duration, avoiding combination of records from different time windows in one risk model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 故障時間窗一致性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Consistent fault time windows: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「故障時間窗一致性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Consistent fault time windows” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 故障時間窗一致性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Consistent fault time windows: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「故障時間窗一致性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Consistent fault time windows” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「故障時間窗一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For consistent fault time windows, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「故障時間窗一致性」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for consistent fault time windows, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「故障時間窗一致性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Consistent fault time windows"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性

The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 故障時間窗一致性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Consistent fault time windows: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「故障時間窗一致性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Consistent fault time windows” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「故障時間窗一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for consistent fault time windows. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「故障時間窗一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for consistent fault time windows. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「故障時間窗一致性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Consistent fault time windows" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 變更後證據重建：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rebuilding evidence after change: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「變更後證據重建」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rebuilding evidence after change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元分析設計變更影響哪些需求和試驗，將需重新取得的證據與可沿用證據分開。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「變更後證據重建」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse which requirements and tests a design change affects, separating evidence that must be regenerated from evidence that remains applicable. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rebuilding evidence after change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「變更後證據重建」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rebuilding evidence after change”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 變更後證據重建
knowledge.text: 本單元分析設計變更影響哪些需求和試驗，將需重新取得的證據與可沿用證據分開。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse which requirements and tests a design change affects, separating evidence that must be regenerated from evidence that remains applicable. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rebuilding evidence after change” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「變更後證據重建」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 變更後證據重建：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rebuilding evidence after change: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「變更後證據重建」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rebuilding evidence after change” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「變更後證據重建」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For rebuilding evidence after change, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「變更後證據重建」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for rebuilding evidence after change, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For rebuilding evidence after change, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「變更後證據重建」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「變更後證據重建」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rebuilding evidence after change"?
options: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 變更後證據重建：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rebuilding evidence after change: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「變更後證據重建」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rebuilding evidence after change” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「變更後證據重建」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for rebuilding evidence after change. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「變更後證據重建」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for rebuilding evidence after change. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「變更後證據重建」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rebuilding evidence after change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。
任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
quiz.explanation: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鐵路平交道警報聯動
courses.summary: 本課聚焦平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合。從道路使用者反應距離建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把路口回堵累積與區段偵測有效性連成可驗證的介面，最後以路鐵整合情境矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration. Start with road-user reaction distance to define physical or information boundaries, connect queue spillback toward the crossing with validity of section detection as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through road–rail integration scenario matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合
courses.focusEn: Crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究道路使用者反應距離。原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。敏感度只改 reaction=2.5 至 2.75 s，輸出變為 44 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究道路車輛停止距離：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate road-user reaction distance. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. For sensitivity, change only reaction=2.5 to 2.75 s; the output becomes 44 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate stopping distance of road vehicles: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use an assumed road-approach speed to analyse travel between detection and response, retaining differences in visibility and user capability. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 道路使用者反應距離與道路車輛停止距離
stages.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance & Stopping distance of road vehicles
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「道路使用者反應距離」與「道路車輛停止距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Road-user reaction distance" and "Stopping distance of road vehicles": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「道路使用者反應距離」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Road-user reaction distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「道路使用者反應距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect. The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear.
Calculate reaction and braking distances separately for a road vehicle, emphasizing that the exercise is not an actual crossing sight-distance design.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將道路車輛反應距離與制動距離分開計算，強調此練習不是實際平交道設計視距。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate reaction and braking distances separately for a road vehicle, emphasizing that the exercise is not an actual crossing sight-distance design. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 道路車輛停止距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance of road vehicles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「道路車輛停止距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping distance of road vehicles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「道路車輛停止距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 道路車輛停止距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance of road vehicles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「道路車輛停止距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stopping distance of road vehicles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「道路車輛停止距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For stopping distance of road vehicles, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「道路車輛停止距離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for stopping distance of road vehicles, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

steps.title: 道路車輛停止距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance of road vehicles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「道路車輛停止距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping distance of road vehicles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「道路車輛停止距離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for stopping distance of road vehicles. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for stopping distance of road vehicles. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 車輛清空所需時間與路口回堵累積
stages.titleEn: Time required for vehicle clearance & Queue spillback toward the crossing
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車輛清空所需時間」與「路口回堵累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Time required for vehicle clearance" and "Queue spillback toward the crossing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車輛清空所需時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time required for vehicle clearance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車輛清空所需時間」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time required for vehicle clearance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以低速穿越距離和等待觀察清空時間，分開長車尾端離開與車頭通過的時刻。道路車輛清空時間從開始等待到車尾完全離開衝突區計算，距離必須包含車長而不能只看車頭的位置。定速度估算只展示等待與移動兩部分，長車起步、轉彎和下游阻塞可能改變速度；鄰近號誌的放行並不保證車尾已有足夠可用空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車輛清空所需時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use low-speed crossing distance and waiting to study clearance time, distinguishing the rear leaving the conflict area from the front merely passing through. Road-vehicle clearance runs from initial waiting until the rear leaves the conflict area, so the distance must include vehicle length rather than front position alone. Constant speed separates waiting and movement conceptually. Long-vehicle acceleration, turning and downstream blockage alter speed; a nearby green indication does not establish adequate space for the vehicle rear. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time required for vehicle clearance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：車尾需行進的清空距離 distance=30 m；假想定車速 speed=2 m/s；起步等待 wait=4 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rear-end clearance travel distance=30 m; assumed constant vehicle speed speed=2 m/s; startup waiting wait=4 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車頭通過平交道出口就表示整輛長車已完全清空」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車輛清空所需時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Time required for vehicle clearance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Use low-speed crossing distance and waiting to study clearance time, distinguishing the rear leaving the conflict area from the front merely passing through. Road-vehicle clearance runs from initial waiting until the rear leaves the conflict area, so the distance must include vehicle length rather than front position alone.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：車尾需行進的清空距離 distance=30 m；假想定車速 speed=2 m/s；起步等待 wait=4 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=19 s。邊界：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rear-end clearance travel distance=30 m; assumed constant vehicle speed speed=2 m/s; startup waiting wait=4 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=19 s. Boundary: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在桌面交通模型標記車頭與車尾事件，分別計算等待與移動；以不同車長重播並核對清空定義完全一致。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 在桌面交通模型標記車頭與車尾事件，分別計算等待與移動；以不同車長重播並核對清空定義完全一致。以「車輛清空所需時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark front and rear events in a desktop traffic model, measure waiting and motion separately, and replay different vehicle lengths with one consistent clearance definition. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. steps.title: 路口回堵累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Queue spillback toward the crossing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路口回堵累積」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Queue spillback toward the crossing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元直接追蹤鄰近路口車輛到達與離開率，說明下游服務不足如何造成車數累積，並將車列長度另列為幾何限制。道路車列的新增存量來自到達與離開流率差乘時間，計數邊界必須在同一車道群。這是預期流量的連續近似，實際車輛是離散事件；回堵是否到達平交道還取決於車長、車間距和可儲存道路長度，僅有平均服務率無法證明衝突區不被占用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均流率且佇列持續存在的增量模型，未計初始車數、儲車長度或離散到達。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路口回堵累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track vehicle arrival and departure rates directly at the adjacent junction, showing how insufficient downstream service accumulates vehicles while treating physical queue length as a separate geometric constraint. New road-queue occupancy is the difference between arrival and departure rates times duration, measured over one lane group. This is a continuous approximation to expected flow while actual vehicles are discrete events. Whether spillback reaches a crossing also depends on vehicle lengths, gaps and storage distance; average service rate alone cannot prove that the conflict area remains clear. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Increment under fixed mean flows with a persistent queue, excluding initial occupancy, storage length and discrete arrivals. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Queue spillback toward the crossing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: road-vehicle arrival rate arrival=0.4 vehicles/s; downstream departure rate service=0.3 vehicles/s; observation duration duration=90 s.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable downstream vehicle discharge per minute proves that upstream spillback cannot occur." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用桌面道路模型核對同一邊界的進出車數與內部存量，再以不同車長重播，將車數與實際排隊長度分開量測。

steps.title: 路口回堵累積：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路口回堵累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Queue spillback toward the crossing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用桌面道路模型核對同一邊界的進出車數與內部存量，再以不同車長重播，將車數與實際排隊長度分開量測。以「路口回堵累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Explain the causal direction for queue spillback toward the crossing, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.title: 路口回堵累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Queue spillback toward the crossing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路口回堵累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Queue spillback toward the crossing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看路口出口放行量會漏掉上游車列增長，長車比例提高又可能在車數不變時使排隊尾端更接近平交道。回到「路口回堵累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exit discharge alone misses upstream queue growth, while a greater proportion of long vehicles can move the queue tail toward the crossing at unchanged vehicle count. Trace the input chain for queue spillback toward the crossing. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均流率且佇列持續存在的增量模型，未計初始車數、儲車長度或離散到達。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Increment under fixed mean flows with a persistent queue, excluding initial occupancy, storage length and discrete arrivals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「下游每分鐘放行車數穩定就能證明上游不會回堵」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable downstream vehicle discharge per minute proves that upstream spillback cannot occur." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看路口出口放行量會漏掉上游車列增長，長車比例提高又可能在車數不變時使排隊尾端更接近平交道。回到「路口回堵累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
