Trace the input chain for queue spillback toward the crossing. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「路口回堵累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Queue spillback toward the crossing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只看路口出口放行量會漏掉上游車列增長，長車比例提高又可能在車數不變時使排隊尾端更接近平交道。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Exit discharge alone misses upstream queue growth, while a greater proportion of long vehicles can move the queue tail toward the crossing at unchanged vehicle count.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 只看路口出口放行量會漏掉上游車列增長，長車比例提高又可能在車數不變時使排隊尾端更接近平交道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Exit discharge alone misses upstream queue growth, while a greater proportion of long vehicles can move the queue tail toward the crossing at unchanged vehicle count. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 警示聯動時序與道路與鐵道事件對齊
stages.titleEn: Timing of coordinated warnings & Aligning road and rail events
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警示聯動時序」與「道路與鐵道事件對齊」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Timing of coordinated warnings" and "Aligning road and rail events": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警示聯動時序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Timing of coordinated warnings: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警示聯動時序」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Timing of coordinated warnings” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將列車接近偵測、介面傳遞與道路警示動作分段記錄，避免漏掉交接時間。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警示聯動時序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Record train-approach detection, interface transfer and road-warning action as separate stages, avoiding omitted handoff time. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Timing of coordinated warnings” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警示聯動時序」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Timing of coordinated warnings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Record train-approach detection, interface transfer and road-warning action as separate stages, avoiding omitted handoff time. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「警示聯動時序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Record train-approach detection, interface transfer and road-warning action as separate stages, avoiding omitted handoff time.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 本單元核對道路控制器與鐵道紀錄的時基，讓事件重建能可靠區分先因後果。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「道路與鐵道事件對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「道路與鐵道事件對齊」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For aligning road and rail events, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「道路與鐵道事件對齊」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for aligning road and rail events, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 道路與鐵道事件對齊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aligning road and rail events: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「道路與鐵道事件對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aligning road and rail events” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「道路與鐵道事件對齊」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for aligning road and rail events. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「道路與鐵道事件對齊」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
quiz.explanation: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 區段偵測有效性與警示備援電源
stages.titleEn: Validity of section detection & Backup energy for warnings
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「區段偵測有效性」與「警示備援電源」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Validity of section detection" and "Backup energy for warnings": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 區段偵測有效性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Validity of section detection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區段偵測有效性」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Validity of section detection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以離線計數模型檢查接近區段的占用資訊，保留感測故障與未知狀態。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段偵測有效性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an offline counting model to check approach-section occupancy information while retaining sensor-failure and unknown states. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Validity of section detection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段偵測有效性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Validity of section detection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 區段偵測有效性
knowledge.text: 本單元以離線計數模型檢查接近區段的占用資訊，保留感測故障與未知狀態。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。
knowledge.textEn: Use an offline counting model to check approach-section occupancy information while retaining sensor-failure and unknown states. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「區段偵測有效性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Validity of section detection" is correct?
options: 進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車

optionsEn: Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
Use an offline counting model to check approach-section occupancy information while retaining sensor-failure and unknown states.
Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以離線計數模型檢查接近區段的占用資訊，保留感測故障與未知狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 區段偵測有效性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Validity of section detection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區段偵測有效性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Validity of section detection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以標記輪對的玩具車雙向重播，對照人工真值、事件順序與感測器有效旗標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.

steps.title: 警示備援電源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup energy for warnings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警示備援電源」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup energy for warnings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 老化電池可能保有部分容量但內阻升高，啟動負載時掉壓使設備提早中止。回到「警示備援電源」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An aged battery may retain some capacity while internal resistance rises, causing early shutdown during a starting load. Trace the input chain for backup energy for warnings. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 警示失效原因樹與路鐵整合情境矩陣
stages.titleEn: Fault causes for warning failure & Road–rail integration scenario matrix
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警示失效原因樹」與「路鐵整合情境矩陣」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fault causes for warning failure" and "Road–rail integration scenario matrix": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警示失效原因樹：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault causes for warning failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警示失效原因樹」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault causes for warning failure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將供電、通訊和顯示器異常分開列入原因樹，要求每個候選原因有可區分的量測。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警示失效原因樹」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate supply, communication and display faults in a cause tree, requiring discriminating measurements for each candidate cause. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault causes for warning failure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警示失效原因樹」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault causes for warning failure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

steps.title: 警示失效原因樹：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault causes for warning failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「警示失效原因樹」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault causes for warning failure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.titleEn: Fault causes for warning failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「警示失效原因樹」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault causes for warning failure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「警示失效原因樹」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. Explain the causal direction for fault causes for warning failure, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 月台門列車停準整合
courses.summary: 本課聚焦停車位置門控時序與月台介面誤差預算。從停準接近軌跡建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把重複停準統計分散與旅客交換與門週期連成可驗證的介面，最後以停準試驗樣本界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies stopping position door timing and platform-interface error budgets. Start with precision-stop approach trajectory to define physical or information boundaries, connect statistical spread of repeated stops with passenger exchange and door cycle as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through sampling limits of stopping trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 停車位置門控時序與月台介面誤差預算
courses.focusEn: Stopping position door timing and platform-interface error budgets
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究停準接近軌跡。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究停準資訊有效時間：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate precision-stop approach trajectory. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate freshness of stopping information: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 停準接近軌跡與停準資訊有效時間
stages.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory & Freshness of stopping information
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停準接近軌跡」與「停準資訊有效時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Precision-stop approach trajectory" and "Freshness of stopping information": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準接近軌跡」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Precision-stop approach trajectory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準接近軌跡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Precision-stop approach trajectory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準接近軌跡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Precision-stop approach trajectory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停準接近軌跡
knowledge.text: 本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。
knowledge.textEn: Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停準接近軌跡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Precision-stop approach trajectory" is correct?
options: 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準接近軌跡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Precision-stop approach trajectory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停準接近軌跡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Precision-stop approach trajectory", which statement holds?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
optionsEn: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準接近軌跡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Precision-stop approach trajectory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「停準接近軌跡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For precision-stop approach trajectory, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「停準接近軌跡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for precision-stop approach trajectory, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「停準接近軌跡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For precision-stop approach trajectory, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「停準接近軌跡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for precision-stop approach trajectory, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停準接近軌跡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Precision-stop approach trajectory"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
quiz.explanation: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準接近軌跡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Precision-stop approach trajectory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「停準接近軌跡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for precision-stop approach trajectory. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 停準資訊有效時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Freshness of stopping information: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準資訊有效時間」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freshness of stopping information” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較最後定位點到開門判定的資料年齡，理解車速接近零仍不代表資料來源已被確認。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準資訊有效時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare data age between the final position observation and the door decision; near-zero speed does not establish that the position source has been validated. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Freshness of stopping information” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly received packet always contains the present position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準資訊有效時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Freshness of stopping information”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A newly received packet always contains the present position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.

steps.title: 停準資訊有效時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Freshness of stopping information: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準資訊有效時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freshness of stopping information” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準資訊有效時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「停準資訊有效時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 車門月台橫向容差：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元列出軌道偏移、車體側移與量測基準的界限，避免把縱向停準良好誤當全部幾何介面良好。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門月台橫向容差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: List bounds for track offset, body movement and survey references, avoiding the assumption that good longitudinal stopping establishes every geometric interface. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral door–platform tolerances” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral door–platform tolerances” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.explanation: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 列車與月台門交接與門組配對狀態機
stages.titleEn: Train and platform-door handoff & Paired-door state machine
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車與月台門交接」與「門組配對狀態機」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train and platform-door handoff" and "Paired-door state machine": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車與月台門交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train and platform-door handoff: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車與月台門交接」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train and platform-door handoff” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元記錄停穩、位置確認、門控接收與動作回授的順序，找出跨設備等待而非只看單門動作時間。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車與月台門交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Record stopped state, position confirmation, command reception and movement feedback to identify inter-device waiting rather than only individual door travel time. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train and platform-door handoff” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車與月台門交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Train and platform-door handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 列車與月台門交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train and platform-door handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車與月台門交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train and platform-door handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 列車與月台門交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train and platform-door handoff: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車與月台門交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Train and platform-door handoff” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「列車與月台門交接」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For train and platform-door handoff, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「列車與月台門交接」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for train and platform-door handoff, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「列車與月台門交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旅客交換與門週期」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Passenger exchange and door cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把旅客交換時間與關門確認時間分開，分析窄門、行李及重複開門如何改變站停變異。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旅客交換與門週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Passenger exchange and door cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 旅客交換與門週期

knowledge.textEn: Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旅客交換與門週期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

本單元把旅客交換時間與關門確認時間分開，分析窄門、行李及重複開門如何改變站停變異。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旅客交換與門週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Passenger exchange and door cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「旅客交換與門週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A newly received packet always contains the present position.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旅客交換與門週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Passenger exchange and door cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「旅客交換與門週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For passenger exchange and door cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「旅客交換與門週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for passenger exchange and door cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「旅客交換與門週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For passenger exchange and door cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「旅客交換與門週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「旅客交換與門週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Passenger exchange and door cycle"?
options: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「旅客交換與門週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Passenger exchange and door cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「旅客交換與門週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for passenger exchange and door cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「旅客交換與門週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for passenger exchange and door cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「旅客交換與門週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Passenger exchange and door cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
quiz.explanation: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 門組故障服務影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service impact of door faults: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門組故障服務影響」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Service impact of door faults” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門組故障服務影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare loss of one doorway with loss of an entire train service, recording repair waiting separately from component replacement time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Service impact of door faults” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「門組故障服務影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Service impact of door faults”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 門組故障服務影響
knowledge.text: 本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。
knowledge.textEn: Compare loss of one doorway with loss of an entire train service, recording repair waiting separately from component replacement time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「門組故障服務影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service impact of door faults" is correct?
options: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。
optionsEn: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

steps.title: 門組故障服務影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service impact of door faults: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門組故障服務影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Service impact of door faults” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「門組故障服務影響」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
