steps.title: 月台交換耦合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coupling platform exchange to dwell: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台交換耦合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Coupling platform exchange to dwell” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「月台交換耦合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For coupling platform exchange to dwell, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「月台交換耦合」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for coupling platform exchange to dwell, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Coupling platform exchange to dwell: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台交換耦合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coupling platform exchange to dwell” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「月台交換耦合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for coupling platform exchange to dwell. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「月台交換耦合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for coupling platform exchange to dwell. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台交換耦合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coupling platform exchange to dwell" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
optionsEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
quiz.explanation: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 非常態需求與出口與人流資料取樣尺度
stages.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits & Sampling scale for flow data
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「非常態需求與出口」與「人流資料取樣尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exceptional demand and exits" and "Sampling scale for flow data": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 非常態需求與出口：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「非常態需求與出口」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exceptional demand and exits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「非常態需求與出口」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exceptional demand and exits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「非常態需求與出口」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Exceptional demand and exits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 非常態需求與出口
knowledge.text: 本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。
knowledge.textEn: Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「非常態需求與出口」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exceptional demand and exits" is correct?
options: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。
只要軌跡取樣頻率提高就必定得到更準確的行人位置
optionsEn: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument.
Increasing trajectory sample rate always produces more accurate pedestrian positions.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 非常態需求與出口：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非常態需求與出口」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exceptional demand and exits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「非常態需求與出口」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exceptional demand and exits", which statement holds?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度
原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 非常態需求與出口：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非常態需求與出口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exceptional demand and exits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「非常態需求與出口」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For exceptional demand and exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「非常態需求與出口」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only evacuating population people from 600 to 601 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 421.667 to 422.111 s. Explain the causal direction for exceptional demand and exits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「非常態需求與出口」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For exceptional demand and exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「非常態需求與出口」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only evacuating population people from 600 to 601 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 421.667 to 422.111 s. Explain the causal direction for exceptional demand and exits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非常態需求與出口」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exceptional demand and exits"?
options: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠
optionsEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded.
quiz.explanation: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 需求群體情境矩陣：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元分別測試攜帶行李、協助需求與單向尖峰，保留未校準的群體而不以平均旅客取代所有人。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「需求群體情境矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Test luggage, assistance needs and directional peaks separately, retaining uncalibrated populations rather than replacing everyone with an average traveller. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元檢查無壅塞結果是否依賴相同隨機種子及固定需求，將可重現性與獨立抽樣明確區分。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模擬成功外推界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether congestion-free results depend on one random seed and fixed demand, distinguishing reproducibility from independent sampling. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Limits of successful simulation runs” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模擬成功外推界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Limits of successful simulation runs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模擬成功外推界限
knowledge.text: 本單元檢查無壅塞結果是否依賴相同隨機種子及固定需求，將可重現性與獨立抽樣明確區分。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether congestion-free results depend on one random seed and fixed demand, distinguishing reproducibility from independent sampling. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模擬成功外推界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Limits of successful simulation runs" is correct?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
本單元檢查無壅塞結果是否依賴相同隨機種子及固定需求，將可重現性與獨立抽樣明確區分。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Check whether congestion-free results depend on one random seed and fixed demand, distinguishing reproducibility from independent sampling.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 本單元檢查無壅塞結果是否依賴相同隨機種子及固定需求，將可重現性與獨立抽樣明確區分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether congestion-free results depend on one random seed and fixed demand, distinguishing reproducibility from independent sampling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模擬成功外推界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Limits of successful simulation runs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模擬成功外推界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Limits of successful simulation runs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模擬成功外推界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Limits of successful simulation runs", which statement holds?
options: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
optionsEn: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模擬成功外推界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Limits of successful simulation runs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模擬成功外推界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Limits of successful simulation runs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「模擬成功外推界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For limits of successful simulation runs, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「模擬成功外推界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for limits of successful simulation runs, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「模擬成功外推界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For limits of successful simulation runs, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「模擬成功外推界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for limits of successful simulation runs, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模擬成功外推界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Limits of successful simulation runs"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模擬成功外推界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Limits of successful simulation runs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模擬成功外推界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Limits of successful simulation runs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「模擬成功外推界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for limits of successful simulation runs. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「模擬成功外推界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for limits of successful simulation runs. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模擬成功外推界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Limits of successful simulation runs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 轉乘車站垂直動線
courses.summary: 本課聚焦轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合。從樓梯出口有效淨寬建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把扶梯下端積壓與垂直運輸往返節拍連成可驗證的介面，最後以跨層動線驗證安排整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration. Start with effective width at stair exits to define physical or information boundaries, connect accumulation at escalator landings with round-trip vertical-service cycle as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through planning multilevel route verification. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合
courses.focusEn: Transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究樓梯出口有效淨寬。原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。敏感度只改 width=2.4 至 2.64 m，輸出變為 2.904 persons/s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究跨樓層轉乘時間：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate effective width at stair exits. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. For sensitivity, change only width=2.4 to 2.64 m; the output becomes 2.904 persons/s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate travel time between levels: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬與跨樓層轉乘時間
stages.titleEn: Effective width at stair exits & Travel time between levels
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樓梯出口有效淨寬」與「跨樓層轉乘時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective width at stair exits" and "Travel time between levels": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective width at stair exits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樓梯出口有效淨寬」如何影響轉乘車站垂直動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective width at stair exits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樓梯出口有效淨寬」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective width at stair exits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樓梯出口有效淨寬」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective width at stair exits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬
knowledge.text: 本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樓梯出口有效淨寬」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective width at stair exits" is correct?
options: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
optionsEn: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective width at stair exits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓梯出口有效淨寬」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective width at stair exits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓梯出口有效淨寬」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective width at stair exits", which statement holds?
options: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠
原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
optionsEn: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective width at stair exits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓梯出口有效淨寬」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective width at stair exits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「樓梯出口有效淨寬」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For effective width at stair exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「樓梯出口有效淨寬」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for effective width at stair exits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「樓梯出口有效淨寬」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For effective width at stair exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「樓梯出口有效淨寬」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for effective width at stair exits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樓梯出口有效淨寬」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective width at stair exits"?
options: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective width at stair exits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓梯出口有效淨寬」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective width at stair exits” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。回到「樓梯出口有效淨寬」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. Trace the input chain for effective width at stair exits. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time.
quiz.explanation: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 高差與坡道路徑與扶梯下端積壓
stages.titleEn: Level changes and ramp routes & Accumulation at escalator landings
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高差與坡道路徑」與「扶梯下端積壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Level changes and ramp routes" and "Accumulation at escalator landings": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高差與坡道路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level changes and ramp routes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高差與坡道路徑」如何影響轉乘車站垂直動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level changes and ramp routes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用端點高程與水平距離檢查坡道幾何，另外保留平台、轉向空間與排水造成的局部橫坡。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高差與坡道路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check ramp geometry using endpoint elevations and horizontal run, while separately retaining landings, turning space and drainage-related local cross-slope. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length. Landings, cross-slope and transitions also matter because wheelchair users need space to turn and stop. Meeting one geometric ratio does not establish continuous usability of an accessible route. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level changes and ramp routes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高差與坡道路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level changes and ramp routes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高差與坡道路徑
knowledge.text: 本單元用端點高程與水平距離檢查坡道幾何，另外保留平台、轉向空間與排水造成的局部橫坡。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。
knowledge.textEn: Check ramp geometry using endpoint elevations and horizontal run, while separately retaining landings, turning space and drainage-related local cross-slope. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高差與坡道路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Level changes and ramp routes" is correct?
options: 本單元用端點高程與水平距離檢查坡道幾何，另外保留平台、轉向空間與排水造成的局部橫坡。
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Check ramp geometry using endpoint elevations and horizontal run, while separately retaining landings, turning space and drainage-related local cross-slope.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用端點高程與水平距離檢查坡道幾何，另外保留平台、轉向空間與排水造成的局部橫坡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Check ramp geometry using endpoint elevations and horizontal run, while separately retaining landings, turning space and drainage-related local cross-slope. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高差與坡道路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Level changes and ramp routes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高差與坡道路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level changes and ramp routes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高差與坡道路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Level changes and ramp routes", which statement holds?
options: 整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠
原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高差與坡道路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level changes and ramp routes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高差與坡道路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level changes and ramp routes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。以「高差與坡道路徑」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route. For level changes and ramp routes, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把水平長度 run 從 7.5 改成 8.25 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變為 5.45455 percent。先說明「高差與坡道路徑」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only horizontal run run from 7.5 to 8.25 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6 to 5.45455 percent. Explain the causal direction for level changes and ramp routes, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。以「高差與坡道路徑」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route. For level changes and ramp routes, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把水平長度 run 從 7.5 改成 8.25 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變為 5.45455 percent。先說明「高差與坡道路徑」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only horizontal run run from 7.5 to 8.25 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6 to 5.45455 percent. Explain the causal direction for level changes and ramp routes, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高差與坡道路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level changes and ramp routes"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route.
quiz.explanation: 以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高差與坡道路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level changes and ramp routes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高差與坡道路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level changes and ramp routes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「高差與坡道路徑」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for level changes and ramp routes. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「高差與坡道路徑」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for level changes and ramp routes. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高差與坡道路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level changes and ramp routes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 扶梯下端積壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Accumulation at escalator landings: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「扶梯下端積壓」如何影響轉乘車站垂直動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accumulation at escalator landings” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤下游突然降速造成的等候存量，避免只用扶梯運轉速度推論落地區可以承受人流。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「扶梯下端積壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track waiting occupancy when downstream movement slows, avoiding inference of landing capacity from escalator running speed alone. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. steps.title: 扶梯下端積壓：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 電梯等候平均存量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean occupancy in elevator waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以共同入口邊界核對平均等待與排隊人數，將乘車時間和候梯時間分開避免重複計入。穩態平均存量等於平均到達率乘平均停留時間，這是流量與庫存的連結，不需要先指定排隊分布。它不能描述單一尖峰時刻，也不會告訴人群在空間上如何分布；量測窗若仍在快速累積，就不宜直接套用穩態關係。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電梯等候平均存量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use one entrance boundary to compare average wait with queue size, separating travel inside the lift from waiting to avoid double counting. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：區內人數 people=180 persons；可站立面積 area=90 m2。公式 y=people/area，代入得 y=2 persons/m2。邊界：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupants people=180 persons; usable standing area area=90 m2. Formula y=people/area gives y=2 persons/m2. Boundary: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉角匯流局部密度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
原創假想教學輸入：區內人數 people=180 persons；可站立面積 area=90 m2。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupants people=180 persons; usable standing area area=90 m2.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：區內人數 people=180 persons；可站立面積 area=90 m2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupants people=180 persons; usable standing area area=90 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉角匯流局部密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local density at merging corners: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉角匯流局部密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local density at merging corners” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。以「轉角匯流局部密度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers. For local density at merging corners, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把可站立面積 area 從 90 改成 99 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 persons/m2。先說明「轉角匯流局部密度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only usable standing area area from 90 to 99 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 persons/m2. Explain the causal direction for local density at merging corners, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。以「轉角匯流局部密度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers. For local density at merging corners, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把可站立面積 area 從 90 改成 99 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 persons/m2。先說明「轉角匯流局部密度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only usable standing area area from 90 to 99 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 persons/m2. Explain the causal direction for local density at merging corners, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉角匯流局部密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local density at merging corners"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
