optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers.
quiz.explanation: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉角匯流局部密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local density at merging corners: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉角匯流局部密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local density at merging corners” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。回到「轉角匯流局部密度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Trace the input chain for local density at merging corners. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。回到「轉角匯流局部密度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Trace the input chain for local density at merging corners. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉角匯流局部密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local density at merging corners" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數
optionsEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour.
quiz.explanation: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 垂直運輸往返節拍與層間辨識與照明
stages.titleEn: Round-trip vertical-service cycle & Level identification and lighting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直運輸往返節拍」與「層間辨識與照明」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Round-trip vertical-service cycle" and "Level identification and lighting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直運輸往返節拍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip vertical-service cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直運輸往返節拍」如何影響轉乘車站垂直動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip vertical-service cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把電梯登乘、行進、離開及回程直接列成完整週期，將門動作納入服務時間並區分每小時循環與每小時旅客數。單台電梯往返週期由登乘、行進、離開及回程組成，門動作必須被計入服務階段。理想每小時循環數不等於每小時可服務人數，還需考慮載客量、樓層呼叫、上下行需求與可用性；乘客集中到達時，平均循環有餘裕也可能形成長候梯隊伍。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩樓層串行往返且無中途停靠的理想循環，未含載客量及等待分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直運輸往返節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: List elevator boarding, travel, alighting and return directly as one complete cycle, including door actions and distinguishing trips per hour from passengers per hour. An elevator round trip includes boarding, travel, alighting and return, with door actions included in the service phases. Ideal cycles per hour are not passengers per hour: occupancy, floor calls, directional demand and availability also matter. Concentrated passenger arrivals can create long waits even when the mean cycle appears to offer spare capacity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal serial round trip between two levels without intermediate stops, excluding occupancy and waiting distributions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip vertical-service cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：開門登乘及關門 board=18 s；載客行進 travel=24 s；開門離開及關門 alight=16 s；回程時間 return_=24 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: door and boarding time board=18 s; loaded travel travel=24 s; door and alighting time alight=16 s; return travel return_=24 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直運輸往返節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip vertical-service cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直運輸往返節拍
knowledge.text: 本單元把電梯登乘、行進、離開及回程直接列成完整週期，將門動作納入服務時間並區分每小時循環與每小時旅客數。單台電梯往返週期由登乘、行進、離開及回程組成，門動作必須被計入服務階段。
knowledge.textEn: List elevator boarding, travel, alighting and return directly as one complete cycle, including door actions and distinguishing trips per hour from passengers per hour. An elevator round trip includes boarding, travel, alighting and return, with door actions included in the service phases.

knowledge.text: 誤解：電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直運輸往返節拍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip vertical-service cycle" is correct?
options: 電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數
本單元把電梯登乘、行進、離開及回程直接列成完整週期，將門動作納入服務時間並區分每小時循環與每小時旅客數。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour.
List elevator boarding, travel, alighting and return directly as one complete cycle, including door actions and distinguishing trips per hour from passengers per hour.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.

quiz.explanationEn: List elevator boarding, travel, alighting and return directly as one complete cycle, including door actions and distinguishing trips per hour from passengers per hour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直運輸往返節拍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip vertical-service cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直運輸往返節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip vertical-service cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：開門登乘及關門 board=18 s；載客行進 travel=24 s；開門離開及關門 alight=16 s；回程時間 return_=24 s。公式 y=3600/(board+travel+alight+return_)，代入得 y=43.9024 trips/h。邊界：兩樓層串行往返且無中途停靠的理想循環，未含載客量及等待分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: door and boarding time board=18 s; loaded travel travel=24 s; door and alighting time alight=16 s; return travel return_=24 s. Formula y=3600/(board+travel+alight+return_) gives y=43.9024 trips/h. Boundary: Ideal serial round trip between two levels without intermediate stops, excluding occupancy and waiting distributions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一門開關事件界定各階段，分別記錄登乘與離開，抽查回程空載及途中呼叫是否改變循環邊界。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define stages with consistent door events, record boarding and alighting separately, and inspect whether empty return or intermediate calls change the cycle boundary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.instruction: 以同一門開關事件界定各階段，分別記錄登乘與離開，抽查回程空載及途中呼叫是否改變循環邊界。以「垂直運輸往返節拍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define stages with consistent door events, record boarding and alighting separately, and inspect whether empty return or intermediate calls change the cycle boundary. For round-trip vertical-service cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. steps.instruction: 漏算回程會高估循環率，把門動作在兩個階段重複計入則會低估能力；實際載客需求還可能由上游排隊控制。回到「垂直運輸往返節拍」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objective: 說明「層間辨識與照明」如何影響轉乘車站垂直動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level identification and lighting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元檢查轉折處照度與指標對比，讓旅客能在到達分流點前辨認正確樓層與方向。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「層間辨識與照明」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check illuminance and sign contrast at turns so travellers can identify the correct level and direction before reaching the route split. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level identification and lighting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 層間辨識與照明：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level identification and lighting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「層間辨識與照明」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level identification and lighting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「層間辨識與照明」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For level identification and lighting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「層間辨識與照明」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for level identification and lighting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.titleEn: Level identification and lighting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「層間辨識與照明」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level identification and lighting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。回到「層間辨識與照明」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Trace the input chain for level identification and lighting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alternative routes during lift outages" and "Planning multilevel route verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電梯停用替代路徑：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「電梯停用替代路徑」如何影響轉乘車站垂直動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alternative routes during lift outages” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical circulation in interchange stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以角色任務矩陣檢查電梯停用後的可達路徑，不能把需要樓梯的替代線視為所有旅客可用。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電梯停用替代路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a user-task matrix to examine accessible routes during a lift outage; a stair-only alternative is not usable by every passenger. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alternative routes during lift outages” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電梯停用替代路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「跨層動線驗證安排」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for planning multilevel route verification, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨層動線驗證安排」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Planning multilevel route verification"?
options: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數
optionsEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour.
quiz.explanation: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 跨層動線驗證安排：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Planning multilevel route verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨層動線驗證安排」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Planning multilevel route verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「跨層動線驗證安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for planning multilevel route verification. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「跨層動線驗證安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for planning multilevel route verification. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「跨層動線驗證安排」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Planning multilevel route verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 軌道運輸無障礙月台
courses.summary: 本課聚焦月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑。從月台與車體界限建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把無障礙完整旅程與協助登乘時間連成可驗證的介面，最後以使用性測試推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys. Start with platform and vehicle bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect complete accessible journey time with assisted boarding time as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from usability trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑
courses.focusEn: Platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究月台與車體界限。原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。敏感度只改 body=10 至 11 mm，輸出變為 22 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究重複量測與共同偏差：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate platform and vehicle bounds. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. For sensitivity, change only body=10 to 11 mm; the output becomes 22 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate repeated observations and shared bias: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：月台與車體界限採 track=8 mm；本課公式結果 21 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：重複量測與共同偏差採 s1=3 mm；本課公式結果 5 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：坡道縱橫坡分離採 rise=0.45 m；本課公式結果 6 percent，非現場額定值。
教學假設：無障礙完整旅程採 distance=120 m；本課公式結果 185 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：輔具通行有效空間採 width=2.4 m；本課公式結果 2.64 persons/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：視覺辨識與暗點採 flux=2400 lm；本課公式結果 45 lx，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for platform and vehicle bounds: track=8 mm; this model gives 21 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for repeated observations and shared bias: s1=3 mm; this model gives 5 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for separating ramp slope and cross-slope: rise=0.45 m; this model gives 6 percent, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for complete accessible journey time: distance=120 m; this model gives 185 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for clear space for mobility aids: width=2.4 m; this model gives 2.64 persons/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for visual recognition and dark areas: flux=2400 lm; this model gives 45 lx, not a field rating.

stages.title: 月台與車體界限與重複量測與共同偏差
stages.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds & Repeated observations and shared bias
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台與車體界限」與「重複量測與共同偏差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Platform and vehicle bounds" and "Repeated observations and shared bias": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台與車體界限」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform and vehicle bounds” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台與車體界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform and vehicle bounds” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台與車體界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform and vehicle bounds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台與車體界限
knowledge.text: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「月台與車體界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Platform and vehicle bounds" is correct?
options: 三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台與車體界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform and vehicle bounds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「月台與車體界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台與車體界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform and vehicle bounds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「月台與車體界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For platform and vehicle bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「月台與車體界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only body displacement bound body from 10 to 11 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 21 to 22 mm. Explain the causal direction for platform and vehicle bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台與車體界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform and vehicle bounds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「月台與車體界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for platform and vehicle bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複量測與共同偏差」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated observations and shared bias” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複量測與共同偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated observations and shared bias” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複量測與共同偏差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeated observations and shared bias”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複量測與共同偏差
knowledge.text: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複量測與共同偏差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated observations and shared bias” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated observations and shared bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「重複量測與共同偏差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for repeated observations and shared bias. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Separating ramp slope and cross-slope" and "Complete accessible journey time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡道縱橫坡分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Separating ramp slope and cross-slope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡道縱橫坡分離」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Separating ramp slope and cross-slope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元同時保留長向高差與橫向排水需求，將整段平均坡度與輪椅實際輪跡局部坡度比較。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡道縱橫坡分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retain longitudinal rise and transverse drainage requirements, comparing whole-route average slope with local slope along actual wheelchair paths. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length. Landings, cross-slope and transitions also matter because wheelchair users need space to turn and stop. Meeting one geometric ratio does not establish continuous usability of an accessible route. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Separating ramp slope and cross-slope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡道縱橫坡分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Separating ramp slope and cross-slope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Retain longitudinal rise and transverse drainage requirements, comparing whole-route average slope with local slope along actual wheelchair paths. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete accessible journey time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無障礙完整旅程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete accessible journey time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
quiz.explanation: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete accessible journey time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無障礙完整旅程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete accessible journey time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「無障礙完整旅程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for complete accessible journey time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「無障礙完整旅程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for complete accessible journey time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無障礙完整旅程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete accessible journey time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 輔具通行有效空間與視覺辨識與暗點
stages.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids & Visual recognition and dark areas
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輔具通行有效空間」與「視覺辨識與暗點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Clear space for mobility aids" and "Visual recognition and dark areas": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輔具通行有效空間」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clear space for mobility aids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輔具通行有效空間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Clear space for mobility aids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輔具通行有效空間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Clear space for mobility aids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輔具通行有效空間
knowledge.text: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輔具通行有效空間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clear space for mobility aids" is correct?
options: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。
optionsEn: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輔具通行有效空間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clear space for mobility aids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輔具通行有效空間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Clear space for mobility aids", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輔具通行有效空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clear space for mobility aids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「輔具通行有效空間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For clear space for mobility aids, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「輔具通行有效空間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for clear space for mobility aids, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「輔具通行有效空間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For clear space for mobility aids, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「輔具通行有效空間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for clear space for mobility aids, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輔具通行有效空間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Clear space for mobility aids"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。

Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.instructionEn: Compare lighting at platform edges, signs and doors, checking whether an average hides dark areas important to passengers with low vision. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Visual recognition and dark areas” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
