quiz.explanation: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 協助登乘時間與電梯服務需求累積
stages.titleEn: Assisted boarding time & Accumulating demand for elevators
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「協助登乘時間」與「電梯服務需求累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Assisted boarding time" and "Accumulating demand for elevators": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「協助登乘時間」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Assisted boarding time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「協助登乘時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Assisted boarding time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「協助登乘時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Assisted boarding time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 協助登乘時間
knowledge.text: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。
knowledge.textEn: Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「協助登乘時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Assisted boarding time" is correct?
options: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「協助登乘時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Assisted boarding time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「協助登乘時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Assisted boarding time", which statement holds?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「協助登乘時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Assisted boarding time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「協助登乘時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For assisted boarding time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「協助登乘時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for assisted boarding time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「協助登乘時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For assisted boarding time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「協助登乘時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for assisted boarding time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「協助登乘時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Assisted boarding time"?
options: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
optionsEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「協助登乘時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Assisted boarding time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「協助登乘時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for assisted boarding time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「協助登乘時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for assisted boarding time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「協助登乘時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Assisted boarding time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電梯服務需求累積」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accumulating demand for elevators” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤行動受限者及攜行李旅客的共同需求，保留無法立即進入下一班電梯的人數。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電梯服務需求累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Accumulating demand for elevators” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Accumulating demand for elevators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電梯服務需求累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accumulating demand for elevators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「電梯服務需求累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Accumulating demand for elevators", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s。
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電梯服務需求累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Accumulating demand for elevators” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「電梯服務需求累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulating demand for elevators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「電梯服務需求累積」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulating demand for elevators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「電梯服務需求累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulating demand for elevators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「電梯服務需求累積」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulating demand for elevators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電梯服務需求累積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Accumulating demand for elevators"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電梯服務需求累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Accumulating demand for elevators” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulating demand for elevators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulating demand for elevators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電梯服務需求累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accumulating demand for elevators" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows.
quiz.explanation: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣與使用性測試推論
stages.titleEn: User-capability case matrix & Inference from usability trials
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「使用者能力案例矩陣」與「使用性測試推論」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "User-capability case matrix" and "Inference from usability trials": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: User-capability case matrix: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「使用者能力案例矩陣」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “User-capability case matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以不同輔具、視覺與聽覺需求檢查同一路徑，要求每個介面都有對應的可觀察任務。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「使用者能力案例矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check one route with different mobility, vision and hearing needs, requiring an observable task for each interface. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “User-capability case matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元檢查受試者是否涵蓋真正的能力差異，強調有限次順利通行不能證明所有使用者都無障礙。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「使用性測試推論」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether participants represent meaningful capability differences; a finite set of successful trips does not establish access for every user. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inference from usability trials” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「使用性測試推論」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inference from usability trials” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「使用性測試推論」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inference from usability trials", which statement holds?
options: 只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
optionsEn: An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 使用性測試推論：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inference from usability trials: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「使用性測試推論」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inference from usability trials” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「使用性測試推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from usability trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「使用性測試推論」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for inference from usability trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「使用性測試推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from usability trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「使用性測試推論」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for inference from usability trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用性測試推論」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inference from usability trials"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 使用性測試推論：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inference from usability trials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「使用性測試推論」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inference from usability trials” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「使用性測試推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for inference from usability trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「使用性測試推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for inference from usability trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用性測試推論」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inference from usability trials" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鐵路車站排煙整合
courses.summary: 本課聚焦車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合。從排煙斷面速度分布建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風速量級與壓力與控制與照明備援連成可驗證的介面，最後以排煙模式整合案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements. Start with velocity distribution in exhaust sections to define physical or information boundaries, connect air-speed scale and pressure with backup for controls and lighting as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through integrated smoke-mode cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合
courses.focusEn: Integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究排煙斷面速度分布。原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。敏感度只改 A=16 至 17.6 m2，輸出變為 1.81818 m/s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究風機壓升能量帳：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. For sensitivity, change only A=16 to 17.6 m2; the output becomes 1.81818 m/s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate fan pressure and energy accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：排煙斷面速度分布採 Q=32 m3/s；本課公式結果 2 m/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：風機壓升能量帳採 Q=40 m3/s；本課公式結果 34.2857 kW，非現場額定值。
教學假設：門口與旁通流量採 Cd=0.65 1；本課公式結果 30.0222 m3/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：風速量級與壓力採 rho=1.2 kg/m3；本課公式結果 135 Pa，非現場額定值。
教學假設：煙流與清空時間邊界採 people=600 persons；本課公式結果 421.667 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：偵測至風路建立採 sense=0.03 s；本課公式結果 0.25 s，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for velocity distribution in exhaust sections: Q=32 m3/s; this model gives 2 m/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for fan pressure and energy accounting: Q=40 m3/s; this model gives 34.2857 kW, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for doorway and bypass flow: Cd=0.65 1; this model gives 30.0222 m3/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for air-speed scale and pressure: rho=1.2 kg/m3; this model gives 135 Pa, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for smoke and clearance-time boundaries: people=600 persons; this model gives 421.667 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for from detection to established airflow: sense=0.03 s; this model gives 0.25 s, not a field rating.

stages.title: 排煙斷面速度分布與風機壓升能量帳
stages.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections & Fan pressure and energy accounting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排煙斷面速度分布」與「風機壓升能量帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections" and "Fan pressure and energy accounting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排煙斷面速度分布」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排煙斷面速度分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean. Direction and smoke-source location also matter. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排煙斷面速度分布」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排煙斷面速度分布
knowledge.text: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排煙斷面速度分布」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections" is correct?
options: 一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求
本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。
風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成
optionsEn: One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements.
Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke.
A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
quiz.explanation: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排煙斷面速度分布」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排煙斷面速度分布」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections", which statement holds?
options: 風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。
optionsEn: Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排煙斷面速度分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。以「排煙斷面速度分布」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions. For velocity distribution in exhaust sections, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把有效通風面積 A 從 16 改成 17.6 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 m/s。先說明「排煙斷面速度分布」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only effective airflow area A from 16 to 17.6 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for velocity distribution in exhaust sections, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。以「排煙斷面速度分布」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions. For velocity distribution in exhaust sections, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把有效通風面積 A 從 16 改成 17.6 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 m/s。先說明「排煙斷面速度分布」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only effective airflow area A from 16 to 17.6 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for velocity distribution in exhaust sections, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排煙斷面速度分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections"?
options: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排煙斷面速度分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。回到「排煙斷面速度分布」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. Trace the input chain for velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。回到「排煙斷面速度分布」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. Trace the input chain for velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排煙斷面速度分布」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。
風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average.
A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
quiz.explanation: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 風機壓升能量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fan pressure and energy accounting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風機壓升能量帳」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fan pressure and energy accounting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將風機壓升、風道損失與輸入功率放在同一工作點，檢查備援設備是否共用阻塞路徑。風機輸入功率由流量乘壓升再除效率估算。壓力不足與流路阻力增加都會改變工作點，不能把銘牌額定流量視為任何風道中都能達成；備援風機還可能共享同一阻塞路徑而無法提供預想的獨立能力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風機壓升能量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Place fan pressure rise, duct loss and input power at one operating point, checking whether redundant equipment shares a blocked path. Fan input power is flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency. Inadequate pressure and increased duct resistance shift the operating point; nameplate flow is not guaranteed in every duct. Redundant fans may also share a blocked path and fail to provide the expected independent capability. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fan pressure and energy accounting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。

steps.title: 風機壓升能量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fan pressure and energy accounting: quantitative estimate

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。以「風機壓升能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 風門位置回授正常但機械連桿脫落會形成錯誤狀態，僅看馬達運轉訊號無法證明有足夠送風。回到「風機壓升能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 本單元以孔口近似比較門開度與壓差，明示此模型無法解析上下反向的分層煙流。開口通風量由壓差驅動，受面積與縮流損失共同控制。流量和壓差平方根成正比，不是線性比例；旁通開口增加可能減輕壓力卻同時改變煙氣路徑，因此開口位置和通風模式必須一起討論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門口與旁通流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare door opening and pressure difference with an orifice approximation, explicitly excluding counterflowing stratified smoke from the model. Pressure difference drives opening flow, with area and contraction losses jointly controlling it. Flow scales with the square root of pressure rather than linearly. Adding a bypass can relieve pressure while changing smoke paths, so location and ventilation mode must be considered together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：流量係數 Cd=0.65 1；開口面積 A=4 m2；兩側壓差 dp=80 Pa；空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3。公式 y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho)，代入得 y=30.0222 m3/s。邊界：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風速量級與壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air-speed scale and pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。以「風速量級與壓力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. For air-speed scale and pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把代表風速 v 從 15 改成 16.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 135 變為 163.35 Pa。先說明「風速量級與壓力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only representative air speed v from 15 to 16.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 135 to 163.35 Pa. Explain the causal direction for air-speed scale and pressure, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 風速量級與壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air-speed scale and pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風速量級與壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air-speed scale and pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。回到「風速量級與壓力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. Trace the input chain for air-speed scale and pressure. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks.
