quiz.explanationEn: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界與偵測至風路建立
stages.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries & From detection to established airflow
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「煙流與清空時間邊界」與「偵測至風路建立」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Smoke and clearance-time boundaries" and "From detection to established airflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「煙流與清空時間邊界」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「煙流與清空時間邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「煙流與清空時間邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界
knowledge.text: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。
knowledge.textEn: Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「煙流與清空時間邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Smoke and clearance-time boundaries" is correct?
options: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。
optionsEn: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「煙流與清空時間邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「煙流與清空時間邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「煙流與清空時間邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For smoke and clearance-time boundaries, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「煙流與清空時間邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only evacuating population people from 600 to 601 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 421.667 to 422.111 s. Explain the causal direction for smoke and clearance-time boundaries, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「煙流與清空時間邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「煙流與清空時間邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。回到「煙流與清空時間邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. Trace the input chain for smoke and clearance-time boundaries. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。回到「煙流與清空時間邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. Trace the input chain for smoke and clearance-time boundaries. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「煙流與清空時間邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Smoke and clearance-time boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity.
quiz.explanation: 把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 偵測至風路建立：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: From detection to established airflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偵測至風路建立」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “From detection to established airflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元記錄偵測、模式判定、風門動作與氣流建立，避免以電氣啟動回授代替真正風路形成。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偵測至風路建立」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Record detection, mode decision, damper travel and airflow establishment, avoiding substitution of electrical start feedback for an established flow path. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “From detection to established airflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偵測至風路建立」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “From detection to established airflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偵測至風路建立
knowledge.text: 本單元記錄偵測、模式判定、風門動作與氣流建立，避免以電氣啟動回授代替真正風路形成。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。
knowledge.textEn: Record detection, mode decision, damper travel and airflow establishment, avoiding substitution of electrical start feedback for an established flow path. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “From detection to established airflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 控制與照明備援：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「控制與照明備援」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup for controls and lighting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把控制器與指示照明負載獨立列帳，明示小型電池算例不代表整組排煙風機的供電。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制與照明備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for controls and directional lighting, explicitly noting that this small-battery example does not represent power for the complete smoke-exhaust fan set. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup for controls and lighting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Egress recognition under low lighting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元先量無煙環境照度與暗點，再列出煙氣散射尚未涵蓋，避免把照度合格當作能見度合格。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低照度疏散辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure smoke-free illuminance and dark areas first, then list unmodelled smoke scattering rather than treating adequate illuminance as adequate visibility. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Egress recognition under low lighting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低照度疏散辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault causes in shared airflow paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把供電、風門卡滯與流路阻塞分開建樹，要求各原因有不同量測證據而非只看運轉訊號。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共用風路失效原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate supply loss, stuck dampers and path blockage in a cause tree, requiring distinct evidence rather than one common running signal. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault causes in shared airflow paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 地下車站活塞風控制
courses.summary: 本課聚焦列車活塞效應旁通開口與壓力瞬變。從列車誘導壓力量級建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風機與活塞作用疊合與壓力量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以不同列車通過情境整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies train piston effects bypass openings and pressure transients. Start with scale of train-induced pressure to define physical or information boundaries, connect fans interacting with piston effects with combining pressure measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through scenarios for different train passages. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 列車活塞效應旁通開口與壓力瞬變
courses.focusEn: Train piston effects bypass openings and pressure transients
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究列車誘導壓力量級。原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。敏感度只改 v=15 至 16.5 m/s，輸出變為 163.35 Pa；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究活塞風斷面積分：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate scale of train-induced pressure. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. For sensitivity, change only v=15 to 16.5 m/s; the output becomes 163.35 Pa. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate section integration of piston airflow: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：列車誘導壓力量級採 rho=1.2 kg/m3；本課公式結果 135 Pa，非現場額定值。
教學假設：活塞風斷面積分採 Q=32 m3/s；本課公式結果 2 m/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：旁通開口壓差流量採 Cd=0.65 1；本課公式結果 30.0222 m3/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：風機與活塞作用疊合採 Q=40 m3/s；本課公式結果 34.2857 kW，非現場額定值。
教學假設：壓力峰值取樣解析採 f=20 Hz；本課公式結果 50 ms，非現場額定值。
教學假設：列車風壓事件同步採 drift=20 ppm；本課公式結果 0.072 s，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for scale of train-induced pressure: rho=1.2 kg/m3; this model gives 135 Pa, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for section integration of piston airflow: Q=32 m3/s; this model gives 2 m/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for pressure-driven bypass flow: Cd=0.65 1; this model gives 30.0222 m3/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for fans interacting with piston effects: Q=40 m3/s; this model gives 34.2857 kW, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for sampling resolution for pressure peaks: f=20 Hz; this model gives 50 ms, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for synchronizing train and pressure events: drift=20 ppm; this model gives 0.072 s, not a field rating.

stages.title: 列車誘導壓力量級與活塞風斷面積分
stages.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure & Section integration of piston airflow
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車誘導壓力量級」與「活塞風斷面積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scale of train-induced pressure" and "Section integration of piston airflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車誘導壓力量級」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale of train-induced pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。動壓與風速平方成正比，這有助判斷列車活塞作用與門扇負載的量級。實際瞬變壓力仍受隧道阻塞率、旁通開口與波傳反射影響；動壓不是任何測點必定出現的靜壓差，兩者不能直接等同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車誘導壓力量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading. Actual transients also depend on blockage, bypass openings and wave reflections. Dynamic pressure is not automatically the static pressure difference measured at a particular location. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale of train-induced pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scale of train-induced pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列車誘導壓力量級
knowledge.text: 本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。動壓與風速平方成正比，這有助判斷列車活塞作用與門扇負載的量級。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車誘導壓力量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scale of train-induced pressure" is correct?
options: 風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍
本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。

optionsEn: Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure.
Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection.
One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車誘導壓力量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scale of train-induced pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車誘導壓力量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scale of train-induced pressure", which statement holds?
options: 風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。
optionsEn: A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車誘導壓力量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale of train-induced pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。以「列車誘導壓力量級」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. For scale of train-induced pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section integration of piston airflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元在列車進出站期間量測有正負號的速度，防止正反流動被平均後誤判為持續單向送風。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「活塞風斷面積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure signed velocity during train entry and departure, preventing reversing flow from being mistaken for sustained one-way ventilation. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section integration of piston airflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 旁通開口壓差流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-driven bypass flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旁通開口壓差流量」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-driven bypass flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較旁通面積增加對流量的影響，另外追蹤煙流模式是否因新增連通路徑而改變。開口通風量由壓差驅動，受面積與縮流損失共同控制。流量和壓差平方根成正比，不是線性比例；旁通開口增加可能減輕壓力卻同時改變煙氣路徑，因此開口位置和通風模式必須一起討論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旁通開口壓差流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the effect of increased bypass area on flow and separately track whether the added connection changes smoke-control paths. Pressure difference drives opening flow, with area and contraction losses jointly controlling it. Flow scales with the square root of pressure rather than linearly. Adding a bypass can relieve pressure while changing smoke paths, so location and ventilation mode must be considered together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-driven bypass flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：流量係數 Cd=0.65 1；開口面積 A=4 m2；兩側壓差 dp=80 Pa；空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開口壓差增加四倍時流量一定增加四倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旁通開口壓差流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 旁通開口壓差流量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旁通開口壓差流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-driven bypass flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：流量係數 Cd=0.65 1；開口面積 A=4 m2；兩側壓差 dp=80 Pa；空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3。公式 y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho)，代入得 y=30.0222 m3/s。邊界：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: discharge coefficient Cd=0.65 1; opening area A=4 m2; pressure difference dp=80 Pa; air density rho=1.2 kg/m3. Formula y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho) gives y=30.0222 m3/s. Boundary: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測開口兩側壓差與斷面流量，將不同開度下的結果畫成流量對壓差平方根。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 旁通開口壓差流量：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「旁通開口壓差流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-driven bypass flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 格柵堵塞會改變有效面積與損失係數，僅看風門命令開度可能誤判實際旁通能力。回到「旁通開口壓差流量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked grilles alter effective area and loss coefficient; commanded damper opening can misrepresent actual bypass capacity. Trace the input chain for pressure-driven bypass flow. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「開口壓差增加四倍時流量一定增加四倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 格柵堵塞會改變有效面積與損失係數，僅看風門命令開度可能誤判實際旁通能力。回到「旁通開口壓差流量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Blocked grilles alter effective area and loss coefficient; commanded damper opening can misrepresent actual bypass capacity. Trace the input chain for pressure-driven bypass flow. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「旁通開口壓差流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-driven bypass flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 格柵堵塞會改變有效面積與損失係數，僅看風門命令開度可能誤判實際旁通能力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成
optionsEn: Blocked grilles alter effective area and loss coefficient; commanded damper opening can misrepresent actual bypass capacity.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
quiz.explanation: 格柵堵塞會改變有效面積與損失係數，僅看風門命令開度可能誤判實際旁通能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocked grilles alter effective area and loss coefficient; commanded damper opening can misrepresent actual bypass capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 風機與活塞作用疊合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fans interacting with piston effects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風機與活塞作用疊合」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fans interacting with piston effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以穩態功率帳作基準，再標記列車通過造成的工作點偏移，避免假設風機流量始終固定。風機輸入功率由流量乘壓升再除效率估算。壓力不足與流路阻力增加都會改變工作點，不能把銘牌額定流量視為任何風道中都能達成；備援風機還可能共享同一阻塞路徑而無法提供預想的獨立能力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風機與活塞作用疊合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a steady power balance as a reference, then mark operating-point shifts during train passage instead of assuming constant fan flow. Fan input power is flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency. Inadequate pressure and increased duct resistance shift the operating point; nameplate flow is not guaranteed in every duct. Redundant fans may also share a blocked path and fail to provide the expected independent capability. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fans interacting with piston effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風機與活塞作用疊合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fans interacting with piston effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

本單元以穩態功率帳作基準，再標記列車通過造成的工作點偏移，避免假設風機流量始終固定。

steps.title: 風機與活塞作用疊合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fans interacting with piston effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風機與活塞作用疊合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fans interacting with piston effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure flow, pressure rise and electrical power together, correlate with damper position, and check energy consistency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風機與活塞作用疊合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 風機與活塞作用疊合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fans interacting with piston effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風機與活塞作用疊合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fans interacting with piston effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。以「風機與活塞作用疊合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure flow, pressure rise and electrical power together, correlate with damper position, and check energy consistency. For fans interacting with piston effects, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把總壓升 dp 從 600 改成 660 Pa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 34.2857 變為 37.7143 kW。先說明「風機與活塞作用疊合」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only total pressure rise dp from 600 to 660 Pa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 34.2857 to 37.7143 kW. Explain the causal direction for fans interacting with piston effects, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風門位置回授正常但機械連桿脫落會形成錯誤狀態，僅看馬達運轉訊號無法證明有足夠送風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A detached damper linkage can coexist with apparently normal position feedback; a motor-running signal does not prove adequate airflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 列車風壓事件同步：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Synchronizing train and pressure events: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車風壓事件同步」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Synchronizing train and pressure events” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把列車位置、風速與壓力記錄對齊，確保觀察到的先後關係來自流場而不是時鐘漂移。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車風壓事件同步」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Align train position, air velocity and pressure logs so observed sequencing reflects the flow field rather than clock drift. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Synchronizing train and pressure events” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 列車風壓事件同步：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Synchronizing train and pressure events: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車風壓事件同步」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Synchronizing train and pressure events” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 列車風壓事件同步：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「列車風壓事件同步」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For synchronizing train and pressure events, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「列車風壓事件同步」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for synchronizing train and pressure events, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「列車風壓事件同步」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 本單元分開通訊命令、致動器移動和壓力實際變化，避免以風門已收到命令推論壓力已被抑制。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風門反應時間鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不同列車通過情境」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scenarios for different train passages", which statement holds?
options: 開口壓差增加四倍時流量一定增加四倍
把相鄰壓力資料內插成更多點就能恢復任何短暫峰值
原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
optionsEn: Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow.
Interpolating extra points between pressure observations can recover every brief pressure peak.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不同列車通過情境：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scenarios for different train passages: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不同列車通過情境」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scenarios for different train passages” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「不同列車通過情境」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For scenarios for different train passages, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「不同列車通過情境」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for scenarios for different train passages, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「不同列車通過情境」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For scenarios for different train passages, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「不同列車通過情境」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for scenarios for different train passages, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不同列車通過情境」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scenarios for different train passages"?
options: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不同列車通過情境：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scenarios for different train passages: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不同列車通過情境」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scenarios for different train passages” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「不同列車通過情境」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for scenarios for different train passages. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「不同列車通過情境」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for scenarios for different train passages. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不同列車通過情境」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scenarios for different train passages" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鐵路隧道疏散步道
courses.summary: 本課聚焦隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散。從步道距離與協助時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把串行疏散時間帳與下車匯流區密度連成可驗證的介面，最後以受控演練證據安排整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation. Start with walkway distance and assistance time to define physical or information boundaries, connect serial accounting of egress time with density in alighting merge areas as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence planning for controlled exercises. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散
courses.focusEn: Tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究步道距離與協助時間。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。敏感度只改 speed=0.8 至 0.88 m/s，輸出變為 171.364 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究步道局部有效淨寬：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate walkway distance and assistance time. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. For sensitivity, change only speed=0.8 to 0.88 m/s; the output becomes 171.364 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local effective walkway width: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：步道距離與協助時間採 distance=120 m；本課公式結果 185 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：步道局部有效淨寬採 width=2.4 m；本課公式結果 2.64 persons/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：高程轉換與橫坡採 rise=0.45 m；本課公式結果 6 percent，非現場額定值。
教學假設：串行疏散時間帳採 people=600 persons；本課公式結果 421.667 s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：步道照度與暗區採 flux=2400 lm；本課公式結果 45 lx，非現場額定值。
教學假設：緊急照明能量採 capacity=80 Ah；本課公式結果 3.84 h，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for walkway distance and assistance time: distance=120 m; this model gives 185 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for local effective walkway width: width=2.4 m; this model gives 2.64 persons/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for elevation changes and cross-slope: rise=0.45 m; this model gives 6 percent, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for serial accounting of egress time: people=600 persons; this model gives 421.667 s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for walkway illuminance and dark zones: flux=2400 lm; this model gives 45 lx, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for emergency-lighting energy: capacity=80 Ah; this model gives 3.84 h, not a field rating.

stages.title: 步道距離與協助時間與步道局部有效淨寬
stages.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time & Local effective walkway width
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步道距離與協助時間」與「步道局部有效淨寬」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Walkway distance and assistance time" and "Local effective walkway width": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「步道距離與協助時間」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Walkway distance and assistance time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「步道距離與協助時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：定量估算
