quiz.question: 要驗證「工單與實體狀態交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Handoff of work orders and physical state"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 工單與實體狀態交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Handoff of work orders and physical state: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工單與實體狀態交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Handoff of work orders and physical state” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「工單與實體狀態交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for handoff of work orders and physical state. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「工單與實體狀態交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for handoff of work orders and physical state. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工單與實體狀態交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Handoff of work orders and physical state" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance.
quiz.explanation: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫與維修品質抽樣推論
stages.titleEn: Planning maintenance verification effort & Sampling inference for maintenance quality
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢修驗證工時計畫」與「維修品質抽樣推論」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Planning maintenance verification effort" and "Sampling inference for maintenance quality": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Planning maintenance verification effort: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢修驗證工時計畫」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Planning maintenance verification effort” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將檢查、重置、證據保存及缺陷重測納入完整時間，不把計畫工時只等同於首次操作時間。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢修驗證工時計畫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Include inspection, reset, evidence preservation and defect reruns in effort estimates rather than equating planned duration with first-pass operation alone. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Planning maintenance verification effort” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢修驗證工時計畫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Planning maintenance verification effort”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫
knowledge.text: 本單元將檢查、重置、證據保存及缺陷重測納入完整時間，不把計畫工時只等同於首次操作時間。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。
knowledge.textEn: Include inspection, reset, evidence preservation and defect reruns in effort estimates rather than equating planned duration with first-pass operation alone. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢修驗證工時計畫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Planning maintenance verification effort" is correct?
options: 本單元將檢查、重置、證據保存及缺陷重測納入完整時間，不把計畫工時只等同於首次操作時間。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Include inspection, reset, evidence preservation and defect reruns in effort estimates rather than equating planned duration with first-pass operation alone.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將檢查、重置、證據保存及缺陷重測納入完整時間，不把計畫工時只等同於首次操作時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Include inspection, reset, evidence preservation and defect reruns in effort estimates rather than equating planned duration with first-pass operation alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Planning maintenance verification effort: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢修驗證工時計畫」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Planning maintenance verification effort” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。

steps.instruction: 本單元比較少數重複車型與多樣車況的抽樣，將零返修紀錄的結論限制於實際觀察族群。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「維修品質抽樣推論」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare repeated sampling of one fleet type with varied vehicle conditions, bounding zero-return claims by the population actually observed. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling inference for maintenance quality” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 維修品質抽樣推論：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling inference for maintenance quality: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「維修品質抽樣推論」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling inference for maintenance quality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「維修品質抽樣推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For sampling inference for maintenance quality, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「維修品質抽樣推論」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for sampling inference for maintenance quality, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「維修品質抽樣推論」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling inference for maintenance quality"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 維修品質抽樣推論：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling inference for maintenance quality: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維修品質抽樣推論」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling inference for maintenance quality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「維修品質抽樣推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for sampling inference for maintenance quality. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「維修品質抽樣推論」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling inference for maintenance quality" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 列車轉向架更換設備
courses.summary: 本課聚焦轉向架更換的載重分配同步與定位。從車體承載點平均反力建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把多點吊升高度差與升降設備穩態散熱連成可驗證的介面，最後以設備驗證與證據重播整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies load sharing synchronization and positioning in bogie exchange. Start with mean reactions at body supports to define physical or information boundaries, connect height mismatch during multipoint lifting with steady cooling of lifting equipment as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through equipment verification and evidence replay. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 轉向架更換的載重分配同步與定位
courses.focusEn: Load sharing synchronization and positioning in bogie exchange
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究車體承載點平均反力。原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。公式 y=m*g*factor/points/1000，代入得 y=50.7667 kN/point。邊界：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。敏感度只改 m=18000 至 19800 kg，輸出變為 55.8434 kN/point；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究偏心載重重新分配：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先用假想車體重量估算平均反力，再強調實際重心與支承剛度必須另有量測證據。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate mean reactions at body supports. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Formula y=m*g*factor/points/1000 gives y=50.7667 kN/point. Boundary: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. For sensitivity, change only m=18000 to 19800 kg; the output becomes 55.8434 kN/point. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate redistribution under eccentric loading: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. First estimate mean reaction from an assumed body weight, then emphasize that actual centre of gravity and support stiffness require separate evidence. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：車體承載點平均反力採 m=18000 kg；本課公式結果 50.7667 kN/point，非現場額定值。
教學假設：偏心載重重新分配採 W=200 kN；本課公式結果 120 kN，非現場額定值。
教學假設：液壓推力與保持採 p=12 MPa；本課公式結果 86.4 kN，非現場額定值。
教學假設：多點吊升高度差採 v1=0.012 m/s；本課公式結果 10 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：轉向架定位基準採 distance=40 m；本課公式結果 1 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：定位量測不確定度採 s1=3 mm；本課公式結果 5 mm，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for mean reactions at body supports: m=18000 kg; this model gives 50.7667 kN/point, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for redistribution under eccentric loading: W=200 kN; this model gives 120 kN, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for hydraulic force and holding: p=12 MPa; this model gives 86.4 kN, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for height mismatch during multipoint lifting: v1=0.012 m/s; this model gives 10 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for reference geometry for bogie positioning: distance=40 m; this model gives 1 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for uncertainty of positioning measurements: s1=3 mm; this model gives 5 mm, not a field rating.

stages.title: 車體承載點平均反力與偏心載重重新分配
stages.titleEn: Mean reactions at body supports & Redistribution under eccentric loading
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車體承載點平均反力」與「偏心載重重新分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean reactions at body supports" and "Redistribution under eccentric loading": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車體承載點平均反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean reactions at body supports: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車體承載點平均反力」如何影響列車轉向架更換設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean reactions at body supports” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元先用假想車體重量估算平均反力，再強調實際重心與支承剛度必須另有量測證據。平均吊點反力來自總重量分配，但實際分力受重心位置、支承剛度與同步誤差控制。動態倍率只是概念帳項，不能取代設備認證；把總能力除以吊點數也無法證明最不利吊點仍有足夠承載餘裕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車體承載點平均反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: First estimate mean reaction from an assumed body weight, then emphasize that actual centre of gravity and support stiffness require separate evidence. Mean lifting reaction follows total load distribution, while actual reactions depend on centre of gravity, support stiffness and synchronization error. A dynamic factor is a conceptual accounting term, not equipment certification. Dividing total rating by support count does not establish margin at the most heavily loaded point. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean reactions at body supports” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車體承載點平均反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 偏心載重重新分配：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心載重重新分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Redistribution under eccentric loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確

steps.title: 偏心載重重新分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Redistribution under eccentric loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「偏心載重重新分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Redistribution under eccentric loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。以「偏心載重重新分配」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. For redistribution under eccentric loading, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把重心偏心 e 從 0.4 改成 0.44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變為 122 kN。先說明「偏心載重重新分配」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only centre-of-gravity eccentricity e from 0.4 to 0.44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 120 to 122 kN. Explain the causal direction for redistribution under eccentric loading, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 偏心載重重新分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Redistribution under eccentric loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏心載重重新分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Redistribution under eccentric loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。回到「偏心載重重新分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Trace the input chain for redistribution under eccentric loading. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。回到「偏心載重重新分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Trace the input chain for redistribution under eccentric loading. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偏心載重重新分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Redistribution under eccentric loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model.
quiz.explanation: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 液壓推力與保持與多點吊升高度差
stages.titleEn: Hydraulic force and holding & Height mismatch during multipoint lifting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「液壓推力與保持」與「多點吊升高度差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic force and holding" and "Height mismatch during multipoint lifting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 液壓推力與保持：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic force and holding: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「液壓推力與保持」如何影響列車轉向架更換設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic force and holding” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以隔離縮尺台核對壓力與力，另觀察停留漂移並說明壓力表不等於機械保持證據。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「液壓推力與保持」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure and force on an isolated scale rig, separately observing holding drift and explaining why a pressure gauge is not evidence of mechanical retention. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic force and holding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「液壓推力與保持」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic force and holding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Compare pressure and force on an isolated scale rig, separately observing holding drift and explaining why a pressure gauge is not evidence of mechanical retention. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「液壓推力與保持」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic force and holding" is correct?
options: 本單元以隔離縮尺台核對壓力與力，另觀察停留漂移並說明壓力表不等於機械保持證據。
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
兩個馬達當下轉速相同就代表兩端高度永遠相同
optionsEn: Compare pressure and force on an isolated scale rig, separately observing holding drift and explaining why a pressure gauge is not evidence of mechanical retention.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Equal instantaneous motor speeds mean that both heights are always identical.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以隔離縮尺台核對壓力與力，另觀察停留漂移並說明壓力表不等於機械保持證據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pressure and force on an isolated scale rig, separately observing holding drift and explaining why a pressure gauge is not evidence of mechanical retention. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 液壓推力與保持：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic force and holding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「液壓推力與保持」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic force and holding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1. Formula y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000 gives y=86.4 kN. Boundary: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Height mismatch during multipoint lifting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元同步量測四個支承的高程，辨認位置差是原始零點偏移還是動作期間逐漸累積。小速度差會累積成高度差，長行程時尤其明顯。位置閉迴路可以限制累積，但感測器基準、通訊延遲和負載差異仍會影響同步；比較瞬間馬達轉速相同，並不足以證明各吊點的實際高度相同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多點吊升高度差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure elevations at four supports simultaneously, distinguishing an initial reference offset from mismatch accumulated during movement. steps.title: 多點吊升高度差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Height mismatch during multipoint lifting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多點吊升高度差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Height mismatch during multipoint lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立高程量測核對兩端位置，分別比較空載與偏載情境的誤差累積斜率。以「多點吊升高度差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check both positions with independent elevation measurement and compare drift slopes for unloaded and eccentric-load scenarios. For height mismatch during multipoint lifting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把動作時間 t 從 20 改成 22 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變為 11 mm。先說明「多點吊升高度差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for height mismatch during multipoint lifting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同位置零點錯誤可能讓控制器以為同步，車體卻已傾斜；某端摩擦突增則會出現斜率轉折。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared zero-reference error can make the controller report synchronization while the body tilts; increased friction at one end changes the drift slope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Height mismatch during multipoint lifting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多點吊升高度差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

stages.title: 轉向架定位基準與定位量測不確定度
stages.titleEn: Reference geometry for bogie positioning & Uncertainty of positioning measurements
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉向架定位基準」與「定位量測不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reference geometry for bogie positioning" and "Uncertainty of positioning measurements": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉向架定位基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reference geometry for bogie positioning: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉向架定位基準」如何影響列車轉向架更換設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reference geometry for bogie positioning” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用小角度誤差估算定位點的橫向偏移，將地坪基準和車體基準分開核對。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉向架定位基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate transverse positioning error from a small angular error, checking floor references separately from body references. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reference geometry for bogie positioning” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉向架定位基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reference geometry for bogie positioning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Estimate transverse positioning error from a small angular error, checking floor references separately from body references. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate.

knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉向架定位基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
本單元用小角度誤差估算定位點的橫向偏移，將地坪基準和車體基準分開核對。
optionsEn: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.

Estimate transverse positioning error from a small angular error, checking floor references separately from body references.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Explain the causal direction for uncertainty of positioning measurements, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「定位量測不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uncertainty of positioning measurements"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
quiz.explanation: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 定位量測不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty of positioning measurements: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定位量測不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uncertainty of positioning measurements” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「定位量測不確定度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for uncertainty of positioning measurements. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「定位量測不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uncertainty of positioning measurements" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
optionsEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
quiz.explanation: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 升降設備穩態散熱與接觸與導向磨耗
stages.titleEn: Steady cooling of lifting equipment & Wear in contact and guidance parts
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「升降設備穩態散熱」與「接觸與導向磨耗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steady cooling of lifting equipment" and "Wear in contact and guidance parts": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 升降設備穩態散熱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steady cooling of lifting equipment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「升降設備穩態散熱」如何影響列車轉向架更換設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steady cooling of lifting equipment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用等效持續功率估算液壓站或馬達穩態溫度，明確保留短時升降熱峰未被模型涵蓋。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「升降設備穩態散熱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use equivalent sustained power to estimate steady hydraulic-unit or motor temperature, explicitly retaining short lifting heat peaks outside the model. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steady cooling of lifting equipment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「升降設備穩態散熱」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steady cooling of lifting equipment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 升降設備穩態散熱
knowledge.text: 本單元用等效持續功率估算液壓站或馬達穩態溫度，明確保留短時升降熱峰未被模型涵蓋。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。
knowledge.textEn: Use equivalent sustained power to estimate steady hydraulic-unit or motor temperature, explicitly retaining short lifting heat peaks outside the model. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「升降設備穩態散熱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steady cooling of lifting equipment" is correct?
options: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
本單元用等效持續功率估算液壓站或馬達穩態溫度，明確保留短時升降熱峰未被模型涵蓋。
前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變
optionsEn: A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
Use equivalent sustained power to estimate steady hydraulic-unit or motor temperature, explicitly retaining short lifting heat peaks outside the model.
The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用等效持續功率估算液壓站或馬達穩態溫度，明確保留短時升降熱峰未被模型涵蓋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use equivalent sustained power to estimate steady hydraulic-unit or motor temperature, explicitly retaining short lifting heat peaks outside the model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 升降設備穩態散熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steady cooling of lifting equipment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「升降設備穩態散熱」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steady cooling of lifting equipment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「升降設備穩態散熱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steady cooling of lifting equipment", which statement holds?

Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.

steps.title: 升降設備穩態散熱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steady cooling of lifting equipment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「升降設備穩態散熱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steady cooling of lifting equipment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。以「升降設備穩態散熱」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes. For steady cooling of lifting equipment, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「升降設備穩態散熱」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only equivalent thermal resistance Rth from 0.035 to 0.0385 K/W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 61.5 to 64.65 degC. Explain the causal direction for steady cooling of lifting equipment, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For steady cooling of lifting equipment, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「升降設備穩態散熱」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「升降設備穩態散熱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steady cooling of lifting equipment"?
options: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩個馬達當下轉速相同就代表兩端高度永遠相同
optionsEn: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal instantaneous motor speeds mean that both heights are always identical.

steps.instruction: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「升降設備穩態散熱」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 接觸與導向磨耗：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「接觸與導向磨耗」如何影響列車轉向架更換設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wear in contact and guidance parts” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤導向輪與承載接點間隙，檢查磨耗率是否因偏載而改變並影響定位重複性。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸與導向磨耗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track clearance at guide rollers and support contacts, checking whether eccentric loading changes wear rate and positioning repeatability. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wear in contact and guidance parts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接觸與導向磨耗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 接觸與導向磨耗：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. Formula y=depth/cycles*future gives y=0.2 mm. Boundary: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元只在離線模型區分承載、移動與定位條件，檢查任何動作是否依賴尚未確認的支承狀態。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「交換作業互鎖狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 設備驗證與證據重播：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「設備驗證與證據重播」如何影響列車轉向架更換設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equipment verification and evidence replay” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bogie-exchange equipment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元規畫空載與縮尺偏載試驗的證據保存，將初始支承設定和感測器校正一併納入重播條件。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備驗證與證據重播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Plan evidence preservation for unloaded and scale eccentric-load tests, including initial support setup and sensor calibration in replay conditions. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment verification and evidence replay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設備驗證與證據重播」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 設備驗證與證據重播：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment verification and evidence replay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設備驗證與證據重播」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equipment verification and evidence replay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 設備驗證與證據重播：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment verification and evidence replay: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設備驗證與證據重播」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equipment verification and evidence replay” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「設備驗證與證據重播」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For equipment verification and evidence replay, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「設備驗證與證據重播」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for equipment verification and evidence replay, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 設備驗證與證據重播：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment verification and evidence replay: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設備驗證與證據重播」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equipment verification and evidence replay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「設備驗證與證據重播」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for equipment verification and evidence replay. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「設備驗證與證據重播」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
