courses.title: 車輪在軌鏇削設備
courses.summary: 本課聚焦輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測。從輪徑與切削線速度建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把加工設備穩態熱路與輪廓量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以輪型與缺陷案例矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining. Start with wheel diameter and cutting speed to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady heat paths in machining equipment with combining profile-measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through wheel-type and defect case matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測
courses.focusEn: Geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑與切削線速度。原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。敏感度只改 D=0.84 至 0.924 m，輸出變為 174.17 m/min；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究徑向去除與壽命帳：原創假想教學輸入：原始輪徑 D0=840 mm；單側徑向去除 depth=1.5 mm。公式 y=D0-2*depth，代入得 y=837 mm。邊界：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel diameter and cutting speed. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. For sensitivity, change only D=0.84 to 0.924 m; the output becomes 174.17 m/min. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate radial removal and life accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial diameter D0=840 mm; radial removal per side depth=1.5 mm. Formula y=D0-2*depth gives y=837 mm. Boundary: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

教學假設：刀具磨耗與輪廓採 depth=0.6 mm；本課公式結果 0.2 mm，非現場額定值。

stages.title: 輪徑與切削線速度與徑向去除與壽命帳
stages.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed & Radial removal and life accounting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪徑與切削線速度」與「徑向去除與壽命帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel diameter and cutting speed" and "Radial removal and life accounting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪徑與切削線速度」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。切削線速度由輪徑與轉速共同決定，相同轉速在不同直徑會造成不同刀具接觸條件。輪對鏇削還要考慮夾持剛度、材料硬點和輪廓基準；把工具轉速設定正確，並不能保證完成後輪廓與同軸度符合需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪徑與切削線速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Cutting surface speed depends on diameter and rotational speed, so the same rotation rate produces different tool conditions on different wheels. Reprofiling also depends on clamping stiffness, hard spots and profile reference. Correct speed setting does not by itself establish final profile or concentricity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪徑與切削線速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wheel diameter and cutting speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪徑與切削線速度
knowledge.text: 本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。切削線速度由輪徑與轉速共同決定，相同轉速在不同直徑會造成不同刀具接觸條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Cutting surface speed depends on diameter and rotational speed, so the same rotation rate produces different tool conditions on different wheels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪徑與切削線速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel diameter and cutting speed" is correct?
options: 輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度
本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。
切去一毫米徑向材料時輪徑也只會減少一毫米
optionsEn: Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes.
Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation.
Removing one millimetre radially reduces diameter by only one millimetre.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪徑與切削線速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪徑與切削線速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wheel diameter and cutting speed", which statement holds?
options: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變
原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。
optionsEn: A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪徑與切削線速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。以「輪徑與切削線速度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately. For wheel diameter and cutting speed, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把輪徑 D 從 0.84 改成 0.924 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 158.336 變為 174.17 m/min。先說明「輪徑與切削線速度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only wheel diameter D from 0.84 to 0.924 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 158.336 to 174.17 m/min. Explain the causal direction for wheel diameter and cutting speed, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以標稱輪徑代替磨耗後直徑會錯估速度，輪面滑動則使驅動滾輪轉速不再代表輪對轉速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominal instead of worn diameter biases speed; roller slip makes drive-roller rotation differ from wheelset rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。以「輪徑與切削線速度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately. For wheel diameter and cutting speed, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把輪徑 D 從 0.84 改成 0.924 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 158.336 變為 174.17 m/min。先說明「輪徑與切削線速度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only wheel diameter D from 0.84 to 0.924 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 158.336 to 174.17 m/min. Explain the causal direction for wheel diameter and cutting speed, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輪徑與切削線速度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wheel diameter and cutting speed"?
options: 以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同
optionsEn: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.
quiz.explanation: 以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪徑與切削線速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.title: 徑向去除與壽命帳：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「徑向去除與壽命帳」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radial removal and life accounting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把單側切深換算成直徑耗用，將每次修整量保留在輪對履歷以檢查剩餘材料。徑向切深在直徑上會出現兩倍的減少，輪徑耗用應與可維修壽命一起追蹤。修掉一處缺陷所需的最小去除量可能決定整個輪對的加工深度；只追求表面光滑而忽略剩餘輪緣與直徑，可能提早耗盡零件壽命。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「徑向去除與壽命帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert radial cut depth to diameter consumption, retaining each reprofiling removal in wheelset history to track remaining material. Radial removal reduces diameter by twice the cut depth, so diameter consumption belongs in life tracking. The removal needed for one defect may govern the entire wheelset. Optimizing surface appearance while ignoring remaining flange and diameter can consume useful life prematurely. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Radial removal and life accounting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：原始輪徑 D0=840 mm；單側徑向去除 depth=1.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial diameter D0=840 mm; radial removal per side depth=1.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「切去一毫米徑向材料時輪徑也只會減少一毫米」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Removing one millimetre radially reduces diameter by only one millimetre." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「徑向去除與壽命帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Radial removal and life accounting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：原始輪徑 D0=840 mm；單側徑向去除 depth=1.5 mm。公式 y=D0-2*depth，代入得 y=837 mm。邊界：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial diameter D0=840 mm; radial removal per side depth=1.5 mm. Formula y=D0-2*depth gives y=837 mm. Boundary: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立量具比對加工前後直徑，將每次去除量累積到輪對履歷並核對輪廓基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare before/after diameters with an independent gauge and accumulate removal in wheelset history while checking profile datums.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 切屑體積與節拍：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「切屑體積與節拍」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chip volume and processing cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以矩形切屑類比計算去除率，另外計入檢測與重工時間以免只追求刀具接觸時間最短。體積去除率由截面乘相對進給估算，能用來連結節拍、切屑與能量需求。增加去除率會同時提高熱與力的負擔，實際效果受刀具、材料與剛度限制；縮短加工時間若造成重工，總維修週期反而可能增加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：矩形切屑截面的概念估算，非輪廓加工刀路與實際參數建議。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切屑體積與節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a rectangular-chip analogy to estimate removal rate and separately include inspection and rework rather than minimizing tool-contact time alone. Volumetric removal rate is cross-sectional area times relative feed, linking cycle time, chips and energy demand. Higher removal increases thermal and mechanical loading, limited by tooling, material and stiffness. A shorter cut can lengthen the total maintenance cycle when it creates rework. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual rectangular chip section, not an actual reprofiling tool path or production setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Chip volume and processing cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：加工寬度 width=6 mm；切入厚度 depth=0.4 mm；相對進給速度 feed=100 mm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: cutting width width=6 mm; cut thickness depth=0.4 mm; relative feed speed feed=100 mm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「切削速度提高就能保證整個維修週期必定縮短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 切屑體積與節拍：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chip volume and processing cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：加工寬度 width=6 mm；切入厚度 depth=0.4 mm；相對進給速度 feed=100 mm/s。公式 y=width*depth*feed，代入得 y=240 mm3/s。邊界：矩形切屑截面的概念估算，非輪廓加工刀路與實際參數建議。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: cutting width width=6 mm; cut thickness depth=0.4 mm; relative feed speed feed=100 mm/s. Formula y=width*depth*feed gives y=240 mm3/s. Boundary: Conceptual rectangular chip section, not an actual reprofiling tool path or production setting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較去除前後體積與切屑收集量，將停頓、量測與重工時間納入完整節拍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare removed volume with collected chips and include pauses, measurements and rework in total cycle time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 比較去除前後體積與切屑收集量，將停頓、量測與重工時間納入完整節拍。以「切屑體積與節拍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steady heat paths in machining equipment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以等效持續熱源觀察冷卻路徑，區分機體穩態溫升與刀尖短時高溫不能由同一模型代表。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「加工設備穩態熱路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Observe cooling paths under equivalent sustained heating, distinguishing machine steady temperature from transient tool-tip heat that this model cannot represent. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steady heat paths in machining equipment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 加工設備穩態熱路：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steady heat paths in machining equipment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元用單自由度模型比較支承剛度與等效質量，指出自然頻率接近激振並不直接給出振幅。單自由度固有頻率由剛度與質量比的平方根決定。提高剛度可能移開一個激振頻率，也可能移近另一個頻率；阻尼控制峰值而不只改變頻率，因此僅比較靜態變形不能預測動態放大。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「加工激振與結構頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a single-degree model to compare support stiffness and effective mass, noting that proximity to excitation frequency does not directly determine amplitude. Damping controls the resonant peak as well as frequency effects, so static deflection alone cannot predict dynamic amplification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling. steps.title: 加工激振與結構頻率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「加工激振與結構頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。公式 y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)，代入得 y=1.94924 Hz。邊界：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg. Formula y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi) gives y=1.94924 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用低能量掃頻或自由衰減試驗量頻率與阻尼，對照載重改變後的模態移動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure frequency and damping with low-energy sweep or free decay, then compare modal shifts after changing load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 用低能量掃頻或自由衰減試驗量頻率與阻尼，對照載重改變後的模態移動。以「加工激振與結構頻率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 刀具磨耗與輪廓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tool wear and profile quality: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「刀具磨耗與輪廓」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tool wear and profile quality” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較刀具使用次數與輪廓殘差，檢查材料硬點是否讓固定線性磨耗率失去代表性。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刀具磨耗與輪廓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare tool-use count with profile residuals, checking whether hard material spots make a constant linear wear rate unrepresentative. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tool wear and profile quality” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Compare tool-use count with profile residuals, checking whether hard material spots make a constant linear wear rate unrepresentative. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism.

steps.title: 刀具磨耗與輪廓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tool wear and profile quality: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刀具磨耗與輪廓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tool wear and profile quality” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. Formula y=depth/cycles*future gives y=0.2 mm. Boundary: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 刀具磨耗與輪廓：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「刀具磨耗與輪廓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tool wear and profile quality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。以「刀具磨耗與輪廓」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation. For tool wear and profile quality, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把外推循環數 future 從 10000 改成 10001 cycles（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變為 0.20002 mm。先說明「刀具磨耗與輪廓」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for tool wear and profile quality, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 刀具磨耗與輪廓：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刀具磨耗與輪廓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tool wear and profile quality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。回到「刀具磨耗與輪廓」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. Trace the input chain for tool wear and profile quality. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Combining profile-measurement uncertainty" and "Sampling intervals for wheel defects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪廓量測誤差合成：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Combining profile-measurement uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪廓量測誤差合成」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Combining profile-measurement uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元分離輪廓掃描重複性與夾持基準偏差，避免把同一基準的相關誤差當成獨立來源。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪廓量測誤差合成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate profile-scanner repeatability from clamping-datum bias, avoiding treatment of errors sharing one reference as independent sources. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Combining profile-measurement uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Combining profile-measurement uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 對已知長度特徵以不同速度重播，檢查事件是否保留並比較位置內插誤差。以「輪面缺陷取樣間距」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.titleEn: Sampling intervals for wheel defects: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling intervals for wheel defects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高頻振動混疊成低頻漂移可能被誤判為幾何偏差，遺失時間戳也會破壞空間重建。回到「輪面缺陷取樣間距」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction. Trace the input chain for sampling intervals for wheel defects. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 加工後驗證完整工時與輪型與缺陷案例矩陣

steps.title: 加工後驗證完整工時：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「加工後驗證完整工時」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete post-machining verification effort” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將輪徑、輪廓、圓度與資料歸檔視為不同驗證工作，將量具重設和異常重測納入節拍。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「加工後驗證完整工時」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat diameter, profile, roundness and archiving as separate verification tasks, including gauge reset and anomaly reruns in the cycle. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete post-machining verification effort” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 加工後驗證完整工時：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete post-machining verification effort: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「加工後驗證完整工時」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete post-machining verification effort” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「加工後驗證完整工時」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For complete post-machining verification effort, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「加工後驗證完整工時」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for complete post-machining verification effort, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 加工後驗證完整工時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete post-machining verification effort: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「加工後驗證完整工時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete post-machining verification effort” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「加工後驗證完整工時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for complete post-machining verification effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 輪型與缺陷案例矩陣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel-type and defect case matrix: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel-type and defect case matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元對不同輪型、偏磨與表面缺陷建立案例，明列未加工過的組合以限制品質推論。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build cases for wheel types, uneven wear and surface defects, listing unmachined combinations explicitly to bound quality claims. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel-type and defect case matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For wheel-type and defect case matrix, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for wheel-type and defect case matrix, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wheel-type and defect case matrix"?

quiz.explanationEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪型與缺陷案例矩陣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel-type and defect case matrix: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel-type and defect case matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for wheel-type and defect case matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪型與缺陷案例矩陣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wheel-type and defect case matrix" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes.

quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 列車自動洗車機
courses.summary: 本課聚焦自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接。從噴洗水量與清水補充建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把乾燥設備穩態熱路與車體偵測到設備退讓連成可驗證的介面，最後以洗車服務與維修配置整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing. Start with spray volume and freshwater makeup to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady thermal paths in drying equipment with from vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through washing service and maintenance allocation. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接
courses.focusEn: Water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究噴洗水量與清水補充。原創假想教學輸入：噴洗總流量 flow=0.003 m3/s；噴洗時間 duration=180 s；回收再用比例 recycle=0.75 1。公式 y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000，代入得 y=135 L。邊界：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。敏感度只改 recycle=0.75 至 0.825 1，輸出變為 94.5 L；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究回收水配藥質量帳：原創假想教學輸入：處理水量 volume=800 L；目標教學濃度 concentration=0.002 kg/L。公式 y=volume*concentration，代入得 y=1.6 kg。邊界：純質量平衡教學，不指定實際清潔化學品或使用濃度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate spray volume and freshwater makeup. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total spray flow flow=0.003 m3/s; spray duration duration=180 s; reused fraction recycle=0.75 1. Formula y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000 gives y=135 L. Boundary: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted. For sensitivity, change only recycle=0.75 to 0.825 1; the output becomes 94.5 L. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate dosing mass balance for recycled water: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: treated water volume volume=800 L; assumed teaching concentration concentration=0.002 kg/L. Formula y=volume*concentration gives y=1.6 kg. Boundary: Mass-balance teaching only; no real cleaning chemical or operating concentration is prescribed. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：噴洗水量與清水補充採 flow=0.003 m3/s；本課公式結果 135 L，非現場額定值。
教學假設：回收水配藥質量帳採 volume=800 L；本課公式結果 1.6 kg，非現場額定值。
教學假設：吹乾風道工作點採 Q=40 m3/s；本課公式結果 34.2857 kW，非現場額定值。
教學假設：乾燥設備穩態熱路採 P=900 W；本課公式結果 61.5 degC，非現場額定值。
教學假設：洗刷臂液壓推進採 p=12 MPa；本課公式結果 86.4 kN，非現場額定值。
教學假設：雙側洗刷臂同步採 v1=0.012 m/s；本課公式結果 10 mm，非現場額定值。

Teaching assumption for dosing mass balance for recycled water: volume=800 L; this model gives 1.6 kg, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for drying-air duct operating point: Q=40 m3/s; this model gives 34.2857 kW, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for steady thermal paths in drying equipment: P=900 W; this model gives 61.5 degC, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for hydraulic positioning of washing arms: p=12 MPa; this model gives 86.4 kN, not a field rating.

stages.title: 噴洗水量與清水補充與回收水配藥質量帳
stages.titleEn: Spray volume and freshwater makeup & Dosing mass balance for recycled water
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「噴洗水量與清水補充」與「回收水配藥質量帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spray volume and freshwater makeup" and "Dosing mass balance for recycled water": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 噴洗水量與清水補充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spray volume and freshwater makeup: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「噴洗水量與清水補充」如何影響列車自動洗車機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spray volume and freshwater makeup” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。補充清水量取決於總噴洗量與可再用比例，回收水的品質限制和總量限制必須同時滿足。污泥、油脂與清潔劑會改變處理需求；回收率提高不一定等於清洗品質提高，也不能將所有排放都假設成可再用水。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「噴洗水量與清水補充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses. Freshwater makeup depends on spray volume and reusable fraction, subject to both quality and quantity constraints. Sludge, oils and detergents alter treatment needs. Higher recovery is not necessarily better cleaning, and not every discharge can be assumed reusable. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spray volume and freshwater makeup” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：噴洗總流量 flow=0.003 m3/s；噴洗時間 duration=180 s；回收再用比例 recycle=0.75 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total spray flow flow=0.003 m3/s; spray duration duration=180 s; reused fraction recycle=0.75 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回收比例越高就能保證清洗效果一定越好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A higher recycling fraction always guarantees better cleaning performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「噴洗水量與清水補充」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spray volume and freshwater makeup”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 噴洗水量與清水補充
knowledge.text: 先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。
knowledge.textEn: Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：回收比例越高就能保證清洗效果一定越好 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A higher recycling fraction always guarantees better cleaning performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「噴洗水量與清水補充」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spray volume and freshwater makeup" is correct?

steps.title: 吹乾風道工作點：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drying-air duct operating point” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 吹乾效果取決於噴口分布與可達風量，不能只比較馬達額定功率。改變濾網阻力時同步記錄壓升和流量，找出能耗上升而乾燥未改善的原因。風機輸入功率由流量乘壓升再除效率估算。壓力不足與流路阻力增加都會改變工作點，不能把銘牌額定流量視為任何風道中都能達成；備援風機還可能共享同一阻塞路徑而無法提供預想的獨立能力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吹乾風道工作點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drying depends on outlet distribution and achieved flow rather than motor rating alone. Record pressure and flow while filter resistance changes to explain higher energy use without better drying. Fan input power is flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency. Inadequate pressure and increased duct resistance shift the operating point; nameplate flow is not guaranteed in every duct. Redundant fans may also share a blocked path and fail to provide the expected independent capability. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. steps.instruction: 同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。以「吹乾風道工作點」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure flow, pressure rise and electrical power together, correlate with damper position, and check energy consistency. steps.title: 乾燥設備穩態熱路：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steady thermal paths in drying equipment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾燥設備穩態熱路」如何影響列車自動洗車機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steady thermal paths in drying equipment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以平均發熱功率建立乾燥風機或驅動器的穩態溫度帳，不把此式當成升溫時間模型。比較清潔與堵塞散熱條件，觀察外殼和內部測點是否同向變化。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾燥設備穩態熱路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a steady temperature balance using mean dissipation, without treating it as a warm-up-time model. Compare clean and obstructed cooling paths and examine whether enclosure and internal temperatures change together. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steady thermal paths in drying equipment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾燥設備穩態熱路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 在假想洗刷臂上區分油缸推力與刷具接觸力，連桿和摩擦會改變兩者關係。用隔離教具比對壓力與行程，不能以壓力正常代替車體間隙確認。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洗刷臂液壓推進」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate cylinder thrust from brush contact force in a hypothetical washing arm because linkage and friction change their relationship. Compare pressure and travel on an isolated rig rather than substituting pressure for vehicle-clearance verification. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic positioning of washing arms” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 車體偵測到設備退讓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: From vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車體偵測到設備退讓」如何影響列車自動洗車機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “From vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將車端辨識、控制處理與刷臂退讓各自的起訖時間寫清楚，避免漏算介面等待。以離線事件重播檢查先後次序，不把範例延遲當成現場保護設定。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車體偵測到設備退讓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Define start and finish events for vehicle-end detection, processing and arm withdrawal so handoff waiting is counted. Check ordering through offline replay without using the example delays as field protection settings. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “From vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. steps.title: 車型與中止情境矩陣：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 把不同車頭外形、感測失效與洗程中止列成分開案例，不以多次同車試洗取代型式覆蓋。核對每案的設備狀態與復原證據，留下未驗證的條件。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車型與中止情境矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: List distinct cases for vehicle profiles, sensing failures and interrupted cycles rather than repeating one vehicle as a substitute for coverage. Check state and recovery evidence and retain untested conditions explicitly. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 車型與中止情境矩陣：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車型與中止情境矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 區分可洗車、降級服務和完全停機，維修履歷才不會高估可用時間。再比較頻繁短停與罕見長停如何影響回廠列車排隊，保留相同可用度下的差異。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洗車服務與維修配置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish full service, degraded washing and complete shutdown to avoid overstated availability. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Washing service and maintenance allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
