stages.title: 總重量與吊點均分與偏心貨載與支承反力
stages.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction & Eccentric cargo and support reactions
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總重量與吊點均分」與「偏心貨載與支承反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total load and mean lifting-point reaction" and "Eccentric cargo and support reactions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總重量與吊點均分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總重量與吊點均分」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先將貨櫃與吊具質量放進同一載重邊界，再計算對稱教學模型的平均吊點反力。將這個平均量與最不利吊點分開，不能由總能力足夠推論每點都有餘裕。平均吊點反力來自總重量分配，但實際分力受重心位置、支承剛度與同步誤差控制。動態倍率只是概念帳項，不能取代設備認證；把總能力除以吊點數也無法證明最不利吊點仍有足夠承載餘裕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總重量與吊點均分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Include container and spreader mass within one load boundary before calculating symmetric mean reactions. Keep that mean distinct from the worst support; adequate total capacity does not prove margin at every point. Mean lifting reaction follows total load distribution, while actual reactions depend on centre of gravity, support stiffness and synchronization error. A dynamic factor is a conceptual accounting term, not equipment certification. Dividing total rating by support count does not establish margin at the most heavily loaded point. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 總重量與吊點均分：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總重量與吊點均分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。公式 y=m*g*factor/points/1000，代入得 y=50.7667 kN/point。邊界：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Formula y=m*g*factor/points/1000 gives y=50.7667 kN/point. Boundary: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。以「總重量與吊點均分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Explain the causal direction for total load and mean lifting-point reaction, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心貨載與支承反力」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 貨物偏向一側會改變兩支承反力，即使總重量完全相同。用已知偏心的縮尺載具核對力與力矩平衡，觀察幾何中心和重心並非同一點。兩支承反力由力與力矩平衡同時決定。重心偏向一側時，該側反力增加而另一側減少，總和仍不變；平均反力看似充足不能掩蓋單側限制，支承接觸若脫離還會改變原先的邊界條件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心貨載與支承反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An off-centre load changes support reactions even when total weight is unchanged. Check force and moment balance on a scale load and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity. Two support reactions follow both force and moment equilibrium. Moving the centre of gravity toward one support raises that reaction while reducing the other without changing the total. Adequate mean reaction cannot hide a local limit, and loss of contact changes the assumed boundary conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心貨載與支承反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: An off-centre load changes support reactions even when total weight is unchanged. Check force and moment balance on a scale load and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity.

quiz.question: 關於「偏心貨載與支承反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric cargo and support reactions" is correct?
options: 總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位

A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心貨載與支承反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「偏心貨載與支承反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。以「偏心貨載與支承反力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. For eccentric cargo and support reactions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把重心偏心 e 從 0.4 改成 0.44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變為 122 kN。先說明「偏心貨載與支承反力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only centre-of-gravity eccentricity e from 0.4 to 0.44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 120 to 122 kN. Explain the causal direction for eccentric cargo and support reactions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏心貨載與支承反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。回到「偏心貨載與支承反力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Trace the input chain for eccentric cargo and support reactions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for eccentric cargo and support reactions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. knowledge.title: 根因確認

stages.title: 吊具定位液壓鏈與完整吊運循環率
stages.titleEn: Hydraulic positioning in the spreader & Complete handling-cycle rate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊具定位液壓鏈」與「完整吊運循環率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic positioning in the spreader" and "Complete handling-cycle rate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊具定位液壓鏈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic positioning in the spreader: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊具定位液壓鏈」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic positioning in the spreader” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將定位油缸的推力與結構保持能力分開，壓力達到目標不代表鎖定已被證實。以隔離教具同時觀察行程與壓力，辨認背壓或摩擦造成的差異。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊具定位液壓鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate positioning-cylinder thrust from structural holding capability; a pressure reading does not prove locking. Observe travel and pressure on an isolated rig to distinguish back-pressure and friction effects. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic positioning in the spreader” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 將起吊、橫移、下降和對位全部計入單次作業，先建立串行節拍基準。再列出空返與等待所占時間，說明理想循環率為何高於實際場站吞吐。吊運節拍需包含吊升、移動、下降與對位等完整工作，而不是只看最快的馬達行程。部分動作可以重疊，但前提是設備允許且不增加碰撞或擺動；空返、等待車輛與查驗也可能使實際吞吐低於理想循環率。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單設備串行理想循環，未含等待、空返或安全聯鎖延遲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完整吊運循環率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 完整吊運循環率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Complete handling-cycle rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完整吊運循環率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Complete handling-cycle rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：吊升時間 lift=35 s；橫移時間 travel=50 s；下降時間 lower=30 s；對位時間 align=25 s。公式 y=3600/(lift+travel+lower+align)，代入得 y=25.7143 moves/h。邊界：單設備串行理想循環，未含等待、空返或安全聯鎖延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hoisting time lift=35 s; travel time travel=50 s; lowering time lower=30 s; alignment time align=25 s. Formula y=3600/(lift+travel+lower+align) gives y=25.7143 moves/h. Boundary: Ideal serial cycle for one machine, excluding waiting, empty returns and interlock delays. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐動作記錄起訖與等待原因，把理想循環率和整班實際完成量分開報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Timestamp every motion and waiting cause, reporting ideal cycle rate separately from completed moves over a shift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 逐動作記錄起訖與等待原因，把理想循環率和整班實際完成量分開報告。以「完整吊運循環率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 忽略空返會高估吞吐，作業區交通互相阻塞則使設備利用率高但有效完成量低。回到「完整吊運循環率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring empty returns overstates throughput; yard traffic conflicts can yield high equipment utilization with low useful completion. stages.title: 吊索長度與殘餘擺動與吊機需求與服務負荷

steps.title: 吊索長度與殘餘擺動：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「吊索長度與殘餘擺動」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension length and residual sway” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比較相同貨重在不同吊索長度下的擺動週期，將質量與週期的角色分清楚。設備橫移停止後仍要觀察殘餘角度，不能用速度歸零代表吊具已穩定。小角度吊重擺動近似單擺，週期主要受吊索長度影響而非質量。移動命令若與擺動相位不合，停止後仍會持續擺盪；反擺控制需知道有效長度和感測延遲，不能只把速度降到零就視為吊具已穩定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：質點、無阻尼、小角度單擺，不含雙擺與柔性吊具。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊索長度與殘餘擺動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sway periods at different suspension lengths for the same cargo mass. Observe residual angle after travel stops because zero machine speed does not establish a stable suspended load. Small-angle suspended-load sway approximates a pendulum, with period governed mainly by suspension length rather than mass. Poorly phased travel commands leave residual sway after stopping. Anti-sway control needs effective length and sensing delay; zero travel speed does not mean a stable load. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Undamped small-angle point-mass pendulum without double-pendulum or flexible-spreader effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspension length and residual sway” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：吊索有效長度 length=8 m；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊重質量加倍就一定使小角度單擺週期加倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 以每小時到達作業數和可服務作業數建立同一系統邊界，不能混用不同吊機群。再比較平均利用率與列車集中到達的尖峰，指出等待仍會在平均有餘裕時發生。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。平均需求小於平均容量仍可能出現短暫尖峰與排隊；若排程把所有時段填滿，任何變異都只能向後傳播，缺乏讓系統恢復的空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊機需求與服務負荷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use arrivals and service jobs per hour for the same crane group rather than mixing boundaries. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。
總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載
optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h.
Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊機需求與服務負荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crane demand and service utilization: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊機需求與服務負荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crane demand and service utilization” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「吊機需求與服務負荷」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For crane demand and service utilization, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「吊機需求與服務負荷」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for crane demand and service utilization, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「吊機需求與服務負荷」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For crane demand and service utilization, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「吊機需求與服務負荷」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for crane demand and service utilization, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊機需求與服務負荷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crane demand and service utilization"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting.
quiz.explanation: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊機需求與服務負荷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crane demand and service utilization: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊機需求與服務負荷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crane demand and service utilization” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「吊機需求與服務負荷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for crane demand and service utilization. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「吊機需求與服務負荷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for crane demand and service utilization. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊機需求與服務負荷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crane demand and service utilization" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 吊具車輛與作業區交接與設備停機與貨櫃積壓
stages.titleEn: Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff & Equipment outages and container backlog
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊具車輛與作業區交接」與「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff" and "Equipment outages and container backlog": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊具車輛與作業區交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊具車輛與作業區交接」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把吊具位置、載具到位與作業區清空各自當成獨立狀態，不讓一項確認代替其他條件。以桌面狀態圖檢查矛盾組合，保留未知和中止而不自動猜測完成。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊具車輛與作業區交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Represent spreader position, vehicle presence and work-zone clearance as separate states. Check conflicting combinations in a desktop graph and retain unknown or interrupted states instead of inferring completion. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吊具車輛與作業區交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊具車輛與作業區交接
knowledge.text: 把吊具位置、載具到位與作業區清空各自當成獨立狀態，不讓一項確認代替其他條件。以桌面狀態圖檢查矛盾組合，保留未知和中止而不自動猜測完成。
knowledge.textEn: Represent spreader position, vehicle presence and work-zone clearance as separate states. Check conflicting combinations in a desktop graph and retain unknown or interrupted states instead of inferring completion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊具車輛與作業區交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff" is correct?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
把吊具位置、載具到位與作業區清空各自當成獨立狀態，不讓一項確認代替其他條件。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Represent spreader position, vehicle presence and work-zone clearance as separate states.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
quiz.explanation: 把吊具位置、載具到位與作業區清空各自當成獨立狀態，不讓一項確認代替其他條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Represent spreader position, vehicle presence and work-zone clearance as separate states. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊具車輛與作業區交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊具車輛與作業區交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊具車輛與作業區交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff", which statement holds?
options: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
optionsEn: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊具車輛與作業區交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊具車輛與作業區交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「吊具車輛與作業區交接」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Explain the causal direction for spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.title: 吊具車輛與作業區交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊具車輛與作業區交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「吊具車輛與作業區交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊具車輛與作業區交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.

quiz.explanationEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 設備停機與貨櫃積壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment outages and container backlog: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equipment outages and container backlog” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 區分吊機故障時間、降級服務和修復等待，避免只統計更換零件的工時。比較同可用度下不同停機分布，評估貨櫃存量與轉乘班次受到的影響。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish crane failure, degraded service and repair waiting rather than counting only hands-on repair. Compare outage patterns at equal availability and examine container inventory and connection effects. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment outages and container backlog” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equipment outages and container backlog”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備停機與貨櫃積壓
knowledge.text: 區分吊機故障時間、降級服務和修復等待，避免只統計更換零件的工時。比較同可用度下不同停機分布，評估貨櫃存量與轉乘班次受到的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish crane failure, degraded service and repair waiting rather than counting only hands-on repair. Compare outage patterns at equal availability and examine container inventory and connection effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment outages and container backlog" is correct?
options: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
區分吊機故障時間、降級服務和修復等待，避免只統計更換零件的工時。
optionsEn: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Distinguish crane failure, degraded service and repair waiting rather than counting only hands-on repair.
quiz.explanation: 區分吊機故障時間、降級服務和修復等待，避免只統計更換零件的工時。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish crane failure, degraded service and repair waiting rather than counting only hands-on repair. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備停機與貨櫃積壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment outages and container backlog: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equipment outages and container backlog” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備停機與貨櫃積壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment outages and container backlog", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.

A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。 重算時請保留單位。

quiz.explanationEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 場站整合試驗工時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Terminal integration-test effort: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「場站整合試驗工時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Terminal integration-test effort” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「場站整合試驗工時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for terminal integration-test effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「場站整合試驗工時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for terminal integration-test effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「場站整合試驗工時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Terminal integration-test effort" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。
總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded.
quiz.explanation: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鐵路連續焊軌應變監測
courses.titleEn: Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以溫度補償和獨立基準追蹤連續焊軌應變。從完全拘束的熱應力量級建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把隨機量測不確定度與溫度與應變時間對齊連成可驗證的介面，最後以監測校驗與追溯計畫整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies temperature compensation and independent references for continuous-welded-rail strain. Start with thermal stress under full restraint to define physical or information boundaries, connect random measurement uncertainty with aligning temperature and strain records as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through calibration effort and traceability. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 以溫度補償和獨立基準追蹤連續焊軌應變
courses.focusEn: Temperature compensation and independent references for continuous-welded-rail strain
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究完全拘束的熱應力量級。原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。公式 y=E*alpha*dT，代入得 y=63 MPa。邊界：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。敏感度只改 dT=25 至 27.5 K，輸出變為 69.3 MPa；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究自由伸長對照試件：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。再比較完全拘束模型與可滑移現場的差異，避免把簡化量級當成挫屈判定。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate thermal stress under full restraint. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K. Formula y=E*alpha*dT gives y=63 MPa. Boundary: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed. For sensitivity, change only dT=25 to 27.5 K; the output becomes 69.3 MPa. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate free-expansion reference specimen: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. Compare full restraint with possible field slip without treating this scale calculation as a buckling decision. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：完全拘束的熱應力量級採 E=210000 MPa；本課公式結果 63 MPa，非現場額定值。
教學假設：自由伸長對照試件採 L=30 m；本課公式結果 7.2 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：橋路輸出與機械應變採 strain=400 microstrain；本課公式結果 1.05 mV，非現場額定值。
教學假設：隨機量測不確定度採 s1=3 microstrain；本課公式結果 5 microstrain，非現場額定值。
教學假設：感測位置與測量基準採 distance=40 m；本課公式結果 1 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：移動檢測的空間取樣採 v=25 m/s；本課公式結果 1.25 m/sample，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for thermal stress under full restraint: E=210000 MPa; this model gives 63 MPa, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for free-expansion reference specimen: L=30 m; this model gives 7.2 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for bridge output and mechanical strain: strain=400 microstrain; this model gives 1.05 mV, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for random measurement uncertainty: s1=3 microstrain; this model gives 5 microstrain, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for sensor positions and survey datums: distance=40 m; this model gives 1 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for spatial sampling during mobile inspection: v=25 m/s; this model gives 1.25 m/sample, not a field rating.

stages.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級與自由伸長對照試件
stages.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint & Free-expansion reference specimen
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「完全拘束的熱應力量級」與「自由伸長對照試件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal stress under full restraint" and "Free-expansion reference specimen": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「完全拘束的熱應力量級」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal stress under full restraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。再比較完全拘束模型與可滑移現場的差異，避免把簡化量級當成挫屈判定。完全軸向拘束的熱應力大小由彈性模數、膨脹係數與溫差相乘得到，加熱時是壓應力。實際鋼軌可能滑移並透過扣件與道床重新分配作用；量得總應變必須分離熱應變與機械應變，才能推論應力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完全拘束的熱應力量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. Compare full restraint with possible field slip without treating this scale calculation as a buckling decision. The magnitude of thermal stress under complete axial restraint is modulus times expansion coefficient times temperature change; heating produces compression. Real rail can slip and redistribute force through fasteners and ballast. Total measured strain must be separated into thermal and mechanical components before inferring stress. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal stress under full restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal stress under full restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級
knowledge.text: 先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。再比較完全拘束模型與可滑移現場的差異，避免把簡化量級當成挫屈判定。
knowledge.textEn: Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. Compare full restraint with possible field slip without treating this scale calculation as a buckling decision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完全拘束的熱應力量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal stress under full restraint" is correct?
options: 任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力
先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。
量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
optionsEn: Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress.
Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating.
No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
quiz.explanation: 先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal stress under full restraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。公式 y=E*alpha*dT，代入得 y=63 MPa。邊界：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K. Formula y=E*alpha*dT gives y=63 MPa. Boundary: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測軌溫與應變，使用獨立參考方法或已知拘束試件檢查溫度補償與零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record rail temperature and strain together and use an independent reference or known-restraint specimen to check thermal compensation and zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。公式 y=E*alpha*dT，代入得 y=63 MPa。邊界：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K. Formula y=E*alpha*dT gives y=63 MPa. Boundary: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal stress under full restraint", which statement holds?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完全拘束的熱應力量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal stress under full restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測軌溫與應變，使用獨立參考方法或已知拘束試件檢查溫度補償與零點。以「完全拘束的熱應力量級」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record rail temperature and strain together and use an independent reference or known-restraint specimen to check thermal compensation and zero. For thermal stress under full restraint, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把相對無應力溫差 dT 從 25 改成 27.5 K（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 63 變為 69.3 MPa。先說明「完全拘束的熱應力量級」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only change from stress-free temperature dT from 25 to 27.5 K (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 63 to 69.3 MPa. Explain the causal direction for thermal stress under full restraint, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總應變直接乘彈性模數可能把自由熱膨脹誤當機械應力，感測器脫膠則會低估變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying total strain by modulus can misinterpret free thermal expansion as mechanical stress; sensor debonding can suppress the response. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完全拘束的熱應力量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal stress under full restraint"?
options: 同步量測軌溫與應變，使用獨立參考方法或已知拘束試件檢查溫度補償與零點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Record rail temperature and strain together and use an independent reference or known-restraint specimen to check thermal compensation and zero.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測軌溫與應變，使用獨立參考方法或已知拘束試件檢查溫度補償與零點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record rail temperature and strain together and use an independent reference or known-restraint specimen to check thermal compensation and zero. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal stress under full restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總應變直接乘彈性模數可能把自由熱膨脹誤當機械應力，感測器脫膠則會低估變化。回到「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying total strain by modulus can misinterpret free thermal expansion as mechanical stress; sensor debonding can suppress the response. Trace the input chain for thermal stress under full restraint. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
