stages.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算與街道集水與排水需求
stages.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget & Street runoff and drainage demand
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」與「街道集水與排水需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget" and "Street runoff and drainage demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將槽型製造、輪緣幾何與測量界限分開相加，所得只是誤差預算而非實際槽寬。用斷面圖標明接觸和非接觸位置，避免把範例數值誤作驗收限值。槽形鋼軌與輪緣之間的幾何介面包含製造、磨耗與量測的不確定度。把各個最大誤差同向相加可得到保守的誤差預算，但不能因此推得槽寬、輪緣空間或真正間隙；實際幾何還需要名義尺寸、變形與曲線姿態，而行人和自行車風險屬另一組介面需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sum manufacturing, flange-geometry and survey bounds as an uncertainty budget rather than an actual groove width. Mark contact and clearance locations on a section sketch without converting example values into acceptance limits. The groove–flange interface contains uncertainty from manufacturing, wear and measurement. Adding same-direction maximum error bounds gives a conservative uncertainty budget, not the groove width, flange clearance or actual gap. Real geometry also needs nominal dimensions, deformation and curve attitude. Pedestrian and bicycle risks form a separate set of street-interface requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三項誤差界的總和就是現場鋼軌槽內的實際間隙」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sum of three error bounds is the actual clearance inside the rail groove." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。公式 y=groove+flange+survey，代入得 y=0.9 mm。邊界：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm. Formula y=groove+flange+survey gives y=0.9 mm. Boundary: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立量具核對槽形與輪緣輪廓，在相同座標保留名義尺寸及誤差符號，另檢查測量零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check groove and flange profiles with independent gauges, retain nominal dimensions and error signs in one coordinate system, and verify instrument zeros separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立量具核對槽形與輪緣輪廓，在相同座標保留名義尺寸及誤差符號，另檢查測量零點。以「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check groove and flange profiles with independent gauges, retain nominal dimensions and error signs in one coordinate system, and verify instrument zeros separately. For flangeway geometry uncertainty budget, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把槽形製造誤差界 groove 從 0.4 改成 0.44 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.9 變為 0.94 mm。先說明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only groove manufacturing error bound groove from 0.4 to 0.44 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.9 to 0.94 mm. Explain the causal direction for flangeway geometry uncertainty budget, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將誤差總和當成實際間隙會省略名義幾何；共用失準量具還可能讓兩個錯誤輪廓看似互相吻合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 街道集水與排水需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Street runoff and drainage demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「街道集水與排水需求」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Street runoff and drainage demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先劃定會流向軌槽的集水面積，將雨強、面積與逕流係數放到一致單位。計算結果只是來水需求，仍需另查坡度、堵塞和排水出口能力。降雨逕流需求可由雨強、集水面積與逕流係數估算，毫米乘平方米等於公升。這個需求量尚未描述排水口能力，槽內泥砂、路面坡度和尾水都會影響真正排放；短小雨場的計算也不能代表暴雨頻率與都市集水區的完整水文過程。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻穩定降雨的簡化需求模型，未求排水容量、集流延遲或淹水水深。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「街道集水與排水需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Delineate the area draining toward the rail and use consistent rainfall, area and runoff units. The result is inflow demand; slopes, blockage and outlet capacity need separate assessment. Rainfall runoff demand follows intensity, catchment area and a runoff coefficient, with millimetres times square metres giving litres. This demand does not describe inlet capacity. Sediment, pavement slope and tailwater affect actual discharge, while a short simple event cannot represent storm frequency or the full hydrology of an urban catchment. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Street runoff and drainage demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：假想逕流係數 C=0.7 1；教學降雨強度 i=30 mm/h；集水面積 A=120 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed runoff coefficient C=0.7 1; teaching rainfall intensity i=30 mm/h; catchment area A=120 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出的降雨逕流量就等於排水口保證可以排走的流量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed runoff coefficient C=0.7 1; teaching rainfall intensity i=30 mm/h; catchment area A=120 m2. Formula y=C*i*A/3600 gives y=0.7 L/s. Boundary: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以集水邊界核對面積與降雨單位，在低風險縮尺水槽量測流入及流出，分開記錄槽內暫存水量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and rainfall units, measure inflow and outflow on a low-risk scale water rig, and record temporary storage separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「街道集水與排水需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Street runoff and drainage demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
漏算鄰近路面集水會低估需求，排水口淤塞則會在雨強不變時使暫存水量上升而不改變此公式的需求。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
Omitted adjoining pavement understates demand; a blocked inlet raises storage at unchanged rainfall without changing the demand calculated by this formula.
quiz.explanation: 漏算鄰近路面集水會低估需求，排水口淤塞則會在雨強不變時使暫存水量上升而不改變此公式的需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted adjoining pavement understates demand; a blocked inlet raises storage at unchanged rainfall without changing the demand calculated by this formula. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準與鋼軌與鋪面自由變形
stages.titleEn: Street and rail survey reference & Free movement of rail and pavement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「路面與鋼軌測量基準」與「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Street and rail survey reference" and "Free movement of rail and pavement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Street and rail survey reference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路面與鋼軌測量基準」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Street and rail survey reference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把路面標高、軌頂與街道交叉坡放在同一測量基準，避免各專業各自看似合格。比較不同視距的定位誤差，檢查施工移交時是否保留一致控制點。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路面與鋼軌測量基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reference pavement level, rail head and crossfall to one survey datum rather than accepting disconnected discipline checks. Compare sight-distance errors and verify continuity of control points at construction handoff. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Street and rail survey reference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路面與鋼軌測量基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Street and rail survey reference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準
knowledge.text: 把路面標高、軌頂與街道交叉坡放在同一測量基準，避免各專業各自看似合格。比較不同視距的定位誤差，檢查施工移交時是否保留一致控制點。
knowledge.textEn: Reference pavement level, rail head and crossfall to one survey datum rather than accepting disconnected discipline checks. Compare sight-distance errors and verify continuity of control points at construction handoff.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「路面與鋼軌測量基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Street and rail survey reference" is correct?
options: 把路面標高、軌頂與街道交叉坡放在同一測量基準，避免各專業各自看似合格。
同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
optionsEn: Reference pavement level, rail head and crossfall to one survey datum rather than accepting disconnected discipline checks.
Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
quiz.explanation: 把路面標高、軌頂與街道交叉坡放在同一測量基準，避免各專業各自看似合格。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reference pavement level, rail head and crossfall to one survey datum rather than accepting disconnected discipline checks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Street and rail survey reference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路面與鋼軌測量基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Street and rail survey reference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「路面與鋼軌測量基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Street and rail survey reference", which statement holds?
options: 前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變
原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
optionsEn: The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Street and rail survey reference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路面與鋼軌測量基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Street and rail survey reference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「路面與鋼軌測量基準」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For street and rail survey reference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「路面與鋼軌測量基準」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for street and rail survey reference, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「路面與鋼軌測量基準」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For street and rail survey reference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「路面與鋼軌測量基準」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for street and rail survey reference, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「路面與鋼軌測量基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Street and rail survey reference"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 路面與鋼軌測量基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Street and rail survey reference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路面與鋼軌測量基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Street and rail survey reference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「路面與鋼軌測量基準」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for street and rail survey reference. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

steps.title: 鋼軌與鋪面自由變形：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free movement of rail and pavement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先算鋼軌自由熱伸長，再討論周邊鋪面和固定條件如何限制這個位移。接縫看不出移動仍可能累積內力，量測需同時保留溫度與邊界狀態。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate free rail expansion before discussing restraint from pavement and fixings. Little visible joint movement may coexist with internal force, so retain temperature and boundary-condition records together. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free movement of rail and pavement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 鋼軌與鋪面自由變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free movement of rail and pavement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free movement of rail and pavement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 鋼軌與鋪面自由變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free movement of rail and pavement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free movement of rail and pavement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. For free movement of rail and pavement, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把構件長度 L 從 30 改成 33 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 7.2 變為 7.92 mm。先說明「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only member length L from 30 to 33 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 7.2 to 7.92 mm. Explain the causal direction for free movement of rail and pavement, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 鋼軌與鋪面自由變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free movement of rail and pavement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free movement of rail and pavement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Trace the input chain for free movement of rail and pavement. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「鋼軌與鋪面自由變形」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for free movement of rail and pavement. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension.
Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.

stages.title: 街道曲線的側向加速度與軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢
stages.titleEn: Lateral acceleration on street curves & Groove-profile wear trends
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「街道曲線的側向加速度」與「軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lateral acceleration on street curves" and "Groove-profile wear trends": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 街道曲線的側向加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral acceleration on street curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「街道曲線的側向加速度」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral acceleration on street curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以車速平方和曲線半徑比較側向加速度量級，不把結果當成輪緣力或脫軌判定。再辨認超高、車體姿態和輪軌接觸是這個簡式未處理的部分。曲線向心加速度與速度平方成正比、與半徑成反比，導向輪與懸吊需共同提供相應作用。傾斜或超高可改變乘客感受的側向分量，但不會消除車輛轉彎所需的向心加速度；轉折處的變化率亦影響舒適。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「街道曲線的側向加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare lateral-acceleration scale using speed squared and curve radius without equating it to flange force or derailment assessment. Identify cant, body attitude and contact behaviour as omitted mechanisms. Centripetal acceleration scales with speed squared and inverse radius, supplied through guidance and suspension forces. quiz.explanation: 固定同一斷面與量測方向比較磨耗深度，先排除測點變動造成的假趨勢。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare wear at a fixed section and direction to exclude false trends from changed measurement positions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groove-profile wear trends: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groove-profile wear trends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. Formula y=depth/cycles*future gives y=0.2 mm. Boundary: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。以「軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groove-profile wear trends” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。回到「軌槽輪廓磨耗趨勢」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 路面混行的停止距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance in shared streets: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路面混行的停止距離」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stopping distance in shared streets” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將反應距離與制動距離分開，觀察速度增加時第二項的平方效應。濕滑路面和軌面黏著另作情境限制，不把平直定減速度模型直接用於街道配置。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路面混行的停止距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate reaction and braking travel to observe the square-speed contribution. Treat wet pavement and rail adhesion as separate scenario limits rather than designing a street from a level constant-deceleration model. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping distance in shared streets” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 路面混行的停止距離：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路面混行的停止距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路面混行的停止距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「路面混行的停止距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping distance in shared streets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「路面混行的停止距離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 把看見提示、理解意義和開始動作列成不同事件，避免只量按鍵反應。以不同假想行進速度換算這段時間消耗的距離，保留道路使用者能力差異。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路口提示與察覺距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「路口提示與察覺距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Junction warnings and reaction travel", which statement holds?

三項誤差界的總和就是現場鋼軌槽內的實際間隙

optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s.
The sum of three error bounds is the actual clearance inside the rail groove.

steps.title: 路口提示與察覺距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Junction warnings and reaction travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路口提示與察覺距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Junction warnings and reaction travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。以「路口提示與察覺距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. For junction warnings and reaction travel, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想反應時間 reaction 從 2.5 改成 2.75 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變為 44 m。先說明「路口提示與察覺距離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed reaction time reaction from 2.5 to 2.75 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40 to 44 m. Explain the causal direction for junction warnings and reaction travel, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 路口提示與察覺距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Junction warnings and reaction travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路口提示與察覺距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Junction warnings and reaction travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。回到「路口提示與察覺距離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Trace the input chain for junction warnings and reaction travel. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Junction warnings and reaction travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
車頭通過平交道出口就表示整輛長車已完全清空
事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear.
Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection.
quiz.explanation: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 混行路口車尾清空與街道介面交付案例
stages.titleEn: Rear clearance at shared intersections & Street-interface acceptance cases
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混行路口車尾清空」與「街道介面交付案例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rear clearance at shared intersections" and "Street-interface acceptance cases": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混行路口車尾清空：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rear clearance at shared intersections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混行路口車尾清空」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rear clearance at shared intersections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 清空距離必須追蹤車尾離開衝突區，不是車頭通過停止線便完成。以離線時空圖核對低速長車與等待因素，避免將教學秒數當成號誌時制。道路車輛清空時間從開始等待到車尾完全離開衝突區計算，距離必須包含車長而不能只看車頭的位置。定速度估算只展示等待與移動兩部分，長車起步、轉彎和下游阻塞可能改變速度；鄰近號誌的放行並不保證車尾已有足夠可用空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混行路口車尾清空」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track the rear leaving the conflict area rather than only the front crossing a line. Use an offline time-distance chart for slow long vehicles and waiting without adopting teaching seconds as signal timings. Road-vehicle clearance runs from initial waiting until the rear leaves the conflict area, so the distance must include vehicle length rather than front position alone. Constant speed separates waiting and movement conceptually. Long-vehicle acceleration, turning and downstream blockage alter speed; a nearby green indication does not establish adequate space for the vehicle rear. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rear clearance at shared intersections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：車尾需行進的清空距離 distance=30 m；假想定車速 speed=2 m/s；起步等待 wait=4 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rear-end clearance travel distance=30 m; assumed constant vehicle speed speed=2 m/s; startup waiting wait=4 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車頭通過平交道出口就表示整輛長車已完全清空」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混行路口車尾清空」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rear clearance at shared intersections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Track the rear leaving the conflict area rather than only the front crossing a line. Use an offline time-distance chart for slow long vehicles and waiting without adopting teaching seconds as signal timings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：車頭通過平交道出口就表示整輛長車已完全清空 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混行路口車尾清空」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rear clearance at shared intersections" is correct?
options: 清空距離必須追蹤車尾離開衝突區，不是車頭通過停止線便完成。

optionsEn: Track the rear leaving the conflict area rather than only the front crossing a line.
The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 清空距離必須追蹤車尾離開衝突區，不是車頭通過停止線便完成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 混行路口車尾清空：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rear clearance at shared intersections: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混行路口車尾清空」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rear clearance at shared intersections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：車尾需行進的清空距離 distance=30 m；假想定車速 speed=2 m/s；起步等待 wait=4 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=19 s。邊界：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rear-end clearance travel distance=30 m; assumed constant vehicle speed speed=2 m/s; startup waiting wait=4 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=19 s. Boundary: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在桌面交通模型標記車頭與車尾事件，分別計算等待與移動；以不同車長重播並核對清空定義完全一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark front and rear events in a desktop traffic model, measure waiting and motion separately, and replay different vehicle lengths with one consistent clearance definition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 混行路口車尾清空：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rear clearance at shared intersections: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混行路口車尾清空」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rear clearance at shared intersections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在桌面交通模型標記車頭與車尾事件，分別計算等待與移動；以不同車長重播並核對清空定義完全一致。以「混行路口車尾清空」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark front and rear events in a desktop traffic model, measure waiting and motion separately, and replay different vehicle lengths with one consistent clearance definition. For rear clearance at shared intersections, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想定車速 speed 從 2 改成 2.2 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 17.6364 s。先說明「混行路口車尾清空」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed constant vehicle speed speed from 2 to 2.2 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 17.6364 s. Explain the causal direction for rear clearance at shared intersections, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用車頭通過代替車尾清空會低估占用時間，下游排隊還可能讓正常起步的車輛停在衝突區內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using front passage instead of rear clearance understates occupation; downstream queues can stop a vehicle inside the conflict area after an otherwise normal start. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 混行路口車尾清空：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rear clearance at shared intersections: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混行路口車尾清空」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rear clearance at shared intersections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用車頭通過代替車尾清空會低估占用時間，下游排隊還可能讓正常起步的車輛停在衝突區內。回到「混行路口車尾清空」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using front passage instead of rear clearance understates occupation; downstream queues can stop a vehicle inside the conflict area after an otherwise normal start. Trace the input chain for rear clearance at shared intersections. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Desktop constant-speed model with fixed startup waiting, excluding acceleration, gradient, turning and field-warning settings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車頭通過平交道出口就表示整輛長車已完全清空」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The front passing the crossing exit means that the entire long vehicle is clear." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混行路口車尾清空」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 用車頭通過代替車尾清空會低估占用時間，下游排隊還可能讓正常起步的車輛停在衝突區內。

optionsEn: Using front passage instead of rear clearance understates occupation.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

steps.title: 街道介面交付案例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Street-interface acceptance cases: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「街道介面交付案例」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Street-interface acceptance cases” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把軌槽幾何、排水、行人穿越與道路資訊分成可追溯的測試需求，避免只驗證列車能通過。對跨單位交接保留版本和條件，清楚列出尚未涵蓋的街道情境。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「街道介面交付案例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace groove geometry, drainage, pedestrian crossing and road information to separate test requirements rather than checking only train passage. Retain handoff versions, conditions and street scenarios still untested. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Street-interface acceptance cases” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「街道介面交付案例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Street-interface acceptance cases”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 街道介面交付案例
knowledge.text: 把軌槽幾何、排水、行人穿越與道路資訊分成可追溯的測試需求，避免只驗證列車能通過。對跨單位交接保留版本和條件，清楚列出尚未涵蓋的街道情境。
knowledge.textEn: Trace groove geometry, drainage, pedestrian crossing and road information to separate test requirements rather than checking only train passage. Retain handoff versions, conditions and street scenarios still untested.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「街道介面交付案例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Street-interface acceptance cases" is correct?
options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
把軌槽幾何、排水、行人穿越與道路資訊分成可追溯的測試需求，避免只驗證列車能通過。
三項誤差界的總和就是現場鋼軌槽內的實際間隙
optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Trace groove geometry, drainage, pedestrian crossing and road information to separate test requirements rather than checking only train passage.
The sum of three error bounds is the actual clearance inside the rail groove.
quiz.explanation: 把軌槽幾何、排水、行人穿越與道路資訊分成可追溯的測試需求，避免只驗證列車能通過。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace groove geometry, drainage, pedestrian crossing and road information to separate test requirements rather than checking only train passage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 街道介面交付案例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Street-interface acceptance cases: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「街道介面交付案例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Street-interface acceptance cases” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「街道介面交付案例」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Street-interface acceptance cases", which statement holds?
options: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍

optionsEn: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Keep units when recalculating.

knowledge.textEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For street-interface acceptance cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. steps.title: 街道介面交付案例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Street-interface acceptance cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「街道介面交付案例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Street-interface acceptance cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「街道介面交付案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for street-interface acceptance cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 無架空線輕軌供電
courses.summary: 本課聚焦區分分段地面供電與車載儲能的無架空線系統。從輪周功率與電源需求建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把輔助供電的跨區續航與電源模式交接時序連成可驗證的介面，最後以線路服務與設備修復整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies distinguishing segmented ground supply from onboard energy storage. Start with wheel power and supply demand to define physical or information boundaries, connect auxiliary backup across supply gaps with power-mode handoff timing as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through line service and equipment recovery. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 區分分段地面供電與車載儲能的無架空線系統
courses.focusEn: Distinguishing segmented ground supply from onboard energy storage
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪周功率與電源需求。原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。公式 y=(m*a+R)*v/1000，代入得 y=1800 kW。邊界：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。敏感度只改 m=180000 至 198000 kg，輸出變為 1962 kW；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究回生能量與接收邊界：原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6，代入得 y=8.47 kWh。邊界：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先以車輛加速和阻力建立輪周機械功率，再另列供電轉換與輔機損失。比較同速度下不同載重需求，不把車載電流直接等同於有效牽引力。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel power and supply demand. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=(m*a+R)*v/1000 gives y=1800 kW. Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted. For sensitivity, change only m=180000 to 198000 kg; the output becomes 1962 kW. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate regeneration and receiving boundaries: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent mass m=180000 kg; speed v=22 m/s; recovery efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6 gives y=8.47 kWh. Boundary: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses. Compare loads at the same speed without treating supply current as effective tractive effort. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：輪周功率與電源需求採 m=180000 kg；本課公式結果 1800 kW，非現場額定值。
教學假設：回生能量與接收邊界採 m=180000 kg；本課公式結果 8.47 kWh，非現場額定值。
教學假設：導體接觸的電阻損失採 I=200 A；本課公式結果 1.2 kW，非現場額定值。
教學假設：輔助供電的跨區續航採 capacity=80 Ah；本課公式結果 3.84 h，非現場額定值。
教學假設：車載轉換器散熱邊界採 P=900 W；本課公式結果 61.5 degC，非現場額定值。
教學假設：供電區段與車載模式採 bits=8 bits；本課公式結果 256 states，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for wheel power and supply demand: m=180000 kg; this model gives 1800 kW, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for regeneration and receiving boundaries: m=180000 kg; this model gives 8.47 kWh, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for resistive losses in conductors and contacts: I=200 A; this model gives 1.2 kW, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for auxiliary backup across supply gaps: capacity=80 Ah; this model gives 3.84 h, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for cooling boundaries of onboard converters: P=900 W; this model gives 61.5 degC, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for supply-section and onboard states: bits=8 bits; this model gives 256 states, not a field rating.

stages.title: 輪周功率與電源需求與回生能量與接收邊界
stages.titleEn: Wheel power and supply demand & Regeneration and receiving boundaries
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪周功率與電源需求」與「回生能量與接收邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel power and supply demand" and "Regeneration and receiving boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪周功率與電源需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel power and supply demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪周功率與電源需求」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel power and supply demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以車輛加速和阻力建立輪周機械功率，再另列供電轉換與輔機損失。比較同速度下不同載重需求，不把車載電流直接等同於有效牽引力。牽引力先克服阻力，剩餘部分才增加列車動量。輪周機械功率等於牽引力乘速度，因此低速大力不必然等於高功率；電源側功率另受效率、輔助負載及回生可受納性影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪周功率與電源需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses. Compare loads at the same speed without treating supply current as effective tractive effort. Traction force first overcomes resistance; the remainder changes train momentum. Mechanical power at the wheel equals force times speed, so a large low-speed force need not imply high power. Electrical input also depends on efficiency, auxiliaries and regenerative receptivity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel power and supply demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪周功率與電源需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wheel power and supply demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪周功率與電源需求
knowledge.text: 先以車輛加速和阻力建立輪周機械功率，再另列供電轉換與輔機損失。比較同速度下不同載重需求，不把車載電流直接等同於有效牽引力。
knowledge.textEn: Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses. Compare loads at the same speed without treating supply current as effective tractive effort.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪周功率與電源需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel power and supply demand" is correct?
options: 牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快
先以車輛加速和阻力建立輪周機械功率，再另列供電轉換與輔機損失。

optionsEn: Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses.
A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat.

quiz.explanationEn: Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪周功率與電源需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel power and supply demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪周功率與電源需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel power and supply demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。公式 y=(m*a+R)*v/1000，代入得 y=1800 kW。邊界：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=(m*a+R)*v/1000 gives y=1800 kW. Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
