steps.title: 輪周功率與電源需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel power and supply demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪周功率與電源需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel power and supply demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將速度與牽引力同步取樣，對照加速度反推的慣性力，並另列輔助設備耗電。以「輪周功率與電源需求」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize speed and traction-force samples, compare inertial force inferred from acceleration, and account separately for auxiliary consumption. For wheel power and supply demand, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把列車質量 m 從 180000 改成 198000 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1800 變為 1962 kW。先說明「輪周功率與電源需求」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only train mass m from 180000 to 198000 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1800 to 1962 kW. Explain the causal direction for wheel power and supply demand, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.

steps.title: 輪周功率與電源需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel power and supply demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪周功率與電源需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel power and supply demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。回到「輪周功率與電源需求」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating grid input as wheel power overstates acceleration capability; low-speed slip can produce high current without increasing train speed. Trace the input chain for wheel power and supply demand. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for wheel power and supply demand. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

quiz.question: 在「輪周功率與電源需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wheel power and supply demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。
有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱

Treating grid input as wheel power overstates acceleration capability; low-speed slip can produce high current without increasing train speed.
A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat.

steps.title: 回生能量與接收邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Regeneration and receiving boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回生能量與接收邊界」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regeneration and receiving boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把列車動能上限、轉換效率和接收能力分開，辨認能量究竟回到電網還是車載儲能。接收端不可用時不能假設全部回收，能量帳仍要列出耗散去向。回生能量的上限先受列車動能限制，再受轉換損失與受電端容量限制。速度平方決定動能量級，回生率不能單獨說明整趟能耗；若鄰車或儲能無法接收，原可回收的能量仍可能轉為電阻熱。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回生能量與接收邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate kinetic-energy limit, conversion efficiency and receptivity, identifying grid and onboard storage as different receivers. When reception is unavailable, retain the dissipation path instead of assuming complete recovery. Recoverable energy is bounded first by kinetic energy and then by conversion losses and receiver capacity. The square of speed sets the energy scale, while recovery efficiency alone cannot describe journey consumption. Energy may still become resistor heat when nearby trains or storage cannot accept it. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regeneration and receiving boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。以「回生能量與接收邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.titleEn: Regeneration and receiving boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回生能量與接收邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。回到「回生能量與接收邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. Trace the input chain for regeneration and receiving boundaries. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 導體接觸的電阻損失與輔助供電的跨區續航

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導體接觸的電阻損失」與「輔助供電的跨區續航」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resistive losses in conductors and contacts" and "Auxiliary backup across supply gaps": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導體接觸的電阻損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Resistive losses in conductors and contacts: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導體接觸的電阻損失」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resistive losses in conductors and contacts” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在理想直流回路中以電流平方比較電阻損失，區分有用牽引功率與局部發熱。接觸劣化會改變電阻與熱點位置，量測需同時保留電流和壓降。直流饋電與接觸路徑的電阻損耗與電流平方成正比，所以尖峰電流對發熱特別敏感。等效電阻可包含導線與接點，卻不能把各部位的散熱條件視為相同；平均總損耗正常仍可能有局部接點過熱，分段供電的安全狀態也不是由此功率公式決定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：理想穩態直流電阻損耗，未提供地面供電分段邏輯或現場帶電作業方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導體接觸的電阻損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use current squared to compare resistive loss in an ideal DC path, separating useful traction power from local heating. Retain current and voltage-drop measurements as contact deterioration changes resistance and hotspot location. Resistive loss in a DC feeder and contact path scales with current squared, making peak current particularly influential. Equivalent resistance may include conductors and contacts, but their cooling conditions differ. A normal total loss can coexist with a hot contact, and the safe state of segmented supply is not determined by this power equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal steady DC resistance loss, without ground-supply segmentation logic or live electrical work procedures. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resistive losses in conductors and contacts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：假想直流電流 I=200 A；等效回路電阻 R=0.03 ohm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed direct current I=200 A; equivalent circuit resistance R=0.03 ohm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「直流電流增加兩倍時導線電阻損耗也只會增加兩倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling DC current merely doubles resistive conductor loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導體接觸的電阻損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：假想直流電流 I=200 A；等效回路電阻 R=0.03 ohm。公式 y=I*I*R/1000，代入得 y=1.2 kW。邊界：理想穩態直流電阻損耗，未提供地面供電分段邏輯或現場帶電作業方法。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在隔離低壓台同時量測電流與電壓降，核對功率帳後以溫度分布尋找局部接觸電阻異常。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure current and voltage drop together on an isolated low-voltage rig, check power balance, and use temperature distribution to locate abnormal contact resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 導體接觸的電阻損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resistive losses in conductors and contacts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導體接觸的電阻損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resistive losses in conductors and contacts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在隔離低壓台同時量測電流與電壓降，核對功率帳後以溫度分布尋找局部接觸電阻異常。以「導體接觸的電阻損失」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure current and voltage drop together on an isolated low-voltage rig, check power balance, and use temperature distribution to locate abnormal contact resistance. For resistive losses in conductors and contacts, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想直流電流 I 從 200 改成 220 A（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.2 變為 1.452 kW。先說明「導體接觸的電阻損失」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed direct current I from 200 to 220 A (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.2 to 1.452 kW. Explain the causal direction for resistive losses in conductors and contacts, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鬆動接點會把損耗集中在小區域，平均回路電阻的低解析度量測可能漏掉隨振動發生的間歇接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A loose contact concentrates loss in a small region; low-resolution mean resistance measurement can miss intermittent contact changes under vibration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Resistive losses in conductors and contacts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鬆動接點會把損耗集中在小區域，平均回路電阻的低解析度量測可能漏掉隨振動發生的間歇接觸。回到「導體接觸的電阻損失」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A loose contact concentrates loss in a small region; low-resolution mean resistance measurement can miss intermittent contact changes under vibration. Trace the input chain for resistive losses in conductors and contacts. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：理想穩態直流電阻損耗，未提供地面供電分段邏輯或現場帶電作業方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal steady DC resistance loss, without ground-supply segmentation logic or live electrical work procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「直流電流增加兩倍時導線電阻損耗也只會增加兩倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling DC current merely doubles resistive conductor loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 輔助供電的跨區續航：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Auxiliary backup across supply gaps: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輔助供電的跨區續航」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Auxiliary backup across supply gaps” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 此單元只估控制和監視負載的定電壓備援時間，不代表車輛主牽引續航。先列可用能量比例，再討論負載尖峰與老化如何讓平均能量估算失準。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輔助供電的跨區續航」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate constant-voltage backup for controls and monitoring only, not main traction range. State usable-energy fraction before discussing surges and ageing that can defeat an average-energy estimate. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Auxiliary backup across supply gaps” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輔助供電的跨區續航」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Auxiliary backup across supply gaps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輔助供電的跨區續航
knowledge.text: 此單元只估控制和監視負載的定電壓備援時間，不代表車輛主牽引續航。先列可用能量比例，再討論負載尖峰與老化如何讓平均能量估算失準。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate constant-voltage backup for controls and monitoring only, not main traction range. State usable-energy fraction before discussing surges and ageing that can defeat an average-energy estimate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
Estimate constant-voltage backup for controls and monitoring only, not main traction range.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.

steps.title: 輔助供電的跨區續航：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Auxiliary backup across supply gaps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輔助供電的跨區續航」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Auxiliary backup across supply gaps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 車載轉換器散熱邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cooling boundaries of onboard converters: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車載轉換器散熱邊界」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cooling boundaries of onboard converters” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以平均損失功率估算轉換器穩態熱點，將環境溫度和散熱路徑分開改變。相同負載下的溫升差異可提示熱阻變化，但此模型不預測每次通過區段的瞬態峰值。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車載轉換器散熱邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate steady converter temperature from mean loss and vary ambient and heat paths separately. Temperature differences can reveal thermal-resistance changes, but the model does not predict each segment-transition transient. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cooling boundaries of onboard converters” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only equivalent thermal resistance Rth from 0.035 to 0.0385 K/W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 61.5 to 64.65 degC. Explain the causal direction for cooling boundaries of onboard converters, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 電源模式交接時序：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 把來源辨識、介面處理和狀態確認分成可測事件，追蹤訊息何時真正被採用。總延遲只是教學預算，不能取代電氣保護與能量緩衝的獨立驗證。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電源模式交接時序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Split source identification, interface processing and confirmation into observable events and trace when information is used. The teaching timing budget does not replace independent protection or energy-buffer verification. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Power-mode handoff timing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

stages.title: 潮濕污損與模式案例與線路服務與設備修復
stages.titleEn: Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases & Line service and equipment recovery
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮濕污損與模式案例」與「線路服務與設備修復」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases" and "Line service and equipment recovery": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潮濕污損與模式案例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮濕污損與模式案例」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把環境狀態與供電模式分成測試軸，不以乾燥正常運轉代表全部使用範圍。追溯每項需求的證據與未測邊界，數值算例不作為實際通電允許條件。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮濕污損與模式案例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat environmental condition and power mode as separate test axes rather than generalizing from dry normal operation. Trace requirement evidence and untested boundaries without using example values as energization permissions. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮濕污損與模式案例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮濕污損與模式案例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 把環境狀態與供電模式分成測試軸，不以乾燥正常運轉代表全部使用範圍。

steps.title: 潮濕污損與模式案例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮濕污損與模式案例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮濕污損與模式案例」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.

steps.title: 潮濕污損與模式案例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮濕污損與模式案例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「潮濕污損與模式案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「潮濕污損與模式案例」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「潮濕污損與模式案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
quiz.explanation: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 潮濕污損與模式案例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮濕污損與模式案例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「潮濕污損與模式案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「潮濕污損與模式案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 線路服務與設備修復：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「線路服務與設備修復」如何影響無架空線輕軌供電的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Line service and equipment recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Catenary-free light-rail power systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分開電源局部退出、車輛降級與全線停駛，才能解釋同樣故障對服務的不同影響。核對修復與恢復服務的時間點，避免可用度漂亮卻遮蔽功能受限。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「線路服務與設備修復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish local supply withdrawal, degraded vehicles and line suspension to explain different service consequences. Audit repair and service-restoration times so attractive availability cannot conceal reduced functionality. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Line service and equipment recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「線路服務與設備修復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Line service and equipment recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線路服務與設備修復
knowledge.text: 分開電源局部退出、車輛降級與全線停駛，才能解釋同樣故障對服務的不同影響。核對修復與恢復服務的時間點，避免可用度漂亮卻遮蔽功能受限。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish local supply withdrawal, degraded vehicles and line suspension to explain different service consequences. Audit repair and service-restoration times so attractive availability cannot conceal reduced functionality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「線路服務與設備修復」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Line service and equipment recovery" is correct?
options: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
分開電源局部退出、車輛降級與全線停駛，才能解釋同樣故障對服務的不同影響。
牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快
optionsEn: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Distinguish local supply withdrawal, degraded vehicles and line suspension to explain different service consequences.
Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
quiz.explanation: 分開電源局部退出、車輛降級與全線停駛，才能解釋同樣故障對服務的不同影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish local supply withdrawal, degraded vehicles and line suspension to explain different service consequences. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 線路服務與設備修復：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Line service and equipment recovery: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「線路服務與設備修復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Line service and equipment recovery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「線路服務與設備修復」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Line service and equipment recovery", which statement holds?
options: 直流電流增加兩倍時導線電阻損耗也只會增加兩倍
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
optionsEn: Doubling DC current merely doubles resistive conductor loss.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 線路服務與設備修復：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Line service and equipment recovery: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「線路服務與設備修復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Line service and equipment recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「線路服務與設備修復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For line service and equipment recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「線路服務與設備修復」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for line service and equipment recovery, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「線路服務與設備修復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For line service and equipment recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「線路服務與設備修復」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「線路服務與設備修復」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Line service and equipment recovery"?
options: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 線路服務與設備修復：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Line service and equipment recovery: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「線路服務與設備修復」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Line service and equipment recovery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「線路服務與設備修復」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for line service and equipment recovery. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「線路服務與設備修復」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for line service and equipment recovery. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「線路服務與設備修復」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Line service and equipment recovery" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 跨座式單軌導梁
courses.summary: 本課聚焦跨座導梁的彎扭變形幾何與車輛動態介面。從導梁彎曲的量級檢查建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把導梁伸縮與支承活動與導梁波長與行車激振連成可驗證的介面，最後以彎扭溫度整合案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies bending, torsion, geometry and vehicle dynamics of straddle-monorail beams. Start with scale check of guideway bending to define physical or information boundaries, connect thermal movement and support travel with guideway wavelength and running excitation as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through combined bending, torsion and temperature cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 跨座導梁的彎扭變形幾何與車輛動態介面
courses.focusEn: Bending, torsion, geometry and vehicle dynamics of straddle-monorail beams
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究導梁彎曲的量級檢查。原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。公式 y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000，代入得 y=0.761905 mm。邊界：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。敏感度只改 L=20 至 22 m，輸出變為 1.0141 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。公式 y=T*L/(G*J)*1000，代入得 y=0.428571 mrad。邊界：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。以簡支跨中力建立導梁撓度基準，觀察跨度三次方對變形的影響。真實輪載分布和支承條件另列，避免將單一教學梁當成整條導梁驗收。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate scale check of guideway bending. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4. Formula y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000 gives y=0.761905 mm. Boundary: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted. For sensitivity, change only L=20 to 22 m; the output becomes 1.0141 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4. Formula y=T*L/(G*J)*1000 gives y=0.428571 mrad. Boundary: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity. Retain real wheel distribution and supports as separate conditions rather than accepting a full guideway through one beam model. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查與偏心輪載與導梁扭轉
stages.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending & Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」與「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scale check of guideway bending" and "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale check of guideway bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以簡支跨中力建立導梁撓度基準，觀察跨度三次方對變形的影響。真實輪載分布和支承條件另列，避免將單一教學梁當成整條導梁驗收。簡支梁跨中集中荷載的撓度隨跨度三次方增加，與彎曲剛度成反比。跨座導梁的車輛輪載並非真正集中於單點，支承與扭轉也會參與；概念梁模型適合量級檢查，但不能直接作為完整導梁的行車驗收。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity. Retain real wheel distribution and supports as separate conditions rather than accepting a full guideway through one beam model. Midspan deflection of a simply supported beam under a central point load scales with span cubed and inversely with flexural rigidity. Monorail wheel loads are distributed and involve supports and torsion. The beam model is useful for scale checks, not complete guideway acceptance. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale check of guideway bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scale check of guideway bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity. Retain real wheel distribution and supports as separate conditions rather than accepting a full guideway through one beam model.

knowledge.text: 誤解：跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scale check of guideway bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。公式 y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000，代入得 y=0.761905 mm。邊界：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4. Formula y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000 gives y=0.761905 mm. Boundary: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale check of guideway bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。以「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. For scale check of guideway bending, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把簡支跨度 L 從 20 改成 22 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.761905 變為 1.0141 mm。先說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only simply supported span L from 20 to 22 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.761905 to 1.0141 mm. Explain the causal direction for scale check of guideway bending, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scale check of guideway bending"?

A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale check of guideway bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。回到「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. Trace the input chain for scale check of guideway bending. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear.
Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur.

steps.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。以成對高程量測檢查扭轉，區分剛體轉動、支承沉陷與截面變形。偏心輪載會扭轉導梁，扭角由扭矩、長度與扭轉剛度控制。兩側輪道相對高差會影響導向輪接觸，即使跨中垂直撓度很小仍可能存在明顯扭轉；開口截面與翹曲拘束的行為不能用單純圓軸公式概括。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. Use paired elevation measurements to distinguish twist, rigid rotation and support settlement. Eccentric wheel loading twists a guideway, with angle governed by torque, length and torsional rigidity. Relative rail-surface height affects guide-wheel contact even when vertical deflection is small. Open sections and restrained warping cannot be represented fully by a simple shaft analogy. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉

knowledge.text: 跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。以成對高程量測檢查扭轉，區分剛體轉動、支承沉陷與截面變形。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. Use paired elevation measurements to distinguish twist, rigid rotation and support settlement.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.
Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection.
quiz.explanation: 跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。公式 y=T*L/(G*J)*1000，代入得 y=0.428571 mrad。邊界：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4. Formula y=T*L/(G*J)*1000 gives y=0.428571 mrad. Boundary: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。以「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison. For eccentric wheel loads and beam twist, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把扭矩 T 從 120000 改成 132000 N*m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.428571 變為 0.471429 mrad。先說明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。回到「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Trace the input chain for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。回到「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Trace the input chain for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.
Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle.
