quiz.explanationEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 曲線速度與側向需求與導梁伸縮與支承活動
stages.titleEn: Curve speed and lateral demand & Thermal movement and support travel
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線速度與側向需求」與「導梁伸縮與支承活動」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Curve speed and lateral demand" and "Thermal movement and support travel": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線速度與側向需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curve speed and lateral demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線速度與側向需求」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curve speed and lateral demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將曲線半徑和車速換成側向加速度量級，觀察車速平方的影響。導向輪力仍取決於車體和懸吊分配，不可把集中質點結果直接當成單輪荷載。曲線向心加速度與速度平方成正比、與半徑成反比，導向輪與懸吊需共同提供相應作用。傾斜或超高可改變乘客感受的側向分量，但不會消除車輛轉彎所需的向心加速度；轉折處的變化率亦影響舒適。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線速度與側向需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert curve radius and speed into a lateral-acceleration scale and examine the square-speed effect. Guide-wheel forces still depend on vehicle and suspension distribution, so a point-mass result is not a single-wheel load. Centripetal acceleration scales with speed squared and inverse radius, supplied through guidance and suspension forces. Tilt or banking changes the lateral component felt by passengers but does not remove the acceleration needed to turn. Its rate of change through transitions also affects comfort. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed planar circular curve, excluding cant, tilt and transition geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curve speed and lateral demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：速度 v=12 m/s；曲線半徑 R=150 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: speed v=12 m/s; curve radius R=150 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線速度與側向需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Curve speed and lateral demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲線速度與側向需求
knowledge.text: 將曲線半徑和車速換成側向加速度量級，觀察車速平方的影響。導向輪力仍取決於車體和懸吊分配，不可把集中質點結果直接當成單輪荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Convert curve radius and speed into a lateral-acceleration scale and examine the square-speed effect. Guide-wheel forces still depend on vehicle and suspension distribution, so a point-mass result is not a single-wheel load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲線速度與側向需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Curve speed and lateral demand" is correct?
options: 將曲線半徑和車速換成側向加速度量級，觀察車速平方的影響。
速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍
量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
optionsEn: Convert curve radius and speed into a lateral-acceleration scale and examine the square-speed effect.
Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.
No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
quiz.explanation: 將曲線半徑和車速換成側向加速度量級，觀察車速平方的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert curve radius and speed into a lateral-acceleration scale and examine the square-speed effect. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲線速度與側向需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Curve speed and lateral demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲線速度與側向需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curve speed and lateral demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：速度 v=12 m/s；曲線半徑 R=150 m。公式 y=v*v/R，代入得 y=0.96 m/s2。邊界：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: speed v=12 m/s; curve radius R=150 m. Formula y=v*v/R gives y=0.96 m/s2. Boundary: Constant-speed planar circular curve, excluding cant, tilt and transition geometry. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較速度、曲率及車體側向加速度，先轉換感測器座標再討論乘坐感受。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare synchronized speed, curvature and body lateral acceleration after transforming sensor coordinates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：速度 v=12 m/s；曲線半徑 R=150 m。公式 y=v*v/R，代入得 y=0.96 m/s2。邊界：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: speed v=12 m/s; curve radius R=150 m. Formula y=v*v/R gives y=0.96 m/s2. Boundary: Constant-speed planar circular curve, excluding cant, tilt and transition geometry.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲線速度與側向需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Curve speed and lateral demand", which statement holds?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
原創假想教學輸入：速度 v=12 m/s；曲線半徑 R=150 m。
結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小
optionsEn: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: speed v=12 m/s; curve radius R=150 m.
A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：速度 v=12 m/s；曲線半徑 R=150 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: speed v=12 m/s; curve radius R=150 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲線速度與側向需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Curve speed and lateral demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲線速度與側向需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curve speed and lateral demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較速度、曲率及車體側向加速度，先轉換感測器座標再討論乘坐感受。以「曲線速度與側向需求」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare synchronized speed, curvature and body lateral acceleration after transforming sensor coordinates. For curve speed and lateral demand, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把速度 v 從 12 改成 13.2 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.96 變為 1.1616 m/s2。先說明「曲線速度與側向需求」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only speed v from 12 to 13.2 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.96 to 1.1616 m/s2. Explain the causal direction for curve speed and lateral demand, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器未扣重力投影會把傾斜誤當側向動態，曲率定位錯位則使模型峰值位置偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved gravity projection can mimic lateral dynamics; misregistered curvature shifts the predicted peak location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 導梁伸縮與支承活動：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 先用自由伸長估計均勻溫差下的位移需求，再比較固定與活動支承如何改變反應。日照熱梯度和支承卡滯不在此簡式內，須另保留量測證據。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁伸縮與支承活動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate uniform-temperature free movement before comparing fixed and sliding support responses. Solar gradients and seized bearings lie outside the simple relation and need separate measurement evidence. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal movement and support travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K.

Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「導梁伸縮與支承活動」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. For thermal movement and support travel, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for thermal movement and support travel, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

stages.title: 導向面幾何控制網與幾何量測隨機成分
stages.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces & Random components of geometry measurement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導向面幾何控制網」與「幾何量測隨機成分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey control for guide surfaces" and "Random components of geometry measurement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導向面幾何控制網：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導向面幾何控制網」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey control for guide surfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。以閉合觀測檢查基準一致性，不用單站重複性代替全線準確度。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導向面幾何控制網」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tie contact guide surfaces reproducibly to the control network because angular error grows with sight distance. Use closure checks rather than substituting repeated readings at one station for network accuracy. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey control for guide surfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導向面幾何控制網」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Survey control for guide surfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導向面幾何控制網
knowledge.text: 車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。以閉合觀測檢查基準一致性，不用單站重複性代替全線準確度。
knowledge.textEn: Tie contact guide surfaces reproducibly to the control network because angular error grows with sight distance. Use closure checks rather than substituting repeated readings at one station for network accuracy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導向面幾何控制網」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey control for guide surfaces" is correct?
options: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。
optionsEn: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Tie contact guide surfaces reproducibly to the control network because angular error grows with sight distance.
quiz.explanation: 車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tie contact guide surfaces reproducibly to the control network because angular error grows with sight distance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導向面幾何控制網：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導向面幾何控制網」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey control for guide surfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導向面幾何控制網」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Survey control for guide surfaces", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導向面幾何控制網：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導向面幾何控制網」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey control for guide surfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「導向面幾何控制網」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For survey control for guide surfaces, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「導向面幾何控制網」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for survey control for guide surfaces, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「導向面幾何控制網」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For survey control for guide surfaces, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「導向面幾何控制網」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for survey control for guide surfaces, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導向面幾何控制網」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Survey control for guide surfaces"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。
導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement.
Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur.
quiz.explanation: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導向面幾何控制網：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導向面幾何控制網」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Survey control for guide surfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「導向面幾何控制網」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for survey control for guide surfaces. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「導向面幾何控制網」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for survey control for guide surfaces. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導向面幾何控制網」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Survey control for guide surfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences.
quiz.explanation: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 幾何量測隨機成分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Random components of geometry measurement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何量測隨機成分」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Random components of geometry measurement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將獨立儀器讀值的標準差與共同基準偏差分開，再決定能否平方和合成。若左右導向面共用同一基準，必須保留相關性而非盲目縮小誤差。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何量測隨機成分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate independent-reading standard deviations from common datum bias before root-sum-square combination. Retain correlations when both guide surfaces share a reference rather than automatically shrinking the uncertainty. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Random components of geometry measurement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。公式 y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)，代入得 y=1.94924 Hz。邊界：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg. Formula y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi) gives y=1.94924 Hz. Boundary: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剛度質量與模態概念」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 剛度質量與模態概念：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剛度質量與模態概念」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用低能量掃頻或自由衰減試驗量頻率與阻尼，對照載重改變後的模態移動。以「剛度質量與模態概念」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure frequency and damping with low-energy sweep or free decay, then compare modal shifts after changing load. For stiffness, mass and modal interpretation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把等效剛度 k 從 1.8e+06 改成 1.98e+06 N/m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.94924 變為 2.04438 Hz。先說明「剛度質量與模態概念」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only equivalent stiffness k from 1.8e+06 to 1.98e+06 N/m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.94924 to 2.04438 Hz. Explain the causal direction for stiffness, mass and modal interpretation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只增加剛度而忽略激振頻帶可能使振動更大，感測器裝在節點則可能漏掉主要模態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stiffening without considering excitation bands can increase vibration; a sensor at a node may miss the dominant mode. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.

steps.title: 剛度質量與模態概念：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剛度質量與模態概念」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只增加剛度而忽略激振頻帶可能使振動更大，感測器裝在節點則可能漏掉主要模態。回到「剛度質量與模態概念」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stiffening without considering excitation bands can increase vibration; a sensor at a node may miss the dominant mode. Trace the input chain for stiffness, mass and modal interpretation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剛度質量與模態概念」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.

stages.title: 導梁車輛與月台界面與彎扭溫度整合案例
stages.titleEn: Guideway, vehicle and platform interface & Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導梁車輛與月台界面」與「彎扭溫度整合案例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Guideway, vehicle and platform interface" and "Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導梁車輛與月台界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Guideway, vehicle and platform interface: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導梁車輛與月台界面」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guideway, vehicle and platform interface” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將導梁位置、懸吊移動和月台測量放到同一間隙預算，避免土建與車輛各自合格卻介面衝突。明確區分有界容差與隨機標準差，不能互換合成方法。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁車輛與月台界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Combine guideway position, suspension movement and platform survey in one gap budget to expose interface conflicts between separately acceptable disciplines. Distinguish bounded tolerances from random standard deviations when combining them. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Guideway, vehicle and platform interface” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導梁車輛與月台界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Guideway, vehicle and platform interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導梁車輛與月台界面
knowledge.text: 將導梁位置、懸吊移動和月台測量放到同一間隙預算，避免土建與車輛各自合格卻介面衝突。明確區分有界容差與隨機標準差，不能互換合成方法。
knowledge.textEn: Combine guideway position, suspension movement and platform survey in one gap budget to expose interface conflicts between separately acceptable disciplines. Distinguish bounded tolerances from random standard deviations when combining them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導梁車輛與月台界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 將導梁位置、懸吊移動和月台測量放到同一間隙預算，避免土建與車輛各自合格卻介面衝突。

steps.title: 導梁車輛與月台界面：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導梁車輛與月台界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Guideway, vehicle and platform interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「彎扭溫度整合案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For combined bending, torsion and temperature cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「彎扭溫度整合案例」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for combined bending, torsion and temperature cases, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 彎扭溫度整合案例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彎扭溫度整合案例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「彎扭溫度整合案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for combined bending, torsion and temperature cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「彎扭溫度整合案例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。

Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.

courses.title: 懸掛式單軌轉轍系統
courses.summary: 本課聚焦懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據。從可動構件力行程帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把致動推力與獨立保持與動作回授的事件次序連成可驗證的介面，最後以維修恢復與服務條件整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
courses.summaryEn: This course studies load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches. Start with force-travel work of moving members to define physical or information boundaries, connect actuation thrust and independent holding with event ordering in actuator feedback as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through maintenance recovery and service conditions. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
courses.focus: 懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據
courses.focusEn: Load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究可動構件力行程帳。原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。敏感度只改 F=4500 至 4950 N，輸出變為 913.846 J；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate force-travel work of moving members. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. For sensitivity, change only F=4500 to 4950 N; the output becomes 913.846 J. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate switch-linkage lever arm and torque: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設：可動構件力行程帳採 F=4500 N；本課公式結果 830.769 J，非現場額定值。
教學假設：轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩採 F=1800 N；本課公式結果 144 N*m，非現場額定值。
教學假設：多致動點位置差採 v1=0.012 m/s；本課公式結果 10 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：致動推力與獨立保持採 p=12 MPa；本課公式結果 86.4 kN，非現場額定值。
教學假設：承載位置與支點反力採 W=200 kN；本課公式結果 120 kN，非現場額定值。
教學假設：位置鎖定與路徑狀態採 bits=8 bits；本課公式結果 256 states，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for force-travel work of moving members: F=4500 N; this model gives 830.769 J, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for switch-linkage lever arm and torque: F=1800 N; this model gives 144 N*m, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for position mismatch across actuators: v1=0.012 m/s; this model gives 10 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for actuation thrust and independent holding: p=12 MPa; this model gives 86.4 kN, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for load position and support reactions: W=200 kN; this model gives 120 kN, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for position, locking and route states: bits=8 bits; this model gives 256 states, not a field rating.

stages.title: 可動構件力行程帳與轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩
stages.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members & Switch-linkage lever arm and torque
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「可動構件力行程帳」與「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force-travel work of moving members" and "Switch-linkage lever arm and torque": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可動構件力行程帳」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force-travel work of moving members” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可動構件力行程帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Force-travel work of moving members” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可動構件力行程帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Force-travel work of moving members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉

steps.title: 多致動點位置差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position mismatch across actuators” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一可動梁的多個致動點若不同步，微小速度差可能累積成扭斜。以共同時基追蹤位置差和負載轉移，不把平均行程完成當成各點同時到位。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多致動點位置差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small speed differences among actuators on one moving beam can accumulate into skew. Track position differences and load transfer on a common clock rather than treating mean completed travel as simultaneous arrival. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position mismatch across actuators” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。公式 y=(v1-v2)*t*1000，代入得 y=10 mm。邊界：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s. Formula y=(v1-v2)*t*1000 gives y=10 mm. Boundary: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 多致動點位置差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position mismatch across actuators: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多致動點位置差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position mismatch across actuators” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立位移計同時量測兩個連接點，對照編碼器零點與連桿幾何，再比較低負載及偏載時的誤差斜率。以「多致動點位置差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure both connection points simultaneously with independent displacement sensors, compare encoder zeros and linkage geometry, then compare drift slopes at low and uneven load. For position mismatch across actuators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把動作時間 t 從 20 改成 22 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變為 11 mm。先說明「多致動點位置差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only motion time t from 20 to 22 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 10 to 11 mm. Explain the causal direction for position mismatch across actuators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.

steps.title: 多致動點位置差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position mismatch across actuators: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多致動點位置差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position mismatch across actuators” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。回到「多致動點位置差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference. Trace the input chain for position mismatch across actuators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多致動點位置差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Position mismatch across actuators" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
optionsEn: Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 致動推力與獨立保持：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Actuation thrust and independent holding: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「致動推力與獨立保持」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Actuation thrust and independent holding” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。將定位、保持和位置確認分開列成介面，使用隔離教具觀察摩擦與背壓。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「致動推力與獨立保持」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path. Separate positioning, holding and confirmation interfaces and inspect friction and back pressure on an isolated rig. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Actuation thrust and independent holding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「致動推力與獨立保持」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Actuation thrust and independent holding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 致動推力與獨立保持
knowledge.text: 液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。將定位、保持和位置確認分開列成介面，使用隔離教具觀察摩擦與背壓。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path. Separate positioning, holding and confirmation interfaces and inspect friction and back pressure on an isolated rig.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「致動推力與獨立保持」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Actuation thrust and independent holding" is correct?
options: 油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。
總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
optionsEn: A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path.
Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
quiz.explanation: 液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 致動推力與獨立保持：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Actuation thrust and independent holding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「致動推力與獨立保持」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Actuation thrust and independent holding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1. Formula y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000 gives y=86.4 kN. Boundary: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立力感測器核對壓力推算，並記錄停留時的位移漂移與油溫變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pressure-derived force with an independent load cell and record displacement drift and oil temperature during holding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 致動推力與獨立保持：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Actuation thrust and independent holding: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「致動推力與獨立保持」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Actuation thrust and independent holding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立力感測器核對壓力推算，並記錄停留時的位移漂移與油溫變化。以「致動推力與獨立保持」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure-derived force with an independent load cell and record displacement drift and oil temperature during holding. For actuation thrust and independent holding, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把油壓 p 從 12 改成 13.2 MPa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 86.4 變為 95.04 kN。先說明「致動推力與獨立保持」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hydraulic pressure p from 12 to 13.2 MPa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 86.4 to 95.04 kN. Explain the causal direction for actuation thrust and independent holding, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：內洩漏可造成保持位置下降但壓力讀值短時正常，空氣混入則可能使動作變軟並延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal leakage can cause sag despite temporarily normal pressure, while entrained air makes motion compliant and delayed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 致動推力與獨立保持：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Actuation thrust and independent holding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「致動推力與獨立保持」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Actuation thrust and independent holding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 內洩漏可造成保持位置下降但壓力讀值短時正常，空氣混入則可能使動作變軟並延遲。回到「致動推力與獨立保持」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal leakage can cause sag despite temporarily normal pressure, while entrained air makes motion compliant and delayed. Trace the input chain for actuation thrust and independent holding. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for actuation thrust and independent holding. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.

stages.title: 承載位置與支點反力與位置鎖定與路徑狀態
stages.titleEn: Load position and support reactions & Position, locking and route states
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「承載位置與支點反力」與「位置鎖定與路徑狀態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load position and support reactions" and "Position, locking and route states": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 承載位置與支點反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load position and support reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「承載位置與支點反力」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load position and support reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在兩支承教學模型中移動偏心載重，觀察反力如何重新分配而總和不變。將可動構件自重和假想車重分列，避免以幾何中心代替實際重心。兩支承反力由力與力矩平衡同時決定。重心偏向一側時，該側反力增加而另一側減少，總和仍不變；平均反力看似充足不能掩蓋單側限制，支承接觸若脫離還會改變原先的邊界條件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「承載位置與支點反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Move an eccentric load in a two-support teaching model and observe reaction redistribution at constant total load. Separate moving-member weight from hypothetical vehicle weight and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity. Two support reactions follow both force and moment equilibrium. Moving the centre of gravity toward one support raises that reaction while reducing the other without changing the total. Adequate mean reaction cannot hide a local limit, and loss of contact changes the assumed boundary conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load position and support reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「承載位置與支點反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Load position and support reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 承載位置與支點反力
knowledge.text: 在兩支承教學模型中移動偏心載重，觀察反力如何重新分配而總和不變。將可動構件自重和假想車重分列，避免以幾何中心代替實際重心。
knowledge.textEn: Move an eccentric load in a two-support teaching model and observe reaction redistribution at constant total load. Separate moving-member weight from hypothetical vehicle weight and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.
