steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「整合失效的原因邏輯」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for cause logic for integrated failures. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「整合失效的原因邏輯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cause logic for integrated failures" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning.
quiz.explanation: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試運轉服務與缺陷修復與試運轉零失敗的證據界限
stages.titleEn: Trial service and defect recovery & Evidence limits of failure-free trials
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」與「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trial service and defect recovery" and "Evidence limits of failure-free trials": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試運轉服務與缺陷修復：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trial service and defect recovery: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」如何影響鐵路系統整合測試與試運轉的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trial service and defect recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail-system integration testing and trial running”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將缺陷發現、功能降級、修復完成與服務恢復分成不同時間戳，讓維修影響可被比較。高可用度只描述服務比例，仍需分開處理安全性與未關閉缺陷。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate defect discovery, degradation, repair completion and service restoration timestamps to compare maintenance effects. High availability describes service fraction while safety and unresolved defects remain separate matters. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trial service and defect recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trial service and defect recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試運轉服務與缺陷修復
knowledge.text: 將缺陷發現、功能降級、修復完成與服務恢復分成不同時間戳，讓維修影響可被比較。高可用度只描述服務比例，仍需分開處理安全性與未關閉缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Separate defect discovery, degradation, repair completion and service restoration timestamps to compare maintenance effects. High availability describes service fraction while safety and unresolved defects remain separate matters.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trial service and defect recovery" is correct?
options: 將缺陷發現、功能降級、修復完成與服務恢復分成不同時間戳，讓維修影響可被比較。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Separate defect discovery, degradation, repair completion and service restoration timestamps to compare maintenance effects.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 將缺陷發現、功能降級、修復完成與服務恢復分成不同時間戳，讓維修影響可被比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate defect discovery, degradation, repair completion and service restoration timestamps to compare maintenance effects. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試運轉服務與缺陷修復：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trial service and defect recovery: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trial service and defect recovery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trial service and defect recovery", which statement holds?
options: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
optionsEn: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試運轉服務與缺陷修復：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trial service and defect recovery: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trial service and defect recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For trial service and defect recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for trial service and defect recovery, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

For trial service and defect recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trial service and defect recovery"?

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試運轉服務與缺陷修復」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trial service and defect recovery" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試運轉零失敗的證據界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits of failure-free trials: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」如何影響鐵路系統整合測試與試運轉的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Evidence limits of failure-free trials” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail-system integration testing and trial running”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先核對試運轉情境是否獨立且代表預定使用範圍，再計算零失敗的單側上界。重複容易案例不能證明所有條件安全，交付結論必須附上抽樣和模型限制。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check independence and representation of intended use before calculating a one-sided bound from failure-free trials. Repeated easy cases cannot establish safety across all conditions; handover conclusions retain sampling and model limits. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Evidence limits of failure-free trials” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Evidence limits of failure-free trials”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試運轉零失敗的證據界限
knowledge.text: 先核對試運轉情境是否獨立且代表預定使用範圍，再計算零失敗的單側上界。重複容易案例不能證明所有條件安全，交付結論必須附上抽樣和模型限制。
knowledge.textEn: Check independence and representation of intended use before calculating a one-sided bound from failure-free trials. Repeated easy cases cannot establish safety across all conditions; handover conclusions retain sampling and model limits.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evidence limits of failure-free trials" is correct?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
先核對試運轉情境是否獨立且代表預定使用範圍，再計算零失敗的單側上界。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Check independence and representation of intended use before calculating a one-sided bound from failure-free trials.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 先核對試運轉情境是否獨立且代表預定使用範圍，再計算零失敗的單側上界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Check independence and representation of intended use before calculating a one-sided bound from failure-free trials. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試運轉零失敗的證據界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits of failure-free trials: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Evidence limits of failure-free trials” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evidence limits of failure-free trials", which statement holds?
options: 每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
optionsEn: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試運轉零失敗的證據界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits of failure-free trials: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Evidence limits of failure-free trials” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For evidence limits of failure-free trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for evidence limits of failure-free trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For evidence limits of failure-free trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for evidence limits of failure-free trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evidence limits of failure-free trials"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試運轉零失敗的證據界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evidence limits of failure-free trials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Evidence limits of failure-free trials” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for evidence limits of failure-free trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for evidence limits of failure-free trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試運轉零失敗的證據界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evidence limits of failure-free trials" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

sources.title: 專案官方歷史與路網背景
sources.titleEn: Official project history and network context

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 台灣高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：臺灣高鐵開始提供營運服務；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以臺灣南北高速運輸走廊為背景，設計一段包含高架橋、曲線與隧道的教學路線。比較正常行車、地震警報和異常受電三種工況，要求學徒追蹤每項設計假設如何傳到停車位置與班表恢復。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: Taiwan High Speed Rail began passenger service; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Taiwan’s north-south high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented alignment with a viaduct, curve and tunnel. Compare routine running, an earthquake warning and disrupted current collection. Trace each design assumption through to stopping position and timetable recovery rather than treating vehicle, structure and control calculations as isolated answers. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1996 年：木柵線開始營運形成後續文湖線基礎；2009 年：內湖線通車並與既有路段連接營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1996: The Muzha line opened as a predecessor of the Wenhu line; 2009: The Neihu line opened and connected with the existing route. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1997 年：淡水線開始營運成為臺北捷運早期路線；2013 年：信義線於十一月通車延伸南北運輸走廊。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1997: The Tamsui line opened as an early Taipei Metro route; 2013: The Xinyi line opened in November and extended the north-south corridor. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 高雄捷運紅線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2008 年：高雄捷運紅線於三月開始營運服務；2023 年：營運者回顧紅橘兩線通車十五周年。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以高雄紅線的南北都市走廊為背景，建立炎熱午後的站車負載案例。學徒需把冷房耗電、尖峰上車與加速電流放在同一時間軸，並在強降雨與單一電源失效下檢查服務降級和人員引導。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2008: Kaohsiung MRT Red Line began service in March; 2023: The operator reviewed fifteen years of Red and Orange line service. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Kaohsiung’s north-south Red Line as the setting for a hot-afternoon station and train load case. Place cooling demand, peak boarding and acceleration current on one timeline. Under heavy rainfall and a single supply failure, examine degraded service and passenger guidance without assuming that comfortable room temperature alone demonstrates system resilience. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 桃園機場捷運
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2017 年：桃園機場捷運於三月正式通車營運；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2017: Taoyuan Airport MRT opened for commercial service in March; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 東海道新幹線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1964 年：東海道新幹線於十月開始營運服務；2024 年：營運者年度報告回顧東海道新幹線六十年。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以東海道新幹線的成熟高速走廊為背景，建立服務密度高且有快慢停站差異的教學班表。將空氣阻力、受電弓、制動及車輛懸吊與運能相連，檢查提高速度後是否反而減少維護或恢復裕度。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1964: The Tokaido Shinkansen began passenger service in October; 2024: The operator annual report reviewed sixty years of the Tokaido Shinkansen. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the mature Tokaido corridor to construct a dense high-speed timetable with different stopping patterns. Connect aerodynamic resistance, current collection, braking and suspension to delivered capacity. Investigate whether raising speed consumes maintenance or recovery margins, and require an explicit distinction between historical project facts and the invented vehicle parameters used in the exercises. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1972 年：山陽新幹線新大阪至岡山區間開通；1975 年：山陽新幹線延伸至博多完成當時全線。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1972: The Shin-Osaka to Okayama section of the Sanyo Shinkansen opened; 1975: The Sanyo Shinkansen extension to Hakata completed the route. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 東北新幹線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1982 年：東北新幹線初期區間開始營運服務；2011 年：東日本旅客鐵道導入 E5 系隼號服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以東北新幹線向日本北部延伸的歷史為背景，設計積雪、低溫與側風並存的教學工況。分析防雪、黏著、道床熱量與輪軌監測之間的取捨，要求每項氣候假設均對應可量測的環境量。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1982: The initial Tohoku Shinkansen sections entered passenger service; 2011: JR East introduced E5 Hayabusa passenger services. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the northward development of the Tohoku Shinkansen to frame a teaching scenario combining snow, low temperature and crosswind. Examine tradeoffs among snow management, adhesion, thermal demand and wheel-rail monitoring. Every weather assumption must correspond to a measurable environmental quantity, and a successful single-condition test must be distinguished from validation across a winter operating envelope. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1981 年：法國東南高速鐵路開始支援 TGV 營運；2023 年：SNCF 網路公司安全報告列示既有高速線背景。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以法國東南高速鐵路開創高速服務的歷史為背景，比較高速專用線和既有線銜接時的設計目標。課程將線形、牽引、分相、訊號與維護放在共同時間尺度，檢查一項速度提升是否需要多個子系統共同改變。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1981: LGV Sud-Est began supporting TGV passenger operations; 2023: The SNCF infrastructure safety report documented the established high-speed network. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the introduction of French high-speed service on LGV Sud-Est to compare dedicated high-speed alignment with connections to conventional infrastructure. Place geometry, traction, neutral sections, signalling and maintenance on a common time axis. Investigate whether a speed increase demands coordinated changes in several subsystems rather than a single adjustment to motor output. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：法國東歐高速鐵路第一期開始營運；2016 年：法國東歐高速鐵路第二期開始營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: The first phase of LGV Est europeenne entered service; 2016: The second phase of LGV Est europeenne entered service. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2003 年：英國一號高速鐵路第一階段路段開通；2007 年：英國一號高速鐵路第二階段通達倫敦終端。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2003: The first phase of High Speed 1 opened; 2007: The second phase of High Speed 1 opened to its London terminal. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1992 年：馬德里至塞維亞高速鐵路開始商業營運；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以馬德里至塞維亞高速鐵路的營運及更新背景，建立夏季高溫與設備改造並行的案例。學徒要分開鋼軌溫度、車廂熱負載和牽引電流，檢查更換控制或供電設備時舊系統與新系統能否用可驗證介面銜接。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1992: The Madrid–Seville high-speed railway began commercial service; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the operation and renewal of the Madrid–Seville line to construct a case combining summer heat with equipment replacement. Separate rail temperature, carriage thermal load and traction current. Check whether renewed control or supply equipment can interface with the remaining system through verifiable conditions, rather than assuming a component upgrade automatically improves the complete railway. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 北京—上海高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2011 年：北京至上海高速鐵路於六月投入營運；2019 年：世界銀行發布中國高速鐵路發展研究報告。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以北京至上海高速鐵路為背景，建立長距離橋梁、路基與多城市車站組成的教學網路。重點是把局部沉陷和橋梁撓度與高速車輛反應聯繫，同時檢查多站停靠造成的班表差異、風險監測與修復後的服務恢復。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2011: The Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway entered service in June; 2019: The World Bank published its study of Chinese high-speed rail development. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail to construct a teaching network of bridges, earthworks and stations in several cities. Relate local settlement and bridge deflection to vehicle response at speed. At the same time, inspect differing stopping patterns, environmental monitoring and service restoration after repair, distinguishing an average network metric from a critical local defect. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 武漢—廣州高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2009 年：武漢至廣州高速鐵路於十二月開通營運；2019 年：世界銀行發布中國高速鐵路發展研究報告。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以武漢至廣州高速鐵路為背景，設計跨越濕熱平原和山地區段的教學走廊。課程將暴雨排水、隧道壓力和長坡牽引連結，要求在設備受潮、黏著下降與列車降速時重算能量、制動與班表影響。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2009: The Wuhan–Guangzhou high-speed railway opened in December; 2019: The World Bank published its study of Chinese high-speed rail development. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Wuhan–Guangzhou high-speed rail to construct a teaching corridor crossing humid plains and mountain sections. Connect storm drainage, tunnel pressure and sustained climbing. Recalculate energy, braking and timetable consequences when equipment becomes damp, adhesion falls and speed is restricted, retaining explicit boundaries between a hydraulic runoff estimate and a complete flood-protection design. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2006 年：青藏鐵路格爾木至拉薩段開始營運服務；2023 年：中國政府公開報導青藏鐵路營運與西藏鐵路網背景。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以青藏鐵路凍土地段為背景，建立路基熱量、地下冰與列車荷載共同作用的教學剖面。學徒必須分開季節凍融和長期溫度趨勢，將溫度、沉陷與排水量同步量測，並辨認縮尺熱模型不能直接預測真實凍土穩定年限。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2006: The Golmud–Lhasa section of the Qinghai–Tibet Railway entered service; 2023: A government publication reviewed Qinghai–Tibet operations and the Tibetan railway network. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the permafrost sections of the Qinghai–Tibet Railway to construct a teaching profile combining ground heat, ice and train loading. Separate seasonal freeze-thaw from long-term temperature trends. Measure temperature, settlement and drainage together, and identify why a scaled thermal model cannot directly predict the actual service life or stability of frozen ground. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2004 年：韓國高速鐵路 KTX 開始提供營運服務；2010 年：韓國鐵道公社導入 KTX 山川號列車服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以京釜高速鐵路及韓國高速列車演進為背景，建立不同車輛世代共用走廊的教學時刻表。課程比較牽引、制動、懸吊與受電特性改變後的介面需求，要求以共同量測基準評估車輛更新，而非只比較額定最高速度。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2004: KTX high-speed rail began passenger service in South Korea; 2010: Korail introduced KTX Sancheon passenger services. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Gyeongbu corridor and Korean high-speed train development to construct a teaching timetable shared by different vehicle generations. Compare interface demands after changes in traction, braking, suspension and current collection. Evaluate renewal using common measurement references, rather than only rated top speed, and track whether differences in dwell or maintenance alter delivered passenger service. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2018 年：哈拉曼高速鐵路開始商業旅客服務；2021 年：沙烏地鐵路公司重組形成整合營運背景。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以麥加至麥地那高速鐵路為背景，建立高溫、砂塵及集中旅客到達並存的教學案例。學徒把進氣過濾、散熱、供電和月台人流連結，在集中特殊需求下檢查系統瓶頸；所有人數與氣候數值均為自訂算例而非營運資料。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2018: Haramain high-speed railway began commercial passenger service; 2021: Saudi railway restructuring established an integrated operating context. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Haramain high-speed corridor to frame a teaching case combining heat, airborne sand and concentrated passenger arrivals. Connect intake filtration, cooling, power supply and platform flow under exceptional demand. All passenger and weather numbers are invented exercises, and students must distinguish a bottleneck revealed by a model from a verified constraint on the actual railway. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2018 年：摩洛哥阿爾波拉克高速服務正式揭幕；2019 年：摩洛哥國家鐵路發布阿爾波拉克一周年營運回顧。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以摩洛哥丹吉爾至蓋尼特拉高速線為背景，建立高速專用段與既有網路連接的教學走廊。學徒比較不同區段速度、供電和停站模式，追蹤旅客轉乘及列車循環，並用原創算例檢查能源改善是否只是把負荷轉移到另一時段。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2018: Morocco inaugurated Al Boraq high-speed service; 2019: ONCF published a first-anniversary review of Al Boraq operations. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Morocco’s Tangier–Kenitra high-speed line to construct a teaching corridor joining a dedicated fast section to an existing network. Compare section speeds, supply boundaries and stopping patterns. Track passenger connections and train circulation, and test whether an apparent energy improvement merely shifts demand to another time instead of reducing total delivered energy. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雅萬高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2023 年：雅萬高速鐵路於十月舉行啟用並開始付費服務；2024 年：營運者發布服務累計旅客與旅遊連結回顧。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以雅加達至萬隆高速鐵路為背景，建立熱帶丘陵中的橋隧連續路線及接駁旅程。學徒從降雨、坡度和曲線開始，延伸到車站轉乘與需求批次到達，要求把列車行車時間和門到門旅程時間分別驗證。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2023: Jakarta–Bandung high-speed rail was inaugurated and began paid service in October; 2024: The operator published a review of accumulated ridership and tourism connections. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway to construct a tropical hillside route with successive bridges, tunnels and feeder journeys. Begin with rainfall, gradients and curves, then extend the analysis to station interchange and batch arrivals. Verify train running time separately from door-to-door journey time so that fast line-haul service is not mistaken for a complete passenger-experience result. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 倫敦伊莉莎白線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2021 年：伊莉莎白線開始試運轉並進入試營運階段；2022 年：伊莉莎白線中央區段於五月開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2021: The Elizabeth line began trial running and progressed into trial operations; 2022: The Elizabeth line central section opened to passengers in May. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 巴黎 RER A 線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1969 年：巴黎區域快鐵東側早期路段開始營運；1977 年：巴黎奧貝爾與民族廣場間中央連結開通。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以巴黎 RER A 的都會區域運輸背景，建立分支線列車進入共同核心段的教學模型。學徒比較列車合流、月台交換與下游延誤恢復，並以逐列隊列檢查高頻服務中平均班距容易掩蓋的局部擁擠。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1969: An early eastern section of the Paris regional express network opened; 1977: The central connection between Auber and Nation opened in Paris. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Paris RER A as a metropolitan regional-rail setting for a teaching model in which branch trains enter a common core. Compare merging, platform exchange and downstream recovery. Track queues train by train to expose local crowding hidden by average headway, and separate a higher scheduled frequency from the ability of the busiest doors to complete passenger exchange. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1998 年：香港機場快綫配合新機場啟用投入服務；2005 年：機場快綫延伸至亞洲國際博覽館站。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以香港機場快綫的城市與機場連接為背景，建立長橋通過、行李服務與航廈步行相連的旅程。學徒要區分列車時間、報到排隊與到登機口的移動，並在側風或服務中斷情境下分析乘客如何累積與轉移。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1998: Hong Kong Airport Express entered service with the new airport; 2005: Airport Express was extended to AsiaWorld-Expo station. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Hong Kong Airport Express to frame a journey linking long-bridge passage, baggage processing and terminal walking. Distinguish train time from check-in queues and movement toward a departure gate. Under crosswind restrictions or interrupted service, analyse passenger accumulation and redistribution without assuming that the scheduled train journey represents the complete airport access time. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2003 年：新加坡東北地鐵線開始營運服務；2024 年：東北線榜鵝海岸站於十二月開放營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以新加坡東北地鐵線為背景，建立全地下自動運轉的教學案例。課程把供電、定位、車門與通風連成系統事件鏈，並以通訊失效和列車停在站間的情境檢查旅客資訊、備援能源及復原次序。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。

The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Singapore’s North East Line as the setting for an underground automated-operation teaching case. Connect power, localisation, doors and ventilation through system events. Use lost communication and an interstation stop to test passenger information, backup energy and recovery sequence, while distinguishing a reliable data link from the proof that a movement is safely authorised. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

Use Dubai Metro Red Line to construct a teaching system with elevated sections, conditioned stations and automated trains. Under dust, intense sunlight and peak arrivals, identify cooling and filter-maintenance bottlenecks. Examine how transfer paths and emergency power affect service restoration, keeping outdoor weather observations separate from measured equipment and rail temperatures. history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2011 年：哥本哈根環狀地鐵進入建設施工階段；2019 年：哥本哈根環狀地鐵於九月開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以哥本哈根環狀地鐵為背景，建立沒有一般端點折返的循環營運實驗。課程研究列車間距、局部停站延誤與車站人流如何沿環線傳遞，並連接地下施工變形、垂直交通和設備備援的驗證資料。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2011: Construction work for Copenhagen Cityringen began; 2019: Copenhagen Cityringen opened to passengers in September. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Copenhagen Cityringen to construct a circular-operation experiment without a normal terminal reversal at each end. Study how train spacing, local dwell delays and station passenger flow propagate around the loop. Connect the operating model to evidence from underground construction movement, vertical circulation and equipment backup, avoiding the assumption that removing a terminus removes every capacity constraint. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2019: Sydney Metro Northwest began passenger service in May; 2024: The Sydney Metro network extension toward the city centre entered service. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Sydney Metro Northwest as the setting for an automated-operation teaching route alternating elevated, underground and interchange sections. Trace structural movement through localisation and door interfaces. Use different test evidence to check whether the complete service has traceable acceptance conditions and recovery capability, instead of treating successful operation of one train as proof of full-system readiness. history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2005 年：加拿大線工程於十一月開始建設施工；2009 年：加拿大線於八月開始旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以溫哥華加拿大線連結市中心、列治文與機場的背景，建立兩分支匯入共用核心段的教學班表。學徒分析機場行李旅客與通勤族不同上車時間，並將橋梁、終端折返與車隊配置納入同一套容量檢核。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。

The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Canada Line’s links among central Vancouver, Richmond and the airport to construct a teaching timetable with two branches entering a common core. Analyse different boarding times for airport passengers with baggage and commuters. Include bridges, terminal reversal and fleet allocation in one capacity review so that branch demand and core service are checked together. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 entered its tunnel construction phase; 2017: Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 opened to passengers on New Year’s Day. Use Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 to construct a teaching section with new stations beneath dense city blocks and a connection to an existing line. Combine surveying, grouting, possession windows and vertical passenger movement. Keep construction-movement control distinct from operational passenger-flow validation, and retain uncertainty rather than treating one instrument reading as a complete statement about building or station performance. history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2014: The Regional Connector secured a federal funding agreement advancing construction; 2023: The Los Angeles Regional Connector opened to passengers in June. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Los Angeles Regional Connector to construct a teaching case about through-running and reconfigured service paths. Compare the benefit of removing one transfer with that of increasing frequency in the central section. Examine how merge routes, platform exchange, underground drainage and construction handback jointly determine the realised passenger benefit, rather than assuming a shorter route diagram guarantees shorter journeys. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 利雅德地鐵
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2024 年：利雅德地鐵第一批路線於十二月開始旅客服務；2025 年：利雅德地鐵橘線於一月加入營運服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2024: The first Riyadh Metro lines began passenger service in December; 2025: Riyadh Metro Orange Line joined passenger operations in January. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 多哈地鐵
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2019 年：多哈地鐵紅線南段於五月開始初期旅客服務；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2019: The southern Red Line section of Doha Metro began initial passenger service in May; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.title: 墨爾本地鐵隧道計畫
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2015 年：墨爾本地鐵隧道展開早期現地調查工作；2025 年：墨爾本地鐵隧道於十一月開放旅客服務；2026 年：二月班表轉換將地鐵隧道整合進完整營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以墨爾本地鐵隧道從建設到接入營運網路的背景，建立新站、隧道及既有郊區鐵路協同運轉的教學案例。學徒把施工沉陷、試驗紀錄、進路切換及轉乘時間相連，分開首次載客與完整班表整合兩個系統狀態。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2015: Early site investigations for Melbourne Metro Tunnel began; 2025: Melbourne Metro Tunnel opened to passengers in November; 2026: The February timetable change integrated Metro Tunnel into full operations. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Melbourne Metro Tunnel’s transition from construction to network operation to construct a teaching case joining new stations and tunnels to suburban railways. Link construction movement, test records, route switching and transfer time. Treat the first passenger opening and full timetable integration as distinct system states with different acceptance and operating evidence. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線
history.text: 本課把鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。專用貨運線把港區裝卸、列車編組與幹線運行連成同一條物流鏈，列車較長與較重會同時改變加速、制動及站場占用，單看最高速度不足以推估吞吐量。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Betuweroute freight railway in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A dedicated freight line links port handling, train assembly and mainline movement; longer heavier trains change acceleration, braking and yard occupation together, so maximum speed alone does not determine throughput. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.text: 本課把軌道道碴搗固整正放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。搗固把道碴重新配置到軌枕下方以恢復支承，起道後的幾何和重載後的幾何並非同一件事；必須把短期整正與長期沉陷追蹤連在一起。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Ballast tamping and track alignment in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Tamping rearranges ballast beneath sleepers to restore support, but geometry immediately after lifting differs from geometry after traffic; short-term correction must therefore be connected with settlement monitoring. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.textEn: The course places Resilient rail-fastening design in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Fastenings locate the rail, provide resilient support and maintain electrical conditions; increasing clamping force does not improve every property, so pads, clips and anchors need separate load-path interpretation. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

Floating slabs separate track mass from the foundation through resilient supports, creating both low-frequency resonance and high-frequency isolation; performance needs specified input and output positions and frequency range. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. history.textEn: The course places Rail corrugation grinding in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Rail corrugation converts spatial irregularity into periodic wheel contact excitation; grinding must preserve profile, material reserve and defect interpretation, and a shiny surface is not proof of quality. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 鋼軌超音波探傷
history.text: 本課把鋼軌超音波探傷放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。超音波探傷以聲束與缺陷交互作用取得間接證據，耦合、角度和鋼軌幾何會改變回波；沒有回波不能獨立證明沒有裂紋。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Ultrasonic testing obtains indirect evidence from beam-defect interaction; coupling, angle and rail geometry alter echoes, so absence of an echo alone does not prove absence of a crack. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.text: 本課把軌枕耐久與承載試驗放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌枕把扣件荷載分散至道碴或支承面，軌座與中部彎矩取決於接觸分布；承載試驗和耐久試驗需要分別定義邊界與損傷指標。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Sleeper durability and load testing in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Sleepers distribute fastening loads to ballast or support surfaces; rail-seat and centre moments depend on contact distribution, so load tests and durability tests need separate boundaries and damage indicators. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.text: 本課把鐵路路基過渡段處理放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Railway subgrade transition treatment in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 多年凍土地區鐵路路基
history.text: 本課把多年凍土地區鐵路路基放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。多年凍土路基的機械反應受溫度與含冰量控制，保冷、排水及熱擾動必須一起評估，短期穩定不代表長期熱狀態不變。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Railway embankments on permafrost in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Permafrost embankment response depends on temperature and ice content; cooling, drainage and thermal disturbance must be assessed together, and short-term stability does not prove a stable long-term thermal state. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

Track modulus relates reaction per unit length to rail displacement and differs from a single fastening stiffness; identification separates rail bending, ballast support and sleeper contact. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. history.text: 本課把軌旁落石與異物偵測放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌旁異物偵測要把感測範圍、事件判定與列車防護動作連接，警報延遲和漏檢比漂亮影像更重要，正常訊號不能直接視為安全許可。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Trackside obstruction detection connects sensing coverage, event decisions and train protection; latency and missed events matter more than attractive images, and a normal signal is not automatically movement permission. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 架空電車線懸掛系統
history.text: 本課把架空電車線懸掛系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。架空電車線同時是導電路徑與受拉結構，跨距、張力和支承彈性共同決定受流幾何，靜態高度並不能代表列車通過的動態接觸。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Overhead contact-line suspension systems in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. An overhead contact line is both a conductor and a tension structure; span, tension and support flexibility determine current-collection geometry, while static height does not establish dynamic contact. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證
history.text: 本課把高速鐵路受流性能驗證放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。受電弓與電車線耦合時，平均接觸力、力的散布、離線與電弧必須分開量測，單一平均值無法描述短暫中斷。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Current-collection verification for high-speed rail in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Coupled pantograph and contact-line behavior requires separate measures of mean force, dispersion, loss of contact and arcing; a mean cannot describe brief interruptions. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.textEn: The course places Traction-substation integration in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Substation integration distinguishes voltage levels, AC phasors, DC circuits and energy balances; equipment ratings do not directly establish how many trains a feeding section supports. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

Third-rail supply links contact geometry with a low-voltage high-current circuit; gaps, shoe arrangement and return paths jointly affect train power. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones.
