history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路回流與雜散電流控制
history.text: 本課把鐵路回流與雜散電流控制放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。牽引回流、軌地電位與雜散電流是不同量；減少一處電位可能把電流轉向其他路徑，需用完整網路及時間電荷帳判斷。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Rail-return and stray-current control in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Traction return current, rail-earth potential and stray current are distinct; reducing voltage at one point can divert current elsewhere, requiring a complete network and time-integrated charge. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統
history.titleEn: Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication
history.text: 本課把軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。輪緣潤滑與軌頂摩擦調節作用位置及目標不同，減少磨耗不能以犧牲牽引制動黏著為代價，需同時追蹤摩擦、磨耗與材料散布。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Flange lubrication and top-of-rail friction management act at different locations with different aims; wear reduction must be evaluated alongside traction/braking adhesion and material carryover. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.text: 本課把軌道旁儲能系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌旁儲能需同時滿足能量容量、充放電功率與列車事件時序，再生能量存在並不保證能被當時的儲能設備接收。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Wayside energy-storage systems in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Wayside storage must satisfy energy capacity, power limits and train-event timing; available regenerative energy does not guarantee that storage can accept it at that moment. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

Automatic train protection combines speed/location, movement authority and braking capability into a continuously checked envelope; offline examples explain boundaries rather than forming a deployable safety controller. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 列車自動駕駛系統
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用舒適加速度過渡及自動駕駛服務恢復連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through comfortable acceleration transitions and automatic-operation service recovery. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌道電路列車占用偵測
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用輪對分流與漏電及乾濕與故障情境矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through wheelset shunts and leakage and dry wet and fault test matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路時刻表衝突消解
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用交會緩衝分配及時刻重播工作量連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through allocating crossing buffers and timetable-replay effort. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對停車位置門控時序與月台介面誤差預算而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用停準資訊有效時間及異車型門位配對連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For stopping position door timing and platform-interface error budgets, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through freshness of stopping information and door-position mapping across fleets. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 車輪在軌鏇削設備
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2015 年品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用徑向去除與壽命帳及加工後驗證完整工時連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2015: The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through radial removal and life accounting and complete post-machining verification effort. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用動能差與平均耗能力及車組任務與路徑狀態連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。

These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force and wagon-group assignments and route states. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1901 年烏帕塔爾懸掛式鐵路開始服務旅客。；2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩及中止偏斜與失訊案例連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。

These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through switch-linkage lever arm and torque and interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 台北捷運文湖線
related.transfer: 可遷移「延遲與制動距離」與「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台北捷運文湖線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Delay and braking distance" and "Regenerative energy and receptivity" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taipei Metro Wenhu Line must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦高速鐵路車軌橋與地震系統介面；台北捷運文湖線則以膠輪中運量自動運轉與高架站介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on high speed vehicle track bridge and seismic interfaces; Taipei Metro Wenhu Line centres on automated medium capacity operation and elevated station interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「延遲與制動距離」與「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台北捷運文湖線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「折返作業與路徑占用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Delay and braking distance” and “Rubber-tyre rolling loss”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei Metro Wenhu Line, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Turnback and route occupation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 東北新幹線

以「空間波長與量測取樣」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Delay and braking distance” and “Snow-melting heat and supply rate”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tohoku Shinkansen, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 山陽新幹線
related.transfer: 可遷移「空氣阻力與牽引功率」與「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；山陽新幹線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Aerodynamic drag and traction power" and "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sanyo Shinkansen must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦高速成熟走廊密集班表與車輛動力；山陽新幹線則以山岳高速線隧道壓力與橋隧連續性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dense mature high speed timetables and vehicle dynamics; Sanyo Shinkansen centres on mountain high speed tunnel pressure and bridge continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「空氣阻力與牽引功率」與「隧道壓力波傳遞」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到山陽新幹線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「沉陷差與軌道坡折」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” and “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sanyo Shinkansen, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Differential settlement and track kink", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「空氣阻力與牽引功率」與「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dense mature high speed timetables and vehicle dynamics; Madrid–Seville high-speed railway centres on hot region high speed rail temperature power and renewal, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「空氣阻力與牽引功率」與「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「互斥進路與真值驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” and “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Madrid–Seville high-speed railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 北京—上海高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；北京—上海高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" and "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦炎熱地區高速線軌溫供電與更新；北京—上海高速鐵路則以長大高架高速走廊沉陷與營運韌性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hot region high speed rail temperature power and renewal; Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway centres on long viaduct high speed corridor settlement and resilience, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」與「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到北京—上海高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「班距與有效運能」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Headway and usable capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 雅萬高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雅萬高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hot region high speed rail temperature power and renewal; Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway centres on tropical new high speed bridges tunnels and feeder service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」與「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雅萬高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「隧道壓力波傳遞」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tunnel pressure-wave travel", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 新加坡東北地鐵線
related.transfer: 可遷移「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「周轉時間與車隊需求」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；新加坡東北地鐵線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Crosswind force and overturning moment" and "Round-trip time and fleet size" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Singapore North East Line must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦機場快線長橋與航廈處理介面；新加坡東北地鐵線則以地下自動化捷運牽引通訊與疏散為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on airport express long bridges and terminal processing; Singapore North East Line centres on underground automated metro traction communication and egress, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到新加坡東北地鐵線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「牽引饋線壓降」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” and “Communication delay and stale position”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Singapore North East Line, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Traction feeder voltage drop", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 洛杉磯區域連接線
related.transfer: 可遷移「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「周轉時間與車隊需求」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；洛杉磯區域連接線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到洛杉磯區域連接線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「集水與排水容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” and “Transfer walking and connection margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Los Angeles Regional Connector, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理
related.transfer: 可遷移「加熱電功率」與「控制遲滯帶寬」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路路基過渡段處理的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Heater electrical power" and "Control hysteresis width" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Railway subgrade transition treatment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦道岔加熱熱損融冰與控制遲滯；鐵路路基過渡段處理則以剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turnout heating heat loss ice melting and control hysteresis; Railway subgrade transition treatment centres on stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「加熱電功率」與「相鄰支承位移差」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路路基過渡段處理，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支承能量比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Railway subgrade transition treatment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Support strain-energy comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。

related.title: 鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線
related.transfer: 可遷移「常減速度停距」與「資料新鮮度距離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Constant-deceleration stop distance" and "Data-age distance scale" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Betuweroute freight railway must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態；鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線則以港區貨運列車的阻力制動與容量協同為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states; Betuweroute freight railway centres on coordinating freight resistance braking and port capacity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「常減速度停距」與「列車單向運能」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「滾動阻力能量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Constant-deceleration stop distance” and “Directional train throughput”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Betuweroute freight railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rolling-resistance energy", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
